m.MultiplayerAPI.poll: Method used for polling the MultiplayerAPI. You only need to worry about this if you set SceneTree.multiplayer_poll to false. By default, SceneTree will poll its MultiplayerAPI(s) for you.
m.MultiplayerAPI.rpc: Sends an RPC to the target peer. The given method will be called on the remote object with the provided arguments. The RPC may also be called locally depending on the implementation and RPC configuration. See Node.rpc() and Node.rpc_config().
m.MultiplayerAPI.server_disconnected: Emitted when this MultiplayerAPI's multiplayer_peer disconnects from server. Only emitted on clients.
m.MultiplayerAPI.set_default_interface: Sets the default MultiplayerAPI implementation class. This method can be used by modules and extensions to configure which implementation will be used by SceneTree when the engine starts.
m.MultiplayerAPIExtension._get_multiplayer: Called when the MultiplayerAPI.multiplayer_peer is retrieved.
m.MultiplayerAPIExtension._set_multiplayer: Called when the MultiplayerAPI.multiplayer_peer is set.
m.MultiplayerPeer.CONNECTION_CONNECTING: The MultiplayerPeer is currently connecting to a server.
m.MultiplayerPeer.TARGET_PEER_BROADCAST: Packets are sent to all connected peers.
m.MultiplayerPeer.TRANSFER_MODE_RELIABLE: Packets must be received and resend attempts should be made until the packets are acknowledged. Packets must be received in the order they were sent in. Most reliable transfer mode, but potentially the slowest due to the overhead. Use for critical data that must be transmitted and arrive in order, for example an ability being triggered or a chat message. Consider carefully if the information real…
m.MultiplayerPeer.TRANSFER_MODE_UNRELIABLE: Packets are not acknowledged, no resend attempts are made for lost packets. Packets may arrive in any order. Potentially faster than TRANSFER_MODE_UNRELIABLE_ORDERED. Use for non-critical data, and always consider whether the order matters.

Packets are not acknowledged, no resend attempts are made for lost packets. Packets are received in the order they were sent in. Potentially faster than TRANSFER_MODE_RELIABLE. Use for non-critical data or data that would be outdated if received late due to resend attempt(s) anyway, for example movement and positional data.
m.MultiplayerPeer.close: Immediately close the multiplayer peer returning to the state CONNECTION_DISCONNECTED. Connected peers will be dropped without emitting peer_disconnected.
m.MultiplayerPeer.disconnect_peer: Disconnects the given peer from this host. If force is true the peer_disconnected signal will not be emitted for this peer.
m.MultiplayerPeer.generate_unique_id: Returns a randomly generated integer that can be used as a network unique ID.
m.MultiplayerPeer.get_connection_status: Returns the current state of the connection.
m.MultiplayerPeer.get_packet_channel: Returns the channel over which the next available packet was received. See PacketPeer.get_available_packet_count().
m.MultiplayerPeer.get_packet_mode: Returns the transfer mode the remote peer used to send the next available packet. See PacketPeer.get_available_packet_count().
m.MultiplayerPeer.get_packet_peer: Returns the ID of the MultiplayerPeer who sent the next available packet. See PacketPeer.get_available_packet_count().
m.MultiplayerPeer.get_unique_id: Returns the ID of this MultiplayerPeer.
m.MultiplayerPeer.is_server_relay_supporte: Returns true if the server can act as a relay in the current configuration. That is, if the higher level MultiplayerAPI should notify connected clients of other peers, and implement a relay protocol to allow communication between them.
m.MultiplayerPeer.peer_connected: Emitted when a remote peer connects.
m.MultiplayerPeer.peer_disconnected: Emitted when a remote peer has disconnected.
m.MultiplayerPeer.poll: Waits up to 1 second to receive a new network event.
m.MultiplayerPeer.refuse_new_connections: If true, this MultiplayerPeer refuses new connections.
m.MultiplayerPeer.set_target_peer: Sets the peer to which packets will be sent.
m.MultiplayerPeer.transfer_channel: The channel to use to send packets. Many network APIs such as ENet and WebRTC allow the creation of multiple independent channels which behaves, in a way, like separate connections. This means that reliable data will only block delivery of other packets on that channel, and ordering will only be in respect to the channel the packet is being sent on. Using different channels to send different and…
m.MultiplayerPeer.transfer_mode: The manner in which to send packets to the target peer. See the set_target_peer() method.
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._close: Called when the multiplayer peer should be immediately closed (see MultiplayerPeer.close()).
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._disconnect_pee: Called when the connected peer should be forcibly disconnected (see MultiplayerPeer.disconnect_peer()).
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._get_available_: Called when the available packet count is internally requested by the MultiplayerAPI.
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._get_connection: Called when the connection status is requested on the MultiplayerPeer (see MultiplayerPeer.get_connection_status()).
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._get_max_packet: Called when the maximum allowed packet size (in bytes) is requested by the MultiplayerAPI.
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._get_packet: Called when a packet needs to be received by the MultiplayerAPI, with r_buffer_size being the size of the binary r_buffer in bytes.
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._get_packet_cha: Called to get the channel over which the next available packet was received. See MultiplayerPeer.get_packet_channel().
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._get_packet_mod: Called to get the transfer mode the remote peer used to send the next available packet. See MultiplayerPeer.get_packet_mode().
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._get_packet_pee: Called when the ID of the MultiplayerPeer who sent the most recent packet is requested (see MultiplayerPeer.get_packet_peer()).
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._get_packet_scr: Called when a packet needs to be received by the MultiplayerAPI, if _get_packet() isn't implemented. Use this when extending this class via GDScript.
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._get_transfer_c: Called when the transfer channel to use is read on this MultiplayerPeer (see MultiplayerPeer.transfer_channel).
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._get_transfer_m: Called when the transfer mode to use is read on this MultiplayerPeer (see MultiplayerPeer.transfer_mode).
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._get_unique_id: Called when the unique ID of this MultiplayerPeer is requested (see MultiplayerPeer.get_unique_id()). The value must be between 1 and 2147483647.
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._is_refusing_ne: Called when the "refuse new connections" status is requested on this MultiplayerPeer (see MultiplayerPeer.refuse_new_connections).
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._is_server: Called when the "is server" status is requested on the MultiplayerAPI. See MultiplayerAPI.is_server().
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._is_server_rela: Called to check if the server can act as a relay in the current configuration. See MultiplayerPeer.is_server_relay_supported().
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._poll: Called when the MultiplayerAPI is polled. See MultiplayerAPI.poll().
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._put_packet: Called when a packet needs to be sent by the MultiplayerAPI, with buffer_size being the size of the binary buffer in bytes.
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._put_packet_scr: Called when a packet needs to be sent by the MultiplayerAPI, if _put_packet() isn't implemented. Use this when extending this class via GDScript.
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._set_refuse_new: Called when the "refuse new connections" status is set on this MultiplayerPeer (see MultiplayerPeer.refuse_new_connections).
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._set_target_pee: Called when the target peer to use is set for this MultiplayerPeer (see MultiplayerPeer.set_target_peer()).
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._set_transfer_c: Called when the channel to use is set for this MultiplayerPeer (see MultiplayerPeer.transfer_channel).
m.MultiplayerPeerExtension._set_transfer_m: Called when the transfer mode is set on this MultiplayerPeer (see MultiplayerPeer.transfer_mode).
m.MultiplayerSpawner.add_spawnable_scene: Adds a scene path to spawnable scenes, making it automatically replicated from the multiplayer authority to other peers when added as children of the node pointed by spawn_path.
m.MultiplayerSpawner.clear_spawnable_scene: Clears all spawnable scenes. Does not despawn existing instances on remote peers.
m.MultiplayerSpawner.despawned: Emitted when a spawnable scene or custom spawn was despawned by the multiplayer authority. Only called on remote peers.
m.MultiplayerSpawner.get_spawnable_scene: Returns the spawnable scene path by index.
m.MultiplayerSpawner.get_spawnable_scene_c: Returns the count of spawnable scene paths.
m.MultiplayerSpawner.spawn: Requests a custom spawn, with data passed to spawn_function on all peers. Returns the locally spawned node instance already inside the scene tree, and added as a child of the node pointed by spawn_path.
m.MultiplayerSpawner.spawn_function: Method called on all peers when a custom spawn() is requested by the authority. Will receive the data parameter, and should return a Node that is not in the scene tree.
m.MultiplayerSpawner.spawn_limit: Maximum number of nodes allowed to be spawned by this spawner. Includes both spawnable scenes and custom spawns.
m.MultiplayerSpawner.spawn_path: Path to the spawn root. Spawnable scenes that are added as direct children are replicated to other peers.
m.MultiplayerSpawner.spawned: Emitted when a spawnable scene or custom spawn was spawned by the multiplayer authority. Only called on remote peers.
m.MultiplayerSynchronizer.VISIBILITY_PROCE: Visibility filters are updated during process frames (see Node.NOTIFICATION_INTERNAL_PROCESS).
Visibility filters are not updated automatically, and must be updated manually by calling update_visibility().
Visibility filters are updated during physics frames (see Node.NOTIFICATION_INTERNAL_PHYSICS_PROCESS).
m.MultiplayerSynchronizer.add_visibility_f: Adds a peer visibility filter for this synchronizer.
m.MultiplayerSynchronizer.delta_interval: Time interval between delta synchronizations. Used when the replication is set to SceneReplicationConfig.REPLICATION_MODE_ON_CHANGE. If set to 0.0 (the default), delta synchronizations happen every network process frame.
m.MultiplayerSynchronizer.delta_synchroniz: Emitted when a new delta synchronization state is received by this synchronizer after the properties have been updated.
m.MultiplayerSynchronizer.get_visibility_f: Queries the current visibility for peer peer.
m.MultiplayerSynchronizer.public_visibilit: Whether synchronization should be visible to all peers by default. See set_visibility_for() and add_visibility_filter() for ways of configuring fine-grained visibility options.
m.MultiplayerSynchronizer.remove_visibilit: Removes a peer visibility filter from this synchronizer.
m.MultiplayerSynchronizer.replication_conf: Resource containing which properties to synchronize.
m.MultiplayerSynchronizer.replication_inte: Time interval between synchronizations. Used when the replication is set to SceneReplicationConfig.REPLICATION_MODE_ALWAYS. If set to 0.0 (the default), synchronizations happen every network process frame.
m.MultiplayerSynchronizer.root_path: Node path that replicated properties are relative to.
m.MultiplayerSynchronizer.set_visibility_f: Sets the visibility of peer to visible. If peer is 0, the value of public_visibility will be updated instead.
m.MultiplayerSynchronizer.synchronized: Emitted when a new synchronization state is received by this synchronizer after the properties have been updated.
m.MultiplayerSynchronizer.update_visibilit: Updates the visibility of for_peer according to visibility filters. If for_peer is 0 (the default), all peers' visibilties are updated.
m.MultiplayerSynchronizer.visibility_chang: Emitted when visibility of for_peer is updated. See update_visibility().
m.MultiplayerSynchronizer.visibility_updat: Specifies when visibility filters are updated.
m.Mutex.lock: Locks this Mutex, blocks until it is unlocked by the current owner.
m.Mutex.try_lock: Tries locking this Mutex, but does not block. Returns true on success, false otherwise.
m.Mutex.unlock: Unlocks this Mutex, leaving it to other threads.
m.NativeMenu.APPLICATION_MENU_ID: Application (first menu after "Apple" menu on macOS) menu ID.
m.NativeMenu.DOCK_MENU_ID: Dock icon right-click menu ID (on macOS this menu include standard application control items and a list of open windows).
m.NativeMenu.FEATURE_GLOBAL_MENU: NativeMenu supports native global main menu.
m.NativeMenu.FEATURE_HOVER_CALLBACK: NativeMenu supports menu item hover callback.
m.NativeMenu.FEATURE_KEY_CALLBACK: NativeMenu supports menu item accelerator/key callback.
m.NativeMenu.FEATURE_OPEN_CLOSE_CALLBACK: NativeMenu supports menu open and close callbacks.
m.NativeMenu.HELP_MENU_ID: "Help" menu ID (on macOS this menu includes help search bar).
m.NativeMenu.WINDOW_MENU_ID: "Window" menu ID (on macOS this menu includes standard window control items and a list of open windows).
m.NativeMenu.add_check_item: Adds a new checkable item with text label to the global menu rid.
m.NativeMenu.add_icon_check_item: Adds a new checkable item with text label and icon icon to the global menu rid.
m.NativeMenu.add_icon_item: Adds a new item with text label and icon icon to the global menu rid.
m.NativeMenu.add_icon_radio_check_item: Adds a new radio-checkable item with text label and icon icon to the global menu rid.
m.NativeMenu.add_item: Adds a new item with text label to the global menu rid.
m.NativeMenu.add_multistate_item: Adds a new item with text label to the global menu rid.
m.NativeMenu.add_radio_check_item: Adds a new radio-checkable item with text label to the global menu rid.
m.NativeMenu.add_separator: Adds a separator between items to the global menu rid. Separators also occupy an index.
m.NativeMenu.add_submenu_item: Adds an item that will act as a submenu of the global menu rid. The submenu_rid argument is the RID of the global menu that will be shown when the item is clicked.
m.NativeMenu.clear: Removes all items from the global menu rid.
m.NativeMenu.create_menu: Creates a new global menu object.
m.NativeMenu.find_item_index_with_submenu: Returns the index of the item with the submenu specified by submenu_rid. Indices are automatically assigned to each item by the engine.
m.NativeMenu.find_item_index_with_tag: Returns the index of the item with the specified tag. Indices are automatically assigned to each item by the engine.
m.NativeMenu.find_item_index_with_text: Returns the index of the item with the specified text. Indices are automatically assigned to each item by the engine.
m.NativeMenu.free_menu: Frees a global menu object created by this NativeMenu.
m.NativeMenu.get_item_accelerator: Returns the accelerator of the item at index idx. Accelerators are special combinations of keys that activate the item, no matter which control is focused.
m.NativeMenu.get_item_callback: Returns the callback of the item at index idx.
m.NativeMenu.get_item_count: Returns number of items in the global menu rid.
m.NativeMenu.get_item_icon: Returns the icon of the item at index idx.
m.NativeMenu.get_item_indentation_level: Returns the horizontal offset of the item at the given idx.
m.NativeMenu.get_item_key_callback: Returns the callback of the item accelerator at index idx.
m.NativeMenu.get_item_max_states: Returns number of states of a multistate item. See add_multistate_item() for details.
m.NativeMenu.get_item_state: Returns the state of a multistate item. See add_multistate_item() for details.
m.NativeMenu.get_item_submenu: Returns the submenu ID of the item at index idx. See add_submenu_item() for more info on how to add a submenu.
m.NativeMenu.get_item_tag: Returns the metadata of the specified item, which might be of any type. You can set it with set_item_tag(), which provides a simple way of assigning context data to items.
m.NativeMenu.get_item_text: Returns the text of the item at index idx.
m.NativeMenu.get_item_tooltip: Returns the tooltip associated with the specified index idx.
m.NativeMenu.get_system_menu: Returns RID of a special system menu.
m.NativeMenu.get_system_menu_name: Returns readable name of a special system menu.
m.NativeMenu.get_system_menu_text: Returns the text of the system menu item.
m.NativeMenu.has_feature: Returns true if the specified feature is supported by the current NativeMenu, false otherwise.
m.NativeMenu.has_menu: Returns true if rid is valid global menu.
m.NativeMenu.has_system_menu: Returns true if a special system menu is supported.
m.NativeMenu.is_item_checkable: Returns true if the item at index idx is checkable in some way, i.e. if it has a checkbox or radio button.
m.NativeMenu.is_item_checked: Returns true if the item at index idx is checked.
m.NativeMenu.is_item_disabled: Returns true if the item at index idx is disabled. When it is disabled it can't be selected, or its action invoked.
m.NativeMenu.is_item_hidden: Returns true if the item at index idx is hidden.
m.NativeMenu.is_item_radio_checkable: Returns true if the item at index idx has radio button-style checkability.
m.NativeMenu.is_opened: Returns true if the menu is currently opened.
m.NativeMenu.is_system_menu: Return true is global menu is a special system menu.
m.NativeMenu.popup: Shows the global menu at position in the screen coordinates.
m.NativeMenu.remove_item: Removes the item at index idx from the global menu rid.
m.NativeMenu.set_interface_direction: Sets the menu text layout direction from right-to-left if is_rtl is true.
m.NativeMenu.set_item_accelerator: Sets the accelerator of the item at index idx. keycode can be a single Key, or a combination of KeyModifierMasks and Keys using bitwise OR such as KEY_MASK_CTRL | KEY_A (Ctrl + A).
m.NativeMenu.set_item_callback: Sets the callback of the item at index idx. Callback is emitted when an item is pressed.
m.NativeMenu.set_item_checkable: Sets whether the item at index idx has a checkbox. If false, sets the type of the item to plain text.
m.NativeMenu.set_item_checked: Sets the checkstate status of the item at index idx.
m.NativeMenu.set_item_disabled: Enables/disables the item at index idx. When it is disabled, it can't be selected and its action can't be invoked.
m.NativeMenu.set_item_hidden: Hides/shows the item at index idx. When it is hidden, an item does not appear in a menu and its action cannot be invoked.
m.NativeMenu.set_item_hover_callbacks: Sets the callback of the item at index idx. The callback is emitted when an item is hovered.
m.NativeMenu.set_item_icon: Replaces the Texture2D icon of the specified idx.
m.NativeMenu.set_item_indentation_level: Sets the horizontal offset of the item at the given idx.
m.NativeMenu.set_item_index: Changes the index of the item at index idx to be at index target_idx. This can be used to move an item above other items.
m.NativeMenu.set_item_key_callback: Sets the callback of the item at index idx. Callback is emitted when its accelerator is activated.
m.NativeMenu.set_item_max_states: Sets number of state of a multistate item. See add_multistate_item() for details.
m.NativeMenu.set_item_radio_checkable: Sets the type of the item at the specified index idx to radio button. If false, sets the type of the item to plain text.
m.NativeMenu.set_item_state: Sets the state of a multistate item. See add_multistate_item() for details.
m.NativeMenu.set_item_submenu: Sets the submenu RID of the item at index idx. The submenu is a global menu that would be shown when the item is clicked.
m.NativeMenu.set_item_tag: Sets the metadata of an item, which may be of any type. You can later get it with get_item_tag(), which provides a simple way of assigning context data to items.
m.NativeMenu.set_item_text: Sets the text of the item at index idx.
m.NativeMenu.set_item_tooltip: Sets the String tooltip of the item at the specified index idx.
m.NativeMenu.set_minimum_width: Sets the minimum width of the global menu.
m.NativeMenu.set_popup_close_callback: Registers callable to emit when the menu is about to show.
m.NativeMenu.set_popup_open_callback: Registers callable to emit after the menu is closed.
m.NativeMenu.set_system_menu_text: Sets the text of the system menu item.
m.NavigationAgent2D.avoidance_enabled: If true the agent is registered for an RVO avoidance callback on the NavigationServer2D. When velocity is used and the processing is completed a safe_velocity Vector2 is received with a signal connection to velocity_computed. Avoidance processing with many registered agents has a significant performance cost and should only be enabled on agents that currently require it.
m.NavigationAgent2D.avoidance_layers: A bitfield determining the avoidance layers for this NavigationAgent. Other agents with a matching bit on the avoidance_mask will avoid this agent.
m.NavigationAgent2D.avoidance_mask: A bitfield determining what other avoidance agents and obstacles this NavigationAgent will avoid when a bit matches at least one of their avoidance_layers.
m.NavigationAgent2D.avoidance_priority: The agent does not adjust the velocity for other agents that would match the avoidance_mask but have a lower avoidance_priority. This in turn makes the other agents with lower priority adjust their velocities even more to avoid collision with this agent.
m.NavigationAgent2D.debug_enabled: If true shows debug visuals for this agent.
m.NavigationAgent2D.debug_path_custom_colo: If debug_use_custom is true uses this color for this agent instead of global color.
m.NavigationAgent2D.debug_path_custom_line: If debug_use_custom is true uses this line width for rendering paths for this agent instead of global line width.
m.NavigationAgent2D.debug_path_custom_poin: If debug_use_custom is true uses this rasterized point size for rendering path points for this agent instead of global point size.
m.NavigationAgent2D.debug_use_custom: If true uses the defined debug_path_custom_color for this agent instead of global color.
m.NavigationAgent2D.distance_to_target: Returns the distance to the target position, using the agent's global position. The user must set target_position in order for this to be accurate.
m.NavigationAgent2D.get_avoidance_layer_va: Returns whether or not the specified layer of the avoidance_layers bitmask is enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationAgent2D.get_avoidance_mask_val: Returns whether or not the specified mask of the avoidance_mask bitmask is enabled, given a mask_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationAgent2D.get_current_navigation: Returns this agent's current path from start to finish in global coordinates. The path only updates when the target position is changed or the agent requires a repath. The path array is not intended to be used in direct path movement as the agent has its own internal path logic that would get corrupted by changing the path array manually. Use the intended get_next_path_position() once every physi…
Returns which index the agent is currently on in the navigation path's PackedVector2Array.
Returns the path query result for the path the agent is currently following.
m.NavigationAgent2D.get_final_position: Returns the reachable final position of the current navigation path in global coordinates. This position can change if the agent needs to update the navigation path which makes the agent emit the path_changed signal.
m.NavigationAgent2D.get_navigation_layer_v: Returns whether or not the specified layer of the navigation_layers bitmask is enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationAgent2D.get_navigation_map: Returns the RID of the navigation map for this NavigationAgent node. This function returns always the map set on the NavigationAgent node and not the map of the abstract agent on the NavigationServer. If the agent map is changed directly with the NavigationServer API the NavigationAgent node will not be aware of the map change. Use set_navigation_map() to change the navigation map for the Navigat…
m.NavigationAgent2D.get_next_path_position: Returns the next position in global coordinates that can be moved to, making sure that there are no static objects in the way. If the agent does not have a navigation path, it will return the position of the agent's parent. The use of this function once every physics frame is required to update the internal path logic of the NavigationAgent.
m.NavigationAgent2D.get_path_length: Returns the length of the currently calculated path. The returned value is 0.0, if the path is still calculating or no calculation has been requested yet.
m.NavigationAgent2D.get_rid: Returns the RID of this agent on the NavigationServer2D.
m.NavigationAgent2D.is_navigation_finished: Returns true if the agent's navigation has finished. If the target is reachable, navigation ends when the target is reached. If the target is unreachable, navigation ends when the last waypoint of the path is reached.
m.NavigationAgent2D.is_target_reachable: Returns true if get_final_position() is within target_desired_distance of the target_position.
m.NavigationAgent2D.is_target_reached: Returns true if the agent reached the target, i.e. the agent moved within target_desired_distance of the target_position. It may not always be possible to reach the target but it should always be possible to reach the final position. See get_final_position().
m.NavigationAgent2D.link_reached: Signals that the agent reached a navigation link. Emitted when the agent moves within path_desired_distance of the next position of the path when that position is a navigation link.
m.NavigationAgent2D.max_neighbors: The maximum number of neighbors for the agent to consider.
m.NavigationAgent2D.max_speed: The maximum speed that an agent can move.
m.NavigationAgent2D.navigation_finished: Signals that the agent's navigation has finished. If the target is reachable, navigation ends when the target is reached. If the target is unreachable, navigation ends when the last waypoint of the path is reached. This signal is emitted only once per loaded path.
m.NavigationAgent2D.navigation_layers: A bitfield determining which navigation layers of navigation regions this agent will use to calculate a path. Changing it during runtime will clear the current navigation path and generate a new one, according to the new navigation layers.
m.NavigationAgent2D.neighbor_distance: The distance to search for other agents.
m.NavigationAgent2D.path_changed: Emitted when the agent had to update the loaded path:
m.NavigationAgent2D.path_desired_distance: The distance threshold before a path point is considered to be reached. This allows agents to not have to hit a path point on the path exactly, but only to reach its general area. If this value is set too high, the NavigationAgent will skip points on the path, which can lead to it leaving the navigation mesh. If this value is set too low, the NavigationAgent will be stuck in a repath loop because…
m.NavigationAgent2D.path_max_distance: The maximum distance the agent is allowed away from the ideal path to the final position. This can happen due to trying to avoid collisions. When the maximum distance is exceeded, it recalculates the ideal path.
m.NavigationAgent2D.path_metadata_flags: Additional information to return with the navigation path.
m.NavigationAgent2D.path_postprocessing: The path postprocessing applied to the raw path corridor found by the pathfinding_algorithm.
m.NavigationAgent2D.path_return_max_length: The maximum allowed length of the returned path in world units. A path will be clipped when going over this length.
m.NavigationAgent2D.path_return_max_radius: The maximum allowed radius in world units that the returned path can be from the path start. The path will be clipped when going over this radius. Compared to path_return_max_length, this allows the agent to go that much further, if they need to walk around a corner.
m.NavigationAgent2D.path_search_max_distan: The maximum distance a searched polygon can be away from the start polygon before the pathfinding cancels the search for a path to the (possibly unreachable or very far away) target position polygon. In this case the pathfinding resets and builds a path from the start polygon to the polygon that was found closest to the target position so far. A value of 0 or below counts as unlimited. In case of…
m.NavigationAgent2D.path_search_max_polygo: The maximum number of polygons that are searched before the pathfinding cancels the search for a path to the (possibly unreachable or very far away) target position polygon. In this case the pathfinding resets and builds a path from the start polygon to the polygon that was found closest to the target position so far. A value of 0 or below counts as unlimited. In case of unlimited the pathfinding…
m.NavigationAgent2D.pathfinding_algorithm: The pathfinding algorithm used in the path query.
m.NavigationAgent2D.radius: The radius of the avoidance agent. This is the "body" of the avoidance agent and not the avoidance maneuver starting radius (which is controlled by neighbor_distance).
m.NavigationAgent2D.set_avoidance_layer_va: Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the avoidance_layers bitmask, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationAgent2D.set_avoidance_mask_val: Based on value, enables or disables the specified mask in the avoidance_mask bitmask, given a mask_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationAgent2D.set_navigation_layer_v: Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the navigation_layers bitmask, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationAgent2D.set_navigation_map: Sets the RID of the navigation map this NavigationAgent node should use and also updates the agent on the NavigationServer.
m.NavigationAgent2D.set_velocity_forced: Replaces the internal velocity in the collision avoidance simulation with velocity. When an agent is teleported to a new position this function should be used in the same frame. If called frequently this function can get agents stuck.
m.NavigationAgent2D.simplify_epsilon: The path simplification amount in worlds units.
m.NavigationAgent2D.simplify_path: If true a simplified version of the path will be returned with less critical path points removed. The simplification amount is controlled by simplify_epsilon. The simplification uses a variant of Ramer-Douglas-Peucker algorithm for curve point decimation.
m.NavigationAgent2D.target_desired_distanc: The distance threshold before the target is considered to be reached. On reaching the target, target_reached is emitted and navigation ends (see is_navigation_finished() and navigation_finished).
m.NavigationAgent2D.target_position: If set, a new navigation path from the current agent position to the target_position is requested from the NavigationServer.
m.NavigationAgent2D.target_reached: Signals that the agent reached the target, i.e. the agent moved within target_desired_distance of the target_position. This signal is emitted only once per loaded path.
m.NavigationAgent2D.time_horizon_agents: The minimal amount of time for which this agent's velocities, that are computed with the collision avoidance algorithm, are safe with respect to other agents. The larger the number, the sooner the agent will respond to other agents, but less freedom in choosing its velocities. A too high value will slow down agents movement considerably. Must be positive.
m.NavigationAgent2D.time_horizon_obstacles: The minimal amount of time for which this agent's velocities, that are computed with the collision avoidance algorithm, are safe with respect to static avoidance obstacles. The larger the number, the sooner the agent will respond to static avoidance obstacles, but less freedom in choosing its velocities. A too high value will slow down agents movement considerably. Must be positive.
m.NavigationAgent2D.velocity: Sets the new wanted velocity for the agent. The avoidance simulation will try to fulfill this velocity if possible but will modify it to avoid collision with other agents and obstacles. When an agent is teleported to a new position, use set_velocity_forced() as well to reset the internal simulation velocity.
m.NavigationAgent2D.velocity_computed: Notifies when the collision avoidance velocity is calculated. Emitted every update as long as avoidance_enabled is true and the agent has a navigation map.
m.NavigationAgent2D.waypoint_reached: Signals that the agent reached a waypoint. Emitted when the agent moves within path_desired_distance of the next position of the path.
m.NavigationAgent3D.avoidance_enabled: If true the agent is registered for an RVO avoidance callback on the NavigationServer3D. When velocity is set and the processing is completed a safe_velocity Vector3 is received with a signal connection to velocity_computed. Avoidance processing with many registered agents has a significant performance cost and should only be enabled on agents that currently require it.
m.NavigationAgent3D.avoidance_layers: A bitfield determining the avoidance layers for this NavigationAgent. Other agents with a matching bit on the avoidance_mask will avoid this agent.
m.NavigationAgent3D.avoidance_mask: A bitfield determining what other avoidance agents and obstacles this NavigationAgent will avoid when a bit matches at least one of their avoidance_layers.
m.NavigationAgent3D.avoidance_priority: The agent does not adjust the velocity for other agents that would match the avoidance_mask but have a lower avoidance_priority. This in turn makes the other agents with lower priority adjust their velocities even more to avoid collision with this agent.
m.NavigationAgent3D.debug_enabled: If true shows debug visuals for this agent.
m.NavigationAgent3D.debug_path_custom_colo: If debug_use_custom is true uses this color for this agent instead of global color.
m.NavigationAgent3D.debug_path_custom_poin: If debug_use_custom is true uses this rasterized point size for rendering path points for this agent instead of global point size.
m.NavigationAgent3D.debug_use_custom: If true uses the defined debug_path_custom_color for this agent instead of global color.
m.NavigationAgent3D.distance_to_target: Returns the distance to the target position, using the agent's global position. The user must set target_position in order for this to be accurate.
m.NavigationAgent3D.get_avoidance_layer_va: Returns whether or not the specified layer of the avoidance_layers bitmask is enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationAgent3D.get_avoidance_mask_val: Returns whether or not the specified mask of the avoidance_mask bitmask is enabled, given a mask_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationAgent3D.get_current_navigation: Returns this agent's current path from start to finish in global coordinates. The path only updates when the target position is changed or the agent requires a repath. The path array is not intended to be used in direct path movement as the agent has its own internal path logic that would get corrupted by changing the path array manually. Use the intended get_next_path_position() once every physi…
Returns which index the agent is currently on in the navigation path's PackedVector3Array.
Returns the path query result for the path the agent is currently following.
m.NavigationAgent3D.get_final_position: Returns the reachable final position of the current navigation path in global coordinates. This position can change if the agent needs to update the navigation path which makes the agent emit the path_changed signal.
m.NavigationAgent3D.get_navigation_layer_v: Returns whether or not the specified layer of the navigation_layers bitmask is enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationAgent3D.get_navigation_map: Returns the RID of the navigation map for this NavigationAgent node. This function returns always the map set on the NavigationAgent node and not the map of the abstract agent on the NavigationServer. If the agent map is changed directly with the NavigationServer API the NavigationAgent node will not be aware of the map change. Use set_navigation_map() to change the navigation map for the Navigat…
m.NavigationAgent3D.get_next_path_position: Returns the next position in global coordinates that can be moved to, making sure that there are no static objects in the way. If the agent does not have a navigation path, it will return the position of the agent's parent. The use of this function once every physics frame is required to update the internal path logic of the NavigationAgent.
m.NavigationAgent3D.get_path_length: Returns the length of the currently calculated path. The returned value is 0.0, if the path is still calculating or no calculation has been requested yet.
m.NavigationAgent3D.get_rid: Returns the RID of this agent on the NavigationServer3D.
m.NavigationAgent3D.height: The height of the avoidance agent. Agents will ignore other agents or obstacles that are above or below their current position + height in 2D avoidance. Does nothing in 3D avoidance which uses radius spheres alone.
m.NavigationAgent3D.is_navigation_finished: Returns true if the agent's navigation has finished. If the target is reachable, navigation ends when the target is reached. If the target is unreachable, navigation ends when the last waypoint of the path is reached.
m.NavigationAgent3D.is_target_reachable: Returns true if get_final_position() is within target_desired_distance of the target_position.
m.NavigationAgent3D.is_target_reached: Returns true if the agent reached the target, i.e. the agent moved within target_desired_distance of the target_position. It may not always be possible to reach the target but it should always be possible to reach the final position. See get_final_position().
m.NavigationAgent3D.keep_y_velocity: If true, and the agent uses 2D avoidance, it will remember the set y-axis velocity and reapply it after the avoidance step. While 2D avoidance has no y-axis and simulates on a flat plane this setting can help to soften the most obvious clipping on uneven 3D geometry.
m.NavigationAgent3D.link_reached: Signals that the agent reached a navigation link. Emitted when the agent moves within path_desired_distance of the next position of the path when that position is a navigation link.
m.NavigationAgent3D.max_neighbors: The maximum number of neighbors for the agent to consider.
m.NavigationAgent3D.max_speed: The maximum speed that an agent can move.
m.NavigationAgent3D.navigation_finished: Signals that the agent's navigation has finished. If the target is reachable, navigation ends when the target is reached. If the target is unreachable, navigation ends when the last waypoint of the path is reached. This signal is emitted only once per loaded path.
m.NavigationAgent3D.navigation_layers: A bitfield determining which navigation layers of navigation regions this agent will use to calculate a path. Changing it during runtime will clear the current navigation path and generate a new one, according to the new navigation layers.
m.NavigationAgent3D.neighbor_distance: The distance to search for other agents.
m.NavigationAgent3D.path_changed: Emitted when the agent had to update the loaded path:
m.NavigationAgent3D.path_desired_distance: The distance threshold before a path point is considered to be reached. This allows agents to not have to hit a path point on the path exactly, but only to reach its general area. If this value is set too high, the NavigationAgent will skip points on the path, which can lead to it leaving the navigation mesh. If this value is set too low, the NavigationAgent will be stuck in a repath loop because…
m.NavigationAgent3D.path_height_offset: The height offset is subtracted from the y-axis value of any vector path position for this NavigationAgent. The NavigationAgent height offset does not change or influence the navigation mesh or pathfinding query result. Additional navigation maps that use regions with navigation meshes that the developer baked with appropriate agent radius or height values are required to support different-sized…
m.NavigationAgent3D.path_max_distance: The maximum distance the agent is allowed away from the ideal path to the final position. This can happen due to trying to avoid collisions. When the maximum distance is exceeded, it recalculates the ideal path.
m.NavigationAgent3D.path_metadata_flags: Additional information to return with the navigation path.
m.NavigationAgent3D.path_postprocessing: The path postprocessing applied to the raw path corridor found by the pathfinding_algorithm.
m.NavigationAgent3D.path_return_max_length: The maximum allowed length of the returned path in world units. A path will be clipped when going over this length.
m.NavigationAgent3D.path_return_max_radius: The maximum allowed radius in world units that the returned path can be from the path start. The path will be clipped when going over this radius. Compared to path_return_max_length, this allows the agent to go that much further, if they need to walk around a corner.
m.NavigationAgent3D.path_search_max_distan: The maximum distance a searched polygon can be away from the start polygon before the pathfinding cancels the search for a path to the (possibly unreachable or very far away) target position polygon. In this case the pathfinding resets and builds a path from the start polygon to the polygon that was found closest to the target position so far. A value of 0 or below counts as unlimited. In case of…
m.NavigationAgent3D.path_search_max_polygo: The maximum number of polygons that are searched before the pathfinding cancels the search for a path to the (possibly unreachable or very far away) target position polygon. In this case the pathfinding resets and builds a path from the start polygon to the polygon that was found closest to the target position so far. A value of 0 or below counts as unlimited. In case of unlimited the pathfinding…
m.NavigationAgent3D.pathfinding_algorithm: The pathfinding algorithm used in the path query.
m.NavigationAgent3D.radius: The radius of the avoidance agent. This is the "body" of the avoidance agent and not the avoidance maneuver starting radius (which is controlled by neighbor_distance).
m.NavigationAgent3D.set_avoidance_layer_va: Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the avoidance_layers bitmask, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationAgent3D.set_avoidance_mask_val: Based on value, enables or disables the specified mask in the avoidance_mask bitmask, given a mask_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationAgent3D.set_navigation_layer_v: Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the navigation_layers bitmask, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationAgent3D.set_navigation_map: Sets the RID of the navigation map this NavigationAgent node should use and also updates the agent on the NavigationServer.
m.NavigationAgent3D.set_velocity_forced: Replaces the internal velocity in the collision avoidance simulation with velocity. When an agent is teleported to a new position this function should be used in the same frame. If called frequently this function can get agents stuck.
m.NavigationAgent3D.simplify_epsilon: The path simplification amount in worlds units.
m.NavigationAgent3D.simplify_path: If true a simplified version of the path will be returned with less critical path points removed. The simplification amount is controlled by simplify_epsilon. The simplification uses a variant of Ramer-Douglas-Peucker algorithm for curve point decimation.
m.NavigationAgent3D.target_desired_distanc: The distance threshold before the target is considered to be reached. On reaching the target, target_reached is emitted and navigation ends (see is_navigation_finished() and navigation_finished).
m.NavigationAgent3D.target_position: If set, a new navigation path from the current agent position to the target_position is requested from the NavigationServer.
m.NavigationAgent3D.target_reached: Signals that the agent reached the target, i.e. the agent moved within target_desired_distance of the target_position. This signal is emitted only once per loaded path.
m.NavigationAgent3D.time_horizon_agents: The minimal amount of time for which this agent's velocities, that are computed with the collision avoidance algorithm, are safe with respect to other agents. The larger the number, the sooner the agent will respond to other agents, but less freedom in choosing its velocities. A too high value will slow down agents movement considerably. Must be positive.
m.NavigationAgent3D.time_horizon_obstacles: The minimal amount of time for which this agent's velocities, that are computed with the collision avoidance algorithm, are safe with respect to static avoidance obstacles. The larger the number, the sooner the agent will respond to static avoidance obstacles, but less freedom in choosing its velocities. A too high value will slow down agents movement considerably. Must be positive.
m.NavigationAgent3D.use_3d_avoidance: If true, the agent calculates avoidance velocities in 3D omnidirectionally, e.g. for games that take place in air, underwater or space. Agents using 3D avoidance only avoid other agents using 3D avoidance, and react to radius-based avoidance obstacles. They ignore any vertex-based obstacles.
m.NavigationAgent3D.velocity: Sets the new wanted velocity for the agent. The avoidance simulation will try to fulfill this velocity if possible but will modify it to avoid collision with other agents and obstacles. When an agent is teleported to a new position, use set_velocity_forced() as well to reset the internal simulation velocity.
m.NavigationAgent3D.velocity_computed: Notifies when the collision avoidance velocity is calculated. Emitted every update as long as avoidance_enabled is true and the agent has a navigation map.
m.NavigationAgent3D.waypoint_reached: Signals that the agent reached a waypoint. Emitted when the agent moves within path_desired_distance of the next position of the path.
m.NavigationLink2D.bidirectional: Whether this link can be traveled in both directions or only from start_position to end_position.
m.NavigationLink2D.enabled: Whether this link is currently active. If false, NavigationServer2D.map_get_path() will ignore this link.
m.NavigationLink2D.enter_cost: When pathfinding enters this link from another regions navigation mesh the enter_cost value is added to the path distance for determining the shortest path.
m.NavigationLink2D.get_global_end_position: Returns the end_position that is relative to the link as a global position.
m.NavigationLink2D.get_global_start_positi: Returns the start_position that is relative to the link as a global position.
m.NavigationLink2D.get_navigation_layer_va: Returns whether or not the specified layer of the navigation_layers bitmask is enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationLink2D.get_navigation_map: Returns the current navigation map RID used by this link.
m.NavigationLink2D.get_rid: Returns the RID of this link on the NavigationServer2D.
m.NavigationLink2D.navigation_layers: A bitfield determining all navigation layers the link belongs to. These navigation layers will be checked when requesting a path with NavigationServer2D.map_get_path().
m.NavigationLink2D.set_global_end_position: Sets the end_position that is relative to the link from a global position.
m.NavigationLink2D.set_global_start_positi: Sets the start_position that is relative to the link from a global position.
m.NavigationLink2D.set_navigation_layer_va: Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the navigation_layers bitmask, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationLink2D.set_navigation_map: Sets the RID of the navigation map this link should use. By default the link will automatically join the World2D default navigation map so this function is only required to override the default map.
m.NavigationLink2D.travel_cost: When pathfinding moves along the link the traveled distance is multiplied with travel_cost for determining the shortest path.
m.NavigationLink3D.bidirectional: Whether this link can be traveled in both directions or only from start_position to end_position.
m.NavigationLink3D.enabled: Whether this link is currently active. If false, NavigationServer3D.map_get_path() will ignore this link.
m.NavigationLink3D.enter_cost: When pathfinding enters this link from another regions navigation mesh the enter_cost value is added to the path distance for determining the shortest path.
m.NavigationLink3D.get_global_end_position: Returns the end_position that is relative to the link as a global position.
m.NavigationLink3D.get_global_start_positi: Returns the start_position that is relative to the link as a global position.
m.NavigationLink3D.get_navigation_layer_va: Returns whether or not the specified layer of the navigation_layers bitmask is enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.

m.NavigationLink3D.get_rid: Returns the RID of this link on the NavigationServer3D.

m.NavigationLink3D.set_global_start_positi: Sets the start_position that is relative to the link from a global position.

m.NavigationMesh.PARSED_GEOMETRY_MAX: Represents the size of the ParsedGeometryType enum.
m.NavigationMesh.PARSED_GEOMETRY_MESH_INST: Parses mesh instances as geometry. This includes MeshInstance3D, CSGShape3D, and GridMap nodes.
m.NavigationMesh.PARSED_GEOMETRY_STATIC_CO: Parses StaticBody3D colliders as geometry. The collider should be in any of the layers specified by geometry_collision_mask.
m.NavigationMesh.SAMPLE_PARTITION_LAYERS: Layer partitioning. Good choice to use for tiled navigation mesh with medium and small sized tiles.
m.NavigationMesh.SAMPLE_PARTITION_MAX: Represents the size of the SamplePartitionType enum.
m.NavigationMesh.SAMPLE_PARTITION_MONOTONE: Monotone partitioning. Use this if you want fast navigation mesh generation.
m.NavigationMesh.SAMPLE_PARTITION_WATERSHE: Watershed partitioning. Generally the best choice if you precompute the navigation mesh, use this if you have large open areas.
m.NavigationMesh.SOURCE_GEOMETRY_GROUPS_EX: Uses nodes in a group for geometry. The group is specified by geometry_source_group_name.
m.NavigationMesh.SOURCE_GEOMETRY_GROUPS_WI: Scans nodes in a group and their child nodes recursively for geometry. The group is specified by geometry_source_group_name.
m.NavigationMesh.SOURCE_GEOMETRY_MAX: Represents the size of the SourceGeometryMode enum.
m.NavigationMesh.SOURCE_GEOMETRY_ROOT_NODE: Scans the child nodes of the root node recursively for geometry.
m.NavigationMesh.add_polygon: Adds a polygon using the indices of the vertices you get when calling get_vertices().
m.NavigationMesh.agent_height: The minimum floor to ceiling height that will still allow the floor area to be considered walkable.
m.NavigationMesh.agent_max_climb: The minimum ledge height that is considered to still be traversable.
m.NavigationMesh.agent_max_slope: The maximum slope that is considered walkable, in degrees.
m.NavigationMesh.agent_radius: The distance to erode/shrink the walkable area of the heightfield away from obstructions.
m.NavigationMesh.border_size: The size of the non-navigable border around the bake bounding area.
m.NavigationMesh.cell_height: The cell height used to rasterize the navigation mesh vertices on the Y axis. Must match with the cell height on the navigation map.
m.NavigationMesh.cell_size: The cell size used to rasterize the navigation mesh vertices on the XZ plane. Must match with the cell size on the navigation map.
m.NavigationMesh.clear: Clears the internal arrays for vertices and polygon indices.
m.NavigationMesh.clear_polygons: Clears the array of polygons, but it doesn't clear the array of vertices.
m.NavigationMesh.create_from_mesh: Initializes the navigation mesh by setting the vertices and indices according to a Mesh.
m.NavigationMesh.detail_sample_distance: The sampling distance to use when generating the detail mesh, in cell unit.
m.NavigationMesh.detail_sample_max_error: The maximum distance the detail mesh surface should deviate from heightfield, in cell unit.
m.NavigationMesh.edge_max_error: The maximum distance a simplified contour's border edges should deviate the original raw contour.
m.NavigationMesh.edge_max_length: The maximum allowed length for contour edges along the border of the mesh. A value of 0.0 disables this feature.
m.NavigationMesh.filter_baking_aabb: If the baking AABB has a volume the navigation mesh baking will be restricted to its enclosing area.
m.NavigationMesh.filter_baking_aabb_offset: The position offset applied to the filter_baking_aabb AABB.
m.NavigationMesh.filter_ledge_spans: If true, marks spans that are ledges as non-walkable.
m.NavigationMesh.filter_low_hanging_obstac: If true, marks non-walkable spans as walkable if their maximum is within agent_max_climb of a walkable neighbor.
m.NavigationMesh.filter_walkable_low_heigh: If true, marks walkable spans as not walkable if the clearance above the span is less than agent_height.
m.NavigationMesh.geometry_collision_mask: The physics layers to scan for static colliders.
m.NavigationMesh.geometry_parsed_geometry_: Determines which type of nodes will be parsed as geometry.
m.NavigationMesh.geometry_source_geometry_: The source of the geometry used when baking.
m.NavigationMesh.geometry_source_group_nam: The name of the group to scan for geometry.
m.NavigationMesh.get_collision_mask_value: Returns whether or not the specified layer of the geometry_collision_mask is enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationMesh.get_polygon: Returns a PackedInt32Array containing the indices of the vertices of a created polygon.
m.NavigationMesh.get_polygon_count: Returns the number of polygons in the navigation mesh.
m.NavigationMesh.get_vertices: Returns a PackedVector3Array containing all the vertices being used to create the polygons.
m.NavigationMesh.region_merge_size: Any regions with a size smaller than this will be merged with larger regions if possible.
m.NavigationMesh.region_min_size: The minimum size of a region for it to be created.
m.NavigationMesh.sample_partition_type: Partitioning algorithm for creating the navigation mesh polys.
m.NavigationMesh.set_collision_mask_value: Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the geometry_collision_mask, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationMesh.set_vertices: Sets the vertices that can be then indexed to create polygons with the add_polygon() method.
m.NavigationMesh.vertices_per_polygon: The maximum number of vertices allowed for polygons generated during the contour to polygon conversion process.

Since NavigationMesh resources have no transform, all vertex positions need to be offset by the node's transform using xform.
m.NavigationMeshSourceGeometryData3D.add_m: Adds the geometry data of a Mesh resource to the navigation mesh baking data. The mesh must have valid triangulated mesh data to be considered. Since NavigationMesh resources have no transform, all vertex positions need to be offset by the node's transform using xform.

Adds an Array the size of Mesh.ARRAY_MAX and with vertices at index Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX and indices at index Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX to the navigation mesh baking data. The array must have valid triangulated mesh data to be considered. Since NavigationMesh resources have no transform, all vertex positions need to be offset by the node's transform using xform.
m.NavigationMeshSourceGeometryData3D.add_p: Adds a projected obstruction shape to the source geometry. The vertices are considered projected on an xz-axes plane, placed at the global y-axis elevation and extruded by height. If carve is true the carved shape will not be affected by additional offsets (e.g. agent radius) of the navigation mesh baking process.
m.NavigationMeshSourceGeometryData3D.appen: Appends arrays of vertices and indices at the end of the existing arrays. Adds the existing index as an offset to the appended indices.
m.NavigationMeshSourceGeometryData3D.get_b: Returns an axis-aligned bounding box that covers all the stored geometry data. The bounds are calculated when calling this function with the result cached until further geometry changes are made.
