m.NavigationPathQueryParameters3D.PATH_MET: Include all available metadata about the returned path.
Don't include any additional metadata about the returned path.
Include the ObjectIDs of the Objects which manage the regions and links each point of the path goes through.
Include the RIDs of the regions and links that each point of the path goes through.
Include the type of navigation primitive (region or link) that each point of the path goes through.
m.NavigationPathQueryParameters3D.PATH_POS: Applies a funnel algorithm to the raw path corridor found by the pathfinding algorithm. This will result in the shortest path possible inside the path corridor. This postprocessing very much depends on the navigation mesh polygon layout and the created corridor. Especially tile- or gridbased layouts can face artificial corners with diagonal movement due to a jagged path corridor imposed by the ce…
Centers every path position in the middle of the traveled navigation mesh polygon edge. This creates better paths for tile- or gridbased layouts that restrict the movement to the cells center.
Applies no postprocessing and returns the raw path corridor as found by the pathfinding algorithm.
m.NavigationPathQueryParameters3D.excluded: The list of region RIDs that will be excluded from the path query. Use NavigationRegion3D.get_rid() to get the RID associated with a NavigationRegion3D node.
m.NavigationPathQueryParameters3D.included: The list of region RIDs that will be included by the path query. Use NavigationRegion3D.get_rid() to get the RID associated with a NavigationRegion3D node. If left empty all regions are included. If a region ends up being both included and excluded at the same time it will be excluded.
m.NavigationPathQueryParameters3D.map: The navigation map RID used in the path query.
m.NavigationPathQueryParameters3D.metadata: Additional information to include with the navigation path.
m.NavigationPathQueryParameters3D.navigati: The navigation layers the query will use (as a bitmask).
m.NavigationPathQueryParameters3D.path_pos: The path postprocessing applied to the raw path corridor found by the pathfinding_algorithm.
m.NavigationPathQueryParameters3D.path_ret: The maximum allowed length of the returned path in world units. A path will be clipped when going over this length. A value of 0 or below counts as disabled.
The maximum allowed radius in world units that the returned path can be from the path start. The path will be clipped when going over this radius. A value of 0 or below counts as disabled.
m.NavigationPathQueryParameters3D.path_sea: The maximum distance a searched polygon can be away from the start polygon before the pathfinding cancels the search for a path to the (possibly unreachable or very far away) target position polygon. In this case the pathfinding resets and builds a path from the start polygon to the polygon that was found closest to the target position so far. A value of 0 or below counts as unlimited. In case of…

The maximum number of polygons that are searched before the pathfinding cancels the search for a path to the (possibly unreachable or very far away) target position polygon. In this case the pathfinding resets and builds a path from the start polygon to the polygon that was found closest to the target position so far. A value of 0 or below counts as unlimited. In case of unlimited the pathfinding…
m.NavigationPathQueryParameters3D.pathfind: The pathfinding algorithm used in the path query.
m.NavigationPathQueryParameters3D.simplify: The path simplification amount in worlds units.

If true a simplified version of the path will be returned with less critical path points removed. The simplification amount is controlled by simplify_epsilon. The simplification uses a variant of Ramer-Douglas-Peucker algorithm for curve point decimation.
m.NavigationPathQueryParameters3D.start_po: The pathfinding start position in global coordinates.
m.NavigationPathQueryParameters3D.target_p: The pathfinding target position in global coordinates.
m.NavigationPathQueryResult2D.PATH_SEGMENT: This segment of the path goes through a link.
This segment of the path goes through a region.
m.NavigationPathQueryResult2D.path: The resulting path array from the navigation query. All path array positions are in global coordinates. Without customized query parameters this is the same path as returned by NavigationServer2D.map_get_path().
m.NavigationPathQueryResult2D.path_length: Returns the length of the path.
m.NavigationPathQueryResult2D.path_owner_i: The ObjectIDs of the Objects which manage the regions and links each point of the path goes through.
m.NavigationPathQueryResult2D.path_rids: The RIDs of the regions and links that each point of the path goes through.
m.NavigationPathQueryResult2D.path_types: The type of navigation primitive (region or link) that each point of the path goes through.
m.NavigationPathQueryResult2D.reset: Reset the result object to its initial state. This is useful to reuse the object across multiple queries.
m.NavigationPathQueryResult3D.PATH_SEGMENT: This segment of the path goes through a link.
This segment of the path goes through a region.
m.NavigationPathQueryResult3D.path: The resulting path array from the navigation query. All path array positions are in global coordinates. Without customized query parameters this is the same path as returned by NavigationServer3D.map_get_path().
m.NavigationPathQueryResult3D.path_length: Returns the length of the path.
m.NavigationPathQueryResult3D.path_owner_i: The ObjectIDs of the Objects which manage the regions and links each point of the path goes through.
m.NavigationPathQueryResult3D.path_rids: The RIDs of the regions and links that each point of the path goes through.
m.NavigationPathQueryResult3D.path_types: The type of navigation primitive (region or link) that each point of the path goes through.
m.NavigationPathQueryResult3D.reset: Reset the result object to its initial state. This is useful to reuse the object across multiple queries.
m.NavigationPolygon.PARSED_GEOMETRY_MAX: Represents the size of the ParsedGeometryType enum.
m.NavigationPolygon.PARSED_GEOMETRY_MESH_I: Parses mesh instances as obstruction geometry. This includes Polygon2D, MeshInstance2D, MultiMeshInstance2D, and TileMap nodes.
m.NavigationPolygon.PARSED_GEOMETRY_STATIC: Parses StaticBody2D and TileMap colliders as obstruction geometry. The collider should be in any of the layers specified by parsed_collision_mask.
m.NavigationPolygon.SAMPLE_PARTITION_CONVE: Convex partitioning that results in a navigation mesh with convex polygons.
m.NavigationPolygon.SAMPLE_PARTITION_MAX: Represents the size of the SamplePartitionType enum.
m.NavigationPolygon.SAMPLE_PARTITION_TRIAN: Triangulation partitioning that results in a navigation mesh with triangle polygons.
m.NavigationPolygon.SOURCE_GEOMETRY_GROUPS: Uses nodes in a group for geometry. The group is specified by source_geometry_group_name.
Scans nodes in a group and their child nodes recursively for geometry. The group is specified by source_geometry_group_name.
m.NavigationPolygon.SOURCE_GEOMETRY_MAX: Represents the size of the SourceGeometryMode enum.
m.NavigationPolygon.SOURCE_GEOMETRY_ROOT_N: Scans the child nodes of the root node recursively for geometry.
m.NavigationPolygon.add_outline: Appends a PackedVector2Array that contains the vertices of an outline to the internal array that contains all the outlines.
m.NavigationPolygon.add_outline_at_index: Adds a PackedVector2Array that contains the vertices of an outline to the internal array that contains all the outlines at a fixed position.
m.NavigationPolygon.add_polygon: Adds a polygon using the indices of the vertices you get when calling get_vertices().
m.NavigationPolygon.agent_radius: The distance to erode/shrink the walkable surface when baking the navigation mesh.
m.NavigationPolygon.baking_rect: If the baking Rect2 has an area the navigation mesh baking will be restricted to its enclosing area.
m.NavigationPolygon.baking_rect_offset: The position offset applied to the baking_rect Rect2.
m.NavigationPolygon.border_size: The size of the non-navigable border around the bake bounding area defined by the baking_rect Rect2.
m.NavigationPolygon.cell_size: The cell size used to rasterize the navigation mesh vertices. Must match with the cell size on the navigation map.
m.NavigationPolygon.clear: Clears the internal arrays for vertices and polygon indices.
m.NavigationPolygon.clear_outlines: Clears the array of the outlines, but it doesn't clear the vertices and the polygons that were created by them.
m.NavigationPolygon.clear_polygons: Clears the array of polygons, but it doesn't clear the array of outlines and vertices.
m.NavigationPolygon.get_navigation_mesh: Returns the NavigationMesh resulting from this navigation polygon. This navigation mesh can be used to update the navigation mesh of a region with the NavigationServer3D.region_set_navigation_mesh() API directly.
m.NavigationPolygon.get_outline: Returns a PackedVector2Array containing the vertices of an outline that was created in the editor or by script.
m.NavigationPolygon.get_outline_count: Returns the number of outlines that were created in the editor or by script.
m.NavigationPolygon.get_parsed_collision_m: Returns whether or not the specified layer of the parsed_collision_mask is enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationPolygon.get_polygon: Returns a PackedInt32Array containing the indices of the vertices of a created polygon.
m.NavigationPolygon.get_polygon_count: Returns the count of all polygons.
m.NavigationPolygon.get_vertices: Returns a PackedVector2Array containing all the vertices being used to create the polygons.
m.NavigationPolygon.parsed_collision_mask: The physics layers to scan for static colliders.
m.NavigationPolygon.parsed_geometry_type: Determines which type of nodes will be parsed as geometry.
m.NavigationPolygon.remove_outline: Removes an outline created in the editor or by script. You have to call make_polygons_from_outlines() for the polygons to update.
m.NavigationPolygon.sample_partition_type: Partitioning algorithm for creating the navigation mesh polys.
m.NavigationPolygon.set_outline: Changes an outline created in the editor or by script. You have to call make_polygons_from_outlines() for the polygons to update.
m.NavigationPolygon.set_parsed_collision_m: Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the parsed_collision_mask, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationPolygon.set_vertices: Sets the vertices that can be then indexed to create polygons with the add_polygon() method.
m.NavigationPolygon.source_geometry_group_: The group name of nodes that should be parsed for baking source geometry.
m.NavigationPolygon.source_geometry_mode: The source of the geometry used when baking.
m.NavigationRegion2D.bake_finished: Emitted when a navigation polygon bake operation is completed.
m.NavigationRegion2D.bake_navigation_polyg: Bakes the NavigationPolygon. If on_thread is set to true (default), the baking is done on a separate thread.
m.NavigationRegion2D.enabled: Determines if the NavigationRegion2D is enabled or disabled.
m.NavigationRegion2D.enter_cost: When pathfinding enters this region's navigation mesh from another regions navigation mesh the enter_cost value is added to the path distance for determining the shortest path.
m.NavigationRegion2D.get_bounds: Returns the axis-aligned rectangle for the region's transformed navigation mesh.
m.NavigationRegion2D.get_navigation_layer_: Returns whether or not the specified layer of the navigation_layers bitmask is enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationRegion2D.get_navigation_map: Returns the current navigation map RID used by this region.
m.NavigationRegion2D.get_rid: Returns the RID of this region on the NavigationServer2D. Combined with NavigationServer2D.map_get_closest_point_owner() can be used to identify the NavigationRegion2D closest to a point on the merged navigation map.
m.NavigationRegion2D.is_baking: Returns true when the NavigationPolygon is being baked on a background thread.
m.NavigationRegion2D.navigation_layers: A bitfield determining all navigation layers the region belongs to. These navigation layers can be checked upon when requesting a path with NavigationServer2D.map_get_path().
m.NavigationRegion2D.navigation_polygon_ch: Emitted when the used navigation polygon is replaced or changes to the internals of the current navigation polygon are committed.
m.NavigationRegion2D.set_navigation_layer_: Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the navigation_layers bitmask, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationRegion2D.set_navigation_map: Sets the RID of the navigation map this region should use. By default the region will automatically join the World2D default navigation map so this function is only required to override the default map.
m.NavigationRegion2D.travel_cost: When pathfinding moves inside this region's navigation mesh the traveled distances are multiplied with travel_cost for determining the shortest path.
m.NavigationRegion2D.use_edge_connections: If enabled the navigation region will use edge connections to connect with other navigation regions within proximity of the navigation map edge connection margin.
m.NavigationRegion3D.bake_finished: Notifies when the navigation mesh bake operation is completed.
m.NavigationRegion3D.bake_navigation_mesh: Bakes the NavigationMesh. If on_thread is set to true (default), the baking is done on a separate thread. Baking on separate thread is useful because navigation baking is not a cheap operation. When it is completed, it automatically sets the new NavigationMesh. Please note that baking on separate thread may be very slow if geometry is parsed from meshes as async access to each mesh involves heavy…
m.NavigationRegion3D.enabled: Determines if the NavigationRegion3D is enabled or disabled.
m.NavigationRegion3D.enter_cost: When pathfinding enters this region's navigation mesh from another regions navigation mesh the enter_cost value is added to the path distance for determining the shortest path.
m.NavigationRegion3D.get_bounds: Returns the axis-aligned bounding box for the region's transformed navigation mesh.
m.NavigationRegion3D.get_navigation_layer_: Returns whether or not the specified layer of the navigation_layers bitmask is enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationRegion3D.get_navigation_map: Returns the current navigation map RID used by this region.
m.NavigationRegion3D.get_rid: Returns the RID of this region on the NavigationServer3D. Combined with NavigationServer3D.map_get_closest_point_owner() can be used to identify the NavigationRegion3D closest to a point on the merged navigation map.
m.NavigationRegion3D.is_baking: Returns true when the NavigationMesh is being baked on a background thread.
m.NavigationRegion3D.navigation_layers: A bitfield determining all navigation layers the region belongs to. These navigation layers can be checked upon when requesting a path with NavigationServer3D.map_get_path().
m.NavigationRegion3D.navigation_mesh_chang: Notifies when the NavigationMesh has changed.
m.NavigationRegion3D.set_navigation_layer_: Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the navigation_layers bitmask, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.NavigationRegion3D.set_navigation_map: Sets the RID of the navigation map this region should use. By default the region will automatically join the World3D default navigation map so this function is only required to override the default map.
m.NavigationRegion3D.travel_cost: When pathfinding moves inside this region's navigation mesh the traveled distances are multiplied with travel_cost for determining the shortest path.
m.NavigationRegion3D.use_edge_connections: If enabled the navigation region will use edge connections to connect with other navigation regions within proximity of the navigation map edge connection margin.
m.NavigationServer2D.INFO_ACTIVE_MAPS: Constant to get the number of active navigation maps.
m.NavigationServer2D.INFO_AGENT_COUNT: Constant to get the number of active navigation agents processing avoidance.
m.NavigationServer2D.INFO_EDGE_CONNECTION_: Constant to get the number of navigation mesh polygon edges that are considered connected by edge proximity.
m.NavigationServer2D.INFO_EDGE_COUNT: Constant to get the number of navigation mesh polygon edges.
m.NavigationServer2D.INFO_EDGE_FREE_COUNT: Constant to get the number of navigation mesh polygon edges that could not be merged but may be still connected by edge proximity or with links.
m.NavigationServer2D.INFO_EDGE_MERGE_COUNT: Constant to get the number of navigation mesh polygon edges that were merged due to edge key overlap.
m.NavigationServer2D.INFO_LINK_COUNT: Constant to get the number of active navigation links.
m.NavigationServer2D.INFO_OBSTACLE_COUNT: Constant to get the number of active navigation obstacles.
m.NavigationServer2D.INFO_POLYGON_COUNT: Constant to get the number of navigation mesh polygons.
m.NavigationServer2D.INFO_REGION_COUNT: Constant to get the number of active navigation regions.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_get_avoidance_e: Return true if the specified agent uses avoidance.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_get_avoidance_l: Returns the avoidance_layers bitmask of the specified agent.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_get_avoidance_m: Returns the avoidance_mask bitmask of the specified agent.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_get_avoidance_p: Returns the avoidance_priority of the specified agent.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_get_map: Returns the navigation map RID the requested agent is currently assigned to.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_get_max_neighbo: Returns the maximum number of other agents the specified agent takes into account in the navigation.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_get_max_speed: Returns the maximum speed of the specified agent.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_get_neighbor_di: Returns the maximum distance to other agents the specified agent takes into account in the navigation.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_get_paused: Returns true if the specified agent is paused.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_get_position: Returns the position of the specified agent in world space.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_get_radius: Returns the radius of the specified agent.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_get_time_horizo: Returns the minimal amount of time for which the specified agent's velocities that are computed by the simulation are safe with respect to other agents.
Returns the minimal amount of time for which the specified agent's velocities that are computed by the simulation are safe with respect to static avoidance obstacles.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_get_velocity: Returns the velocity of the specified agent.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_has_avoidance_c: Return true if the specified agent has an avoidance callback.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_is_map_changed: Returns true if the map got changed the previous frame.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_set_avoidance_c: Sets the callback Callable that gets called after each avoidance processing step for the agent. The calculated safe_velocity will be dispatched with a signal to the object just before the physics calculations.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_set_avoidance_e: If enabled is true, the specified agent uses avoidance.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_set_avoidance_p: Set the agent's avoidance_priority with a priority between 0.0 (lowest priority) to 1.0 (highest priority).
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_set_map: Puts the agent in the map.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_set_max_neighbo: Sets the maximum number of other agents the agent takes into account in the navigation. The larger this number, the longer the running time of the simulation. If the number is too low, the simulation will not be safe.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_set_max_speed: Sets the maximum speed of the agent. Must be positive.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_set_neighbor_di: Sets the maximum distance to other agents this agent takes into account in the navigation. The larger this number, the longer the running time of the simulation. If the number is too low, the simulation will not be safe.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_set_paused: If paused is true the specified agent will not be processed. For example, it will not calculate avoidance velocities or receive avoidance callbacks.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_set_position: Sets the position of the agent in world space.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_set_radius: Sets the radius of the agent.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_set_time_horizo: The minimal amount of time for which the agent's velocities that are computed by the simulation are safe with respect to other agents. The larger this number, the sooner this agent will respond to the presence of other agents, but the less freedom this agent has in choosing its velocities. A too high value will slow down agents movement considerably. Must be positive.

The minimal amount of time for which the agent's velocities that are computed by the simulation are safe with respect to static avoidance obstacles. The larger this number, the sooner this agent will respond to the presence of static avoidance obstacles, but the less freedom this agent has in choosing its velocities. A too high value will slow down agents movement considerably. Must be positive.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_set_velocity: Sets velocity as the new wanted velocity for the specified agent. The avoidance simulation will try to fulfill this velocity if possible but will modify it to avoid collision with other agent's and obstacles. When an agent is teleported to a new position far away use agent_set_velocity_forced() instead to reset the internal velocity state.
m.NavigationServer2D.agent_set_velocity_fo: Replaces the internal velocity in the collision avoidance simulation with velocity for the specified agent. When an agent is teleported to a new position far away this function should be used in the same frame. If called frequently this function can get agents stuck.
m.NavigationServer2D.avoidance_debug_chang: Emitted when avoidance debug settings are changed. Only available in debug builds.
m.NavigationServer2D.bake_from_source_geom: Bakes the provided navigation_polygon with the data from the provided source_geometry_data. After the process is finished the optional callback will be called.

Bakes the provided navigation_polygon with the data from the provided source_geometry_data as an async task running on a background thread. After the process is finished the optional callback will be called.
m.NavigationServer2D.get_debug_enabled: Returns true when the NavigationServer has debug enabled.
m.NavigationServer2D.get_maps: Returns all created navigation map RIDs on the NavigationServer. This returns both 2D and 3D created navigation maps as there is technically no distinction between them.
m.NavigationServer2D.get_process_info: Returns information about the current state of the NavigationServer.
m.NavigationServer2D.is_baking_navigation_: Returns true when the provided navigation polygon is being baked on a background thread.
m.NavigationServer2D.link_create: Create a new link between two positions on a map.
m.NavigationServer2D.link_get_enabled: Returns true if the specified link is enabled.
m.NavigationServer2D.link_get_end_position: Returns the ending position of this link.
m.NavigationServer2D.link_get_enter_cost: Returns the enter cost of this link.
m.NavigationServer2D.link_get_iteration_id: Returns the current iteration ID of the navigation link. Every time the navigation link changes and synchronizes, the iteration ID increases. An iteration ID of 0 means the navigation link has never synchronized.
m.NavigationServer2D.link_get_map: Returns the navigation map RID the requested link is currently assigned to.
m.NavigationServer2D.link_get_navigation_l: Returns the navigation layers for this link.
m.NavigationServer2D.link_get_owner_id: Returns the ObjectID of the object which manages this link.
m.NavigationServer2D.link_get_start_positi: Returns the starting position of this link.
m.NavigationServer2D.link_get_travel_cost: Returns the travel cost of this link.
m.NavigationServer2D.link_is_bidirectional: Returns whether this link can be travelled in both directions.
m.NavigationServer2D.link_set_bidirectiona: Sets whether this link can be travelled in both directions.
m.NavigationServer2D.link_set_enabled: If enabled is true, the specified link will contribute to its current navigation map.
m.NavigationServer2D.link_set_end_position: Sets the exit position for the link.
m.NavigationServer2D.link_set_enter_cost: Sets the enter_cost for this link.
m.NavigationServer2D.link_set_map: Sets the navigation map RID for the link.
m.NavigationServer2D.link_set_navigation_l: Set the links's navigation layers. This allows selecting links from a path request (when using map_get_path()).
m.NavigationServer2D.link_set_owner_id: Set the ObjectID of the object which manages this link.
m.NavigationServer2D.link_set_start_positi: Sets the entry position for this link.
m.NavigationServer2D.link_set_travel_cost: Sets the travel_cost for this link.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_changed: Emitted when a navigation map is updated, when a region moves or is modified.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_force_update: Deprecated: This method is no longer supported, as it is incompatible with asynchronous updates. It can only be used in a single-threaded context, at your own risk.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_get_agents: Returns all navigation agents RIDs that are currently assigned to the requested navigation map.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_get_cell_size: Returns the map cell size used to rasterize the navigation mesh vertices.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_get_closest_point: Returns the navigation mesh surface point closest to the provided to_point on the navigation map.
Returns the owner region RID for the navigation mesh surface point closest to the provided to_point on the navigation map.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_get_edge_connecti: Returns the edge connection margin of the map. The edge connection margin is a distance used to connect two regions.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_get_iteration_id: Returns the current iteration id of the navigation map. Every time the navigation map changes and synchronizes the iteration id increases. An iteration id of 0 means the navigation map has never synchronized.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_get_link_connecti: Returns the link connection radius of the map. This distance is the maximum range any link will search for navigation mesh polygons to connect to.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_get_links: Returns all navigation link RIDs that are currently assigned to the requested navigation map.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_get_merge_rasteri: Returns map's internal merge rasterizer cell scale.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_get_obstacles: Returns all navigation obstacle RIDs that are currently assigned to the requested navigation map.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_get_path: Returns the navigation path to reach the destination from the origin. navigation_layers is a bitmask of all region navigation layers that are allowed to be in the path.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_get_random_point: Returns a random position picked from all map region polygons with matching navigation_layers.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_get_regions: Returns all navigation regions RIDs that are currently assigned to the requested navigation map.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_get_use_async_ite: Returns true if the map synchronization uses an async process that runs on a background thread.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_get_use_edge_conn: Returns whether the navigation map allows navigation regions to use edge connections to connect with other navigation regions within proximity of the navigation map edge connection margin.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_is_active: Returns true if the map is active.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_set_cell_size: Sets the map cell size used to rasterize the navigation mesh vertices. Must match with the cell size of the used navigation meshes.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_set_edge_connecti: Set the map edge connection margin used to weld the compatible region edges.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_set_link_connecti: Set the map's link connection radius used to connect links to navigation polygons.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_set_merge_rasteri: Set the map's internal merge rasterizer cell scale used to control merging sensitivity.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_set_use_async_ite: If enabled is true the map synchronization uses an async process that runs on a background thread.
m.NavigationServer2D.map_set_use_edge_conn: Set the navigation map edge connection use. If enabled is true, the navigation map allows navigation regions to use edge connections to connect with other navigation regions within proximity of the navigation map edge connection margin.
m.NavigationServer2D.navigation_debug_chan: Emitted when navigation debug settings are changed. Only available in debug builds.
m.NavigationServer2D.obstacle_get_avoidanc: Returns true if the provided obstacle has avoidance enabled.
Returns the avoidance_layers bitmask of the specified obstacle.
m.NavigationServer2D.obstacle_get_map: Returns the navigation map RID the requested obstacle is currently assigned to.
m.NavigationServer2D.obstacle_get_paused: Returns true if the specified obstacle is paused.
m.NavigationServer2D.obstacle_get_position: Returns the position of the specified obstacle in world space.
m.NavigationServer2D.obstacle_get_radius: Returns the radius of the specified dynamic obstacle.
m.NavigationServer2D.obstacle_get_velocity: Returns the velocity of the specified dynamic obstacle.
m.NavigationServer2D.obstacle_get_vertices: Returns the outline vertices for the specified obstacle.
m.NavigationServer2D.obstacle_set_avoidanc: If enabled is true, the provided obstacle affects avoidance using agents.
m.NavigationServer2D.obstacle_set_map: Sets the navigation map RID for the obstacle.
m.NavigationServer2D.obstacle_set_paused: If paused is true the specified obstacle will not be processed. For example, it will no longer affect avoidance velocities.
m.NavigationServer2D.obstacle_set_position: Sets the position of the obstacle in world space.
m.NavigationServer2D.obstacle_set_radius: Sets the radius of the dynamic obstacle.
m.NavigationServer2D.obstacle_set_velocity: Sets velocity of the dynamic obstacle. Allows other agents to better predict the movement of the dynamic obstacle. Only works in combination with the radius of the obstacle.
m.NavigationServer2D.obstacle_set_vertices: Sets the outline vertices for the obstacle. If the vertices are winded in clockwise order agents will be pushed in by the obstacle, else they will be pushed out.
m.NavigationServer2D.parse_source_geometry: Parses the SceneTree for source geometry according to the properties of navigation_polygon. Updates the provided source_geometry_data resource with the resulting data. The resource can then be used to bake a navigation mesh with bake_from_source_geometry_data(). After the process is finished the optional callback will be called.
m.NavigationServer2D.query_path: Queries a path in a given navigation map. Start and target position and other parameters are defined through NavigationPathQueryParameters2D. Updates the provided NavigationPathQueryResult2D result object with the path among other results requested by the query. After the process is finished the optional callback will be called.
m.NavigationServer2D.region_get_bounds: Returns the axis-aligned rectangle for the region's transformed navigation mesh.
m.NavigationServer2D.region_get_closest_po: Returns the navigation mesh surface point closest to the provided to_point on the navigation region.
m.NavigationServer2D.region_get_connection: Returns the ending point of a connection door. connection is an index between 0 and the return value of region_get_connections_count().
Returns the starting point of a connection door. connection is an index between 0 and the return value of region_get_connections_count().
Returns how many connections this region has with other regions in the map.
m.NavigationServer2D.region_get_enabled: Returns true if the specified region is enabled.
m.NavigationServer2D.region_get_enter_cost: Returns the enter cost of this region.
m.NavigationServer2D.region_get_iteration_: Returns the current iteration ID of the navigation region. Every time the navigation region changes and synchronizes, the iteration ID increases. An iteration ID of 0 means the navigation region has never synchronized.
m.NavigationServer2D.region_get_map: Returns the navigation map RID the requested region is currently assigned to.
m.NavigationServer2D.region_get_owner_id: Returns the ObjectID of the object which manages this region.

m.NavigationServer2D.region_set_use_edge_c: If enabled is true, the navigation region will use edge connections to connect with other navigation regions within proximity of the navigation map edge connection margin.
m.NavigationServer2D.set_debug_enabled: If true enables debug mode on the NavigationServer.

m.NavigationServer3D.INFO_ACTIVE_MAPS: Constant to get the number of active navigation maps.
m.NavigationServer3D.INFO_AGENT_COUNT: Constant to get the number of active navigation agents processing avoidance.
m.NavigationServer3D.INFO_EDGE_CONNECTION_: Constant to get the number of navigation mesh polygon edges that are considered connected by edge proximity.
m.NavigationServer3D.INFO_EDGE_COUNT: Constant to get the number of navigation mesh polygon edges.
m.NavigationServer3D.INFO_EDGE_FREE_COUNT: Constant to get the number of navigation mesh polygon edges that could not be merged but may be still connected by edge proximity or with links.
m.NavigationServer3D.INFO_EDGE_MERGE_COUNT: Constant to get the number of navigation mesh polygon edges that were merged due to edge key overlap.
m.NavigationServer3D.INFO_LINK_COUNT: Constant to get the number of active navigation links.
m.NavigationServer3D.INFO_OBSTACLE_COUNT: Constant to get the number of active navigation obstacles.
m.NavigationServer3D.INFO_POLYGON_COUNT: Constant to get the number of navigation mesh polygons.
m.NavigationServer3D.INFO_REGION_COUNT: Constant to get the number of active navigation regions.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_get_avoidance_e: Returns true if the provided agent has avoidance enabled.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_get_avoidance_l: Returns the avoidance_layers bitmask of the specified agent.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_get_avoidance_m: Returns the avoidance_mask bitmask of the specified agent.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_get_avoidance_p: Returns the avoidance_priority of the specified agent.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_get_height: Returns the height of the specified agent.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_get_map: Returns the navigation map RID the requested agent is currently assigned to.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_get_max_neighbo: Returns the maximum number of other agents the specified agent takes into account in the navigation.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_get_max_speed: Returns the maximum speed of the specified agent.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_get_neighbor_di: Returns the maximum distance to other agents the specified agent takes into account in the navigation.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_get_paused: Returns true if the specified agent is paused.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_get_position: Returns the position of the specified agent in world space.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_get_radius: Returns the radius of the specified agent.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_get_time_horizo: Returns the minimal amount of time for which the specified agent's velocities that are computed by the simulation are safe with respect to other agents.
Returns the minimal amount of time for which the specified agent's velocities that are computed by the simulation are safe with respect to static avoidance obstacles.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_get_use_3d_avoi: Returns true if the provided agent uses avoidance in 3D space Vector3(x,y,z) instead of horizontal 2D Vector2(x,y) / Vector3(x,0.0,z).
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_get_velocity: Returns the velocity of the specified agent.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_has_avoidance_c: Return true if the specified agent has an avoidance callback.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_is_map_changed: Returns true if the map got changed the previous frame.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_set_avoidance_c: Sets the callback Callable that gets called after each avoidance processing step for the agent. The calculated safe_velocity will be dispatched with a signal to the object just before the physics calculations.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_set_avoidance_e: If enabled is true, the provided agent calculates avoidance.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_set_avoidance_p: Set the agent's avoidance_priority with a priority between 0.0 (lowest priority) to 1.0 (highest priority).
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_set_map: Puts the agent in the map.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_set_max_neighbo: Sets the maximum number of other agents the agent takes into account in the navigation. The larger this number, the longer the running time of the simulation. If the number is too low, the simulation will not be safe.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_set_max_speed: Sets the maximum speed of the agent. Must be positive.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_set_neighbor_di: Sets the maximum distance to other agents this agent takes into account in the navigation. The larger this number, the longer the running time of the simulation. If the number is too low, the simulation will not be safe.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_set_paused: If paused is true the specified agent will not be processed. For example, it will not calculate avoidance velocities or receive avoidance callbacks.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_set_position: Sets the position of the agent in world space.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_set_radius: Sets the radius of the agent.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_set_time_horizo: The minimal amount of time for which the agent's velocities that are computed by the simulation are safe with respect to other agents. The larger this number, the sooner this agent will respond to the presence of other agents, but the less freedom this agent has in choosing its velocities. A too high value will slow down agents movement considerably. Must be positive.

The minimal amount of time for which the agent's velocities that are computed by the simulation are safe with respect to static avoidance obstacles. The larger this number, the sooner this agent will respond to the presence of static avoidance obstacles, but the less freedom this agent has in choosing its velocities. A too high value will slow down agents movement considerably. Must be positive.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_set_use_3d_avoi: Sets if the agent uses the 2D avoidance or the 3D avoidance while avoidance is enabled.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_set_velocity: Sets velocity as the new wanted velocity for the specified agent. The avoidance simulation will try to fulfill this velocity if possible but will modify it to avoid collision with other agent's and obstacles. When an agent is teleported to a new position use agent_set_velocity_forced() as well to reset the internal simulation velocity.
m.NavigationServer3D.agent_set_velocity_fo: Replaces the internal velocity in the collision avoidance simulation with velocity for the specified agent. When an agent is teleported to a new position this function should be used in the same frame. If called frequently this function can get agents stuck.
m.NavigationServer3D.avoidance_debug_chang: Emitted when avoidance debug settings are changed. Only available in debug builds.
m.NavigationServer3D.bake_from_source_geom: Bakes the provided navigation_mesh with the data from the provided source_geometry_data. After the process is finished the optional callback will be called.

Bakes the provided navigation_mesh with the data from the provided source_geometry_data as an async task running on a background thread. After the process is finished the optional callback will be called.
m.NavigationServer3D.get_debug_enabled: Returns true when the NavigationServer has debug enabled.
m.NavigationServer3D.get_maps: Returns all created navigation map RIDs on the NavigationServer. This returns both 2D and 3D created navigation maps as there is technically no distinction between them.
m.NavigationServer3D.get_process_info: Returns information about the current state of the NavigationServer.
m.NavigationServer3D.is_baking_navigation_: Returns true when the provided navigation mesh is being baked on a background thread.

m.NavigationServer3D.map_changed: Emitted when a navigation map is updated, when a region moves or is modified.

m.NinePatchRect.AXIS_STRETCH_MODE_STRETCH: Stretches the center texture across the NinePatchRect. This may cause the texture to be distorted.
m.NinePatchRect.AXIS_STRETCH_MODE_TILE: Repeats the center texture across the NinePatchRect. This won't cause any visible distortion. The texture must be seamless for this to work without displaying artifacts between edges.
m.NinePatchRect.AXIS_STRETCH_MODE_TILE_FIT: Repeats the center texture across the NinePatchRect, but will also stretch the texture to make sure each tile is visible in full. This may cause the texture to be distorted, but less than AXIS_STRETCH_MODE_STRETCH. The texture must be seamless for this to work without displaying artifacts between edges.
m.NinePatchRect.axis_stretch_horizontal: The stretch mode to use for horizontal stretching/tiling.
m.NinePatchRect.axis_stretch_vertical: The stretch mode to use for vertical stretching/tiling.
m.NinePatchRect.draw_center: If true, draw the panel's center. Else, only draw the 9-slice's borders.
m.NinePatchRect.get_patch_margin: Returns the size of the margin on the specified Side.
m.NinePatchRect.patch_margin_bottom: The height of the 9-slice's bottom row. A margin of 16 means the 9-slice's bottom corners and side will have a height of 16 pixels. You can set all 4 margin values individually to create panels with non-uniform borders.
m.NinePatchRect.patch_margin_left: The width of the 9-slice's left column. A margin of 16 means the 9-slice's left corners and side will have a width of 16 pixels. You can set all 4 margin values individually to create panels with non-uniform borders.
m.NinePatchRect.patch_margin_right: The width of the 9-slice's right column. A margin of 16 means the 9-slice's right corners and side will have a width of 16 pixels. You can set all 4 margin values individually to create panels with non-uniform borders.
m.NinePatchRect.patch_margin_top: The height of the 9-slice's top row. A margin of 16 means the 9-slice's top corners and side will have a height of 16 pixels. You can set all 4 margin values individually to create panels with non-uniform borders.
m.NinePatchRect.region_rect: Rectangular region of the texture to sample from. If you're working with an atlas, use this property to define the area the 9-slice should use. All other properties are relative to this one. If the rect is empty, NinePatchRect will use the whole texture.
m.NinePatchRect.set_patch_margin: Sets the size of the margin on the specified Side to value pixels.
m.NinePatchRect.texture_changed: Emitted when the node's texture changes.
m.Node.AUTO_TRANSLATE_MODE_ALWAYS: Always automatically translate. This is the inverse of AUTO_TRANSLATE_MODE_DISABLED, and the default for the root node.
m.Node.AUTO_TRANSLATE_MODE_DISABLED: Never automatically translate. This is the inverse of AUTO_TRANSLATE_MODE_ALWAYS.
m.Node.AUTO_TRANSLATE_MODE_INHERIT: Inherits auto_translate_mode from the node's parent. This is the default for any newly created node.
m.Node.DUPLICATE_DEFAULT: Duplicate using default flags. This constant is useful to add or remove a single flag.
m.Node.DUPLICATE_SCRIPTS: Duplicate the node's script (also overriding the duplicated children's scripts, if combined with DUPLICATE_USE_INSTANTIATION).
m.Node.DUPLICATE_SIGNALS: Duplicate the node's signal connections that are connected with the Object.CONNECT_PERSIST flag.
m.Node.DUPLICATE_USE_INSTANTIATION: Duplicate using PackedScene.instantiate(). If the node comes from a scene saved on disk, reuses PackedScene.instantiate() as the base for the duplicated node and its children.
m.Node.FLAG_PROCESS_THREAD_MESSAGES: Allows this node to process threaded messages created with call_deferred_thread_group() right before _process() is called.
m.Node.FLAG_PROCESS_THREAD_MESSAGES_ALL: Allows this node to process threaded messages created with call_deferred_thread_group() right before either _process() or _physics_process() are called.
m.Node.FLAG_PROCESS_THREAD_MESSAGES_PHYSIC: Allows this node to process threaded messages created with call_deferred_thread_group() right before _physics_process() is called.
m.Node.INTERNAL_MODE_BACK: The node will be placed at the end of the parent's children, after any non-internal sibling.
m.Node.INTERNAL_MODE_DISABLED: The node will not be internal.
m.Node.INTERNAL_MODE_FRONT: The node will be placed at the beginning of the parent's children, before any non-internal sibling.
m.Node.NOTIFICATION_ENTER_TREE: Notification received when the node enters a SceneTree. See _enter_tree().
m.Node.PHYSICS_INTERPOLATION_MODE_INHERIT: Inherits physics_interpolation_mode from the node's parent. This is the default for any newly created node.
m.Node.PHYSICS_INTERPOLATION_MODE_OFF: Disables physics interpolation for this node and for children set to PHYSICS_INTERPOLATION_MODE_INHERIT.
m.Node.PHYSICS_INTERPOLATION_MODE_ON: Enables physics interpolation for this node and for children set to PHYSICS_INTERPOLATION_MODE_INHERIT. This is the default for the root node.
m.Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS: Always processes. Keeps processing, ignoring SceneTree.paused. This is the inverse of PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED.
m.Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED: Never processes. Completely disables processing, ignoring SceneTree.paused. This is the inverse of PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS.
m.Node.PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT: Inherits process_mode from the node's parent. This is the default for any newly created node.
m.Node.PROCESS_MODE_PAUSABLE: Processes when SceneTree.paused is false. This is the inverse of PROCESS_MODE_WHEN_PAUSED, and the default for the root node.
m.Node.PROCESS_MODE_WHEN_PAUSED: Processes only when SceneTree.paused is true. This is the inverse of PROCESS_MODE_PAUSABLE.
m.Node.PROCESS_THREAD_GROUP_INHERIT: Process this node based on the thread group mode of the first parent (or grandparent) node that has a thread group mode that is not inherit. See process_thread_group for more information.
m.Node.PROCESS_THREAD_GROUP_MAIN_THREAD: Process this node (and child nodes set to inherit) on the main thread. See process_thread_group for more information.
m.Node.PROCESS_THREAD_GROUP_SUB_THREAD: Process this node (and child nodes set to inherit) on a sub-thread. See process_thread_group for more information.
m.Node._enter_tree: Called when the node enters the SceneTree (e.g. upon instantiating, scene changing, or after calling add_child() in a script). If the node has children, its _enter_tree() callback will be called first, and then that of the children.
m.Node._exit_tree: Called when the node is about to leave the SceneTree (e.g. upon freeing, scene changing, or after calling remove_child() in a script). If the node has children, its _exit_tree() callback will be called last, after all its children have left the tree.
m.Node._get_accessibility_configuration_wa: The elements in the array returned from this method are displayed as warnings in the Scene dock if the script that overrides it is a tool script, and accessibility warnings are enabled in the editor settings.
m.Node._get_configuration_warnings: The elements in the array returned from this method are displayed as warnings in the Scene dock if the script that overrides it is a tool script.
m.Node._get_focused_accessibility_element: Called during accessibility information updates to determine the currently focused sub-element, should return a sub-element RID or the value returned by get_accessibility_element().
m.Node._input: Called when there is an input event. The input event propagates up through the node tree until a node consumes it.
m.Node._physics_process: Called once on each physics tick, and allows Nodes to synchronize their logic with physics ticks. delta is the logical time between physics ticks in seconds and is equal to Engine.time_scale / Engine.physics_ticks_per_second.
m.Node._process: Called on each idle frame, prior to rendering, and after physics ticks have been processed. delta is the time between frames in seconds.
m.Node._ready: Called when the node is "ready", i.e. when both the node and its children have entered the scene tree. If the node has children, their _ready() callbacks get triggered first, and the parent node will receive the ready notification afterwards.
m.Node._shortcut_input: Called when an InputEventKey, InputEventShortcut, or InputEventJoypadButton hasn't been consumed by _input() or any GUI Control item. It is called before _unhandled_key_input() and _unhandled_input(). The input event propagates up through the node tree until a node consumes it.
m.Node._unhandled_input: Called when an InputEvent hasn't been consumed by _input() or any GUI Control item. It is called after _shortcut_input() and after _unhandled_key_input(). The input event propagates up through the node tree until a node consumes it.
m.Node._unhandled_key_input: Called when an InputEventKey hasn't been consumed by _input() or any GUI Control item. It is called after _shortcut_input() but before _unhandled_input(). The input event propagates up through the node tree until a node consumes it.
m.Node.add_child: 将节点添加为子节点。add_child 后节点进入场景树，生命周期回调开始触发。
m.Node.add_sibling: Adds a sibling node to this node's parent, and moves the added sibling right below this node.
m.Node.add_to_group: Adds the node to the group. Groups can be helpful to organize a subset of nodes, for example "enemies" or "collectables". See notes in the description, and the group methods in SceneTree.
m.Node.atr: Translates a message, using the translation catalogs configured in the Project Settings. Further context can be specified to help with the translation. Note that most Control nodes automatically translate their strings, so this method is mostly useful for formatted strings or custom drawn text.
m.Node.atr_n: Translates a message or plural_message, using the translation catalogs configured in the Project Settings. Further context can be specified to help with the translation.
m.Node.auto_translate_mode: Defines if any text should automatically change to its translated version depending on the current locale (for nodes such as Label, RichTextLabel, Window, etc.). Also decides if the node's strings should be parsed for translation template generation.
m.Node.call_deferred_thread_group: This function is similar to Object.call_deferred() except that the call will take place when the node thread group is processed. If the node thread group processes in sub-threads, then the call will be done on that thread, right before NOTIFICATION_PROCESS or NOTIFICATION_PHYSICS_PROCESS, the _process() or _physics_process() or their internal versions are called.
m.Node.call_thread_safe: This function ensures that the calling of this function will succeed, no matter whether it's being done from a thread or not. If called from a thread that is not allowed to call the function, the call will become deferred. Otherwise, the call will go through directly.
m.Node.can_auto_translate: Returns true if this node can automatically translate messages depending on the current locale. See auto_translate_mode, atr(), and atr_n().
m.Node.can_process: Returns true if the node can receive processing notifications and input callbacks (NOTIFICATION_PROCESS, _input(), etc.) from the SceneTree and Viewport. The returned value depends on process_mode:
m.Node.child_entered_tree: Emitted when the child node enters the SceneTree, usually because this node entered the tree (see tree_entered), or add_child() has been called.
m.Node.child_exiting_tree: Emitted when the child node is about to exit the SceneTree, usually because this node is exiting the tree (see tree_exiting), or because the child node is being removed or freed.
m.Node.child_order_changed: Emitted when the list of children is changed. This happens when child nodes are added, moved or removed.
m.Node.create_tween: Creates a new Tween and binds it to this node.
m.Node.editor_description: An optional description to the node. It will be displayed as a tooltip when hovering over the node in the editor's Scene dock.
m.Node.editor_description_changed: Emitted when the node's editor description field changed.
m.Node.editor_state_changed: Emitted when an attribute of the node that is relevant to the editor is changed. Only emitted in the editor.
m.Node.find_child: 按名称递归查找子节点。
m.Node.find_children: Finds all descendants of this node whose names match pattern, returning an empty Array if no match is found. The matching is done against node names, not their paths, through String.match(). As such, it is case-sensitive, "*" matches zero or more characters, and "?" matches any single character.
m.Node.find_parent: Finds the first ancestor of this node whose name matches pattern, returning null if no match is found. The matching is done through String.match(). As such, it is case-sensitive, "*" matches zero or more characters, and "?" matches any single character. See also find_child() and find_children().
m.Node.get_child: Fetches a child node by its index. Each child node has an index relative to its siblings (see get_index()). The first child is at index 0. Negative values can also be used to start from the end of the list. This method can be used in combination with get_child_count() to iterate over this node's children. If no child exists at the given index, this method returns null and an error is generated.
m.Node.get_child_count: Returns the number of children of this node.
m.Node.get_children: Returns all children of this node inside an Array.
m.Node.get_groups: Returns an Array of group names that the node has been added to.
m.Node.get_index: Returns this node's order among its siblings. The first node's index is 0. See also get_child().
m.Node.get_last_exclusive_window: Returns the Window that contains this node, or the last exclusive child in a chain of windows starting with the one that contains this node.
m.Node.get_multiplayer_authority: Returns the peer ID of the multiplayer authority for this node. See set_multiplayer_authority().
m.Node.get_node: 按路径获取节点。路径如 $Player/Sprite2D 或 "Player/Sprite2D"。
m.Node.get_node_and_resource: Fetches a node and its most nested resource as specified by the NodePath's subname. Returns an Array of size 3 where:
m.Node.get_node_or_null: Fetches a node by NodePath. Similar to get_node(), but does not generate an error if path does not point to a valid node.
m.Node.get_node_rpc_config: Returns a Dictionary mapping method names to their RPC configuration defined for this node using rpc_config().
m.Node.get_orphan_node_ids: Returns object IDs of all orphan nodes (nodes outside the SceneTree). Used for debugging.
m.Node.get_parent: 返回父节点。无父节点返回 null。
m.Node.get_path: Returns the node's absolute path, relative to the SceneTree.root. If the node is not inside the scene tree, this method fails and returns an empty NodePath.
m.Node.get_path_to: Returns the relative NodePath from this node to the specified node. Both nodes must be in the same SceneTree or scene hierarchy, otherwise this method fails and returns an empty NodePath.
m.Node.get_physics_process_delta_time: Returns the time elapsed (in seconds) since the last physics callback. This value is identical to _physics_process()'s delta parameter, and is often consistent at run-time, unless Engine.physics_ticks_per_second is changed. See also NOTIFICATION_PHYSICS_PROCESS.
m.Node.get_process_delta_time: Returns the time elapsed (in seconds) since the last process callback. This value is identical to _process()'s delta parameter, and may vary from frame to frame. See also NOTIFICATION_PROCESS.
m.Node.get_scene_instance_load_placeholder: Returns true if this node is an instance load placeholder. See InstancePlaceholder and set_scene_instance_load_placeholder().
m.Node.get_tree_string: Returns the tree as a String. Used mainly for debugging purposes. This version displays the path relative to the current node, and is good for copy/pasting into the get_node() function. It also can be used in game UI/UX.
m.Node.get_tree_string_pretty: Similar to get_tree_string(), this returns the tree as a String. This version displays a more graphical representation similar to what is displayed in the Scene Dock. It is useful for inspecting larger trees.
m.Node.get_viewport: Returns the node's closest Viewport ancestor, if the node is inside the tree. Otherwise, returns null.
m.Node.get_window: Returns the Window that contains this node. If the node is in the main window, this is equivalent to getting the root node (get_tree().get_root()).
m.Node.has_node: Returns true if the path points to a valid node. See also get_node().
m.Node.has_node_and_resource: Returns true if path points to a valid node and its subnames point to a valid Resource, e.g. Area2D/CollisionShape2D:shape. Properties that are not Resource types (such as nodes or other Variant types) are not considered. See also get_node_and_resource().
m.Node.is_ancestor_of: Returns true if the given node is a direct or indirect child of this node.
m.Node.is_displayed_folded: Returns true if the node is folded (collapsed) in the Scene dock. This method is intended to be used in editor plugins and tools. See also set_display_folded().
m.Node.is_editable_instance: Returns true if node has editable children enabled relative to this node. This method is intended to be used in editor plugins and tools. See also set_editable_instance().
m.Node.is_greater_than: Returns true if the given node occurs later in the scene hierarchy than this node. A node occurring later is usually processed last.
m.Node.is_in_group: Returns true if this node has been added to the given group. See add_to_group() and remove_from_group(). See also notes in the description, and the SceneTree's group methods.
m.Node.is_inside_tree: Returns true if this node is currently inside a SceneTree. See also get_tree().
m.Node.is_multiplayer_authority: Returns true if the local system is the multiplayer authority of this node.
m.Node.is_node_ready: Returns true if the node is ready, i.e. it's inside scene tree and all its children are initialized.
m.Node.is_part_of_edited_scene: Returns true if the node is part of the scene currently opened in the editor.
m.Node.is_physics_interpolated: Returns true if physics interpolation is enabled for this node (see physics_interpolation_mode).
m.Node.is_physics_interpolated_and_enabled: Returns true if physics interpolation is enabled (see physics_interpolation_mode) and enabled in the SceneTree.
m.Node.is_physics_processing: Returns true if physics processing is enabled (see set_physics_process()).
m.Node.is_physics_processing_internal: Returns true if internal physics processing is enabled (see set_physics_process_internal()).
m.Node.is_processing: Returns true if processing is enabled (see set_process()).
m.Node.is_processing_input: Returns true if the node is processing input (see set_process_input()).
m.Node.is_processing_internal: Returns true if internal processing is enabled (see set_process_internal()).
m.Node.is_processing_shortcut_input: Returns true if the node is processing shortcuts (see set_process_shortcut_input()).
m.Node.is_processing_unhandled_input: Returns true if the node is processing unhandled input (see set_process_unhandled_input()).
m.Node.is_processing_unhandled_key_input: Returns true if the node is processing unhandled key input (see set_process_unhandled_key_input()).
m.Node.move_child: Moves child_node to the given index. A node's index is the order among its siblings. If to_index is negative, the index is counted from the end of the list. See also get_child() and get_index().
m.Node.multiplayer: The MultiplayerAPI instance associated with this node. See SceneTree.get_multiplayer().
m.Node.name: 节点名称。在父节点下必须唯一。
m.Node.notify_deferred_thread_group: Similar to call_deferred_thread_group(), but for notifications.
m.Node.notify_thread_safe: Similar to call_thread_safe(), but for notifications.
m.Node.owner: 场景所有者。决定实例化时哪些节点被保存。
m.Node.physics_interpolation_mode: The physics interpolation mode to use for this node. Only effective if ProjectSettings.physics/common/physics_interpolation or SceneTree.physics_interpolation is true.
m.Node.print_orphan_nodes: Prints all orphan nodes (nodes outside the SceneTree). Useful for debugging.
m.Node.print_tree: Prints the node and its children to the console, recursively. The node does not have to be inside the tree. This method outputs NodePaths relative to this node, and is good for copy/pasting into get_node(). See also print_tree_pretty().
m.Node.print_tree_pretty: Prints the node and its children to the console, recursively. The node does not have to be inside the tree. Similar to print_tree(), but the graphical representation looks like what is displayed in the editor's Scene dock. It is useful for inspecting larger trees.
m.Node.process_mode: The node's processing behavior. To check if the node can process in its current mode, use can_process().
m.Node.process_physics_priority: Similar to process_priority but for NOTIFICATION_PHYSICS_PROCESS, _physics_process(), or NOTIFICATION_INTERNAL_PHYSICS_PROCESS.
m.Node.process_priority: The node's execution order of the process callbacks (_process(), NOTIFICATION_PROCESS, and NOTIFICATION_INTERNAL_PROCESS). Nodes whose priority value is lower call their process callbacks first, regardless of tree order.
m.Node.process_thread_group: Set the process thread group for this node (basically, whether it receives NOTIFICATION_PROCESS, NOTIFICATION_PHYSICS_PROCESS, _process() or _physics_process() (and the internal versions) on the main thread or in a sub-thread.
m.Node.process_thread_group_order: Change the process thread group order. Groups with a lesser order will process before groups with a greater order. This is useful when a large amount of nodes process in sub thread and, afterwards, another group wants to collect their result in the main thread, as an example.
m.Node.process_thread_messages: Set whether the current thread group will process messages (calls to call_deferred_thread_group() on threads), and whether it wants to receive them during regular process or physics process callbacks.
m.Node.propagate_call: Calls the given method name, passing args as arguments, on this node and all of its children, recursively.
m.Node.propagate_notification: Calls Object.notification() with what on this node and all of its children, recursively.
m.Node.queue_accessibility_update: Queues an accessibility information update for this node.
m.Node.queue_free: 在当前帧结束后安全销毁节点。推荐替代 free()。
m.Node.ready: Emitted when the node is considered ready, after _ready() is called.
m.Node.remove_child: 从父节点移除节点。不销毁，只是脱离树。
m.Node.remove_from_group: Removes the node from the given group. Does nothing if the node is not in the group. See also notes in the description, and the SceneTree's group methods.
m.Node.renamed: Emitted when the node's name is changed, if the node is inside the tree.
m.Node.reparent: Changes the parent of this Node to the new_parent. The node needs to already have a parent. The node's owner is preserved if its owner is still reachable from the new location (i.e., the node is still a descendant of the new parent after the operation).
m.Node.replace_by: Replaces this node by the given node. All children of this node are moved to node.
m.Node.replacing_by: Emitted when this node is being replaced by the node, see replace_by().
m.Node.request_ready: Requests _ready() to be called again the next time the node enters the tree. Does not immediately call _ready().
m.Node.reset_physics_interpolation: When physics interpolation is active, moving a node to a radically different transform (such as placement within a level) can result in a visible glitch as the object is rendered moving from the old to new position over the physics tick.
m.Node.rpc: Sends a remote procedure call request for the given method to peers on the network (and locally), sending additional arguments to the method called by the RPC. The call request will only be received by nodes with the same NodePath, including the exact same name. Behavior depends on the RPC configuration for the given method (see rpc_config() and @GDScript.@rpc). By default, methods are not expose…
m.Node.rpc_config: Changes the RPC configuration for the given method. config should either be null to disable the feature (as by default), or a Dictionary containing the following entries:
m.Node.rpc_id: Sends a rpc() to a specific peer identified by peer_id (see MultiplayerPeer.set_target_peer()).
m.Node.scene_file_path: The original scene's file path, if the node has been instantiated from a PackedScene file. Only scene root nodes contains this.
m.Node.set_deferred_thread_group: Similar to call_deferred_thread_group(), but for setting properties.
m.Node.set_display_folded: If set to true, the node appears folded in the Scene dock. As a result, all of its children are hidden. This method is intended to be used in editor plugins and tools, but it also works in release builds. See also is_displayed_folded().
m.Node.set_editable_instance: Set to true to allow all nodes owned by node to be available, and editable, in the Scene dock, even if their owner is not the scene root. This method is intended to be used in editor plugins and tools, but it also works in release builds. See also is_editable_instance().
m.Node.set_multiplayer_authority: Sets the node's multiplayer authority to the peer with the given peer id. The multiplayer authority is the peer that has authority over the node on the network. Defaults to peer ID 1 (the server). Useful in conjunction with rpc_config() and the MultiplayerAPI.
m.Node.set_physics_process: If set to true, enables physics (fixed framerate) processing. When a node is being processed, it will receive a NOTIFICATION_PHYSICS_PROCESS at a fixed (usually 60 FPS, see Engine.physics_ticks_per_second to change) interval (and the _physics_process() callback will be called if it exists).
m.Node.set_physics_process_internal: If set to true, enables internal physics for this node. Internal physics processing happens in isolation from the normal _physics_process() calls and is used by some nodes internally to guarantee proper functioning even if the node is paused or physics processing is disabled for scripting (set_physics_process()).
m.Node.set_process: If set to true, enables processing. When a node is being processed, it will receive a NOTIFICATION_PROCESS on every drawn frame (and the _process() callback will be called if it exists).
m.Node.set_process_input: If set to true, enables input processing.
m.Node.set_process_internal: If set to true, enables internal processing for this node. Internal processing happens in isolation from the normal _process() calls and is used by some nodes internally to guarantee proper functioning even if the node is paused or processing is disabled for scripting (set_process()).
m.Node.set_process_shortcut_input: If set to true, enables shortcut processing for this node.
m.Node.set_process_unhandled_input: If set to true, enables unhandled input processing. It enables the node to receive all input that was not previously handled (usually by a Control).
m.Node.set_process_unhandled_key_input: If set to true, enables unhandled key input processing.
m.Node.set_scene_instance_load_placeholder: If set to true, the node becomes an InstancePlaceholder when packed and instantiated from a PackedScene. See also get_scene_instance_load_placeholder().
m.Node.set_thread_safe: Similar to call_thread_safe(), but for setting properties.
m.Node.set_translation_domain_inherited: Makes this node inherit the translation domain from its parent node. If this node has no parent, the main translation domain will be used.
m.Node.tree_entered: Emitted when the node enters the tree.
m.Node.tree_exited: Emitted after the node exits the tree and is no longer active.
m.Node.tree_exiting: Emitted when the node is just about to exit the tree. The node is still valid. As such, this is the right place for de-initialization (or a "destructor", if you will).
m.Node.unique_name_in_owner: If true, the node can be accessed from any node sharing the same owner or from the owner itself, with special %Name syntax in get_node().
m.Node.update_configuration_warnings: Refreshes the warnings displayed for this node in the Scene dock. Use _get_configuration_warnings() to customize the warning messages to display.
m.Node2D.apply_scale: Multiplies the current scale by the ratio vector.
m.Node2D.get_angle_to: Returns the angle between the node and the point in radians. See also look_at().
m.Node2D.get_relative_transform_to_parent: Returns the Transform2D relative to this node's parent.
m.Node2D.global_rotation_degrees: Helper property to access global_rotation in degrees instead of radians. See also rotation_degrees.
m.Node2D.global_skew: Global skew in radians. See also skew.
m.Node2D.global_translate: Adds the offset vector to the node's global position.
m.Node2D.look_at: Rotates the node so that its local +X axis points towards the point, which is expected to use global coordinates. This method is a combination of both rotate() and get_angle_to().
m.Node2D.move_local_x: Applies a local translation on the node's X axis with the amount specified in delta. If scaled is false, normalizes the movement to occur independently of the node's scale.
m.Node2D.move_local_y: Applies a local translation on the node's Y axis with the amount specified in delta. If scaled is false, normalizes the movement to occur independently of the node's scale.
m.Node2D.position: 节点在父节点坐标系中的位置。
m.Node2D.rotate: Applies a rotation to the node, in radians, starting from its current rotation. This is equivalent to rotation += radians.
m.Node2D.rotation: 节点绕 Z 轴的旋转角度（弧度）。
m.Node2D.rotation_degrees: Helper property to access rotation in degrees instead of radians. See also global_rotation_degrees.
m.Node2D.scale: 节点的缩放因子。(1,1) 为原始大小。
m.Node2D.skew: If set to a non-zero value, slants the node in one direction or another. This can be used for pseudo-3D effects. See also global_skew.
m.Node2D.to_global: Transforms the provided local position into a position in global coordinate space. The input is expected to be local relative to the Node2D it is called on. e.g. Applying this method to the positions of child nodes will correctly transform their positions into the global coordinate space, but applying it to a node's own position will give an incorrect result, as it will incorporate the node's own…
m.Node2D.to_local: Transforms the provided global position into a position in local coordinate space. The output will be local relative to the Node2D it is called on. e.g. It is appropriate for determining the positions of child nodes, but it is not appropriate for determining its own position relative to its parent.
m.Node2D.transform: The node's Transform2D, relative to the node's parent. See also global_transform.
m.Node2D.translate: Translates the node by the given offset in local coordinates. This is equivalent to position += offset.
m.Node3D.NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED: Notification received when this node's global_transform changes, if is_transform_notification_enabled() is true. See also set_notify_transform().
m.Node3D.ROTATION_EDIT_MODE_BASIS: The rotation is edited using a Basis. In this mode, the raw basis's axes can be freely modified, but the scale property is not available.
m.Node3D.ROTATION_EDIT_MODE_EULER: The rotation is edited using a Vector3 in Euler angles [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Euler_angles]. In Godot, Euler angles always use intrinsic order, meaning that rotation happens around the local axes of the object.
m.Node3D.ROTATION_EDIT_MODE_QUATERNION: The rotation is edited using a Quaternion. Quaternions avoid gimbal lock and having to choose an order of rotation, but are less intuitive. Quaternion rotation is mostly the same as rotors in 3D geometric algebra, except that the numbers are labeled differently.
m.Node3D.add_gizmo: Attaches the given gizmo to this node. Only works in the editor.
m.Node3D.basis: Basis of the transform property. Represents the rotation, scale, and shear of this node in parent space (relative to the parent node).
m.Node3D.clear_gizmos: Clears all EditorNode3DGizmo objects attached to this node. Only works in the editor.
m.Node3D.clear_subgizmo_selection: Deselects all subgizmos for this node. Useful to call when the selected subgizmo may no longer exist after a property change. Only works in the editor.
m.Node3D.force_update_transform: Forces the node's global_transform to update, by sending NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED. Fails if the node is not inside the tree.
m.Node3D.get_gizmos: Returns all the EditorNode3DGizmo objects attached to this node. Only works in the editor.
m.Node3D.get_global_transform_interpolated: When using physics interpolation, there will be circumstances in which you want to know the interpolated (displayed) transform of a node rather than the standard transform (which may only be accurate to the most recent physics tick).
m.Node3D.get_parent_node_3d: Returns the parent Node3D that directly affects this node's global_transform. Returns null if no parent exists, the parent is not a Node3D, or top_level is true.
m.Node3D.get_world_3d: Returns the World3D this node is registered to.
m.Node3D.global_basis: Basis of the global_transform property. Represents the rotation, scale, and shear of this node in global space (relative to the world).
m.Node3D.global_position: Global position (translation) of this node in global space (relative to the world). This is equivalent to the global_transform's Transform3D.origin.
m.Node3D.global_rotate: Rotates this node's global_basis around the global axis by the given angle, in radians. This operation is calculated in global space (relative to the world) and preserves the global_position.
m.Node3D.global_rotation: Global rotation of this node as Euler angles [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Euler_angles], in radians and in global space (relative to the world). This value is obtained from global_basis's rotation.
m.Node3D.global_rotation_degrees: The global_rotation of this node, in degrees instead of radians.
m.Node3D.global_scale: Scales this node's global_basis by the given scale factor. This operation is calculated in global space (relative to the world) and preserves the global_position.
m.Node3D.global_transform: The transformation of this node, in global space (relative to the world). Contains and represents this node's global_position, global_rotation, and global scale.
m.Node3D.global_translate: Adds the given translation offset to the node's global_position in global space (relative to the world).
m.Node3D.hide: Prevents this node from being rendered. Equivalent to setting visible to false. This is the opposite of show().
m.Node3D.is_local_transform_notification_e: Returns true if the node receives NOTIFICATION_LOCAL_TRANSFORM_CHANGED whenever transform changes. This is enabled with set_notify_local_transform().
m.Node3D.is_scale_disabled: Returns true if this node's global_transform is automatically orthonormalized. This results in this node not appearing distorted, as if its global scale were set to Vector3.ONE (or its negative counterpart). See also set_disable_scale() and orthonormalize().
m.Node3D.is_transform_notification_enabled: Returns true if the node receives NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED whenever global_transform changes. This is enabled with set_notify_transform().
m.Node3D.is_visible_in_tree: Returns true if this node is inside the scene tree and the visible property is true for this node and all of its Node3D ancestors in sequence. An ancestor of any other type (such as Node or Node2D) breaks the sequence. See also Node.get_parent().
m.Node3D.look_at: Rotates the node so that the local forward axis (-Z, Vector3.FORWARD) points toward the target position. This operation is calculated in global space (relative to the world).
m.Node3D.look_at_from_position: Moves the node to the specified position, then rotates the node to point toward the target position, similar to look_at(). This operation is calculated in global space (relative to the world).
m.Node3D.orthonormalize: Orthonormalizes this node's basis. This method sets this node's scale to Vector3.ONE (or its negative counterpart), but preserves the position and rotation. See also Transform3D.orthonormalized().
m.Node3D.position: Position (translation) of this node in parent space (relative to the parent node). This is equivalent to the transform's Transform3D.origin.
m.Node3D.quaternion: Rotation of this node represented as a Quaternion in parent space (relative to the parent node). This value is obtained from basis's rotation.
m.Node3D.rotate: Rotates this node's basis around the axis by the given angle, in radians. This operation is calculated in parent space (relative to the parent) and preserves the position.
m.Node3D.rotate_object_local: Rotates this node's basis around the axis by the given angle, in radians. This operation is calculated in local space (relative to this node) and preserves the position.
m.Node3D.rotate_x: Rotates this node's basis around the X axis by the given angle, in radians. This operation is calculated in parent space (relative to the parent) and preserves the position.
m.Node3D.rotate_y: Rotates this node's basis around the Y axis by the given angle, in radians. This operation is calculated in parent space (relative to the parent) and preserves the position.
m.Node3D.rotate_z: Rotates this node's basis around the Z axis by the given angle, in radians. This operation is calculated in parent space (relative to the parent) and preserves the position.
m.Node3D.rotation: Rotation of this node as Euler angles [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Euler_angles], in radians and in parent space (relative to the parent node). This value is obtained from basis's rotation.
m.Node3D.rotation_degrees: The rotation of this node, in degrees instead of radians.
m.Node3D.rotation_edit_mode: How this node's rotation and scale are displayed in the Inspector dock.
m.Node3D.rotation_order: The axis rotation order of the rotation property. In Godot, Euler angles always use intrinsic order, meaning that the final orientation is calculated by rotating around the local axes in this order.
m.Node3D.scale: Scale of this node in local space (relative to this node). This value is obtained from basis's scale.
m.Node3D.scale_object_local: Scales this node's basis by the given scale factor. This operation is calculated in local space (relative to this node) and preserves the position.
m.Node3D.set_disable_scale: If true, this node's global_transform is automatically orthonormalized. This results in this node not appearing distorted, as if its global scale were set to Vector3.ONE (or its negative counterpart). See also is_scale_disabled() and orthonormalize().
m.Node3D.set_identity: Sets this node's transform to Transform3D.IDENTITY, which resets all transformations in parent space (position, rotation, and scale).
m.Node3D.set_ignore_transform_notification: If true, the node will not receive NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED or NOTIFICATION_LOCAL_TRANSFORM_CHANGED.
