m.PhysicsMaterial.absorbent: If true, subtracts the bounciness from the colliding object's bounciness instead of adding it.
m.PhysicsMaterial.bounce: The body's bounciness. Values range from 0 (no bounce) to 1 (full bounciness).
m.PhysicsMaterial.friction: The body's friction. Values range from 0 (frictionless) to 1 (maximum friction).
m.PhysicsMaterial.rough: If true, the physics engine will use the friction of the object marked as "rough" when two objects collide. If false, the physics engine will use the lowest friction of all colliding objects instead. If true for both colliding objects, the physics engine will use the highest friction.
m.PhysicsPointQueryParameters2D.canvas_ins: If different from 0, restricts the query to a specific canvas layer specified by its instance ID. See Object.get_instance_id().
m.PhysicsPointQueryParameters2D.collide_wi: If true, the query will take Area2Ds into account.
If true, the query will take PhysicsBody2Ds into account.
m.PhysicsPointQueryParameters2D.collision_: The physics layers the query will detect (as a bitmask). By default, all collision layers are detected. See Collision layers and masks in the documentation for more information.
m.PhysicsPointQueryParameters2D.exclude: The list of object RIDs that will be excluded from collisions. Use CollisionObject2D.get_rid() to get the RID associated with a CollisionObject2D-derived node.
m.PhysicsPointQueryParameters2D.position: The position being queried for, in global coordinates.
m.PhysicsPointQueryParameters3D.collide_wi: If true, the query will take Area3Ds into account.
If true, the query will take PhysicsBody3Ds into account.
m.PhysicsPointQueryParameters3D.collision_: The physics layers the query will detect (as a bitmask). By default, all collision layers are detected. See Collision layers and masks in the documentation for more information.
m.PhysicsPointQueryParameters3D.exclude: The list of object RIDs that will be excluded from collisions. Use CollisionObject3D.get_rid() to get the RID associated with a CollisionObject3D-derived node.
m.PhysicsPointQueryParameters3D.position: The position being queried for, in global coordinates.
m.PhysicsRayQueryParameters2D.collide_with: If true, the query will take Area2Ds into account.
If true, the query will take PhysicsBody2Ds into account.
m.PhysicsRayQueryParameters2D.collision_ma: The physics layers the query will detect (as a bitmask). By default, all collision layers are detected. See Collision layers and masks in the documentation for more information.
m.PhysicsRayQueryParameters2D.create: Returns a new, pre-configured PhysicsRayQueryParameters2D object. Use it to quickly create query parameters using the most common options.
m.PhysicsRayQueryParameters2D.exclude: The list of object RIDs that will be excluded from collisions. Use CollisionObject2D.get_rid() to get the RID associated with a CollisionObject2D-derived node.
m.PhysicsRayQueryParameters2D.from: The starting point of the ray being queried for, in global coordinates.
m.PhysicsRayQueryParameters2D.hit_from_ins: If true, the query will detect a hit when starting inside shapes. In this case the collision normal will be Vector2(0, 0). Does not affect concave polygon shapes.
m.PhysicsRayQueryParameters2D.to: The ending point of the ray being queried for, in global coordinates.
m.PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.collide_with: If true, the query will take Area3Ds into account.
If true, the query will take PhysicsBody3Ds into account.
m.PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.collision_ma: The physics layers the query will detect (as a bitmask). By default, all collision layers are detected. See Collision layers and masks in the documentation for more information.
m.PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create: Returns a new, pre-configured PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D object. Use it to quickly create query parameters using the most common options.
m.PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.exclude: The list of object RIDs that will be excluded from collisions. Use CollisionObject3D.get_rid() to get the RID associated with a CollisionObject3D-derived node.
m.PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.from: The starting point of the ray being queried for, in global coordinates.
m.PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.hit_back_fac: If true, the query will hit back faces with concave polygon shapes with back face enabled or heightmap shapes.
m.PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.hit_from_ins: If true, the query will detect a hit when starting inside shapes. In this case the collision normal will be Vector3(0, 0, 0). Does not affect concave polygon shapes or heightmap shapes.
m.PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.to: The ending point of the ray being queried for, in global coordinates.
m.PhysicsServer2D.AREA_BODY_ADDED: The value of the first parameter and area callback function receives, when an object enters one of its shapes.
m.PhysicsServer2D.AREA_BODY_REMOVED: The value of the first parameter and area callback function receives, when an object exits one of its shapes.
m.PhysicsServer2D.AREA_PARAM_ANGULAR_DAMP: Constant to set/get the angular damping factor of an area. The default value of this parameter is 1.0.
m.PhysicsServer2D.AREA_PARAM_ANGULAR_DAMP_: Constant to set/get angular damping override mode in an area. See AreaSpaceOverrideMode for possible values. The default value of this parameter is AREA_SPACE_OVERRIDE_DISABLED.
m.PhysicsServer2D.AREA_PARAM_GRAVITY: Constant to set/get gravity strength in an area. The default value of this parameter is 9.80665.
m.PhysicsServer2D.AREA_PARAM_GRAVITY_IS_PO: Constant to set/get whether the gravity vector of an area is a direction, or a center point. The default value of this parameter is false.
m.PhysicsServer2D.AREA_PARAM_GRAVITY_OVERR: Constant to set/get gravity override mode in an area. See AreaSpaceOverrideMode for possible values. The default value of this parameter is AREA_SPACE_OVERRIDE_DISABLED.
m.PhysicsServer2D.AREA_PARAM_GRAVITY_POINT: Constant to set/get the distance at which the gravity strength is equal to the gravity controlled by AREA_PARAM_GRAVITY. For example, on a planet 100 pixels in radius with a surface gravity of 4.0 px/s², set the gravity to 4.0 and the unit distance to 100.0. The gravity will have falloff according to the inverse square law, so in the example, at 200 pixels from the center the gravity will be 1.0…
m.PhysicsServer2D.AREA_PARAM_GRAVITY_VECTO: Constant to set/get gravity vector/center in an area. The default value of this parameter is Vector2(0, -1).
m.PhysicsServer2D.AREA_PARAM_LINEAR_DAMP: Constant to set/get the linear damping factor of an area. The default value of this parameter is 0.1.
m.PhysicsServer2D.AREA_PARAM_LINEAR_DAMP_O: Constant to set/get linear damping override mode in an area. See AreaSpaceOverrideMode for possible values. The default value of this parameter is AREA_SPACE_OVERRIDE_DISABLED.
m.PhysicsServer2D.AREA_PARAM_PRIORITY: Constant to set/get the priority (order of processing) of an area. The default value of this parameter is 0.
m.PhysicsServer2D.AREA_SPACE_OVERRIDE_COMB: This area adds its gravity/damp values to whatever has been calculated so far. This way, many overlapping areas can combine their physics to make interesting effects.
This area adds its gravity/damp values to whatever has been calculated so far. Then stops taking into account the rest of the areas, even the default one.
m.PhysicsServer2D.AREA_SPACE_OVERRIDE_DISA: This area does not affect gravity/damp. These are generally areas that exist only to detect collisions, and objects entering or exiting them.
m.PhysicsServer2D.AREA_SPACE_OVERRIDE_REPL: This area replaces any gravity/damp, even the default one, and stops taking into account the rest of the areas.
This area replaces any gravity/damp calculated so far, but keeps calculating the rest of the areas, down to the default one.
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_DAMP_MODE_COMBINE: The body's damping value is added to any value set in areas or the default value.
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_DAMP_MODE_REPLACE: The body's damping value replaces any value set in areas or the default value.
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_MODE_KINEMATIC: Constant for kinematic bodies. In this mode, a body can be only moved by user code and collides with other bodies along its path.
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_MODE_RIGID: Constant for rigid bodies. In this mode, a body can be pushed by other bodies and has forces applied.
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_MODE_RIGID_LINEAR: Constant for linear rigid bodies. In this mode, a body can not rotate, and only its linear velocity is affected by external forces.
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_MODE_STATIC: Constant for static bodies. In this mode, a body can be only moved by user code and doesn't collide with other bodies along its path when moved.
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_PARAM_ANGULAR_DAMP: Constant to set/get a body's angular damping factor. The default value of this parameter is 0.0.
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_PARAM_ANGULAR_DAMP_: Constant to set/get a body's angular damping mode. See BodyDampMode for possible values. The default value of this parameter is BODY_DAMP_MODE_COMBINE.
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_PARAM_BOUNCE: Constant to set/get a body's bounce factor. The default value of this parameter is 0.0.
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_PARAM_CENTER_OF_MAS: Constant to set/get a body's center of mass position in the body's local coordinate system. The default value of this parameter is Vector2(0, 0). If this parameter is never set explicitly, then it is recalculated based on the body's shapes when setting the parameter BODY_PARAM_MASS or when calling body_set_space().
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_PARAM_FRICTION: Constant to set/get a body's friction. The default value of this parameter is 1.0.
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_PARAM_GRAVITY_SCALE: Constant to set/get a body's gravity multiplier. The default value of this parameter is 1.0.
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_PARAM_INERTIA: Constant to set/get a body's inertia. The default value of this parameter is 0.0. If the body's inertia is set to a value <= 0.0, then the inertia will be recalculated based on the body's shapes, mass, and center of mass.
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_PARAM_LINEAR_DAMP: Constant to set/get a body's linear damping factor. The default value of this parameter is 0.0.
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_PARAM_LINEAR_DAMP_M: Constant to set/get a body's linear damping mode. See BodyDampMode for possible values. The default value of this parameter is BODY_DAMP_MODE_COMBINE.
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_PARAM_MASS: Constant to set/get a body's mass. The default value of this parameter is 1.0. If the body's mode is set to BODY_MODE_RIGID, then setting this parameter will have the following additional effects:
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_PARAM_MAX: Represents the size of the BodyParameter enum.
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_STATE_ANGULAR_VELOC: Constant to set/get the current angular velocity of the body.
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_STATE_CAN_SLEEP: Constant to set/get whether the body can sleep.
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_STATE_LINEAR_VELOCI: Constant to set/get the current linear velocity of the body.
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_STATE_SLEEPING: Constant to sleep/wake up a body, or to get whether it is sleeping.
m.PhysicsServer2D.BODY_STATE_TRANSFORM: Constant to set/get the current transform matrix of the body.
m.PhysicsServer2D.CCD_MODE_CAST_RAY: Enables continuous collision detection by raycasting. It is faster than shapecasting, but less precise.
m.PhysicsServer2D.CCD_MODE_CAST_SHAPE: Enables continuous collision detection by shapecasting. It is the slowest CCD method, and the most precise.
m.PhysicsServer2D.CCD_MODE_DISABLED: Disables continuous collision detection. This is the fastest way to detect body collisions, but it can miss small and/or fast-moving objects.
m.PhysicsServer2D.DAMPED_SPRING_DAMPING: Sets the damping ratio of the spring joint. A value of 0 indicates an undamped spring, while 1 causes the system to reach equilibrium as fast as possible (critical damping). The default value of this parameter is 1.5.
m.PhysicsServer2D.DAMPED_SPRING_REST_LENGT: Sets the resting length of the spring joint. The joint will always try to go to back this length when pulled apart. The default value of this parameter is the distance between the joint's anchor points.
m.PhysicsServer2D.DAMPED_SPRING_STIFFNESS: Sets the stiffness of the spring joint. The joint applies a force equal to the stiffness times the distance from its resting length. The default value of this parameter is 20.0.
m.PhysicsServer2D.INFO_ACTIVE_OBJECTS: Constant to get the number of objects that are not sleeping.
m.PhysicsServer2D.INFO_COLLISION_PAIRS: Constant to get the number of possible collisions.
m.PhysicsServer2D.INFO_ISLAND_COUNT: Constant to get the number of space regions where a collision could occur.
m.PhysicsServer2D.JOINT_PARAM_BIAS: Constant to set/get how fast the joint pulls the bodies back to satisfy the joint constraint. The lower the value, the more the two bodies can pull on the joint. The default value of this parameter is 0.0.
m.PhysicsServer2D.JOINT_PARAM_MAX_BIAS: Constant to set/get the maximum speed with which the joint can apply corrections. The default value of this parameter is 3.40282e+38.
m.PhysicsServer2D.JOINT_PARAM_MAX_FORCE: Constant to set/get the maximum force that the joint can use to act on the two bodies. The default value of this parameter is 3.40282e+38.
m.PhysicsServer2D.JOINT_TYPE_DAMPED_SPRING: Constant to create damped spring joints.
m.PhysicsServer2D.JOINT_TYPE_MAX: Represents the size of the JointType enum.
m.PhysicsServer2D.PIN_JOINT_FLAG_ANGULAR_L: If true, the pin has a maximum and a minimum rotation.
m.PhysicsServer2D.PIN_JOINT_FLAG_MOTOR_ENA: If true, a motor turns the pin.
m.PhysicsServer2D.PIN_JOINT_LIMIT_LOWER: The minimum rotation around the pin.
m.PhysicsServer2D.PIN_JOINT_LIMIT_UPPER: The maximum rotation around the pin.
m.PhysicsServer2D.PIN_JOINT_MOTOR_TARGET_V: Target speed for the motor. In radians per second.
m.PhysicsServer2D.PIN_JOINT_SOFTNESS: Constant to set/get a how much the bond of the pin joint can flex. The default value of this parameter is 0.0.
m.PhysicsServer2D.SHAPE_CAPSULE: This is the constant for creating capsule shapes. A capsule shape is defined by a radius and a length. It can be used for intersections and inside/outside checks.
m.PhysicsServer2D.SHAPE_CIRCLE: This is the constant for creating circle shapes. A circle shape only has a radius. It can be used for intersections and inside/outside checks.
m.PhysicsServer2D.SHAPE_CONCAVE_POLYGON: This is the constant for creating concave polygon shapes. A polygon is defined by a list of points. It can be used for intersections checks, but not for inside/outside checks.
m.PhysicsServer2D.SHAPE_CONVEX_POLYGON: This is the constant for creating convex polygon shapes. A polygon is defined by a list of points. It can be used for intersections and inside/outside checks.
m.PhysicsServer2D.SHAPE_CUSTOM: This constant is used internally by the engine. Any attempt to create this kind of shape results in an error.
m.PhysicsServer2D.SHAPE_RECTANGLE: This is the constant for creating rectangle shapes. A rectangle shape is defined by a width and a height. It can be used for intersections and inside/outside checks.
m.PhysicsServer2D.SHAPE_SEGMENT: This is the constant for creating segment shapes. A segment shape is a finite line from a point A to a point B. It can be checked for intersections.
m.PhysicsServer2D.SHAPE_SEPARATION_RAY: This is the constant for creating separation ray shapes. A separation ray is defined by a length and separates itself from what is touching its far endpoint. Useful for character controllers.
m.PhysicsServer2D.SHAPE_WORLD_BOUNDARY: This is the constant for creating world boundary shapes. A world boundary shape is an infinite line with an origin point, and a normal. Thus, it can be used for front/behind checks.
m.PhysicsServer2D.SPACE_PARAM_BODY_ANGULAR: Constant to set/get the threshold angular velocity of activity. A body marked as potentially inactive for both linear and angular velocity will be put to sleep after the time given. The default value of this parameter is ProjectSettings.physics/2d/sleep_threshold_angular.
m.PhysicsServer2D.SPACE_PARAM_BODY_LINEAR_: Constant to set/get the threshold linear velocity of activity. A body marked as potentially inactive for both linear and angular velocity will be put to sleep after the time given. The default value of this parameter is ProjectSettings.physics/2d/sleep_threshold_linear.
m.PhysicsServer2D.SPACE_PARAM_BODY_TIME_TO: Constant to set/get the maximum time of activity. A body marked as potentially inactive for both linear and angular velocity will be put to sleep after this time. The default value of this parameter is ProjectSettings.physics/2d/time_before_sleep.
m.PhysicsServer2D.SPACE_PARAM_CONSTRAINT_D: Constant to set/get the default solver bias for all physics constraints. A solver bias is a factor controlling how much two objects "rebound", after violating a constraint, to avoid leaving them in that state because of numerical imprecision. The default value of this parameter is ProjectSettings.physics/2d/solver/default_constraint_bias.
m.PhysicsServer2D.SPACE_PARAM_CONTACT_DEFA: Constant to set/get the default solver bias for all physics contacts. A solver bias is a factor controlling how much two objects "rebound", after overlapping, to avoid leaving them in that state because of numerical imprecision. The default value of this parameter is ProjectSettings.physics/2d/solver/default_contact_bias.
m.PhysicsServer2D.SPACE_PARAM_CONTACT_MAX_: Constant to set/get the maximum distance a shape can penetrate another shape before it is considered a collision. The default value of this parameter is ProjectSettings.physics/2d/solver/contact_max_allowed_penetration.

Constant to set/get the maximum distance a shape can be from another before they are considered separated and the contact is discarded. The default value of this parameter is ProjectSettings.physics/2d/solver/contact_max_separation.
m.PhysicsServer2D.SPACE_PARAM_CONTACT_RECY: Constant to set/get the maximum distance a pair of bodies has to move before their collision status has to be recalculated. The default value of this parameter is ProjectSettings.physics/2d/solver/contact_recycle_radius.
m.PhysicsServer2D.SPACE_PARAM_SOLVER_ITERA: Constant to set/get the number of solver iterations for all contacts and constraints. The greater the number of iterations, the more accurate the collisions will be. However, a greater number of iterations requires more CPU power, which can decrease performance. The default value of this parameter is ProjectSettings.physics/2d/solver/solver_iterations.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_add_shape: Adds a shape to the area, with the given local transform. The shape (together with its transform and disabled properties) is added to an array of shapes, and the shapes of an area are usually referenced by their index in this array.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_attach_canvas_insta: Attaches the ObjectID of a canvas to the area. Use Object.get_instance_id() to get the ObjectID of a CanvasLayer.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_attach_object_insta: Attaches the ObjectID of an Object to the area. Use Object.get_instance_id() to get the ObjectID of a CollisionObject2D.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_clear_shapes: Removes all shapes from the area. This does not delete the shapes themselves, so they can continue to be used elsewhere or added back later.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_create: Creates a 2D area object in the physics server, and returns the RID that identifies it. The default settings for the created area include a collision layer and mask set to 1, and monitorable set to false.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_get_canvas_instance: Returns the ObjectID of the canvas attached to the area. Use @GlobalScope.instance_from_id() to retrieve a CanvasLayer from a nonzero ObjectID.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_get_collision_layer: Returns the physics layer or layers the area belongs to, as a bitmask.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_get_collision_mask: Returns the physics layer or layers the area can contact with, as a bitmask.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_get_object_instance: Returns the ObjectID attached to the area. Use @GlobalScope.instance_from_id() to retrieve an Object from a nonzero ObjectID.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_get_param: Returns the value of the given area parameter.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_get_shape: Returns the RID of the shape with the given index in the area's array of shapes.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_get_shape_count: Returns the number of shapes added to the area.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_get_shape_transform: Returns the local transform matrix of the shape with the given index in the area's array of shapes.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_get_space: Returns the RID of the space assigned to the area. Returns an empty RID if no space is assigned.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_get_transform: Returns the transform matrix of the area.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_remove_shape: Removes the shape with the given index from the area's array of shapes. The shape itself is not deleted, so it can continue to be used elsewhere or added back later. As a result of this operation, the area's shapes which used to have indices higher than shape_idx will have their index decreased by one.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_set_area_monitor_ca: Sets the area's area monitor callback. This callback will be called when any other (shape of an) area enters or exits (a shape of) the given area, and must take the following five parameters:
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_set_collision_layer: Assigns the area to one or many physics layers, via a bitmask.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_set_collision_mask: Sets which physics layers the area will monitor, via a bitmask.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_set_monitor_callbac: Sets the area's body monitor callback. This callback will be called when any other (shape of a) body enters or exits (a shape of) the given area, and must take the following five parameters:
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_set_monitorable: Sets whether the area is monitorable or not. If monitorable is true, the area monitoring callback of other areas will be called when this area enters or exits them.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_set_param: Sets the value of the given area parameter.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_set_shape: Replaces the area's shape at the given index by another shape, while not affecting the transform and disabled properties at the same index.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_set_shape_disabled: Sets the disabled property of the area's shape with the given index. If disabled is true, then the shape will not detect any other shapes entering or exiting it.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_set_shape_transform: Sets the local transform matrix of the area's shape with the given index.
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_set_space: Adds the area to the given space, after removing the area from the previously assigned space (if any).
m.PhysicsServer2D.area_set_transform: Sets the transform matrix of the area.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_add_collision_excep: Adds excepted_body to the body's list of collision exceptions, so that collisions with it are ignored.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_add_constant_centra: Adds a constant directional force to the body. The force does not affect rotation. The force remains applied over time until cleared with PhysicsServer2D.body_set_constant_force(body, Vector2(0, 0)).
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_add_constant_force: Adds a constant positioned force to the body. The force can affect rotation if position is different from the body's center of mass. The force remains applied over time until cleared with PhysicsServer2D.body_set_constant_force(body, Vector2(0, 0)).
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_add_constant_torque: Adds a constant rotational force to the body. The force does not affect position. The force remains applied over time until cleared with PhysicsServer2D.body_set_constant_torque(body, 0).
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_add_shape: Adds a shape to the area, with the given local transform. The shape (together with its transform and disabled properties) is added to an array of shapes, and the shapes of a body are usually referenced by their index in this array.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_apply_central_force: Applies a directional force to the body, at the body's center of mass. The force does not affect rotation. A force is time dependent and meant to be applied every physics update.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_apply_central_impul: Applies a directional impulse to the body, at the body's center of mass. The impulse does not affect rotation.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_apply_force: Applies a positioned force to the body. The force can affect rotation if position is different from the body's center of mass. A force is time dependent and meant to be applied every physics update.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_apply_impulse: Applies a positioned impulse to the body. The impulse can affect rotation if position is different from the body's center of mass.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_apply_torque: Applies a rotational force to the body. The force does not affect position. A force is time dependent and meant to be applied every physics update.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_apply_torque_impuls: Applies a rotational impulse to the body. The impulse does not affect position.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_attach_canvas_insta: Attaches the ObjectID of a canvas to the body. Use Object.get_instance_id() to get the ObjectID of a CanvasLayer.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_attach_object_insta: Attaches the ObjectID of an Object to the body. Use Object.get_instance_id() to get the ObjectID of a CollisionObject2D.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_clear_shapes: Removes all shapes from the body. This does not delete the shapes themselves, so they can continue to be used elsewhere or added back later.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_create: Creates a 2D body object in the physics server, and returns the RID that identifies it. The default settings for the created area include a collision layer and mask set to 1, and body mode set to BODY_MODE_RIGID.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_get_canvas_instance: Returns the ObjectID of the canvas attached to the body. Use @GlobalScope.instance_from_id() to retrieve a CanvasLayer from a nonzero ObjectID.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_get_collision_layer: Returns the physics layer or layers the body belongs to, as a bitmask.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_get_collision_mask: Returns the physics layer or layers the body can collide with, as a bitmask.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_get_collision_prior: Returns the body's collision priority. This is used in the depenetration phase of body_test_motion(). The higher the priority is, the lower the penetration into the body will be.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_get_constant_force: Returns the body's total constant positional force applied during each physics update.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_get_constant_torque: Returns the body's total constant rotational force applied during each physics update.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_get_continuous_coll: Returns the body's continuous collision detection mode.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_get_direct_state: Returns the PhysicsDirectBodyState2D of the body. Returns null if the body is destroyed or not assigned to a space.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_get_max_contacts_re: Returns the maximum number of contacts that the body can report. See body_set_max_contacts_reported().
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_get_object_instance: Returns the ObjectID attached to the body. Use @GlobalScope.instance_from_id() to retrieve an Object from a nonzero ObjectID.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_get_param: Returns the value of the given body parameter.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_get_shape: Returns the RID of the shape with the given index in the body's array of shapes.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_get_shape_count: Returns the number of shapes added to the body.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_get_shape_transform: Returns the local transform matrix of the shape with the given index in the area's array of shapes.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_get_space: Returns the RID of the space assigned to the body. Returns an empty RID if no space is assigned.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_get_state: Returns the value of the given state of the body.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_is_omitting_force_i: Returns true if the body is omitting the standard force integration. See body_set_omit_force_integration().
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_remove_collision_ex: Removes excepted_body from the body's list of collision exceptions, so that collisions with it are no longer ignored.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_remove_shape: Removes the shape with the given index from the body's array of shapes. The shape itself is not deleted, so it can continue to be used elsewhere or added back later. As a result of this operation, the body's shapes which used to have indices higher than shape_idx will have their index decreased by one.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_reset_mass_properti: Restores the default inertia and center of mass of the body based on its shapes. This undoes any custom values previously set using body_set_param().
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_set_axis_velocity: Modifies the body's linear velocity so that its projection to the axis axis_velocity.normalized() is exactly axis_velocity.length(). This is useful for jumping behavior.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_set_collision_layer: Sets the physics layer or layers the body belongs to, via a bitmask.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_set_collision_mask: Sets the physics layer or layers the body can collide with, via a bitmask.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_set_collision_prior: Sets the body's collision priority. This is used in the depenetration phase of body_test_motion(). The higher the priority is, the lower the penetration into the body will be.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_set_constant_force: Sets the body's total constant positional force applied during each physics update.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_set_constant_torque: Sets the body's total constant rotational force applied during each physics update.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_set_continuous_coll: Sets the continuous collision detection mode.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_set_force_integrati: Sets the body's custom force integration callback function to callable. Use an empty Callable (Callable()) to clear the custom callback.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_set_max_contacts_re: Sets the maximum number of contacts that the body can report. If amount is greater than zero, then the body will keep track of at most this many contacts with other bodies.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_set_omit_force_inte: Sets whether the body omits the standard force integration. If enable is true, the body will not automatically use applied forces, torques, and damping to update the body's linear and angular velocity. In this case, body_set_force_integration_callback() can be used to manually update the linear and angular velocity instead.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_set_param: Sets the value of the given body parameter.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_set_shape: Replaces the body's shape at the given index by another shape, while not affecting the transform, disabled, and one-way collision properties at the same index.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_set_shape_as_one_wa: Sets the one-way collision properties of the body's shape with the given index. If enable is true, the one-way collision direction given by direction in the shape's local space (that is body_get_shape_transform(body, shape_idx).basis_xform(direction).normalized() in the body's local space) will be used to ignore collisions with the shape in the opposite direction, and to ensure depenetration of k…
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_set_shape_disabled: Sets the disabled property of the body's shape with the given index. If disabled is true, then the shape will be ignored in all collision detection.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_set_shape_transform: Sets the local transform matrix of the body's shape with the given index.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_set_space: Adds the body to the given space, after removing the body from the previously assigned space (if any). If the body's mode is set to BODY_MODE_RIGID, then adding the body to a space will have the following additional effects:
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_set_state: Sets the value of a body's state.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_set_state_sync_call: Sets the body's state synchronization callback function to callable. Use an empty Callable (Callable()) to clear the callback.
m.PhysicsServer2D.body_test_motion: Returns true if a collision would result from moving the body along a motion vector from a given point in space. See PhysicsTestMotionParameters2D for the available motion parameters. Optionally a PhysicsTestMotionResult2D object can be passed, which will be used to store the information about the resulting collision.
m.PhysicsServer2D.capsule_shape_create: Creates a 2D capsule shape in the physics server, and returns the RID that identifies it. Use shape_set_data() to set the capsule's height and radius.
m.PhysicsServer2D.circle_shape_create: Creates a 2D circle shape in the physics server, and returns the RID that identifies it. Use shape_set_data() to set the circle's radius.
m.PhysicsServer2D.concave_polygon_shape_cr: Creates a 2D concave polygon shape in the physics server, and returns the RID that identifies it. Use shape_set_data() to set the concave polygon's segments.
m.PhysicsServer2D.convex_polygon_shape_cre: Creates a 2D convex polygon shape in the physics server, and returns the RID that identifies it. Use shape_set_data() to set the convex polygon's points.
m.PhysicsServer2D.damped_spring_joint_get_: Returns the value of the given damped spring joint parameter.
m.PhysicsServer2D.damped_spring_joint_set_: Sets the value of the given damped spring joint parameter.
m.PhysicsServer2D.free_rid: Destroys any of the objects created by PhysicsServer2D. If the RID passed is not one of the objects that can be created by PhysicsServer2D, an error will be printed to the console.
m.PhysicsServer2D.get_process_info: Returns the value of a physics engine state specified by process_info.
m.PhysicsServer2D.joint_clear: Destroys the joint with the given RID, creates a new uninitialized joint, and makes the RID refer to this new joint.
m.PhysicsServer2D.joint_create: Creates a 2D joint in the physics server, and returns the RID that identifies it. To set the joint type, use joint_make_damped_spring(), joint_make_groove() or joint_make_pin(). Use joint_set_param() to set generic joint parameters.
m.PhysicsServer2D.joint_disable_collisions: Sets whether the bodies attached to the Joint2D will collide with each other.
m.PhysicsServer2D.joint_get_param: Returns the value of the given joint parameter.
m.PhysicsServer2D.joint_is_disabled_collis: Returns whether the bodies attached to the Joint2D will collide with each other.
m.PhysicsServer2D.joint_make_damped_spring: Makes the joint a damped spring joint, attached at the point anchor_a (given in global coordinates) on the body body_a and at the point anchor_b (given in global coordinates) on the body body_b. To set the parameters which are specific to the damped spring, see damped_spring_joint_set_param().
m.PhysicsServer2D.joint_make_groove: Makes the joint a groove joint.
m.PhysicsServer2D.joint_make_pin: Makes the joint a pin joint. If body_b is an empty RID, then body_a is pinned to the point anchor (given in global coordinates); otherwise, body_a is pinned to body_b at the point anchor (given in global coordinates). To set the parameters which are specific to the pin joint, see pin_joint_set_param().
m.PhysicsServer2D.joint_set_param: Sets the value of the given joint parameter.
m.PhysicsServer2D.pin_joint_get_param: Returns the value of a pin joint parameter.
m.PhysicsServer2D.rectangle_shape_create: Creates a 2D rectangle shape in the physics server, and returns the RID that identifies it. Use shape_set_data() to set the rectangle's half-extents.
m.PhysicsServer2D.segment_shape_create: Creates a 2D segment shape in the physics server, and returns the RID that identifies it. Use shape_set_data() to set the segment's start and end points.
m.PhysicsServer2D.separation_ray_shape_cre: Creates a 2D separation ray shape in the physics server, and returns the RID that identifies it. Use shape_set_data() to set the shape's length and slide_on_slope properties.
m.PhysicsServer2D.set_active: Activates or deactivates the 2D physics server. If active is false, then the physics server will not do anything in its physics step.
m.PhysicsServer2D.shape_get_data: Returns the shape data that defines the configuration of the shape, such as the half-extents of a rectangle or the segments of a concave shape. See shape_set_data() for the precise format of this data in each case.
m.PhysicsServer2D.shape_set_data: Sets the shape data that defines the configuration of the shape. The data to be passed depends on the shape's type (see shape_get_type()):
m.PhysicsServer2D.space_create: Creates a 2D space in the physics server, and returns the RID that identifies it. A space contains bodies and areas, and controls the stepping of the physics simulation of the objects in it.
m.PhysicsServer2D.space_get_direct_state: Returns the state of a space, a PhysicsDirectSpaceState2D. This object can be used for collision/intersection queries.
m.PhysicsServer2D.space_get_param: Returns the value of the given space parameter.
m.PhysicsServer2D.space_is_active: Returns true if the space is active.
m.PhysicsServer2D.space_set_active: Activates or deactivates the space. If active is false, then the physics server will not do anything with this space in its physics step.
m.PhysicsServer2D.space_set_param: Sets the value of the given space parameter.
m.PhysicsServer2D.world_boundary_shape_cre: Creates a 2D world boundary shape in the physics server, and returns the RID that identifies it. Use shape_set_data() to set the shape's normal direction and distance properties.
m.PhysicsServer2DExtension._area_set_picka: If set to true, allows the area with the given RID to detect mouse inputs when the mouse cursor is hovering on it.
m.PhysicsServer2DExtension._body_collide_s: Given a body, a shape, and their respective parameters, this method should return true if a collision between the two would occur, with additional details passed in r_results.
m.PhysicsServer2DExtension._body_get_colli: Returns the RIDs of all bodies added as collision exceptions for the given body. See also _body_add_collision_exception() and _body_remove_collision_exception().
m.PhysicsServer2DExtension._body_get_conta: Overridable version of PhysicsServer2D's internal body_get_contacts_reported_depth_threshold method.
m.PhysicsServer2DExtension._body_set_conta: Overridable version of PhysicsServer2D's internal body_set_contacts_reported_depth_threshold method.
m.PhysicsServer2DExtension._body_set_picka: If set to true, allows the body with the given RID to detect mouse inputs when the mouse cursor is hovering on it.
m.PhysicsServer2DExtension._body_set_state: Assigns the body to call the given callable during the synchronization phase of the loop, before _step() is called. See also _sync().
m.PhysicsServer2DExtension._body_test_moti: Overridable version of PhysicsServer2D.body_test_motion(). Unlike the exposed implementation, this method does not receive all of the arguments inside a PhysicsTestMotionParameters2D.
m.PhysicsServer2DExtension._end_sync: Called to indicate that the physics server has stopped synchronizing. It is in the loop's iteration/physics phase, and can access physics objects even if running on a separate thread. See also _sync().
m.PhysicsServer2DExtension._finish: Called when the main loop finalizes to shut down the physics server. See also MainLoop._finalize() and _init().
m.PhysicsServer2DExtension._flush_queries: Called every physics step before _step() to process all remaining queries.
m.PhysicsServer2DExtension._init: Called when the main loop is initialized and creates a new instance of this physics server. See also MainLoop._initialize() and _finish().
m.PhysicsServer2DExtension._is_flushing_qu: Overridable method that should return true when the physics server is processing queries. See also _flush_queries().
m.PhysicsServer2DExtension._shape_collide: Given two shapes and their parameters, should return true if a collision between the two would occur, with additional details passed in r_results.
m.PhysicsServer2DExtension._shape_get_cust: Should return the custom solver bias of the given shape, which defines how much bodies are forced to separate on contact when this shape is involved.
m.PhysicsServer2DExtension._shape_set_cust: Should set the custom solver bias for the given shape. It defines how much bodies are forced to separate on contact.
m.PhysicsServer2DExtension._space_get_cont: Should return how many contacts have occurred during the last physics step in the given space. See also _space_get_contacts() and _space_set_debug_contacts().
Should return the positions of all contacts that have occurred during the last physics step in the given space. See also _space_get_contact_count() and _space_set_debug_contacts().
m.PhysicsServer2DExtension._space_set_debu: Used internally to allow the given space to store contact points, up to max_contacts. This is automatically set for the main World2D's space when SceneTree.debug_collisions_hint is true, or by checking "Visible Collision Shapes" in the editor. Only works in debug builds.
m.PhysicsServer2DExtension._step: Called every physics step to process the physics simulation. step is the time elapsed since the last physics step, in seconds. It is usually the same as the value returned by Node.get_physics_process_delta_time().
m.PhysicsServer2DExtension._sync: Called to indicate that the physics server is synchronizing and cannot access physics states if running on a separate thread. See also _end_sync().
m.PhysicsServer2DExtension.body_test_motio: Returns true if the body with the given RID is being excluded from _body_test_motion(). See also Object.get_instance_id().
Returns true if the object with the given instance ID is being excluded from _body_test_motion(). See also Object.get_instance_id().
m.PhysicsServer2DManager.register_server: Register a PhysicsServer2D implementation by passing a name and a Callable that returns a PhysicsServer2D object.
m.PhysicsServer2DManager.set_default_serve: Set the default PhysicsServer2D implementation to the one identified by name, if priority is greater than the priority of the current default implementation.
m.PhysicsServer3D.AREA_BODY_ADDED: The value of the first parameter and area callback function receives, when an object enters one of its shapes.
m.PhysicsServer3D.AREA_BODY_REMOVED: The value of the first parameter and area callback function receives, when an object exits one of its shapes.
m.PhysicsServer3D.AREA_PARAM_ANGULAR_DAMP: Constant to set/get the angular damping factor of an area.
m.PhysicsServer3D.AREA_PARAM_ANGULAR_DAMP_: Constant to set/get angular damping override mode in an area. See AreaSpaceOverrideMode for possible values.
m.PhysicsServer3D.AREA_PARAM_GRAVITY: Constant to set/get gravity strength in an area.
m.PhysicsServer3D.AREA_PARAM_GRAVITY_IS_PO: Constant to set/get whether the gravity vector of an area is a direction, or a center point.
m.PhysicsServer3D.AREA_PARAM_GRAVITY_OVERR: Constant to set/get gravity override mode in an area. See AreaSpaceOverrideMode for possible values.
m.PhysicsServer3D.AREA_PARAM_GRAVITY_POINT: Constant to set/get the distance at which the gravity strength is equal to the gravity controlled by AREA_PARAM_GRAVITY. For example, on a planet 100 meters in radius with a surface gravity of 4.0 m/s², set the gravity to 4.0 and the unit distance to 100.0. The gravity will have falloff according to the inverse square law, so in the example, at 200 meters from the center the gravity will be 1.0 m…
m.PhysicsServer3D.AREA_PARAM_GRAVITY_VECTO: Constant to set/get gravity vector/center in an area.
m.PhysicsServer3D.AREA_PARAM_LINEAR_DAMP: Constant to set/get the linear damping factor of an area.
m.PhysicsServer3D.AREA_PARAM_LINEAR_DAMP_O: Constant to set/get linear damping override mode in an area. See AreaSpaceOverrideMode for possible values.
m.PhysicsServer3D.AREA_PARAM_PRIORITY: Constant to set/get the priority (order of processing) of an area.
m.PhysicsServer3D.AREA_PARAM_WIND_ATTENUAT: Constant to set/get the exponential rate at which wind force decreases with distance from its origin.
m.PhysicsServer3D.AREA_PARAM_WIND_DIRECTIO: Constant to set/get the 3D vector that specifies the direction in which an area-specific wind blows.
m.PhysicsServer3D.AREA_PARAM_WIND_FORCE_MA: Constant to set/get the magnitude of area-specific wind force. This wind force only applies to SoftBody3D nodes. Other physics bodies are currently not affected by wind.
m.PhysicsServer3D.AREA_PARAM_WIND_SOURCE: Constant to set/get the 3D vector that specifies the origin from which an area-specific wind blows.
m.PhysicsServer3D.AREA_SPACE_OVERRIDE_COMB: This area adds its gravity/damp values to whatever has been calculated so far. This way, many overlapping areas can combine their physics to make interesting effects.
This area adds its gravity/damp values to whatever has been calculated so far. Then stops taking into account the rest of the areas, even the default one.
m.PhysicsServer3D.AREA_SPACE_OVERRIDE_DISA: This area does not affect gravity/damp. These are generally areas that exist only to detect collisions, and objects entering or exiting them.
m.PhysicsServer3D.AREA_SPACE_OVERRIDE_REPL: This area replaces any gravity/damp, even the default one, and stops taking into account the rest of the areas.
This area replaces any gravity/damp calculated so far, but keeps calculating the rest of the areas, down to the default one.

m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_DAMP_MODE_COMBINE: The body's damping value is added to any value set in areas or the default value.
m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_DAMP_MODE_REPLACE: The body's damping value replaces any value set in areas or the default value.
m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_MODE_KINEMATIC: Constant for kinematic bodies. In this mode, a body can be only moved by user code and collides with other bodies along its path.
m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_MODE_RIGID: Constant for rigid bodies. In this mode, a body can be pushed by other bodies and has forces applied.
m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_MODE_RIGID_LINEAR: Constant for linear rigid bodies. In this mode, a body can not rotate, and only its linear velocity is affected by external forces.
m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_MODE_STATIC: Constant for static bodies. In this mode, a body can be only moved by user code and doesn't collide with other bodies along its path when moved.
m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_PARAM_ANGULAR_DAMP: Constant to set/get a body's angular damping factor.
m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_PARAM_ANGULAR_DAMP_: Constant to set/get a body's angular damping mode. See BodyDampMode for possible values.
m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_PARAM_BOUNCE: Constant to set/get a body's bounce factor.
m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_PARAM_CENTER_OF_MAS: Constant to set/get a body's center of mass position in the body's local coordinate system.
m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_PARAM_FRICTION: Constant to set/get a body's friction.
m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_PARAM_GRAVITY_SCALE: Constant to set/get a body's gravity multiplier.
m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_PARAM_INERTIA: Constant to set/get a body's inertia.
m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_PARAM_LINEAR_DAMP: Constant to set/get a body's linear damping factor.
m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_PARAM_LINEAR_DAMP_M: Constant to set/get a body's linear damping mode. See BodyDampMode for possible values.
m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_PARAM_MASS: Constant to set/get a body's mass.
m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_PARAM_MAX: Represents the size of the BodyParameter enum.
m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_STATE_ANGULAR_VELOC: Constant to set/get the current angular velocity of the body.
m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_STATE_CAN_SLEEP: Constant to set/get whether the body can sleep.
m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_STATE_LINEAR_VELOCI: Constant to set/get the current linear velocity of the body.
m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_STATE_SLEEPING: Constant to sleep/wake up a body, or to get whether it is sleeping.
m.PhysicsServer3D.BODY_STATE_TRANSFORM: Constant to set/get the current transform matrix of the body.
m.PhysicsServer3D.CONE_TWIST_JOINT_BIAS: The speed with which the swing or twist will take place. The higher, the faster.
m.PhysicsServer3D.CONE_TWIST_JOINT_RELAXAT: Defines, how fast the swing- and twist-speed-difference on both sides gets synced.
m.PhysicsServer3D.CONE_TWIST_JOINT_SOFTNES: The ease with which the Joint3D twists, if it's too low, it takes more force to twist the joint.
m.PhysicsServer3D.CONE_TWIST_JOINT_SWING_S: Swing is rotation from side to side, around the axis perpendicular to the twist axis.
m.PhysicsServer3D.CONE_TWIST_JOINT_TWIST_S: Twist is the rotation around the twist axis, this value defined how far the joint can twist. Twist is locked if below 0.05.
m.PhysicsServer3D.G6DOF_JOINT_ANGULAR_DAMP: The amount of rotational damping across the axes. The lower, the more damping occurs.
m.PhysicsServer3D.G6DOF_JOINT_ANGULAR_ERP: When correcting the crossing of limits in rotation across the axes, this error tolerance factor defines how much the correction gets slowed down. The lower, the slower.
m.PhysicsServer3D.G6DOF_JOINT_ANGULAR_FORC: The maximum amount of force that can occur, when rotating around the axes.
m.PhysicsServer3D.G6DOF_JOINT_ANGULAR_LIMI: A factor that gets multiplied onto all rotations across the axes.
m.PhysicsServer3D.G6DOF_JOINT_ANGULAR_LOWE: The minimum rotation in negative direction to break loose and rotate around the axes.
m.PhysicsServer3D.G6DOF_JOINT_ANGULAR_MOTO: Maximum acceleration for the motor at the axes.
Target speed for the motor at the axes.
m.PhysicsServer3D.G6DOF_JOINT_ANGULAR_REST: The amount of rotational restitution across the axes. The lower, the more restitution occurs.

m.PhysicsServer3D.G6DOF_JOINT_ANGULAR_UPPE: The minimum rotation in positive direction to break loose and rotate around the axes.
m.PhysicsServer3D.G6DOF_JOINT_FLAG_ENABLE_: If set, rotational motion is possible.

m.PhysicsServer3D.soft_body_set_state: Sets the given body state for the given body.
m.PhysicsServer3D.soft_body_set_total_mass: Sets the total mass for the given soft body.
m.PhysicsServer3D.soft_body_set_transform: Sets the global transform of the given soft body.
m.PhysicsServer3D.soft_body_update_renderi: Requests that the physics server updates the rendering server with the latest positions of the given soft body's points through the rendering_server_handler interface.
m.PhysicsServer3D.space_create: Creates a space. A space is a collection of parameters for the physics engine that can be assigned to an area or a body. It can be assigned to an area with area_set_space(), or to a body with body_set_space().
m.PhysicsServer3D.space_get_direct_state: Returns the state of a space, a PhysicsDirectSpaceState3D. This object can be used to make collision/intersection queries.
m.PhysicsServer3D.space_get_param: Returns the value of a space parameter.
m.PhysicsServer3D.space_is_active: Returns whether the space is active.
m.PhysicsServer3D.space_set_active: Marks a space as active. It will not have an effect, unless it is assigned to an area or body.
m.PhysicsServer3D.space_set_param: Sets the value for a space parameter. A list of available parameters is on the SpaceParameter constants.
m.PhysicsServer3D.sphere_shape_create: Creates a 3D sphere shape in the physics server, and returns the RID that identifies it. Use shape_set_data() to set the sphere's radius.
m.PhysicsServer3D.world_boundary_shape_cre: Creates a 3D world boundary shape in the physics server, and returns the RID that identifies it. Use shape_set_data() to set the shape's normal direction and distance properties.

m.PinJoint2D.angular_limit_enabled: If true, the pin maximum and minimum rotation, defined by angular_limit_lower and angular_limit_upper are applied.
m.PinJoint2D.angular_limit_lower: The minimum rotation. Only active if angular_limit_enabled is true.
m.PinJoint2D.angular_limit_upper: The maximum rotation. Only active if angular_limit_enabled is true.
m.PinJoint2D.motor_enabled: When activated, a motor turns the pin.
m.PinJoint2D.motor_target_velocity: Target speed for the motor. In radians per second.
m.PinJoint2D.softness: The higher this value, the more the bond to the pinned partner can flex.
m.PinJoint3D.PARAM_BIAS: The force with which the pinned objects stay in positional relation to each other. The higher, the stronger.
m.PinJoint3D.PARAM_DAMPING: The force with which the pinned objects stay in velocity relation to each other. The higher, the stronger.
m.PinJoint3D.PARAM_IMPULSE_CLAMP: If above 0, this value is the maximum value for an impulse that this Joint3D produces.
m.PinJoint3D.get_param: Returns the value of the specified parameter.
m.PinJoint3D.set_param: Sets the value of the specified parameter.
m.PlaceholderMesh.aabb: The smallest AABB enclosing this mesh in local space.
m.PlaceholderTextureLayered.layers: The number of layers in the texture array.
m.PlaceholderTextureLayered.size: The size of each texture layer (in pixels).
m.Plane.PLANE_YZ: A plane that extends in the Y and Z axes (normal vector points +X).
m.Plane.d: The distance from the origin to the plane, expressed in terms of normal (according to its direction and magnitude). Actual absolute distance from the origin to the plane can be calculated as abs(d) / normal.length() (if normal has zero length then this Plane does not represent a valid plane).
m.Plane.distance_to: Returns the shortest distance from the plane to the position point. If the point is above the plane, the distance will be positive. If below, the distance will be negative.
m.Plane.get_center: Returns the center of the plane.
m.Plane.has_point: Returns true if point is inside the plane. Comparison uses a custom minimum tolerance threshold.
m.Plane.intersect_3: Returns the intersection point of the three planes b, c and this plane. If no intersection is found, null is returned.
m.Plane.intersects_ray: Returns the intersection point of a ray consisting of the position from and the direction normal dir with this plane. If no intersection is found, null is returned.
m.Plane.intersects_segment: Returns the intersection point of a segment from position from to position to with this plane. If no intersection is found, null is returned.
m.Plane.is_equal_approx: Returns true if this plane and to_plane are approximately equal, by running @GlobalScope.is_equal_approx() on each component.
m.Plane.is_finite: Returns true if this plane is finite, by calling @GlobalScope.is_finite() on each component.
m.Plane.is_point_over: Returns true if point is located above the plane.
m.Plane.normal: The normal of the plane, typically a unit vector. Shouldn't be a zero vector as Plane with such normal does not represent a valid plane.
m.Plane.normalized: Returns a copy of the plane, with normalized normal (so it's a unit vector). Returns Plane(0, 0, 0, 0) if normal can't be normalized (it has zero length).
m.Plane.project: Returns the orthogonal projection of point into a point in the plane.
m.Plane.x: The X component of the plane's normal vector.
m.Plane.y: The Y component of the plane's normal vector.
m.Plane.z: The Z component of the plane's normal vector.
m.PlaneMesh.FACE_X: PlaneMesh will face the positive X-axis.
m.PlaneMesh.FACE_Y: PlaneMesh will face the positive Y-axis. This matches the behavior of the PlaneMesh in Godot 3.x.
m.PlaneMesh.FACE_Z: PlaneMesh will face the positive Z-axis. This matches the behavior of the QuadMesh in Godot 3.x.
m.PlaneMesh.center_offset: Offset of the generated plane. Useful for particles.
m.PlaneMesh.orientation: Direction that the PlaneMesh is facing.
m.PlaneMesh.subdivide_depth: Number of subdivision along the Z axis.
m.PlaneMesh.subdivide_width: Number of subdivision along the X axis.
m.PointLight2D.height: The height of the light. Used with 2D normal mapping. The units are in pixels, e.g. if the height is 100, then it will illuminate an object 100 pixels away at a 45° angle to the plane.
m.PointLight2D.offset: The offset of the light's texture.
m.PointLight2D.texture: Texture2D used for the light's appearance.
m.Polygon2D.add_bone: Adds a bone with the specified path and weights.
m.Polygon2D.antialiased: If true, polygon edges will be anti-aliased.
m.Polygon2D.clear_bones: Removes all bones from this Polygon2D.
m.Polygon2D.color: The polygon's fill color. If texture is set, it will be multiplied by this color. It will also be the default color for vertices not set in vertex_colors.
m.Polygon2D.erase_bone: Removes the specified bone from this Polygon2D.
m.Polygon2D.get_bone_count: Returns the number of bones in this Polygon2D.
m.Polygon2D.get_bone_path: Returns the path to the node associated with the specified bone.
m.Polygon2D.get_bone_weights: Returns the weight values of the specified bone.
m.Polygon2D.internal_vertex_count: Number of internal vertices, used for UV mapping.
m.Polygon2D.invert_border: Added padding applied to the bounding box when invert_enabled is set to true. Setting this value too small may result in a "Bad Polygon" error.
m.Polygon2D.invert_enabled: If true, the polygon will be inverted, containing the area outside the defined points and extending to the invert_border.
m.Polygon2D.offset: The offset applied to each vertex.
m.Polygon2D.polygon: The polygon's list of vertices. The final point will be connected to the first.
m.Polygon2D.polygons: The list of polygons, in case more than one is being represented. Every individual polygon is stored as a PackedInt32Array where each int is an index to a point in polygon. If empty, this property will be ignored, and the resulting single polygon will be composed of all points in polygon, using the order they are stored in.
m.Polygon2D.set_bone_path: Sets the path to the node associated with the specified bone.
m.Polygon2D.set_bone_weights: Sets the weight values for the specified bone.
m.Polygon2D.skeleton: Path to a Skeleton2D node used for skeleton-based deformations of this polygon. If empty or invalid, skeletal deformations will not be used.
m.Polygon2D.texture: The polygon's fill texture. Use uv to set texture coordinates.
m.Polygon2D.texture_offset: Amount to offset the polygon's texture. If set to Vector2(0, 0), the texture's origin (its top-left corner) will be placed at the polygon's position.
m.Polygon2D.texture_scale: Amount to multiply the uv coordinates when using texture. Larger values make the texture smaller, and vice versa.
m.Polygon2D.uv: Texture coordinates for each vertex of the polygon. There should be one UV value per polygon vertex. If there are fewer, undefined vertices will use Vector2(0, 0).
m.Polygon2D.vertex_colors: Color for each vertex. Colors are interpolated between vertices, resulting in smooth gradients. There should be one per polygon vertex. If there are fewer, undefined vertices will use color.
m.PolygonOccluder3D.polygon: The polygon to use for occlusion culling. The polygon can be convex or concave, but it should have as few points as possible to maximize performance.

m.PopupMenu.add_icon_item: Adds a new item with text label and icon texture.
m.PopupMenu.add_icon_radio_check_item: Same as add_icon_check_item(), but uses a radio check button.
m.PopupMenu.add_icon_radio_check_shortcut: Same as add_icon_check_shortcut(), but uses a radio check button.
m.PopupMenu.add_icon_shortcut: Adds a new item and assigns the specified Shortcut and icon texture to it. Sets the label of the checkbox to the Shortcut's name.
m.PopupMenu.add_item: Adds a new item with text label.
m.PopupMenu.add_multistate_item: Adds a new multistate item with text label.
m.PopupMenu.add_radio_check_item: Adds a new radio check button with text label.
m.PopupMenu.add_radio_check_shortcut: Adds a new radio check button and assigns a Shortcut to it. Sets the label of the checkbox to the Shortcut's name.
m.PopupMenu.add_separator: Adds a separator between items. Separators also occupy an index, which you can set by using the id parameter.
m.PopupMenu.add_submenu_node_item: Adds an item that will act as a submenu of the parent PopupMenu node when clicked. This submenu will be shown when the item is clicked, hovered for long enough, or activated using the ui_select or ui_right input actions.
m.PopupMenu.allow_search: If true, allows navigating PopupMenu with letter keys.
m.PopupMenu.clear: Removes all items from the PopupMenu. If free_submenus is true, the submenu nodes are automatically freed.
m.PopupMenu.get_focused_item: Returns the index of the currently focused item. Returns -1 if no item is focused.
m.PopupMenu.get_item_accelerator: Returns the accelerator of the item at the given index. An accelerator is a keyboard shortcut that can be pressed to trigger the menu button even if it's not currently open. The return value is an integer which is generally a combination of KeyModifierMasks and Keys using bitwise OR such as KEY_MASK_CTRL | KEY_A (Ctrl + A). If no accelerator is defined for the specified index, get_item_accelerato…
m.PopupMenu.get_item_auto_translate_mode: Returns the auto translate mode of the item at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.get_item_icon: Returns the icon of the item at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.get_item_icon_max_width: Returns the maximum allowed width of the icon for the item at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.get_item_icon_modulate: Returns a Color modulating the item's icon at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.get_item_id: Returns the ID of the item at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.get_item_indent: Returns the horizontal offset of the item at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.get_item_index: Returns the index of the item containing the specified id. The index is automatically assigned to each item by the engine when added and represents the order items will be displayed.
m.PopupMenu.get_item_metadata: Returns the metadata of the specified item, which might be of any type. You can set it with set_item_metadata(), which provides a simple way of assigning context data to items.
m.PopupMenu.get_item_multistate: Returns the state of the item at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.get_item_multistate_max: Returns the max states of the item at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.get_item_shortcut: Returns the Shortcut associated with the item at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.get_item_submenu_node: Returns the submenu of the item at the given index, or null if no submenu was added. See add_submenu_node_item() for more info on how to add a submenu.
m.PopupMenu.get_item_text: Returns the text of the item at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.get_item_text_direction: Returns item's text base writing direction.
m.PopupMenu.get_item_tooltip: Returns the tooltip associated with the item at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.hide_on_checkable_item_selecti: If true, hides the PopupMenu when a checkbox or radio button is selected.
m.PopupMenu.hide_on_item_selection: If true, hides the PopupMenu when an item is selected.
m.PopupMenu.hide_on_state_item_selection: If true, hides the PopupMenu when a state item is selected.
m.PopupMenu.id_focused: Emitted when the user navigated to an item of some id using the ProjectSettings.input/ui_up or ProjectSettings.input/ui_down input action.
m.PopupMenu.id_pressed: Emitted when an item of some id is pressed. Also emitted when its accelerator is activated on macOS.
m.PopupMenu.index_pressed: Emitted when an item of some index is pressed. Also emitted when its accelerator is activated on macOS.
m.PopupMenu.is_item_checkable: Returns true if the item at the given index is checkable in some way, i.e. if it has a checkbox or radio button.
m.PopupMenu.is_item_checked: Returns true if the item at the given index is checked.
m.PopupMenu.is_item_disabled: Returns true if the item at the given index is disabled. When it is disabled it can't be selected, or its action invoked.
m.PopupMenu.is_item_radio_checkable: Returns true if the item at the given index has radio button-style checkability.
m.PopupMenu.is_item_separator: Returns true if the item is a separator. If it is, it will be displayed as a line. See add_separator() for more info on how to add a separator.
m.PopupMenu.is_item_shortcut_disabled: Returns true if the specified item's shortcut is disabled.
m.PopupMenu.is_native_menu: Returns true if the system native menu is supported and currently used by this PopupMenu.
m.PopupMenu.is_system_menu: Returns true if the menu is bound to the special system menu.
m.PopupMenu.item_count: The number of items currently in the list.
m.PopupMenu.menu_changed: Emitted when any item is added, modified or removed.
m.PopupMenu.prefer_native_menu: If true, MenuBar will use native menu when supported.
m.PopupMenu.remove_item: Removes the item at the given index from the menu.
m.PopupMenu.scroll_to_item: Moves the scroll view to make the item at the given index visible.
m.PopupMenu.search_bar_enabled: If true, shows a search bar at the top of the PopupMenu for filtering items. See search_bar_min_item_count for dynamically controlling its visibility based on the number of items.
m.PopupMenu.search_bar_fuzzy_search_enable: If true, enables fuzzy searching in the PopupMenu search bar. This allows the search results to include items that almost match the search query, as well items that match the individual characters of the search query, but not in sequence.
m.PopupMenu.search_bar_fuzzy_search_max_mi: Sets the maximum number of mismatches allowed in each search result when fuzzy searching is enabled for the PopupMenu search bar. Any item with more mismatches will be hidden from the search results.
m.PopupMenu.search_bar_min_item_count: Sets the minimum number of items required for the search bar to be visible. search_bar_enabled must be true for this to have any effect. Separator items are not counted.
m.PopupMenu.set_focused_item: Sets the currently focused item as the given index.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_accelerator: Sets the accelerator of the item at the given index. An accelerator is a keyboard shortcut that can be pressed to trigger the menu button even if it's not currently open. accel is generally a combination of KeyModifierMasks and Keys using bitwise OR such as KEY_MASK_CTRL | KEY_A (Ctrl + A).
m.PopupMenu.set_item_as_checkable: Sets whether the item at the given index has a checkbox. If false, sets the type of the item to plain text.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_as_radio_checkable: Sets the type of the item at the given index to radio button. If false, sets the type of the item to plain text.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_as_separator: Mark the item at the given index as a separator, which means that it would be displayed as a line. If false, sets the type of the item to plain text.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_auto_translate_mode: Sets the auto translate mode of the item at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_checked: Sets the checkstate status of the item at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_disabled: Enables/disables the item at the given index. When it is disabled, it can't be selected and its action can't be invoked.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_icon: Replaces the Texture2D icon of the item at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_icon_max_width: Sets the maximum allowed width of the icon for the item at the given index. This limit is applied on top of the default size of the icon and on top of icon_max_width. The height is adjusted according to the icon's ratio.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_icon_modulate: Sets a modulating Color of the item's icon at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_id: Sets the id of the item at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_indent: Sets the horizontal offset of the item at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_index: Changes the index of the item at index index to be at index target_index. This can be used to move an item above other items. The moved item will keep the same ID, even if it was generated from the original index.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_language: Sets the language code of the text for the item at the given index to language. This is used for line-breaking and text shaping algorithms. If language is empty, the current locale is used.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_metadata: Sets the metadata of an item, which may be of any type. You can later get it with get_item_metadata(), which provides a simple way of assigning context data to items.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_multistate: Sets the state of a multistate item. See add_multistate_item() for details.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_multistate_max: Sets the max states of a multistate item. See add_multistate_item() for details.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_shortcut: Sets a Shortcut for the item at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_shortcut_disabled: Disables the Shortcut of the item at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_submenu_node: Sets the submenu of the item at the given index. The submenu is a PopupMenu node that would be shown when the item is clicked. It must either be a child of this PopupMenu or has no parent (in which case it will be automatically added as a child). If the submenu popup has another parent, this method will fail.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_text: Sets the text of the item at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_text_direction: Sets item's text base writing direction.
m.PopupMenu.set_item_tooltip: Sets the String tooltip of the item at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.shrink_height: If true, shrinks PopupMenu to minimum height when it's shown.
m.PopupMenu.shrink_width: If true, shrinks PopupMenu to minimum width when it's shown.
m.PopupMenu.submenu_popup_delay: Sets the delay time in seconds for the submenu item to popup on mouse hovering. If the popup menu is added as a child of another (acting as a submenu), it will inherit the delay time of the parent menu item.
m.PopupMenu.system_menu_id: If set to one of the values of SystemMenus, this PopupMenu is bound to the special system menu. Only one PopupMenu can be bound to each special menu at a time.
m.PopupMenu.toggle_item_checked: Toggles the check state of the item at the given index.
m.PopupMenu.toggle_item_multistate: Cycle to the next state of a multistate item. See add_multistate_item() for details.
