m.ScrollBar.custom_step: Overrides the step used when clicking increment and decrement buttons or when using arrow keys when the ScrollBar is focused.
m.ScrollBar.scrolling: Emitted when the scrollbar is being scrolled.
m.ScrollContainer.SCROLL_HINT_MODE_ALL: Scroll hints will be shown at the top and bottom (if vertical), or left and right (if horizontal).
m.ScrollContainer.SCROLL_HINT_MODE_BOTTOM_: Scroll hints will be shown at the bottom (if horizontal), or the right (if horizontal).
m.ScrollContainer.SCROLL_HINT_MODE_DISABLE: Scroll hints will never be shown.
m.ScrollContainer.SCROLL_HINT_MODE_TOP_AND: Scroll hints will be shown at the top (if vertical), or the left (if horizontal).
m.ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_AUTO: Scrolling enabled, scrollbar will be visible only if necessary, i.e. container's content is bigger than the container.
m.ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED: Scrolling disabled, scrollbar will be invisible.
m.ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_MAXIMIZE_FIR: Behaves like SCROLL_MODE_AUTO, but makes the ScrollContainer report a minimum size based on its content (limited by Control.custom_maximum_size when set on the corresponding axis). This allows it to grow first and only start scrolling once constrained.
m.ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_RESERVE: Combines SCROLL_MODE_AUTO and SCROLL_MODE_SHOW_ALWAYS. The scrollbar is only visible if necessary, but the content size is adjusted as if it was always visible. It's useful for ensuring that content size stays the same regardless if the scrollbar is visible.
m.ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_SHOW_ALWAYS: Scrolling enabled, scrollbar will be always visible.
m.ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_SHOW_NEVER: Scrolling enabled, scrollbar will be hidden.
m.ScrollContainer.draw_focus_border: If true, focus is drawn when the ScrollContainer or one of its descendant nodes is focused.
m.ScrollContainer.ensure_control_visible: Ensures the given control is visible (must be a direct or indirect child of the ScrollContainer). Used by follow_focus.
m.ScrollContainer.follow_focus: If true, the ScrollContainer will automatically scroll to focused children (including indirect children) to make sure they are fully visible.
m.ScrollContainer.get_h_scroll_bar: Returns the horizontal scrollbar HScrollBar of this ScrollContainer.
m.ScrollContainer.get_v_scroll_bar: Returns the vertical scrollbar VScrollBar of this ScrollContainer.
m.ScrollContainer.horizontal_scroll_mode: Controls whether horizontal scrollbar can be used and when it should be visible.
m.ScrollContainer.scroll_deadzone: Deadzone for touch scrolling. Lower deadzone makes the scrolling more sensitive.
m.ScrollContainer.scroll_ended: Emitted when scrolling stops when dragging the scrollable area with a touch event. This signal is not emitted when scrolling by dragging the scrollbar, scrolling with the mouse wheel or scrolling with keyboard/gamepad events.
m.ScrollContainer.scroll_hint_mode: The way which scroll hints (indicators that show that the content can still be scrolled in a certain direction) will be shown.
m.ScrollContainer.scroll_horizontal_by_def: If true, the mouse wheel scrolls the view horizontally, and holding Shift scrolls vertically.
m.ScrollContainer.scroll_horizontal_custom: Overrides the ScrollBar.custom_step used when clicking the internal scroll bar's horizontal increment and decrement buttons or when using arrow keys when the ScrollBar is focused.
m.ScrollContainer.scroll_started: Emitted when scrolling starts when dragging the scrollable area with a touch event. This signal is not emitted when scrolling by dragging the scrollbar, scrolling with the mouse wheel or scrolling with keyboard/gamepad events.
m.ScrollContainer.scroll_vertical_custom_s: Overrides the ScrollBar.custom_step used when clicking the internal scroll bar's vertical increment and decrement buttons or when using arrow keys when the ScrollBar is focused.
m.ScrollContainer.tile_scroll_hint: If true, the scroll hint texture will be tiled instead of stretched. See scroll_hint_mode.
m.ScrollContainer.vertical_scroll_mode: Controls whether vertical scrollbar can be used and when it should be visible.
m.Semaphore.post: Lowers the Semaphore, allowing one thread in, or more if count is specified.
m.Semaphore.try_wait: Like wait(), but won't block, so if the value is zero, fails immediately and returns false. If non-zero, it returns true to report success.
m.Semaphore.wait: Waits for the Semaphore, if its value is zero, blocks until non-zero.
m.SeparationRayShape2D.slide_on_slope: If false (default), the shape always separates and returns a normal along its own direction.
m.SeparationRayShape3D.slide_on_slope: If false (default), the shape always separates and returns a normal along its own direction.
m.Shader.MODE_CANVAS_ITEM: Mode used to draw all 2D objects.
m.Shader.MODE_FOG: Mode used for setting the color and density of volumetric fog effect.
m.Shader.MODE_PARTICLES: Mode used to calculate particle information on a per-particle basis. Not used for drawing.
m.Shader.MODE_SKY: Mode used for drawing skies. Only works with shaders attached to Sky objects.
m.Shader.MODE_SPATIAL: Mode used to draw all 3D objects.
m.Shader.MODE_TEXTURE_BLIT: Mode used for drawing to DrawableTexture resources via blit calls.
m.Shader.code: Returns the shader's code as the user has written it, not the full generated code used internally.
m.Shader.get_default_texture_parameter: Returns the texture that is set as default for the specified parameter.
m.Shader.get_mode: Returns the shader mode for the shader.
m.Shader.get_shader_uniform_list: Returns the list of shader uniforms that can be assigned to a ShaderMaterial, for use with ShaderMaterial.set_shader_parameter() and ShaderMaterial.get_shader_parameter(). The parameters returned are contained in dictionaries in a similar format to the ones returned by Object.get_property_list().
m.Shader.inspect_native_shader_code: Only available when running in the editor. Opens a popup that visualizes the generated shader code, including all variants and internal shader code. See also Material.inspect_native_shader_code().
m.Shader.set_default_texture_parameter: Sets the default texture to be used with a texture uniform. The default is used if a texture is not set in the ShaderMaterial.
m.ShaderInclude.code: Returns the code of the shader include file. The returned text is what the user has written, not the full generated code used internally.
m.ShaderIncludeDB.get_built_in_include_fil: Returns the code for the built-in shader fragment. You can also access this in your shader code through #include "filename".
m.ShaderIncludeDB.has_built_in_include_fil: Returns true if an include file with this name exists.
m.ShaderIncludeDB.list_built_in_include_fi: Returns a list of built-in include files that are currently registered.
m.ShaderMaterial.get_shader_parameter: Returns the current value set for this material of a uniform in the shader.
m.ShaderMaterial.set_shader_parameter: Changes the value set for this material of a uniform in the shader.
m.ShaderMaterial.shader: The Shader program used to render this material.
m.Shape2D.collide: Returns true if this shape is colliding with another.
m.Shape2D.collide_and_get_contacts: Returns a list of contact point pairs where this shape touches another.
m.Shape2D.collide_with_motion: Returns whether this shape would collide with another, if a given movement was applied.
m.Shape2D.collide_with_motion_and_get_cont: Returns a list of contact point pairs where this shape would touch another, if a given movement was applied.
m.Shape2D.custom_solver_bias: The shape's custom solver bias. Defines how much bodies react to enforce contact separation when this shape is involved.
m.Shape2D.draw: Draws a solid shape onto a CanvasItem with the RenderingServer API filled with the specified color. The exact drawing method is specific for each shape and cannot be configured.
m.Shape2D.get_rect: Returns a Rect2 representing the shapes boundary.
m.Shape3D.custom_solver_bias: The shape's custom solver bias. Defines how much bodies react to enforce contact separation when this shape is involved.
m.Shape3D.get_debug_mesh: Returns the ArrayMesh used to draw the debug collision for this Shape3D.
m.Shape3D.margin: The collision margin for the shape. This is not used in Godot Physics.
m.ShapeCast2D.add_exception: Adds a collision exception so the shape does not report collisions with the specified node.
m.ShapeCast2D.add_exception_rid: Adds a collision exception so the shape does not report collisions with the specified RID.
m.ShapeCast2D.clear_exceptions: Removes all collision exceptions for this shape.
m.ShapeCast2D.collide_with_areas: If true, collisions with Area2Ds will be reported.
m.ShapeCast2D.collide_with_bodies: If true, collisions with PhysicsBody2Ds will be reported.
m.ShapeCast2D.collision_mask: The shape's collision mask. Only objects in at least one collision layer enabled in the mask will be detected. See Collision layers and masks in the documentation for more information.
m.ShapeCast2D.collision_result: Returns the complete collision information from the collision sweep. The data returned is the same as in the PhysicsDirectSpaceState2D.get_rest_info() method.
m.ShapeCast2D.enabled: If true, collisions will be reported.
m.ShapeCast2D.exclude_parent: If true, the parent node will be excluded from collision detection.
m.ShapeCast2D.force_shapecast_update: Updates the collision information for the shape immediately, without waiting for the next _physics_process call. Use this method, for example, when the shape or its parent has changed state.
m.ShapeCast2D.get_closest_collision_safe_f: Returns the fraction from this cast's origin to its target_position of how far the shape can move without triggering a collision, as a value between 0.0 and 1.0.
m.ShapeCast2D.get_closest_collision_unsafe: Returns the fraction from this cast's origin to its target_position of how far the shape must move to trigger a collision, as a value between 0.0 and 1.0.
m.ShapeCast2D.get_collider: Returns the collided Object of one of the multiple collisions at index, or null if no object is intersecting the shape (i.e. is_colliding() returns false).
m.ShapeCast2D.get_collider_rid: Returns the RID of the collided object of one of the multiple collisions at index.
m.ShapeCast2D.get_collider_shape: Returns the shape ID of the colliding shape of one of the multiple collisions at index, or 0 if no object is intersecting the shape (i.e. is_colliding() returns false).
m.ShapeCast2D.get_collision_count: The number of collisions detected at the point of impact. Use this to iterate over multiple collisions as provided by get_collider(), get_collider_shape(), get_collision_point(), and get_collision_normal() methods.
m.ShapeCast2D.get_collision_mask_value: Returns whether or not the specified layer of the collision_mask is enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.ShapeCast2D.get_collision_normal: Returns the normal of one of the multiple collisions at index of the intersecting object.
m.ShapeCast2D.get_collision_point: Returns the collision point of one of the multiple collisions at index where the shape intersects the colliding object.
m.ShapeCast2D.is_colliding: Returns whether any object is intersecting with the shape's vector (considering the vector length).
m.ShapeCast2D.margin: The collision margin for the shape. A larger margin helps detecting collisions more consistently, at the cost of precision.
m.ShapeCast2D.max_results: The number of intersections can be limited with this parameter, to reduce the processing time.
m.ShapeCast2D.remove_exception: Removes a collision exception so the shape does report collisions with the specified node.
m.ShapeCast2D.remove_exception_rid: Removes a collision exception so the shape does report collisions with the specified RID.
m.ShapeCast2D.set_collision_mask_value: Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the collision_mask, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.ShapeCast2D.shape: The shape to be used for collision queries.
m.ShapeCast2D.target_position: The shape's destination point, relative to this node's Node2D.position.

m.Shortcut.get_as_text: Returns the shortcut's first valid InputEvent as a String.
m.Shortcut.has_valid_event: Returns whether events contains an InputEvent which is valid.
m.Shortcut.matches_event: Returns whether any InputEvent in events equals event. This uses InputEvent.is_match() to compare events.
m.Signal.emit: 发射信号。4.x 推荐写法：my_signal.emit(args)。
m.Signal.get_connections: Returns an Array of connections for this signal. Each connection is represented as a Dictionary that contains three entries:
m.Signal.get_name: Returns the name of this signal.
m.Signal.get_object: Returns the object emitting this signal.
m.Signal.get_object_id: Returns the ID of the object emitting this signal (see Object.get_instance_id()).
m.Signal.has_connections: Returns true if any Callable is connected to this signal.
m.Signal.is_connected: Returns true if the specified Callable is connected to this signal.
m.Signal.is_null: Returns true if this Signal has no object and the signal name is empty. Equivalent to signal == Signal().
m.Skeleton2D.bone_setup_changed: Emitted when the Bone2D setup attached to this skeletons changes. This is primarily used internally within the skeleton.
m.Skeleton2D.execute_modifications: Executes all the modifications on the SkeletonModificationStack2D, if the Skeleton2D has one assigned.
m.Skeleton2D.get_bone: Returns a Bone2D from the node hierarchy parented by Skeleton2D. The object to return is identified by the parameter idx. Bones are indexed by descending the node hierarchy from top to bottom, adding the children of each branch before moving to the next sibling.
m.Skeleton2D.get_bone_count: Returns the number of Bone2D nodes in the node hierarchy parented by Skeleton2D.
m.Skeleton2D.get_bone_local_pose_override: Returns the local pose override transform for bone_idx.
m.Skeleton2D.get_modification_stack: Returns the SkeletonModificationStack2D attached to this skeleton, if one exists.
m.Skeleton2D.get_skeleton: Returns the RID of a Skeleton2D instance.
m.Skeleton2D.set_bone_local_pose_override: Sets the local pose transform, override_pose, for the bone at bone_idx.
m.Skeleton2D.set_modification_stack: Sets the SkeletonModificationStack2D attached to this skeleton.
m.Skeleton3D.MODIFIER_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCES: Set a flag to process modification during process frames (see Node.NOTIFICATION_INTERNAL_PROCESS).
Do not process modification. Use advance() to process the modification manually.
Set a flag to process modification during physics frames (see Node.NOTIFICATION_INTERNAL_PHYSICS_PROCESS).
m.Skeleton3D.NOTIFICATION_UPDATE_SKELETON: Notification received when this skeleton's pose needs to be updated. In that case, this is called only once per frame in a deferred process.
m.Skeleton3D.add_bone: Adds a new bone with the given name. Returns the new bone's index, or -1 if this method fails.
m.Skeleton3D.advance: Manually advance the child SkeletonModifier3Ds by the specified time (in seconds).
m.Skeleton3D.animate_physical_bones: Deprecated: This property may be changed or removed in future versions.
m.Skeleton3D.bone_enabled_changed: Emitted when the bone at bone_idx is toggled with set_bone_enabled(). Use is_bone_enabled() to check the new value.
m.Skeleton3D.bone_list_changed: Emitted when the list of bones changes, such as when calling add_bone(), set_bone_parent(), unparent_bone_and_rest(), or clear_bones().
m.Skeleton3D.clear_bones: Clear all the bones in this skeleton.
m.Skeleton3D.clear_bones_global_pose_overr: Deprecated: This method may be changed or removed in future versions.
m.Skeleton3D.create_skin_from_rest_transfo: There is currently no description for this method. Please help us by contributing one [https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/documentation/class_reference.html]!
m.Skeleton3D.find_bone: Returns the bone index that matches name as its name. Returns -1 if no bone with this name exists.
m.Skeleton3D.force_update_all_bone_transfo: Deprecated: This method should only be called internally.
m.Skeleton3D.force_update_bone_child_trans: Force updates the bone transform for the bone at bone_idx and all of its children.
m.Skeleton3D.get_bone_children: Returns an array containing the bone indexes of all the child node of the passed in bone, bone_idx.
m.Skeleton3D.get_bone_count: Returns the number of bones in the skeleton.
m.Skeleton3D.get_bone_global_pose: Returns the overall transform of the specified bone, with respect to the skeleton. Being relative to the skeleton frame, this is not the actual "global" transform of the bone.
m.Skeleton3D.get_bone_global_pose_no_overr: Deprecated: This method may be changed or removed in future versions.
m.Skeleton3D.get_bone_global_pose_override: Deprecated: This method may be changed or removed in future versions.
m.Skeleton3D.get_bone_global_rest: Returns the global rest transform for bone_idx.
m.Skeleton3D.get_bone_meta: Returns the metadata with the given key for the bone at index bone_idx.
m.Skeleton3D.get_bone_meta_list: Returns the list of all metadata keys for the bone at index bone_idx.
m.Skeleton3D.get_bone_name: Returns the name of the bone at index bone_idx.
m.Skeleton3D.get_bone_parent: Returns the bone index which is the parent of the bone at bone_idx. If -1, then bone has no parent.
m.Skeleton3D.get_bone_pose: Returns the pose transform of the specified bone.
m.Skeleton3D.get_bone_pose_position: Returns the pose position of the bone at bone_idx. The returned Vector3 is in the local coordinate space of the Skeleton3D node.
m.Skeleton3D.get_bone_pose_rotation: Returns the pose rotation of the bone at bone_idx. The returned Quaternion is local to the bone with respect to the rotation of any parent bones.
m.Skeleton3D.get_bone_pose_scale: Returns the pose scale of the bone at bone_idx.
m.Skeleton3D.get_bone_rest: Returns the rest transform for a bone bone_idx.
m.Skeleton3D.get_concatenated_bone_names: Returns all bone names concatenated with commas (,) as a single StringName.
m.Skeleton3D.get_parentless_bones: Returns an array with all of the bones that are parentless. Another way to look at this is that it returns the indexes of all the bones that are not dependent or modified by other bones in the Skeleton.
m.Skeleton3D.get_version: Returns the number of times the bone hierarchy has changed within this skeleton, including renames.
m.Skeleton3D.has_bone_meta: Returns true if the bone at index bone_idx has metadata with the given key.
m.Skeleton3D.is_bone_enabled: Returns whether the bone pose for the bone at bone_idx is enabled.
m.Skeleton3D.localize_rests: Returns all bones in the skeleton to their rest poses.
m.Skeleton3D.modifier_callback_mode_proces: Sets the processing timing for the Modifier.
m.Skeleton3D.physical_bones_add_collision_: Deprecated: This method may be changed or removed in future versions.
m.Skeleton3D.physical_bones_remove_collisi: Deprecated: This method may be changed or removed in future versions.
m.Skeleton3D.physical_bones_start_simulati: Deprecated: This method may be changed or removed in future versions.
m.Skeleton3D.physical_bones_stop_simulatio: Deprecated: This method may be changed or removed in future versions.
m.Skeleton3D.pose_updated: Emitted when the pose is updated.
m.Skeleton3D.register_skin: Binds the given Skin to the Skeleton.
m.Skeleton3D.reset_bone_pose: Sets the bone pose to rest for bone_idx.
m.Skeleton3D.reset_bone_poses: Sets all bone poses to rests.
m.Skeleton3D.rest_updated: Emitted when the rest is updated.
m.Skeleton3D.set_bone_enabled: Disables the pose for the bone at bone_idx if false, enables the bone pose if true.
m.Skeleton3D.set_bone_global_pose: Sets the global pose transform, pose, for the bone at bone_idx.
m.Skeleton3D.set_bone_global_pose_override: Deprecated: This method may be changed or removed in future versions.
m.Skeleton3D.set_bone_meta: Sets the metadata with the given key to value for the bone at index bone_idx.
m.Skeleton3D.set_bone_name: Sets the bone name, name, for the bone at bone_idx.
m.Skeleton3D.set_bone_parent: Sets the bone index parent_idx as the parent of the bone at bone_idx. If -1, then bone has no parent.
m.Skeleton3D.set_bone_pose: Sets the pose transform, pose, for the bone at bone_idx.
m.Skeleton3D.set_bone_pose_position: Sets the pose position of the bone at bone_idx to position. position is a Vector3 describing a position local to the Skeleton3D node.
m.Skeleton3D.set_bone_pose_rotation: Sets the pose rotation of the bone at bone_idx to rotation. rotation is a Quaternion describing a rotation in the bone's local coordinate space with respect to the rotation of any parent bones.
m.Skeleton3D.set_bone_pose_scale: Sets the pose scale of the bone at bone_idx to scale.
m.Skeleton3D.set_bone_rest: Sets the rest transform for bone bone_idx.
m.Skeleton3D.show_rest_only: If true, forces the bones in their default rest pose, regardless of their values. In the editor, this also prevents the bones from being edited.
m.Skeleton3D.show_rest_only_changed: Emitted when the value of show_rest_only changes.
m.Skeleton3D.skeleton_updated: Emitted when the final pose has been calculated will be applied to the skin in the update process.
m.Skeleton3D.unparent_bone_and_rest: Unparents the bone at bone_idx and sets its rest position to that of its parent prior to being reset.
m.SkeletonIK3D.get_parent_skeleton: Returns the parent Skeleton3D node that was present when SkeletonIK entered the scene tree. Returns null if the parent node was not a Skeleton3D node when SkeletonIK3D entered the scene tree.
m.SkeletonIK3D.is_running: Returns true if SkeletonIK is applying IK effects on continues frames to the Skeleton3D bones. Returns false if SkeletonIK is stopped or start() was used with the one_time parameter set to true.
m.SkeletonIK3D.magnet: Secondary target position (first is target property or target_node) for the IK chain. Use magnet position (pole target) to control the bending of the IK chain. Only works if the bone chain has more than 2 bones. The middle chain bone position will be linearly interpolated with the magnet position.
m.SkeletonIK3D.max_iterations: Number of iteration loops used by the IK solver to produce more accurate (and elegant) bone chain results.
m.SkeletonIK3D.min_distance: The minimum distance between bone and goal target. If the distance is below this value, the IK solver stops further iterations.
m.SkeletonIK3D.override_tip_basis: If true overwrites the rotation of the tip bone with the rotation of the target (or target_node if defined).
m.SkeletonIK3D.root_bone: The name of the current root bone, the first bone in the IK chain.
m.SkeletonIK3D.start: Starts applying IK effects on each frame to the Skeleton3D bones but will only take effect starting on the next frame. If one_time is true, this will take effect immediately but also reset on the next frame.
m.SkeletonIK3D.stop: Stops applying IK effects on each frame to the Skeleton3D bones and also calls Skeleton3D.clear_bones_global_pose_override() to remove existing overrides on all bones.
m.SkeletonIK3D.target: First target of the IK chain where the tip bone is placed and, if override_tip_basis is true, how the tip bone is rotated. If a target_node path is available the nodes transform is used instead and this property is ignored.
m.SkeletonIK3D.target_node: Target node NodePath for the IK chain. If available, the node's current Transform3D is used instead of the target property.
m.SkeletonIK3D.tip_bone: The name of the current tip bone, the last bone in the IK chain placed at the target transform (or target_node if defined).
m.SkeletonIK3D.use_magnet: If true, instructs the IK solver to consider the secondary magnet target (pole target) when calculating the bone chain. Use the magnet position (pole target) to control the bending of the IK chain.
m.SkeletonModification2D._draw_editor_gizm: Used for drawing editor-only modification gizmos. This function will only be called in the Godot editor and can be overridden to draw custom gizmos.
m.SkeletonModification2D._execute: Executes the given modification. This is where the modification performs whatever function it is designed to do.
m.SkeletonModification2D._setup_modificati: Called when the modification is setup. This is where the modification performs initialization.
m.SkeletonModification2D.clamp_angle: Takes an angle and clamps it so it is within the passed-in min and max range. invert will inversely clamp the angle, clamping it to the range outside of the given bounds.
m.SkeletonModification2D.enabled: If true, the modification's _execute() function will be called by the SkeletonModificationStack2D.
m.SkeletonModification2D.execution_mode: The execution mode for the modification. This tells the modification stack when to execute the modification. Some modifications have settings that are only available in certain execution modes.
m.SkeletonModification2D.get_editor_draw_g: Returns whether this modification will call _draw_editor_gizmo() in the Godot editor to draw modification-specific gizmos.
m.SkeletonModification2D.get_is_setup: Returns whether this modification has been successfully setup or not.
m.SkeletonModification2D.get_modification_: Returns the SkeletonModificationStack2D that this modification is bound to. Through the modification stack, you can access the Skeleton2D the modification is operating on.
m.SkeletonModification2D.set_editor_draw_g: Sets whether this modification will call _draw_editor_gizmo() in the Godot editor to draw modification-specific gizmos.
m.SkeletonModification2D.set_is_setup: Manually allows you to set the setup state of the modification. This function should only rarely be used, as the SkeletonModificationStack2D the modification is bound to should handle setting the modification up.
m.SkeletonModification2DCCDIK.ccdik_data_c: The number of CCDIK joints in the CCDIK modification.

Returns the index of the Bone2D node assigned to the CCDIK joint at joint_idx.
Returns whether the CCDIK joint at joint_idx uses an inverted joint constraint. See set_ccdik_joint_constraint_angle_invert() for details.
Returns the maximum angle constraint for the joint at joint_idx.
Returns the minimum angle constraint for the joint at joint_idx.
Returns whether angle constraints on the CCDIK joint at joint_idx are enabled.
Returns whether the joint at joint_idx is set to rotate from the joint, true, or to rotate from the tip, false. The default is to rotate from the tip.
m.SkeletonModification2DCCDIK.set_ccdik_jo: Sets the Bone2D node assigned to the CCDIK joint at joint_idx.
Sets the bone index, bone_idx, of the CCDIK joint at joint_idx. When possible, this will also update the bone2d_node of the CCDIK joint based on data provided by the linked skeleton.
Sets whether the CCDIK joint at joint_idx uses an inverted joint constraint.
Sets the maximum angle constraint for the joint at joint_idx.
Sets the minimum angle constraint for the joint at joint_idx.
Determines whether angle constraints on the CCDIK joint at joint_idx are enabled. When true, constraints will be enabled and taken into account when solving.
Sets whether the joint at joint_idx is set to rotate from the joint, true, or to rotate from the tip, false.
m.SkeletonModification2DCCDIK.target_nodep: The NodePath to the node that is the target for the CCDIK modification. This node is what the CCDIK chain will attempt to rotate the bone chain to.
m.SkeletonModification2DCCDIK.tip_nodepath: The end position of the CCDIK chain. Typically, this should be a child of a Bone2D node attached to the final Bone2D in the CCDIK chain.
m.SkeletonModification2DFABRIK.fabrik_data: The number of FABRIK joints in the FABRIK modification.
m.SkeletonModification2DFABRIK.get_fabrik_: Returns the Bone2D node assigned to the FABRIK joint at joint_idx.
Returns the index of the Bone2D node assigned to the FABRIK joint at joint_idx.
Returns the magnet position vector for the joint at joint_idx.
Returns whether the joint is using the target's rotation rather than allowing FABRIK to rotate the joint. This option only applies to the tip/final joint in the chain.
m.SkeletonModification2DFABRIK.set_fabrik_: Sets the Bone2D node assigned to the FABRIK joint at joint_idx.
Sets the bone index, bone_idx, of the FABRIK joint at joint_idx. When possible, this will also update the bone2d_node of the FABRIK joint based on data provided by the linked skeleton.
Sets the magnet position vector for the joint at joint_idx.
Sets whether the joint at joint_idx will use the target node's rotation rather than letting FABRIK rotate the node.
m.SkeletonModification2DFABRIK.target_node: The NodePath to the node that is the target for the FABRIK modification. This node is what the FABRIK chain will attempt to rotate the bone chain to.
m.SkeletonModification2DJiggle.damping: The default amount of damping applied to the Jiggle joints, if they are not overridden. Higher values lead to more of the calculated velocity being applied.
m.SkeletonModification2DJiggle.get_collisi: Returns the collision mask used by the Jiggle modifier when collisions are enabled.
m.SkeletonModification2DJiggle.get_jiggle_: Returns the Bone2D node assigned to the Jiggle joint at joint_idx.
Returns the index of the Bone2D node assigned to the Jiggle joint at joint_idx.
Returns the amount of damping of the Jiggle joint at joint_idx.
Returns a Vector2 representing the amount of gravity the Jiggle joint at joint_idx is influenced by.
Returns the amount of mass of the jiggle joint at joint_idx.
Returns a boolean that indicates whether the joint at joint_idx is overriding the default Jiggle joint data defined in the modification.
Returns the stiffness of the Jiggle joint at joint_idx.
Returns a boolean that indicates whether the joint at joint_idx is using gravity or not.
m.SkeletonModification2DJiggle.get_use_col: Returns whether the jiggle modifier is taking physics colliders into account when solving.
m.SkeletonModification2DJiggle.gravity: The default amount of gravity applied to the Jiggle joints, if they are not overridden.
m.SkeletonModification2DJiggle.jiggle_data: The amount of Jiggle joints in the Jiggle modification.
m.SkeletonModification2DJiggle.mass: The default amount of mass assigned to the Jiggle joints, if they are not overridden. Higher values lead to faster movements and more overshooting.
m.SkeletonModification2DJiggle.reset: Resets the internal jiggle simulation state to the current bone positions, clearing velocity, acceleration, and accumulated forces.
m.SkeletonModification2DJiggle.set_collisi: Sets the collision mask that the Jiggle modifier will use when reacting to colliders, if the Jiggle modifier is set to take colliders into account.
m.SkeletonModification2DJiggle.set_jiggle_: Sets the Bone2D node assigned to the Jiggle joint at joint_idx.
Sets the bone index, bone_idx, of the Jiggle joint at joint_idx. When possible, this will also update the bone2d_node of the Jiggle joint based on data provided by the linked skeleton.
Sets the amount of damping of the Jiggle joint at joint_idx.
Sets the gravity vector of the Jiggle joint at joint_idx.
Sets the of mass of the Jiggle joint at joint_idx.

Sets whether the Jiggle joint at joint_idx should override the default Jiggle joint settings. Setting this to true will make the joint use its own settings rather than the default ones attached to the modification.
Sets the of stiffness of the Jiggle joint at joint_idx.

m.SkeletonModification2DJiggle.set_use_col: If true, the Jiggle modifier will take colliders into account, keeping them from entering into these collision objects.
m.SkeletonModification2DJiggle.stiffness: The default amount of stiffness assigned to the Jiggle joints, if they are not overridden. Higher values act more like springs, quickly moving into the correct position.
m.SkeletonModification2DJiggle.target_node: The NodePath to the node that is the target for the Jiggle modification. This node is what the Jiggle chain will attempt to rotate the bone chain to.
m.SkeletonModification2DJiggle.use_gravity: Whether the gravity vector, gravity, should be applied to the Jiggle joints, assuming they are not overriding the default settings.
m.SkeletonModification2DLookAt.bone2d_node: The Bone2D node that the modification will operate on.
m.SkeletonModification2DLookAt.bone_index: The index of the Bone2D node that the modification will operate on.
m.SkeletonModification2DLookAt.get_additio: Returns the amount of additional rotation that is applied after the LookAt modification executes.
m.SkeletonModification2DLookAt.get_constra: Returns whether the constraints to this modification are inverted or not.
Returns the constraint's maximum allowed angle.
Returns the constraint's minimum allowed angle.
m.SkeletonModification2DLookAt.get_enable_: Returns true if the LookAt modification is using constraints.
m.SkeletonModification2DLookAt.set_additio: Sets the amount of additional rotation that is to be applied after executing the modification. This allows for offsetting the results by the inputted rotation amount.
m.SkeletonModification2DLookAt.set_constra: When true, the modification will use an inverted joint constraint.
Sets the constraint's maximum allowed angle.
Sets the constraint's minimum allowed angle.
m.SkeletonModification2DLookAt.set_enable_: Sets whether this modification will use constraints or not. When true, constraints will be applied when solving the LookAt modification.
m.SkeletonModification2DLookAt.target_node: The NodePath to the node that is the target for the LookAt modification. This node is what the modification will rotate the Bone2D to.
m.SkeletonModification2DPhysicalBones.fetc: Empties the list of PhysicalBone2D nodes and populates it with all PhysicalBone2D nodes that are children of the Skeleton2D.
m.SkeletonModification2DPhysicalBones.get_: Returns the PhysicalBone2D node at joint_idx.
m.SkeletonModification2DPhysicalBones.phys: The number of PhysicalBone2D nodes linked in this modification.
m.SkeletonModification2DPhysicalBones.set_: Sets the PhysicalBone2D node at joint_idx.
m.SkeletonModification2DPhysicalBones.star: Tell the PhysicalBone2D nodes to start simulating and interacting with the physics world.
m.SkeletonModification2DPhysicalBones.stop: Tell the PhysicalBone2D nodes to stop simulating and interacting with the physics world.
m.SkeletonModification2DStackHolder.get_he: Returns the SkeletonModificationStack2D that this modification is holding.
m.SkeletonModification2DStackHolder.set_he: Sets the SkeletonModificationStack2D that this modification is holding. This modification stack will then be executed when this modification is executed.
m.SkeletonModification2DTwoBoneIK.flip_ben: If true, the bones in the modification will bend outward as opposed to inwards when contracting. If false, the bones will bend inwards when contracting.
m.SkeletonModification2DTwoBoneIK.get_join: Returns the Bone2D node that is being used as the first bone in the TwoBoneIK modification.
Returns the index of the Bone2D node that is being used as the first bone in the TwoBoneIK modification.
Returns the Bone2D node that is being used as the second bone in the TwoBoneIK modification.
Returns the index of the Bone2D node that is being used as the second bone in the TwoBoneIK modification.
m.SkeletonModification2DTwoBoneIK.set_join: Sets the Bone2D node that is being used as the first bone in the TwoBoneIK modification.
Sets the index of the Bone2D node that is being used as the first bone in the TwoBoneIK modification.
Sets the Bone2D node that is being used as the second bone in the TwoBoneIK modification.
Sets the index of the Bone2D node that is being used as the second bone in the TwoBoneIK modification.
m.SkeletonModification2DTwoBoneIK.target_m: The maximum distance the target can be at. If the target is farther than this distance, the modification will solve as if it's at this maximum distance. When set to 0, the modification will solve without distance constraints.

The minimum distance the target can be at. If the target is closer than this distance, the modification will solve as if it's at this minimum distance. When set to 0, the modification will solve without distance constraints.
m.SkeletonModification2DTwoBoneIK.target_n: The NodePath to the node that is the target for the TwoBoneIK modification. This node is what the modification will use when bending the Bone2D nodes.
m.SkeletonModificationStack2D.add_modifica: Adds the passed-in SkeletonModification2D to the stack.
m.SkeletonModificationStack2D.delete_modif: Deletes the SkeletonModification2D at the index position mod_idx, if it exists.
m.SkeletonModificationStack2D.enable_all_m: Enables all SkeletonModification2Ds in the stack.
m.SkeletonModificationStack2D.enabled: If true, the modification's in the stack will be called. This is handled automatically through the Skeleton2D node.
m.SkeletonModificationStack2D.execute: Executes all of the SkeletonModification2Ds in the stack that use the same execution mode as the passed-in execution_mode, starting from index 0 to modification_count.
m.SkeletonModificationStack2D.get_is_setup: Returns a boolean that indicates whether the modification stack is setup and can execute.
m.SkeletonModificationStack2D.get_modifica: Returns the SkeletonModification2D at the passed-in index, mod_idx.
m.SkeletonModificationStack2D.get_skeleton: Returns the Skeleton2D node that the SkeletonModificationStack2D is bound to.
m.SkeletonModificationStack2D.modification: The number of modifications in the stack.
m.SkeletonModificationStack2D.set_modifica: Sets the modification at mod_idx to the passed-in modification, modification.
m.SkeletonModificationStack2D.setup: Sets up the modification stack so it can execute. This function should be called by Skeleton2D and shouldn't be manually called unless you know what you are doing.
m.SkeletonModificationStack2D.strength: The interpolation strength of the modifications in stack. A value of 0 will make it where the modifications are not applied, a strength of 0.5 will be half applied, and a strength of 1 will allow the modifications to be fully applied and override the Skeleton2D Bone2D poses.
m.SkeletonModifier3D.BONE_DIRECTION_FROM_P: Enumerated value for the axis from a parent bone to the child bone.
m.SkeletonModifier3D.ROTATION_AXIS_ALL: Enumerated value for the unconstrained rotation.
m.SkeletonModifier3D.ROTATION_AXIS_CUSTOM: Enumerated value for an optional rotation axis.
m.SkeletonModifier3D.ROTATION_AXIS_X: Enumerated value for the rotation of the X axis.
m.SkeletonModifier3D.ROTATION_AXIS_Y: Enumerated value for the rotation of the Y axis.
m.SkeletonModifier3D.ROTATION_AXIS_Z: Enumerated value for the rotation of the Z axis.
m.SkeletonModifier3D.SECONDARY_DIRECTION_C: Enumerated value for an optional axis.
m.SkeletonModifier3D.SECONDARY_DIRECTION_N: Enumerated value for the case when the axis is undefined.
m.SkeletonModifier3D._process_modification: Override this virtual method to implement a custom skeleton modifier. You should do things like get the Skeleton3D's current pose and apply the pose here.
m.SkeletonModifier3D._skeleton_changed: Called when the skeleton is changed.
m.SkeletonModifier3D._validate_bone_names: Called when bone names and indices need to be validated, such as when entering the scene tree or changing skeleton.
m.SkeletonModifier3D.active: If true, the SkeletonModifier3D will be processing.
m.SkeletonModifier3D.get_skeleton: Returns the parent Skeleton3D node if it exists. Otherwise, returns null.
m.SkeletonModifier3D.influence: Sets the influence of the modification.
m.SkeletonModifier3D.modification_processe: Notifies when the modification have been finished.
m.SkeletonProfile.TAIL_DIRECTION_AVERAGE_C: Direction to the average coordinates of bone children.
m.SkeletonProfile.TAIL_DIRECTION_SPECIFIC_: Direction to the coordinates of specified bone child.
m.SkeletonProfile.bone_size: The amount of bones in retargeting section's BoneMap editor. For example, SkeletonProfileHumanoid has 56 bones.
m.SkeletonProfile.find_bone: Returns the bone index that matches bone_name as its name.
m.SkeletonProfile.get_bone_name: Returns the name of the bone at bone_idx that will be the key name in the BoneMap.
m.SkeletonProfile.get_bone_parent: Returns the name of the bone which is the parent to the bone at bone_idx. The result is empty if the bone has no parent.
m.SkeletonProfile.get_bone_tail: Returns the name of the bone which is the tail of the bone at bone_idx.
m.SkeletonProfile.get_group: Returns the group of the bone at bone_idx.
m.SkeletonProfile.get_group_name: Returns the name of the group at group_idx that will be the drawing group in the BoneMap editor.
m.SkeletonProfile.get_handle_offset: Returns the offset of the bone at bone_idx that will be the button position in the BoneMap editor.
m.SkeletonProfile.get_reference_pose: Returns the reference pose transform for bone bone_idx.
m.SkeletonProfile.get_tail_direction: Returns the tail direction of the bone at bone_idx.
m.SkeletonProfile.get_texture: Returns the texture of the group at group_idx that will be the drawing group background image in the BoneMap editor.

m.SkeletonProfile.scale_base_bone: A bone name which will use model's height as the coefficient for normalization. For example, SkeletonProfileHumanoid defines it as Hips.

m.SkeletonProfile.set_bone_parent: Sets the bone with name bone_parent as the parent of the bone at bone_idx. If an empty string is passed, then the bone has no parent.
m.SkeletonProfile.set_bone_tail: Sets the bone with name bone_tail as the tail of the bone at bone_idx.
m.SkeletonProfile.set_group: Sets the group of the bone at bone_idx.
m.SkeletonProfile.set_group_name: Sets the name of the group at group_idx that will be the drawing group in the BoneMap editor.
m.SkeletonProfile.set_handle_offset: Sets the offset of the bone at bone_idx that will be the button position in the BoneMap editor.
m.SkeletonProfile.set_reference_pose: Sets the reference pose transform for bone bone_idx.
m.SkeletonProfile.set_required: Sets the required status for bone bone_idx to required.
m.SkeletonProfile.set_tail_direction: Sets the tail direction of the bone at bone_idx.
m.SkeletonProfile.set_texture: Sets the texture of the group at group_idx that will be the drawing group background image in the BoneMap editor.
