m.SkinReference.get_skeleton: Returns the RID owned by this SkinReference, as returned by RenderingServer.skeleton_create().
m.SkinReference.get_skin: Returns the Skin connected to this SkinReference. In the case of MeshInstance3D with no MeshInstance3D.skin assigned, this will reference an internal default Skin owned by that MeshInstance3D.
m.Sky.PROCESS_MODE_AUTOMATIC: Automatically selects the appropriate process mode based on your sky shader. If your shader uses TIME or POSITION, this will use PROCESS_MODE_REALTIME. If your shader uses any of the LIGHT_* variables or any custom uniforms, this uses PROCESS_MODE_INCREMENTAL. Otherwise, this defaults to PROCESS_MODE_QUALITY.
m.Sky.PROCESS_MODE_INCREMENTAL: Uses the same high quality importance sampling to process the radiance map as PROCESS_MODE_QUALITY, but updates over several frames. The number of frames is determined by ProjectSettings.rendering/reflections/sky_reflections/roughness_layers. Use this when you need highest quality radiance maps, but have a sky that updates slowly.
m.Sky.PROCESS_MODE_QUALITY: Uses high quality importance sampling to process the radiance map. In general, this results in much higher quality than PROCESS_MODE_REALTIME but takes much longer to generate. This should not be used if you plan on changing the sky at runtime. If you are finding that the reflection is not blurry enough and is showing sparkles or fireflies, try increasing ProjectSettings.rendering/reflections/sky…
m.Sky.PROCESS_MODE_REALTIME: Uses the fast filtering algorithm to process the radiance map. In general this results in lower quality, but substantially faster run times. If you need better quality, but still need to update the sky every frame, consider turning on ProjectSettings.rendering/reflections/sky_reflections/fast_filter_high_quality.
m.Sky.RADIANCE_SIZE_MAX: Represents the size of the RadianceSize enum.
m.Sky.process_mode: The method for generating the radiance map from the sky. The radiance map is a cubemap with increasingly blurry versions of the sky corresponding to different levels of roughness. Radiance maps can be expensive to calculate.
m.Sky.radiance_size: The Sky's radiance map size. The higher the radiance map size, the more detailed the lighting from the Sky will be.
m.Sky.sky_material: Material used to draw the background. Can be PanoramaSkyMaterial, ProceduralSkyMaterial, PhysicalSkyMaterial, or even a ShaderMaterial if you want to use your own custom shader.
m.Slider.TICK_POSITION_BOTH: Places the ticks at the both sides of the slider.
m.Slider.TICK_POSITION_BOTTOM_RIGHT: Places the ticks at the bottom of the HSlider, or right of the VSlider.
m.Slider.TICK_POSITION_CENTER: Places the ticks at the center of the slider.
m.Slider.TICK_POSITION_TOP_LEFT: Places the ticks at the top of the HSlider, or left of the VSlider.
m.Slider.drag_ended: Emitted when the grabber stops being dragged. If value_changed is true, Range.value is different from the value when the dragging was started.
m.Slider.drag_started: Emitted when the grabber starts being dragged. This is emitted before the corresponding Range.value_changed signal.
m.Slider.editable: If true, the slider can be interacted with. If false, the value can be changed only by code.
m.Slider.scrollable: If true, the value can be changed using the mouse wheel.
m.Slider.tick_count: Number of ticks displayed on the slider, including border ticks. Ticks are uniformly-distributed value markers.
m.Slider.ticks_on_borders: If true, the slider will display ticks for minimum and maximum values.
m.Slider.ticks_position: Sets the position of the ticks. See TickPosition for details.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_ANGULAR_LIMIT_DAMPIN: Constant for accessing angular_limit/damping. The amount of damping of the rotation when the limit is surpassed.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_ANGULAR_LIMIT_LOWER: Constant for accessing angular_limit/lower_angle. The lower limit of rotation in the slider.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_ANGULAR_LIMIT_RESTIT: Constant for accessing angular_limit/restitution. The amount of restitution of the rotation when the limit is surpassed.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_ANGULAR_LIMIT_SOFTNE: Constant for accessing angular_limit/softness. A factor applied to the all rotation once the limit is surpassed.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_ANGULAR_LIMIT_UPPER: Constant for accessing angular_limit/upper_angle. The upper limit of rotation in the slider.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_ANGULAR_MOTION_DAMPI: Constant for accessing angular_motion/damping. The amount of damping of the rotation in the limits.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_ANGULAR_MOTION_RESTI: Constant for accessing angular_motion/restitution. The amount of restitution of the rotation in the limits.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_ANGULAR_MOTION_SOFTN: Constant for accessing angular_motion/softness. A factor applied to the all rotation in the limits.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_ANGULAR_ORTHOGONAL_D: Constant for accessing angular_ortho/damping. The amount of damping of the rotation across axes orthogonal to the slider.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_ANGULAR_ORTHOGONAL_R: Constant for accessing angular_ortho/restitution. The amount of restitution of the rotation across axes orthogonal to the slider.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_ANGULAR_ORTHOGONAL_S: Constant for accessing angular_ortho/softness. A factor applied to the all rotation across axes orthogonal to the slider.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_LINEAR_LIMIT_DAMPING: Constant for accessing linear_limit/damping. The amount of damping once the slider limits are surpassed.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_LINEAR_LIMIT_LOWER: Constant for accessing linear_limit/lower_distance. The minimum difference between the pivot points on their X axis before damping happens.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_LINEAR_LIMIT_RESTITU: Constant for accessing linear_limit/restitution. The amount of restitution once the limits are surpassed. The lower, the more velocity-energy gets lost.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_LINEAR_LIMIT_SOFTNES: Constant for accessing linear_limit/softness. A factor applied to the movement across the slider axis once the limits get surpassed. The lower, the slower the movement.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_LINEAR_LIMIT_UPPER: Constant for accessing linear_limit/upper_distance. The maximum difference between the pivot points on their X axis before damping happens.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_LINEAR_MOTION_DAMPIN: Constant for accessing linear_motion/damping. The amount of damping inside the slider limits.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_LINEAR_MOTION_RESTIT: Constant for accessing linear_motion/restitution. The amount of restitution inside the slider limits.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_LINEAR_MOTION_SOFTNE: Constant for accessing linear_motion/softness. A factor applied to the movement across the slider axis as long as the slider is in the limits. The lower, the slower the movement.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_LINEAR_ORTHOGONAL_DA: Constant for accessing linear_motion/damping. The amount of damping when movement is across axes orthogonal to the slider.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_LINEAR_ORTHOGONAL_RE: Constant for accessing linear_motion/restitution. The amount of restitution when movement is across axes orthogonal to the slider.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_LINEAR_ORTHOGONAL_SO: Constant for accessing linear_ortho/softness. A factor applied to the movement across axes orthogonal to the slider.
m.SliderJoint3D.PARAM_MAX: Represents the size of the Param enum.
m.SliderJoint3D.get_param: Returns the value of the given parameter.
m.SliderJoint3D.set_param: Assigns value to the given parameter.
m.SocketServer.is_connection_available: Returns true if a connection is available for taking.
m.SocketServer.is_listening: Returns true if the server is currently listening for connections.
m.SocketServer.take_socket_connection: If a connection is available, returns a StreamPeerSocket with the connection.
m.SoftBody3D.DISABLE_MODE_KEEP_ACTIVE: When Node.process_mode is set to Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED, do not affect the physics simulation.
m.SoftBody3D.DISABLE_MODE_REMOVE: When Node.process_mode is set to Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED, remove from the physics simulation to stop all physics interactions with this SoftBody3D.
m.SoftBody3D.add_collision_exception_with: Adds a body to the list of bodies that this body can't collide with.
m.SoftBody3D.apply_central_force: Distributes and applies a force to all points. A force is time dependent and meant to be applied every physics update.
m.SoftBody3D.apply_central_impulse: Distributes and applies an impulse to all points.
m.SoftBody3D.apply_force: Applies a force to a point. A force is time dependent and meant to be applied every physics update.
m.SoftBody3D.apply_impulse: Applies an impulse to a point.
m.SoftBody3D.collision_layer: The physics layers this SoftBody3D is in. Collision objects can exist in one or more of 32 different layers. See also collision_mask.
m.SoftBody3D.collision_mask: The physics layers this SoftBody3D scans. Collision objects can scan one or more of 32 different layers. See also collision_layer.
m.SoftBody3D.damping_coefficient: The body's damping coefficient. Higher values will slow down the body more noticeably when forces are applied.
m.SoftBody3D.disable_mode: Defines the behavior in physics when Node.process_mode is set to Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED.
m.SoftBody3D.drag_coefficient: The body's drag coefficient. Higher values increase this body's air resistance.
m.SoftBody3D.get_collision_exceptions: Returns an array of nodes that were added as collision exceptions for this body.
m.SoftBody3D.get_collision_layer_value: Returns whether or not the specified layer of the collision_layer is enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.SoftBody3D.get_collision_mask_value: Returns whether or not the specified layer of the collision_mask is enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.SoftBody3D.get_physics_rid: Returns the internal RID used by the PhysicsServer3D for this body.
m.SoftBody3D.get_point_transform: Returns local translation of a vertex in the surface array.
m.SoftBody3D.is_point_pinned: Returns true if vertex is set to pinned.
m.SoftBody3D.linear_stiffness: Higher values will result in a stiffer body, while lower values will increase the body's ability to bend. The value can be between 0.0 and 1.0 (inclusive).
m.SoftBody3D.parent_collision_ignore: NodePath to a CollisionObject3D this SoftBody3D should avoid clipping.
m.SoftBody3D.pressure_coefficient: The pressure coefficient of this soft body. Simulate pressure build-up from inside this body. Higher values increase the strength of this effect.
m.SoftBody3D.ray_pickable: If true, the SoftBody3D will respond to RayCast3Ds.
m.SoftBody3D.remove_collision_exception_wi: Removes a body from the list of bodies that this body can't collide with.
m.SoftBody3D.set_collision_layer_value: Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the collision_layer, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.SoftBody3D.set_collision_mask_value: Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the collision_mask, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.SoftBody3D.set_point_pinned: Sets the pinned state of a surface vertex. When set to true, the optional attachment_path can define a Node3D the pinned vertex will be attached to.
m.SoftBody3D.shrinking_factor: Scales the rest lengths of SoftBody3D's edge constraints. Positive values shrink the mesh, while negative values expand it. For example, a value of 0.1 shortens the edges of the mesh by 10%, while -0.1 expands the edges by 10%.
m.SoftBody3D.simulation_precision: Increasing this value will improve the resulting simulation, but can affect performance. Use with care.
m.SphereMesh.is_hemisphere: If true, a hemisphere is created rather than a full sphere.
m.SphereMesh.radial_segments: Number of radial segments on the sphere.
m.SphereMesh.rings: Number of segments along the height of the sphere.
m.SphereShape3D.radius: The sphere's radius. The shape's diameter is double the radius.
m.SpinBox.alignment: Changes the alignment of the underlying LineEdit.
m.SpinBox.apply: Applies the current value of this SpinBox. This is equivalent to pressing Enter while editing the LineEdit used by the SpinBox. This will cause LineEdit.text_submitted to be emitted and its currently contained expression to be evaluated.
m.SpinBox.custom_arrow_round: If true, the value will be rounded to a multiple of custom_arrow_step when interacting with the arrow buttons. Otherwise, increments the value by custom_arrow_step and then rounds it according to Range.step.
m.SpinBox.custom_arrow_step: If not 0, sets the step when interacting with the arrow buttons of the SpinBox.
m.SpinBox.editable: If true, the SpinBox will be editable. Otherwise, it will be read only.
m.SpinBox.get_line_edit: Returns the LineEdit instance from this SpinBox. You can use it to access properties and methods of LineEdit.
m.SpinBox.prefix: Adds the specified prefix string before the numerical value of the SpinBox.
m.SpinBox.select_all_on_focus: If true, the SpinBox will select the whole text when the LineEdit gains focus. Clicking the up and down arrows won't trigger this behavior.
m.SpinBox.suffix: Adds the specified suffix string after the numerical value of the SpinBox.
m.SpinBox.update_on_text_changed: Sets the value of the Range for this SpinBox when the LineEdit text is changed instead of submitted. See LineEdit.text_changed and LineEdit.text_submitted.
m.SplineIK3D.get_path_3d: Returns the node path of the Path3D which is describing the path.
m.SplineIK3D.get_tilt_fade_in: Returns the tilt interpolation method used between the root bone and the start point of the Curve3D when they are apart. See also set_tilt_fade_in().
m.SplineIK3D.get_tilt_fade_out: Returns the tilt interpolation method used between the end bone and the end point of the Curve3D when they are apart. See also set_tilt_fade_out().
m.SplineIK3D.is_tilt_enabled: Returns if the tilt property of the Curve3D affects the bone twist.
m.SplineIK3D.set_path_3d: Sets the node path of the Path3D which is describing the path.
m.SplineIK3D.set_tilt_enabled: Sets if the tilt property of the Curve3D should affect the bone twist.
m.SplineIK3D.set_tilt_fade_in: If size is greater than 0, the tilt is interpolated between size start bones from the start point of the Curve3D when they are apart.
m.SplineIK3D.set_tilt_fade_out: If size is greater than 0, the tilt is interpolated between size end bones from the end point of the Curve3D when they are apart.
m.SplitContainer.DRAGGER_HIDDEN: The split dragger icon is never visible regardless of the value of autohide.
m.SplitContainer.DRAGGER_HIDDEN_COLLAPSED: The split dragger icon is not visible, and the split bar is collapsed to zero thickness.
m.SplitContainer.DRAGGER_VISIBLE: The split dragger icon is always visible when autohide is false, otherwise visible only when the cursor hovers it.
m.SplitContainer.clamp_split_offset: Clamps the split_offsets values to ensure they are within valid ranges and do not overlap with each other. When overlaps occur, this method prioritizes one split offset (at index priority_index) by clamping any overlapping split offsets to it.
m.SplitContainer.collapsed: If true, the draggers will be disabled and the children will be sized as if all split_offsets were 0.
m.SplitContainer.drag_area_highlight_in_ed: Highlights the drag area Rect2 so you can see where it is during development. The drag area is gold if dragging_enabled is true, and red if false.
m.SplitContainer.drag_area_margin_begin: Reduces the size of the drag area and split bar split_bar_background at the beginning of the container.
m.SplitContainer.drag_area_margin_end: Reduces the size of the drag area and split bar split_bar_background at the end of the container.
m.SplitContainer.drag_area_offset: Shifts the drag area in the axis of the container to prevent the drag area from overlapping the ScrollBar or other selectable Control of a child node.
m.SplitContainer.drag_ended: Emitted when the user ends dragging.
m.SplitContainer.drag_nested_intersections: Adds extra draggers at the intersection of the draggers of two SplitContainers to allow dragging both at once. This must be set to true for both SplitContainers, and one needs to be a descendant of the other. They also must be orthogonal (their vertical are different) and the descendant must be next to at least one of the ancestor's draggers (within minimum_grab_thickness).
m.SplitContainer.drag_started: Emitted when the user starts dragging.
m.SplitContainer.dragged: Emitted when any dragger is dragged by user.
m.SplitContainer.dragger_visibility: Determines the dragger's visibility. This property does not determine whether dragging is enabled or not. Use dragging_enabled for that.
m.SplitContainer.get_drag_area_control: Deprecated: Use the first element of get_drag_area_controls() instead.
m.SplitContainer.get_drag_area_controls: Returns an Array of the drag area Controls. These are the interactable Control nodes between each child. For example, this can be used to add a pre-configured button to a drag area Control so that it rides along with the split bar. Try setting the Button anchors to center prior to the Node.reparent() call.
m.SplitContainer.split_offset: Deprecated: Use split_offsets instead. The first element of the array is the split offset between the first two children.
m.SplitContainer.split_offsets: Offsets for each dragger in pixels. Each one is the offset of the split between the Control nodes before and after the dragger, with 0 being the default position. The default position is based on the Control nodes expand flags and minimum sizes. See Control.size_flags_horizontal, Control.size_flags_vertical, and Control.size_flags_stretch_ratio.
m.SplitContainer.touch_dragger_enabled: If true, a touch-friendly drag handle will be enabled for better usability on smaller screens. Unlike the standard grabber, this drag handle overlaps the SplitContainer's children and does not affect their minimum separation. The standard grabber will no longer be drawn when this option is enabled.
m.SplitContainer.vertical: If true, the SplitContainer will arrange its children vertically, rather than horizontally.
m.SpotLight3D.spot_angle: The spotlight's angle in degrees. This is the angular radius, meaning the angle from the -Z axis, the cone's center, to the edge of the cone. The default angular radius of 45 degrees corresponds to a cone with an angular diameter of 90 degrees.
m.SpotLight3D.spot_angle_attenuation: The spotlight's angular attenuation curve. See also spot_attenuation.
m.SpotLight3D.spot_attenuation: Controls the distance attenuation function for spotlights.
m.SpotLight3D.spot_range: The maximal range that can be reached by the spotlight. Note that the effectively lit area may appear to be smaller depending on the spot_attenuation in use. No matter the spot_attenuation in use, the light will never reach anything outside this range.
m.SpringArm3D.add_excluded_object: Adds the PhysicsBody3D object with the given RID to the list of PhysicsBody3D objects excluded from the collision check.
m.SpringArm3D.clear_excluded_objects: Clears the list of PhysicsBody3D objects excluded from the collision check.
m.SpringArm3D.collision_mask: The layers against which the collision check will be done. See Collision layers and masks in the documentation for more information.
m.SpringArm3D.get_hit_length: Returns the spring arm's current length.
m.SpringArm3D.margin: When the collision check is made, a candidate length for the SpringArm3D is given.
m.SpringArm3D.remove_excluded_object: Removes the given RID from the list of PhysicsBody3D objects excluded from the collision check.
m.SpringArm3D.shape: The Shape3D to use for the SpringArm3D.
m.SpringArm3D.spring_length: The maximum extent of the SpringArm3D. This is used as a length for both the ray and the shape cast used internally to calculate the desired position of the SpringArm3D's child nodes.
m.SpringBoneCollision3D.bone: The index of the attached bone.
m.SpringBoneCollision3D.bone_name: The name of the attached bone.
m.SpringBoneCollision3D.get_skeleton: Get parent Skeleton3D node of the parent SpringBoneSimulator3D if found.
m.SpringBoneCollision3D.position_offset: The offset of the position from Skeleton3D's bone pose position.
m.SpringBoneCollision3D.rotation_offset: The offset of the rotation from Skeleton3D's bone pose rotation.
m.SpringBoneCollisionCapsule3D.height: The capsule's full height, including the hemispheres.
m.SpringBoneCollisionCapsule3D.inside: If true, the collision acts to trap the joint within the collision.
m.SpringBoneCollisionCapsule3D.mid_height: The capsule's height, excluding the hemispheres. This is the height of the central cylindrical part in the middle of the capsule, and is the distance between the centers of the two hemispheres. This is a wrapper for height.
m.SpringBoneCollisionSphere3D.inside: If true, the collision acts to trap the joint within the collision.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.CENTER_FROM_BONE: The bone pose origin of the parent Skeleton3D specified by set_center_bone() is defined as center.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.CENTER_FROM_NODE: The Node3D specified by set_center_node() is defined as center.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.CENTER_FROM_WORLD_: The world origin is defined as center.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.are_all_child_coll: Returns true if all child SpringBoneCollision3Ds are contained in the collision list at index in the settings.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.clear_collisions: Clears all collisions from the collision list at index in the settings when are_all_child_collisions_enabled() is false.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.clear_exclude_coll: Clears all exclude collisions from the collision list at index in the settings when are_all_child_collisions_enabled() is true.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.external_force: The constant force that always affected bones. It is equal to the result when the parent Skeleton3D moves at this speed in the opposite direction.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_center_bone: Returns the center bone index of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_center_bone_na: Returns the center bone name of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_center_from: Returns what the center originates from in the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_center_node: Returns the center node path of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_collision_coun: Returns the collision count of the bone chain's collision list when are_all_child_collisions_enabled() is false.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_collision_path: Returns the node path of the SpringBoneCollision3D at collision in the bone chain's collision list when are_all_child_collisions_enabled() is false.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_drag: Returns the drag force damping curve of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_drag_damping_c: Returns the drag force damping curve of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_end_bone: Returns the end bone index of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_end_bone_direc: Returns the tail direction of the end bone of the bone chain when is_end_bone_extended() is true.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_end_bone_lengt: Returns the end bone tail length of the bone chain when is_end_bone_extended() is true.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_end_bone_name: Returns the end bone name of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_exclude_collis: Returns the exclude collision count of the bone chain's exclude collision list when are_all_child_collisions_enabled() is true.
Returns the node path of the SpringBoneCollision3D at collision in the bone chain's exclude collision list when are_all_child_collisions_enabled() is true.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_gravity: Returns the gravity amount of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_gravity_dampin: Returns the gravity amount damping curve of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_gravity_direct: Returns the gravity direction of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_joint_bone: Returns the bone index at joint in the bone chain's joint list.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_joint_bone_nam: Returns the bone name at joint in the bone chain's joint list.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_joint_count: Returns the joint count of the bone chain's joint list.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_joint_drag: Returns the drag force at joint in the bone chain's joint list.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_joint_gravity: Returns the gravity amount at joint in the bone chain's joint list.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_joint_gravity_: Returns the gravity direction at joint in the bone chain's joint list.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_joint_radius: Returns the radius at joint in the bone chain's joint list.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_joint_rotation: Returns the rotation axis at joint in the bone chain's joint list.

Returns the rotation axis vector for the specified joint in the bone chain. This vector represents the axis around which the joint can rotate. It is determined based on the rotation axis set for the joint.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_joint_stiffnes: Returns the stiffness force at joint in the bone chain's joint list.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_radius: Returns the joint radius of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_radius_damping: Returns the joint radius damping curve of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_root_bone: Returns the root bone index of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_root_bone_name: Returns the root bone name of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_rotation_axis: Returns the rotation axis of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_rotation_axis_: Returns the rotation axis vector of the bone chain. This vector represents the axis around which the bone chain can rotate. It is determined based on the rotation axis set for the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_stiffness: Returns the stiffness force of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.get_stiffness_damp: Returns the stiffness force damping curve of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.is_config_individu: Returns true if the config can be edited individually for each joint.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.is_end_bone_extend: Returns true if the end bone is extended to have a tail.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.mutable_bone_axes: If true, the solver retrieves the bone axis from the bone pose every frame.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.reset: Resets a simulating state with respect to the current bone pose.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_center_bone: Sets the center bone index of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_center_bone_na: Sets the center bone name of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_center_from: Sets what the center originates from in the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_center_node: Sets the center node path of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_collision_coun: Sets the number of collisions in the collision list at index in the settings when are_all_child_collisions_enabled() is false.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_collision_path: Sets the node path of the SpringBoneCollision3D at collision in the bone chain's collision list when are_all_child_collisions_enabled() is false.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_drag: Sets the drag force of the bone chain. The greater the value, the more suppressed the wiggling.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_drag_damping_c: Sets the drag force damping curve of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_enable_all_chi: If enabled is true, all child SpringBoneCollision3Ds are colliding and set_exclude_collision_path() is enabled as an exclusion list at index in the settings.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_end_bone: Sets the end bone index of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_end_bone_direc: Sets the end bone tail direction of the bone chain when is_end_bone_extended() is true.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_end_bone_lengt: Sets the end bone tail length of the bone chain when is_end_bone_extended() is true.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_end_bone_name: Sets the end bone name of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_exclude_collis: Sets the number of exclude collisions in the exclude collision list at index in the settings when are_all_child_collisions_enabled() is true.
Sets the node path of the SpringBoneCollision3D at collision in the bone chain's exclude collision list when are_all_child_collisions_enabled() is true.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_extend_end_bon: If enabled is true, the end bone is extended to have a tail.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_gravity: Sets the gravity amount of the bone chain. This value is not an acceleration, but a constant velocity of movement in set_gravity_direction().
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_gravity_dampin: Sets the gravity amount damping curve of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_gravity_direct: Sets the gravity direction of the bone chain. This value is internally normalized and then multiplied by set_gravity().
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_individual_con: If enabled is true, the config can be edited individually for each joint.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_joint_drag: Sets the drag force at joint in the bone chain's joint list when is_config_individual() is true.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_joint_gravity: Sets the gravity amount at joint in the bone chain's joint list when is_config_individual() is true.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_joint_gravity_: Sets the gravity direction at joint in the bone chain's joint list when is_config_individual() is true.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_joint_radius: Sets the joint radius at joint in the bone chain's joint list when is_config_individual() is true.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_joint_rotation: Sets the rotation axis at joint in the bone chain's joint list when is_config_individual() is true.
Sets the rotation axis vector for the specified joint in the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_joint_stiffnes: Sets the stiffness force at joint in the bone chain's joint list when is_config_individual() is true.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_radius: Sets the joint radius of the bone chain. It is used to move and slide with the SpringBoneCollision3D in the collision list.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_radius_damping: Sets the joint radius damping curve of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_root_bone: Sets the root bone index of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_root_bone_name: Sets the root bone name of the bone chain.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_rotation_axis: Sets the rotation axis of the bone chain. If set to a specific axis, it acts like a hinge joint. The value is cached in each joint setting in the joint list.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_rotation_axis_: Sets the rotation axis vector of the bone chain. The value is cached in each joint setting in the joint list.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_stiffness: Sets the stiffness force of the bone chain. The greater the value, the faster it recovers to its initial pose.
m.SpringBoneSimulator3D.set_stiffness_damp: Sets the stiffness force damping curve of the bone chain.
m.Sprite2D.flip_h: If true, texture is flipped horizontally.
m.Sprite2D.flip_v: If true, texture is flipped vertically.
m.Sprite2D.frame: Current frame to display from sprite sheet. hframes or vframes must be greater than 1. This property is automatically adjusted when hframes or vframes are changed to keep pointing to the same visual frame (same column and row). If that's impossible, this value is reset to 0.
m.Sprite2D.frame_coords: Coordinates of the frame to display from sprite sheet. This is as an alias for the frame property. hframes or vframes must be greater than 1.
m.Sprite2D.get_rect: Returns a Rect2 representing the Sprite2D's boundary in local coordinates.
m.Sprite2D.hframes: The number of columns in the sprite sheet. When this property is changed, frame is adjusted so that the same visual frame is maintained (same row and column). If that's impossible, frame is reset to 0.
m.Sprite2D.is_pixel_opaque: Returns true if the pixel at the given position is opaque, false otherwise. Also returns false if the given position is out of bounds or this sprite's texture is null. pos is in local coordinates.
m.Sprite2D.region_enabled: If true, texture is cut from a larger atlas texture. See region_rect.
m.Sprite2D.region_filter_clip_enabled: If true, the area outside of the region_rect is clipped to avoid bleeding of the surrounding texture pixels. region_enabled must be true.
m.Sprite2D.region_rect: The region of the atlas texture to display. region_enabled must be true.
m.Sprite2D.vframes: The number of rows in the sprite sheet. When this property is changed, frame is adjusted so that the same visual frame is maintained (same row and column). If that's impossible, frame is reset to 0.
m.Sprite3D.frame: Current frame to display from sprite sheet. hframes or vframes must be greater than 1. This property is automatically adjusted when hframes or vframes are changed to keep pointing to the same visual frame (same column and row). If that's impossible, this value is reset to 0.
m.Sprite3D.frame_coords: Coordinates of the frame to display from sprite sheet. This is as an alias for the frame property. hframes or vframes must be greater than 1.
m.Sprite3D.hframes: The number of columns in the sprite sheet. When this property is changed, frame is adjusted so that the same visual frame is maintained (same row and column). If that's impossible, frame is reset to 0.
m.Sprite3D.region_enabled: If true, the sprite will use region_rect and display only the specified part of its texture.
m.Sprite3D.region_rect: The region of the atlas texture to display. region_enabled must be true.
m.Sprite3D.texture: Texture2D object to draw. If GeometryInstance3D.material_override is used, this will be overridden. The size information is still used.
m.Sprite3D.vframes: The number of rows in the sprite sheet. When this property is changed, frame is adjusted so that the same visual frame is maintained (same row and column). If that's impossible, frame is reset to 0.
m.SpriteBase3D.ALPHA_CUT_DISABLED: This mode performs standard alpha blending. It can display translucent areas, but transparency sorting issues may be visible when multiple transparent materials are overlapping.
m.SpriteBase3D.ALPHA_CUT_DISCARD: This mode only allows fully transparent or fully opaque pixels. Harsh edges will be visible unless some form of screen-space antialiasing is enabled (see ProjectSettings.rendering/anti_aliasing/quality/screen_space_aa). On the bright side, this mode doesn't suffer from transparency sorting issues when multiple transparent materials are overlapping. This mode is also known as alpha testing or 1-bi…
m.SpriteBase3D.ALPHA_CUT_HASH: This mode draws cuts off all values below a spatially-deterministic threshold, the rest will remain opaque.
m.SpriteBase3D.ALPHA_CUT_OPAQUE_PREPASS: This mode draws fully opaque pixels in the depth prepass. This is slower than ALPHA_CUT_DISABLED or ALPHA_CUT_DISCARD, but it allows displaying translucent areas and smooth edges while using proper sorting.
m.SpriteBase3D.FLAG_DISABLE_DEPTH_TEST: Disables the depth test, so this object is drawn on top of all others. However, objects drawn after it in the draw order may cover it.
m.SpriteBase3D.FLAG_DOUBLE_SIDED: If set, texture can be seen from the back as well. If not, the texture is invisible when looking at it from behind.
m.SpriteBase3D.FLAG_FIXED_SIZE: Label is scaled by depth so that it always appears the same size on screen.
m.SpriteBase3D.FLAG_MAX: Represents the size of the DrawFlags enum.
m.SpriteBase3D.FLAG_SHADED: If set, lights in the environment affect the sprite.
m.SpriteBase3D.FLAG_TRANSPARENT: If set, the texture's transparency and the opacity are used to make those parts of the sprite invisible.
m.SpriteBase3D.alpha_antialiasing_edge: Threshold at which antialiasing will be applied on the alpha channel.
m.SpriteBase3D.alpha_antialiasing_mode: The type of alpha antialiasing to apply.
m.SpriteBase3D.alpha_cut: The alpha cutting mode to use for the sprite.
m.SpriteBase3D.alpha_hash_scale: The hashing scale for Alpha Hash. Recommended values between 0 and 2.
m.SpriteBase3D.alpha_scissor_threshold: Threshold at which the alpha scissor will discard values.
m.SpriteBase3D.axis: The direction in which the front of the texture faces.
m.SpriteBase3D.billboard: The billboard mode to use for the sprite.
m.SpriteBase3D.centered: If true, texture will be centered.
m.SpriteBase3D.double_sided: If true, texture can be seen from the back as well, if false, it is invisible when looking at it from behind.
m.SpriteBase3D.fixed_size: If true, the texture is rendered at the same size regardless of distance. The texture's size on screen is the same as if the camera was 1.0 units away from the texture's origin, regardless of the actual distance from the camera. The Camera3D's field of view (or Camera3D.size when in orthogonal/frustum mode) still affects the size the sprite is drawn at.
m.SpriteBase3D.flip_h: If true, texture is flipped horizontally.
m.SpriteBase3D.flip_v: If true, texture is flipped vertically.
m.SpriteBase3D.generate_triangle_mesh: Returns a TriangleMesh with the sprite's vertices following its current configuration (such as its axis and pixel_size).
m.SpriteBase3D.get_draw_flag: Returns the value of the specified flag.
m.SpriteBase3D.get_item_rect: Returns the rectangle representing this sprite.
m.SpriteBase3D.modulate: A color value used to multiply the texture's colors. Can be used for mood-coloring or to simulate the color of ambient light.
m.SpriteBase3D.no_depth_test: If true, depth testing is disabled and the object will be drawn in render order.
m.SpriteBase3D.pixel_size: The size of one pixel's width on the sprite to scale it in 3D.
m.SpriteBase3D.render_priority: Sets the render priority for the sprite. Higher priority objects will be sorted in front of lower priority objects.
m.SpriteBase3D.set_draw_flag: If true, the specified flag will be enabled.
m.SpriteBase3D.shaded: If true, the Light3D in the Environment has effects on the sprite.
m.SpriteBase3D.transparent: If true, the texture's transparency and the opacity are used to make those parts of the sprite invisible.
m.SpriteFrames.LOOP_LINEAR: The animation restarts from the beginning when it reaches the end, or from the end if played in reverse, repeating continuously.
m.SpriteFrames.LOOP_NONE: The animation plays once and stops when it reaches the end, or the start if played in reverse.
m.SpriteFrames.LOOP_PINGPONG: The animation alternates direction each time it reaches the end or start, playing forward and then in reverse repeatedly.
m.SpriteFrames.add_animation: Adds a new anim animation to the library.
m.SpriteFrames.add_frame: Adds a frame to the anim animation. If at_position is -1, the frame will be added to the end of the animation. duration specifies the relative duration, see get_frame_duration() for details.
m.SpriteFrames.clear: Removes all frames from the anim animation.
m.SpriteFrames.clear_all: Removes all animations. An empty default animation will be created.
m.SpriteFrames.duplicate_animation: Duplicates the animation anim_from to a new animation named anim_to. Fails if anim_to already exists, or if anim_from does not exist.
m.SpriteFrames.get_animation_loop_mode: Returns the loop mode for the anim animation.
m.SpriteFrames.get_animation_names: Returns an array containing the names associated to each animation. Values are placed in alphabetical order.
m.SpriteFrames.get_animation_speed: Returns the speed in frames per second for the anim animation.
m.SpriteFrames.get_frame_count: Returns the number of frames for the anim animation.
m.SpriteFrames.get_frame_duration: Returns a relative duration of the frame idx in the anim animation (defaults to 1.0). m.SpriteFrames.get_frame_texture: Returns the texture of the frame idx in the anim animation.
m.SpriteFrames.has_animation: Returns true if the anim animation exists.
m.SpriteFrames.remove_frame: Removes the anim animation's frame idx.
m.SpriteFrames.rename_animation: Changes the anim animation's name to newname.
m.SpriteFrames.set_animation_loop_mode: Sets the loop_mode for the anim animation.
m.SpriteFrames.set_animation_speed: Sets the speed for the anim animation in frames per second.
m.SpriteFrames.set_frame: Sets the texture and the duration of the frame idx in the anim animation. duration specifies the relative duration, see get_frame_duration() for details.
m.StaticBody2D.constant_angular_velocity: The body's constant angular velocity. This does not rotate the body, but affects touching bodies, as if it were rotating.
m.StaticBody2D.constant_linear_velocity: The body's constant linear velocity. This does not move the body, but affects touching bodies, as if it were moving.
m.StaticBody2D.physics_material_override: The physics material override for the body.
m.StaticBody3D.constant_angular_velocity: The body's constant angular velocity. This does not rotate the body, but affects touching bodies, as if it were rotating.
m.StaticBody3D.constant_linear_velocity: The body's constant linear velocity. This does not move the body, but affects touching bodies, as if it were moving.
m.StaticBody3D.physics_material_override: The physics material override for the body.
m.StatusIndicator.get_rect: Returns the status indicator rectangle in screen coordinates. If this status indicator is not visible, returns an empty Rect2.
m.StatusIndicator.menu: Status indicator native popup menu. If this is set, the pressed signal is not emitted.
m.StatusIndicator.pressed: Emitted when the status indicator is pressed.
m.StatusIndicator.visible: If true, the status indicator is visible.
m.StreamPeer.big_endian: If true, this StreamPeer will using big-endian format for encoding and decoding.
m.StreamPeer.get_16: Gets a signed 16-bit value from the stream.
m.StreamPeer.get_32: Gets a signed 32-bit value from the stream.
m.StreamPeer.get_64: Gets a signed 64-bit value from the stream.
m.StreamPeer.get_8: Gets a signed byte from the stream.
m.StreamPeer.get_available_bytes: Returns the number of bytes this StreamPeer has available.
m.StreamPeer.get_data: Returns a chunk data with the received bytes, as an Array containing two elements: an Error constant and a PackedByteArray. bytes is the number of bytes to be received. If not enough bytes are available, the function will block until the desired amount is received.
m.StreamPeer.get_double: Gets a double-precision float from the stream.
m.StreamPeer.get_float: Gets a single-precision float from the stream.
m.StreamPeer.get_half: Gets a half-precision float from the stream.
m.StreamPeer.get_partial_data: Returns a chunk data with the received bytes, as an Array containing two elements: an Error constant and a PackedByteArray. bytes is the number of bytes to be received. If not enough bytes are available, the function will return how many were actually received.
m.StreamPeer.get_string: Gets an ASCII string with byte-length bytes from the stream. If bytes is negative (default) the length will be read from the stream using the reverse process of put_string().
m.StreamPeer.get_u16: Gets an unsigned 16-bit value from the stream.
m.StreamPeer.get_u32: Gets an unsigned 32-bit value from the stream.
m.StreamPeer.get_u64: Gets an unsigned 64-bit value from the stream.
m.StreamPeer.get_u8: Gets an unsigned byte from the stream.
m.StreamPeer.get_utf8_string: Gets a UTF-8 string with byte-length bytes from the stream (this decodes the string sent as UTF-8). If bytes is negative (default) the length will be read from the stream using the reverse process of put_utf8_string().
m.StreamPeer.get_var: Gets a Variant from the stream. If allow_objects is true, decoding objects is allowed.
m.StreamPeer.put_16: Puts a signed 16-bit value into the stream.
m.StreamPeer.put_32: Puts a signed 32-bit value into the stream.
m.StreamPeer.put_64: Puts a signed 64-bit value into the stream.
m.StreamPeer.put_8: Puts a signed byte into the stream.
m.StreamPeer.put_data: Sends a chunk of data through the connection, blocking if necessary until the data is done sending. This function returns an Error code.
m.StreamPeer.put_double: Puts a double-precision float into the stream.
m.StreamPeer.put_float: Puts a single-precision float into the stream.
m.StreamPeer.put_half: Puts a half-precision float into the stream.
m.StreamPeer.put_partial_data: Sends a chunk of data through the connection. If all the data could not be sent at once, only part of it will. This function returns two values, an Error code and an integer, describing how much data was actually sent.
m.StreamPeer.put_string: Puts a zero-terminated ASCII string into the stream prepended by a 32-bit unsigned integer representing its size.
m.StreamPeer.put_u16: Puts an unsigned 16-bit value into the stream.
m.StreamPeer.put_u32: Puts an unsigned 32-bit value into the stream.
m.StreamPeer.put_u64: Puts an unsigned 64-bit value into the stream.
m.StreamPeer.put_u8: Puts an unsigned byte into the stream.
m.StreamPeer.put_utf8_string: Puts a zero-terminated UTF-8 string into the stream prepended by a 32 bits unsigned integer representing its size.
m.StreamPeer.put_var: Puts a Variant into the stream. If full_objects is true encoding objects is allowed (and can potentially include code).
m.StreamPeerBuffer.clear: Clears the data_array and resets the cursor.
m.StreamPeerBuffer.data_array: The underlying data buffer. Setting this value resets the cursor.
m.StreamPeerBuffer.duplicate: Returns a new StreamPeerBuffer with the same data_array content.
m.StreamPeerBuffer.resize: Resizes the data_array. This doesn't update the cursor.
m.StreamPeerBuffer.seek: Moves the cursor to the specified position. position must be a valid index of data_array.

m.StreamPeerGZIP.clear: Clears this stream, resetting the internal state.
m.StreamPeerGZIP.finish: Finalizes the stream, compressing any buffered chunk left.
m.StreamPeerGZIP.start_compression: Start the stream in compression mode with the given buffer_size, if use_deflate is true uses deflate instead of GZIP.
m.StreamPeerGZIP.start_decompression: Start the stream in decompression mode with the given buffer_size, if use_deflate is true uses deflate instead of GZIP.
m.StreamPeerSocket.STATUS_CONNECTED: A status representing a StreamPeerSocket that is connected to a host.
m.StreamPeerSocket.STATUS_CONNECTING: A status representing a StreamPeerSocket that is connecting to a host.
m.StreamPeerSocket.STATUS_ERROR: A status representing a StreamPeerSocket in error state.
m.StreamPeerSocket.STATUS_NONE: The initial status of the StreamPeerSocket. This is also the status after disconnecting.
m.StreamPeerSocket.get_status: Returns the status of the connection.
m.StreamPeerSocket.poll: Polls the socket, updating its state. See get_status().
m.StreamPeerTCP.bind: Opens the TCP socket, and binds it to the specified local address.
m.StreamPeerTCP.connect_to_host: Connects to the specified host:port pair. A hostname will be resolved if valid. Returns @GlobalScope.OK on success.
m.StreamPeerTCP.get_connected_host: Returns the IP of this peer.
m.StreamPeerTCP.get_connected_port: Returns the port of this peer.
m.StreamPeerTCP.get_local_port: Returns the local port to which this peer is bound.
m.StreamPeerTCP.set_no_delay: If enabled is true, packets will be sent immediately. If enabled is false (the default), packet transfers will be delayed and combined using Nagle's algorithm [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagle%27s_algorithm].
m.StreamPeerTLS.STATUS_CONNECTED: A status representing a StreamPeerTLS that is connected to a host.
m.StreamPeerTLS.STATUS_DISCONNECTED: A status representing a StreamPeerTLS that is disconnected.
m.StreamPeerTLS.STATUS_ERROR: A status representing a StreamPeerTLS in error state.
m.StreamPeerTLS.STATUS_ERROR_HOSTNAME_MISM: An error status that shows a mismatch in the TLS certificate domain presented by the host and the domain requested for validation.
m.StreamPeerTLS.STATUS_HANDSHAKING: A status representing a StreamPeerTLS during handshaking.
m.StreamPeerTLS.accept_stream: Accepts a peer connection as a server using the given server_options. See TLSOptions.server().
m.StreamPeerTLS.connect_to_stream: Connects to a peer using an underlying StreamPeer stream and verifying the remote certificate is correctly signed for the given common_name. You can pass the optional client_options parameter to customize the trusted certification authorities, or disable the common name verification. See TLSOptions.client() and TLSOptions.client_unsafe().
m.StreamPeerTLS.get_status: Returns the status of the connection.
m.StreamPeerTLS.get_stream: Returns the underlying StreamPeer connection, used in accept_stream() or connect_to_stream().
m.StreamPeerTLS.poll: Poll the connection to check for incoming bytes. Call this right before StreamPeer.get_available_bytes() for it to work properly.
m.StreamPeerUDS.bind: Opens the UDS socket, and binds it to the specified socket path.
m.StreamPeerUDS.connect_to_host: Connects to the specified UNIX Domain Socket path. Returns @GlobalScope.OK on success.
m.StreamPeerUDS.get_connected_path: Returns the socket path of this peer.
m.String.begins_with: Returns true if the string begins with the given text. See also ends_with().
m.String.bigrams: Returns an array containing the bigrams (pairs of consecutive characters) of this string.
m.String.bin_to_int: Converts the string representing a binary number into an int. The string may optionally be prefixed with "0b", and an additional - prefix for negative numbers.
m.String.c_escape: Returns a copy of the string with special characters escaped using the C language standard.
m.String.c_unescape: Returns a copy of the string with escaped characters replaced by their meanings. Supported escape sequences are \', \", \\, \a, \b, \f, \n, \r, \t, \v.
m.String.capitalize: Returns a copy of the string with changed appearance. Replaces underscores (_) and hyphens (-) with spaces, adds spaces before uppercase letters in the middle of a word, converts all letters to lowercase, then converts the first one and each one following a space to uppercase.
m.String.casecmp_to: Performs a case-sensitive comparison to another string. Returns -1 if less than, 1 if greater than, or 0 if equal. "Less than" and "greater than" are determined by the Unicode code points [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Unicode_characters] of each string, which roughly matches the alphabetical order.
m.String.chr: Returns a single Unicode character from the integer code. You may use unicodelookup.com [https://unicodelookup.com/] or unicode.org [https://www.unicode.org/charts/] as points of reference.
m.String.contains: Returns true if the string contains what. In GDScript, this corresponds to the in operator.
m.String.containsn: Returns true if the string contains what, ignoring case.
m.String.count: Returns the number of occurrences of the substring what between from and to positions. If to is 0, the search continues until the end of the string.
m.String.countn: Returns the number of occurrences of the substring what between from and to positions, ignoring case. If to is 0, the search continues until the end of the string.
m.String.dedent: Returns a copy of the string with indentation (leading tabs and spaces) removed. See also indent() to add indentation.
m.String.ends_with: Returns true if the string ends with the given text. See also begins_with().
m.String.erase: Returns a string with chars characters erased starting from position. If chars goes beyond the string's length given the specified position, fewer characters will be erased from the returned string. Returns an empty string if either position or chars is negative. Returns the original string unmodified if chars is 0.
m.String.filecasecmp_to: Like naturalcasecmp_to() but prioritizes strings that begin with periods (.) and underscores (_) before any other character. Useful when sorting folders or file names.
m.String.filenocasecmp_to: Like naturalnocasecmp_to() but prioritizes strings that begin with periods (.) and underscores (_) before any other character. Useful when sorting folders or file names.
m.String.find: 查找子串位置，找不到返回 -1。
m.String.findn: Returns the index of the first case-insensitive occurrence of what in this string, or -1 if there are none. The starting search index can be specified with from, continuing to the end of the string.
m.String.get_base_dir: If the string is a valid file path, returns the base directory name.
m.String.get_basename: If the string is a valid file path, returns the full file path, without the extension.
m.String.get_extension: If the string is a valid file name or path, returns the file extension without the leading period (.). Otherwise, returns an empty string.
m.String.get_file: If the string is a valid file path, returns the file name, including the extension.
m.String.get_slice: Splits the string using a delimiter and returns the substring at index slice. Returns the original string if delimiter does not occur in the string. Returns an empty string if the slice does not exist.
m.String.get_slice_count: Returns the total number of slices when the string is split with the given delimiter (see split()).
m.String.get_slicec: Splits the string using a Unicode character with code delimiter and returns the substring at index slice. Returns an empty string if the slice does not exist.
m.String.hash: Returns the 32-bit hash value representing the string's contents.
m.String.hex_decode: Decodes a hexadecimal string as a PackedByteArray.
m.String.hex_to_int: Converts the string representing a hexadecimal number into an int. The string may be optionally prefixed with "0x", and an additional - prefix for negative numbers.
m.String.humanize_size: Converts size which represents a number of bytes into a human-readable form.
m.String.indent: Indents every line of the string with the given prefix. Empty lines are not indented. See also dedent() to remove indentation.
m.String.insert: Inserts what at the given position in the string.
m.String.is_absolute_path: Returns true if the string is a path to a file or directory, and its starting point is explicitly defined. This method is the opposite of is_relative_path().
m.String.is_empty: Returns true if the string's length is 0 (""). See also length().
m.String.is_relative_path: Returns true if the string is a path, and its starting point is dependent on context. The path could begin from the current directory, or the current Node (if the string is derived from a NodePath), and may sometimes be prefixed with "./". This method is the opposite of is_absolute_path().
m.String.is_subsequence_of: Returns true if all characters of this string can be found in text in their original order. This is not the same as contains().
m.String.is_subsequence_ofn: Returns true if all characters of this string can be found in text in their original order, ignoring case. This is not the same as containsn().
m.String.is_valid_ascii_identifier: Returns true if this string is a valid ASCII identifier. A valid ASCII identifier may contain only letters, digits, and underscores (_), and the first character may not be a digit.
m.String.is_valid_filename: Returns true if this string is a valid file name. A valid file name cannot be empty, begin or end with space characters, or contain characters that are not allowed (: / \ ? * " | % < >).
m.String.is_valid_float: Returns true if this string represents a valid floating-point number. A valid float may contain only digits, one decimal point (.), and the exponent letter (e). It may also be prefixed with a positive (+) or negative (-) sign. Any valid integer is also a valid float (see is_valid_int()). See also to_float().
m.String.is_valid_hex_number: Returns true if this string is a valid hexadecimal number. A valid hexadecimal number only contains digits or letters A to F (either uppercase or lowercase), and may be prefixed with a positive (+) or negative (-) sign.
m.String.is_valid_html_color: Returns true if this string is a valid color in hexadecimal HTML notation. The string must be a hexadecimal value (see is_valid_hex_number()) of either 3, 4, 6 or 8 digits, and may be prefixed by a hash sign (#). Other HTML notations for colors, such as names or hsl(), are not considered valid. See also Color.html().
m.String.is_valid_int: Returns true if this string represents a valid integer. A valid integer only contains digits, and may be prefixed with a positive (+) or negative (-) sign. See also to_int().
m.String.is_valid_ip_address: Returns true if this string represents a well-formatted IPv4 or IPv6 address. This method considers reserved IP addresses [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reserved_IP_addresses] such as "0.0.0.0" and "ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff" as valid.
m.String.is_valid_unicode_identifier: Returns true if this string is a valid Unicode identifier.
m.String.join: Returns the concatenation of parts' elements, with each element separated by the string calling this method. This method is the opposite of split().
m.String.json_escape: Returns a copy of the string with special characters escaped using the JSON standard. Because it closely matches the C standard, it is possible to use c_unescape() to unescape the string, if necessary.
m.String.left: Returns the first length characters from the beginning of the string. If length is negative, strips the last length characters from the string's end.
m.String.lpad: Formats the string to be at least min_length long by adding characters to the left of the string, if necessary. See also rpad().
m.String.lstrip: Removes a set of characters defined in chars from the string's beginning. See also rstrip().
m.String.match: Does a simple expression match (also called "glob" or "globbing"), where * matches zero or more arbitrary characters and ? matches any single character except a period (.). An empty string or empty expression always evaluates to false.
m.String.matchn: Does a simple case-insensitive expression match, where * matches zero or more arbitrary characters and ? matches any single character except a period (.). An empty string or empty expression always evaluates to false.
m.String.md5_buffer: Returns the MD5 hash [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MD5] of the string as a PackedByteArray.
m.String.md5_text: Returns the MD5 hash [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MD5] of the string as another String.
m.String.naturalcasecmp_to: Performs a case-sensitive, natural order comparison to another string. Returns -1 if less than, 1 if greater than, or 0 if equal. "Less than" or "greater than" are determined by the Unicode code points [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Unicode_characters] of each string, which roughly matches the alphabetical order.
m.String.naturalnocasecmp_to: Performs a case-insensitive, natural order comparison to another string. Returns -1 if less than, 1 if greater than, or 0 if equal. "Less than" or "greater than" are determined by the Unicode code points [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Unicode_characters] of each string, which roughly matches the alphabetical order. Internally, lowercase characters are converted to uppercase for the compar…
m.String.nocasecmp_to: Performs a case-insensitive comparison to another string. Returns -1 if less than, 1 if greater than, or 0 if equal. "Less than" or "greater than" are determined by the Unicode code points [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Unicode_characters] of each string, which roughly matches the alphabetical order. Internally, lowercase characters are converted to uppercase for the comparison.
m.String.num: Converts a float to a string representation of a decimal number, with the number of decimal places specified in decimals.
m.String.num_int64: Converts the given number to a string representation, with the given base.
m.String.num_scientific: Converts the given number to a string representation, in scientific notation.
m.String.num_uint64: Converts the given unsigned int to a string representation, with the given base.
m.String.pad_decimals: Formats the string representing a number to have an exact number of digits after the decimal point.
m.String.pad_zeros: Formats the string representing a number to have an exact number of digits before the decimal point.
m.String.path_join: Concatenates path at the end of the string as a subpath, adding / if necessary.
m.String.remove_char: Removes all occurrences of the Unicode character with code what. Faster version of replace() when the key is only one character long and the replacement is "".
m.String.remove_chars: Removes all occurrences of the characters in chars. See also remove_char().
m.String.repeat: Repeats this string a number of times. count needs to be greater than 0. Otherwise, returns an empty string.
m.String.replace_char: Replaces all occurrences of the Unicode character with code key with the Unicode character with code with. Faster version of replace() when the key is only one character long. To get a single character use "X".unicode_at(0) (note that some strings, like compound letters and emoji, can be composed of multiple unicode codepoints, and will not work with this method, use length() to make sure).
m.String.replace_chars: Replaces any occurrence of the characters in keys with the Unicode character with code with. See also replace_char().
m.String.replacen: Replaces all case-insensitive occurrences of what inside the string with the given forwhat.
m.String.reverse: Returns the copy of this string in reverse order. This operation works on unicode codepoints, rather than sequences of codepoints, and may break things like compound letters or emojis.
m.String.rfind: Returns the index of the last occurrence of what in this string, or -1 if there are none. The search's start can be specified with from, continuing to the beginning of the string. This method is the reverse of find().
m.String.rfindn: Returns the index of the last case-insensitive occurrence of what in this string, or -1 if there are none. The starting search index can be specified with from, continuing to the beginning of the string. This method is the reverse of findn().
m.String.right: Returns the last length characters from the end of the string. If length is negative, strips the first length characters from the string's beginning.
m.String.rpad: Formats the string to be at least min_length long, by adding characters to the right of the string, if necessary. See also lpad().
m.String.rsplit: Splits the string using a delimiter and returns an array of the substrings, starting from the end of the string. The splits in the returned array appear in the same order as the original string. If delimiter is an empty string, each substring will be a single character.
m.String.rstrip: Removes a set of characters defined in chars from the string's end. See also lstrip().
m.String.sha1_buffer: Returns the SHA-1 [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SHA-1] hash of the string as a PackedByteArray.
m.String.sha1_text: Returns the SHA-1 [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SHA-1] hash of the string as another String.
m.String.sha256_buffer: Returns the SHA-256 [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SHA-2] hash of the string as a PackedByteArray.
m.String.sha256_text: Returns the SHA-256 [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SHA-2] hash of the string as another String.
m.String.similarity: Returns the similarity index (Sørensen-Dice coefficient [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C3%B8rensen%E2%80%93Dice_coefficient]) of this string compared to another. A result of 1.0 means totally similar, while 0.0 means totally dissimilar.
m.String.simplify_path: If the string is a valid file path, converts the string into a canonical path. This is the shortest possible path, without "./", and all the unnecessary ".." and "/".
m.String.split: 按分隔符分割为字符串数组。
m.String.split_floats: Splits the string into floats by using a delimiter and returns a PackedFloat64Array.
m.String.strip_edges: Strips all non-printable characters from the beginning and the end of the string. These include spaces, tabulations (\t), and newlines (\n \r).
m.String.strip_escapes: Strips all escape characters from the string. These include all non-printable control characters of the first page of the ASCII table (values from 0 to 31), such as tabulation (\t) and newline (\n, \r) characters, but not spaces.
m.String.substr: Returns part of the string from the position from with length len. If len is -1 (as by default), returns the rest of the string starting from the given position.
m.String.to_ascii_buffer: Converts the string to an ASCII [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ASCII]/Latin-1 encoded PackedByteArray. This method is slightly faster than to_utf8_buffer(), but replaces all unsupported characters with spaces. This is the inverse of PackedByteArray.get_string_from_ascii().
m.String.to_camel_case: Returns the string converted to camelCase.
m.String.to_float: Converts the string representing a decimal number into a float. This method stops on the first non-number character, except the first decimal point (.) and the exponent letter (e). See also is_valid_float().
m.String.to_int: Converts the string representing an integer number into an int. This method removes any non-number character and stops at the first decimal point (.). See also is_valid_int().
m.String.to_kebab_case: Returns the string converted to kebab-case.
m.String.to_lower: Returns the string converted to lowercase.
m.String.to_multibyte_char_buffer: Converts the string to system multibyte code page encoded PackedByteArray. If conversion fails, empty array is returned.
m.String.to_pascal_case: Returns the string converted to PascalCase.
m.String.to_snake_case: Returns the string converted to snake_case.
m.String.to_upper: Returns the string converted to UPPERCASE.
m.String.to_utf16_buffer: Converts the string to a UTF-16 [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UTF-16] encoded PackedByteArray. This is the inverse of PackedByteArray.get_string_from_utf16().
m.String.to_utf32_buffer: Converts the string to a UTF-32 [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UTF-32] encoded PackedByteArray. This is the inverse of PackedByteArray.get_string_from_utf32().
m.String.to_utf8_buffer: Converts the string to a UTF-8 [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UTF-8] encoded PackedByteArray. This method is slightly slower than to_ascii_buffer(), but supports all UTF-8 characters. For most cases, prefer using this method. This is the inverse of PackedByteArray.get_string_from_utf8().
m.String.to_wchar_buffer: Converts the string to a wide character [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wide_character] (wchar_t, UTF-16 on Windows, UTF-32 on other platforms) encoded PackedByteArray. This is the inverse of PackedByteArray.get_string_from_wchar().
m.String.trim_prefix: Removes the given prefix from the start of the string, or returns the string unchanged.
m.String.trim_suffix: Removes the given suffix from the end of the string, or returns the string unchanged.
m.String.unicode_at: Returns the character code at position at.
m.String.uri_decode: Decodes the string from its URL-encoded format. This method is meant to properly decode the parameters in a URL when receiving an HTTP request. See also uri_encode().
m.String.uri_encode: Encodes the string to URL-friendly format. This method is meant to properly encode the parameters in a URL when sending an HTTP request. See also uri_decode().
m.String.uri_file_decode: Decodes the file path from its URL-encoded format. Unlike uri_decode() this method leaves + as is.
m.String.validate_filename: Returns a copy of the string with all characters that are not allowed in is_valid_filename() replaced with underscores.
m.String.validate_node_name: Returns a copy of the string with all characters that are not allowed in Node.name (. : @ / " %) replaced with underscores.
m.String.xml_escape: Returns a copy of the string with special characters escaped using the XML standard. If escape_quotes is true, the single quote (') and double quote (") characters are also escaped.
m.String.xml_unescape: Returns a copy of the string with escaped characters replaced by their meanings according to the XML standard.
m.StringName.begins_with: Returns true if the string begins with the given text. See also ends_with().
m.StringName.bigrams: Returns an array containing the bigrams (pairs of consecutive characters) of this string.
m.StringName.bin_to_int: Converts the string representing a binary number into an int. The string may optionally be prefixed with "0b", and an additional - prefix for negative numbers.
m.StringName.c_escape: Returns a copy of the string with special characters escaped using the C language standard.
m.StringName.c_unescape: Returns a copy of the string with escaped characters replaced by their meanings. Supported escape sequences are \', \", \\, \a, \b, \f, \n, \r, \t, \v.
m.StringName.capitalize: Changes the appearance of the string: replaces underscores (_) with spaces, adds spaces before uppercase letters in the middle of a word, converts all letters to lowercase, then converts the first one and each one following a space to uppercase.
m.StringName.casecmp_to: Performs a case-sensitive comparison to another string. Returns -1 if less than, 1 if greater than, or 0 if equal. "Less than" and "greater than" are determined by the Unicode code points [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Unicode_characters] of each string, which roughly matches the alphabetical order.
m.StringName.contains: Returns true if the string contains what. In GDScript, this corresponds to the in operator.
m.StringName.containsn: Returns true if the string contains what, ignoring case.
m.StringName.count: Returns the number of occurrences of the substring what between from and to positions. If to is 0, the search continues until the end of the string.
m.StringName.countn: Returns the number of occurrences of the substring what between from and to positions, ignoring case. If to is 0, the search continues until the end of the string.
m.StringName.dedent: Returns a copy of the string with indentation (leading tabs and spaces) removed. See also indent() to add indentation.
m.StringName.ends_with: Returns true if the string ends with the given text. See also begins_with().
m.StringName.erase: Returns a string with chars characters erased starting from position. If chars goes beyond the string's length given the specified position, fewer characters will be erased from the returned string. Returns an empty string if either position or chars is negative. Returns the original string unmodified if chars is 0.
m.StringName.filecasecmp_to: Like naturalcasecmp_to() but prioritizes strings that begin with periods (.) and underscores (_) before any other character. Useful when sorting folders or file names.
m.StringName.filenocasecmp_to: Like naturalnocasecmp_to() but prioritizes strings that begin with periods (.) and underscores (_) before any other character. Useful when sorting folders or file names.
m.StringName.find: Returns the index of the first occurrence of what in this string, or -1 if there are none. The search's start can be specified with from, continuing to the end of the string.
m.StringName.findn: Returns the index of the first case-insensitive occurrence of what in this string, or -1 if there are none. The starting search index can be specified with from, continuing to the end of the string.
m.StringName.format: Formats the string by replacing all occurrences of placeholder with the elements of values.
m.StringName.get_base_dir: If the string is a valid file path, returns the base directory name.
m.StringName.get_basename: If the string is a valid file path, returns the full file path, without the extension.
m.StringName.get_extension: If the string is a valid file name or path, returns the file extension without the leading period (.). Otherwise, returns an empty string.
m.StringName.get_file: If the string is a valid file path, returns the file name, including the extension.
m.StringName.get_slice: Splits the string using a delimiter and returns the substring at index slice. Returns the original string if delimiter does not occur in the string. Returns an empty string if the slice does not exist.
m.StringName.get_slice_count: Returns the total number of slices when the string is split with the given delimiter (see split()).
m.StringName.get_slicec: Splits the string using a Unicode character with code delimiter and returns the substring at index slice. Returns an empty string if the slice does not exist.
m.StringName.hash: Returns the 32-bit hash value representing the string's contents.
m.StringName.hex_decode: Decodes a hexadecimal string as a PackedByteArray.
m.StringName.hex_to_int: Converts the string representing a hexadecimal number into an int. The string may be optionally prefixed with "0x", and an additional - prefix for negative numbers.
m.StringName.indent: Indents every line of the string with the given prefix. Empty lines are not indented. See also dedent() to remove indentation.
m.StringName.insert: Inserts what at the given position in the string.
m.StringName.is_absolute_path: Returns true if the string is a path to a file or directory, and its starting point is explicitly defined. This method is the opposite of is_relative_path().
m.StringName.is_empty: Returns true if the string's length is 0 (""). See also length().
m.StringName.is_relative_path: Returns true if the string is a path, and its starting point is dependent on context. The path could begin from the current directory, or the current Node (if the string is derived from a NodePath), and may sometimes be prefixed with "./". This method is the opposite of is_absolute_path().
m.StringName.is_subsequence_of: Returns true if all characters of this string can be found in text in their original order. This is not the same as contains().
m.StringName.is_subsequence_ofn: Returns true if all characters of this string can be found in text in their original order, ignoring case. This is not the same as containsn().
m.StringName.is_valid_ascii_identifier: Returns true if this string is a valid ASCII identifier. A valid ASCII identifier may contain only letters, digits, and underscores (_), and the first character may not be a digit.
m.StringName.is_valid_filename: Returns true if this string is a valid file name. A valid file name cannot be empty, begin or end with space characters, or contain characters that are not allowed (: / \ ? * " | % < >).
m.StringName.is_valid_float: Returns true if this string represents a valid floating-point number. A valid float may contain only digits, one decimal point (.), and the exponent letter (e). It may also be prefixed with a positive (+) or negative (-) sign. Any valid integer is also a valid float (see is_valid_int()). See also to_float().
m.StringName.is_valid_hex_number: Returns true if this string is a valid hexadecimal number. A valid hexadecimal number only contains digits or letters A to F (either uppercase or lowercase), and may be prefixed with a positive (+) or negative (-) sign.
m.StringName.is_valid_html_color: Returns true if this string is a valid color in hexadecimal HTML notation. The string must be a hexadecimal value (see is_valid_hex_number()) of either 3, 4, 6 or 8 digits, and may be prefixed by a hash sign (#). Other HTML notations for colors, such as names or hsl(), are not considered valid. See also Color.html().
m.StringName.is_valid_int: Returns true if this string represents a valid integer. A valid integer only contains digits, and may be prefixed with a positive (+) or negative (-) sign. See also to_int().
m.StringName.is_valid_ip_address: Returns true if this string represents a well-formatted IPv4 or IPv6 address. This method considers reserved IP addresses [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reserved_IP_addresses] such as "0.0.0.0" and "ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff" as valid.
m.StringName.is_valid_unicode_identifier: Returns true if this string is a valid Unicode identifier.
m.StringName.join: Returns the concatenation of parts' elements, with each element separated by the string calling this method. This method is the opposite of split().
m.StringName.json_escape: Returns a copy of the string with special characters escaped using the JSON standard. Because it closely matches the C standard, it is possible to use c_unescape() to unescape the string, if necessary.
m.StringName.left: Returns the first length characters from the beginning of the string. If length is negative, strips the last length characters from the string's end.
m.StringName.length: Returns the number of characters in the string. Empty strings ("") always return 0. See also is_empty().
m.StringName.lpad: Formats the string to be at least min_length long by adding characters to the left of the string, if necessary. See also rpad().
m.StringName.lstrip: Removes a set of characters defined in chars from the string's beginning. See also rstrip().
m.StringName.match: Does a simple expression match (also called "glob" or "globbing"), where * matches zero or more arbitrary characters and ? matches any single character except a period (.). An empty string or empty expression always evaluates to false.
m.StringName.matchn: Does a simple case-insensitive expression match, where * matches zero or more arbitrary characters and ? matches any single character except a period (.). An empty string or empty expression always evaluates to false.
m.StringName.md5_buffer: Returns the MD5 hash [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MD5] of the string as a PackedByteArray.
m.StringName.md5_text: Returns the MD5 hash [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MD5] of the string as another String.
m.StringName.naturalcasecmp_to: Performs a case-sensitive, natural order comparison to another string. Returns -1 if less than, 1 if greater than, or 0 if equal. "Less than" or "greater than" are determined by the Unicode code points [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Unicode_characters] of each string, which roughly matches the alphabetical order.
m.StringName.naturalnocasecmp_to: Performs a case-insensitive, natural order comparison to another string. Returns -1 if less than, 1 if greater than, or 0 if equal. "Less than" or "greater than" are determined by the Unicode code points [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Unicode_characters] of each string, which roughly matches the alphabetical order. Internally, lowercase characters are converted to uppercase for the compar…
m.StringName.nocasecmp_to: Performs a case-insensitive comparison to another string. Returns -1 if less than, 1 if greater than, or 0 if equal. "Less than" or "greater than" are determined by the Unicode code points [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Unicode_characters] of each string, which roughly matches the alphabetical order. Internally, lowercase characters are converted to uppercase for the comparison.
m.StringName.pad_decimals: Formats the string representing a number to have an exact number of digits after the decimal point.
m.StringName.pad_zeros: Formats the string representing a number to have an exact number of digits before the decimal point.
m.StringName.path_join: Concatenates path at the end of the string as a subpath, adding / if necessary.
m.StringName.remove_char: Removes all occurrences of the Unicode character with code what. Faster version of replace() when the key is only one character long and the replacement is "".
m.StringName.remove_chars: Removes all occurrences of the characters in chars. See also remove_char().
m.StringName.repeat: Repeats this string a number of times. count needs to be greater than 0. Otherwise, returns an empty string.
m.StringName.replace: Replaces all occurrences of what inside the string with the given forwhat.
m.StringName.replace_char: Replaces all occurrences of the Unicode character with code key with the Unicode character with code with. Faster version of replace() when the key is only one character long.
