To get a single character use "X".unicode_at(0) (note that some strings, like compound letters and emoji, can be composed of multiple unicode codepoints, and will not work with this method, use length() to make sure).
m.StringName.replace_chars: Replaces any occurrence of the characters in keys with the Unicode character with code with. See also replace_char().
m.StringName.replacen: Replaces all case-insensitive occurrences of what inside the string with the given forwhat.
m.StringName.reverse: Returns the copy of this string in reverse order. This operation works on unicode codepoints, rather than sequences of codepoints, and may break things like compound letters or emojis.
m.StringName.rfind: Returns the index of the last occurrence of what in this string, or -1 if there are none. The search's start can be specified with from, continuing to the beginning of the string. This method is the reverse of find().
m.StringName.rfindn: Returns the index of the last case-insensitive occurrence of what in this string, or -1 if there are none. The starting search index can be specified with from, continuing to the beginning of the string. This method is the reverse of findn().
m.StringName.right: Returns the last length characters from the end of the string. If length is negative, strips the first length characters from the string's beginning.
m.StringName.rpad: Formats the string to be at least min_length long, by adding characters to the right of the string, if necessary. See also lpad().
m.StringName.rsplit: Splits the string using a delimiter and returns an array of the substrings, starting from the end of the string. The splits in the returned array appear in the same order as the original string. If delimiter is an empty string, each substring will be a single character.
m.StringName.rstrip: Removes a set of characters defined in chars from the string's end. See also lstrip().
m.StringName.sha1_buffer: Returns the SHA-1 [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SHA-1] hash of the string as a PackedByteArray.
m.StringName.sha1_text: Returns the SHA-1 [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SHA-1] hash of the string as another String.
m.StringName.sha256_buffer: Returns the SHA-256 [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SHA-2] hash of the string as a PackedByteArray.
m.StringName.sha256_text: Returns the SHA-256 [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SHA-2] hash of the string as another String.
m.StringName.similarity: Returns the similarity index (Sørensen-Dice coefficient [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C3%B8rensen%E2%80%93Dice_coefficient]) of this string compared to another. A result of 1.0 means totally similar, while 0.0 means totally dissimilar.
m.StringName.simplify_path: If the string is a valid file path, converts the string into a canonical path. This is the shortest possible path, without "./", and all the unnecessary ".." and "/".
m.StringName.split: Splits the string using a delimiter and returns an array of the substrings. If delimiter is an empty string, each substring will be a single character. This method is the opposite of join().
m.StringName.split_floats: Splits the string into floats by using a delimiter and returns a PackedFloat64Array.
m.StringName.strip_edges: Strips all non-printable characters from the beginning and the end of the string. These include spaces, tabulations (\t), and newlines (\n \r).
m.StringName.strip_escapes: Strips all escape characters from the string. These include all non-printable control characters of the first page of the ASCII table (values from 0 to 31), such as tabulation (\t) and newline (\n, \r) characters, but not spaces.
m.StringName.substr: Returns part of the string from the position from with length len. If len is -1 (as by default), returns the rest of the string starting from the given position.
m.StringName.to_ascii_buffer: Converts the string to an ASCII [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ASCII]/Latin-1 encoded PackedByteArray. This method is slightly faster than to_utf8_buffer(), but replaces all unsupported characters with spaces. This is the inverse of PackedByteArray.get_string_from_ascii().
m.StringName.to_camel_case: Returns the string converted to camelCase.
m.StringName.to_float: Converts the string representing a decimal number into a float. This method stops on the first non-number character, except the first decimal point (.) and the exponent letter (e). See also is_valid_float().
m.StringName.to_int: Converts the string representing an integer number into an int. This method removes any non-number character and stops at the first decimal point (.). See also is_valid_int().
m.StringName.to_kebab_case: Returns the string converted to kebab-case.
m.StringName.to_lower: Returns the string converted to lowercase.
m.StringName.to_multibyte_char_buffer: Converts the string to system multibyte code page encoded PackedByteArray. If conversion fails, empty array is returned.
m.StringName.to_pascal_case: Returns the string converted to PascalCase.
m.StringName.to_snake_case: Returns the string converted to snake_case.
m.StringName.to_upper: Returns the string converted to UPPERCASE.
m.StringName.to_utf16_buffer: Converts the string to a UTF-16 [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UTF-16] encoded PackedByteArray. This is the inverse of PackedByteArray.get_string_from_utf16().
m.StringName.to_utf32_buffer: Converts the string to a UTF-32 [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UTF-32] encoded PackedByteArray. This is the inverse of PackedByteArray.get_string_from_utf32().
m.StringName.to_utf8_buffer: Converts the string to a UTF-8 [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UTF-8] encoded PackedByteArray. This method is slightly slower than to_ascii_buffer(), but supports all UTF-8 characters. For most cases, prefer using this method. This is the inverse of PackedByteArray.get_string_from_utf8().
m.StringName.to_wchar_buffer: Converts the string to a wide character [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wide_character] (wchar_t, UTF-16 on Windows, UTF-32 on other platforms) encoded PackedByteArray. This is the inverse of PackedByteArray.get_string_from_wchar().
m.StringName.trim_prefix: Removes the given prefix from the start of the string, or returns the string unchanged.
m.StringName.trim_suffix: Removes the given suffix from the end of the string, or returns the string unchanged.
m.StringName.unicode_at: Returns the character code at position at.
m.StringName.uri_decode: Decodes the string from its URL-encoded format. This method is meant to properly decode the parameters in a URL when receiving an HTTP request. See also uri_encode().
m.StringName.uri_encode: Encodes the string to URL-friendly format. This method is meant to properly encode the parameters in a URL when sending an HTTP request. See also uri_decode().
m.StringName.uri_file_decode: Decodes the file path from its URL-encoded format. Unlike uri_decode() this method leaves + as is.
m.StringName.validate_filename: Returns a copy of the string with all characters that are not allowed in is_valid_filename() replaced with underscores.
m.StringName.validate_node_name: Returns a copy of the string with all characters that are not allowed in Node.name (. : @ / " %) replaced with underscores.
m.StringName.xml_escape: Returns a copy of the string with special characters escaped using the XML standard. If escape_quotes is true, the single quote (') and double quote (") characters are also escaped.
m.StringName.xml_unescape: Returns a copy of the string with escaped characters replaced by their meanings according to the XML standard.
m.StyleBox._draw: There is currently no description for this method. Please help us by contributing one [https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/documentation/class_reference.html]!
m.StyleBox._get_draw_rect: There is currently no description for this method. Please help us by contributing one [https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/documentation/class_reference.html]!
m.StyleBox._get_minimum_size: Virtual method to be implemented by the user. Returns a custom minimum size that the stylebox must respect when drawing. By default get_minimum_size() only takes content margins into account. This method can be overridden to add another size restriction. A combination of the default behavior and the output of this method will be used, to account for both sizes.
m.StyleBox._test_mask: There is currently no description for this method. Please help us by contributing one [https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/documentation/class_reference.html]!
m.StyleBox.content_margin_bottom: The bottom margin for the contents of this style box. Increasing this value reduces the space available to the contents from the bottom.
m.StyleBox.content_margin_left: The left margin for the contents of this style box. Increasing this value reduces the space available to the contents from the left.
m.StyleBox.content_margin_right: The right margin for the contents of this style box. Increasing this value reduces the space available to the contents from the right.
m.StyleBox.content_margin_top: The top margin for the contents of this style box. Increasing this value reduces the space available to the contents from the top.
m.StyleBox.draw: Draws this stylebox using a canvas item identified by the given RID.
m.StyleBox.get_content_margin: Returns the default margin of the specified Side.
m.StyleBox.get_current_item_drawn: Returns the CanvasItem that handles its CanvasItem.NOTIFICATION_DRAW or CanvasItem._draw() callback at this moment.
m.StyleBox.get_margin: Returns the content margin offset for the specified Side.
m.StyleBox.get_minimum_size: Returns the minimum size that this stylebox can be shrunk to.
m.StyleBox.get_offset: Returns the "offset" of a stylebox. This helper function returns a value equivalent to Vector2(style.get_margin(MARGIN_LEFT), style.get_margin(MARGIN_TOP)).
m.StyleBox.set_content_margin: Sets the default value of the specified Side to offset pixels.
m.StyleBox.set_content_margin_all: Sets the default margin to offset pixels for all sides.
m.StyleBox.test_mask: Test a position in a rectangle, return whether it passes the mask test.
m.StyleBoxFlat.anti_aliasing: Antialiasing draws a small ring around the edges, which fades to transparency. As a result, edges look much smoother. This is only noticeable when using rounded corners or skew.
m.StyleBoxFlat.anti_aliasing_size: This changes the size of the antialiasing effect. 1.0 is recommended for an optimal result at 100% scale, identical to how rounded rectangles are rendered in web browsers and most vector drawing software.
m.StyleBoxFlat.bg_color: The background color of the stylebox.
m.StyleBoxFlat.border_blend: If true, the border will fade into the background color.
m.StyleBoxFlat.border_color: Sets the color of the border.
m.StyleBoxFlat.border_width_bottom: Border width for the bottom border.
m.StyleBoxFlat.border_width_left: Border width for the left border.
m.StyleBoxFlat.border_width_right: Border width for the right border.
m.StyleBoxFlat.border_width_top: Border width for the top border.
m.StyleBoxFlat.corner_detail: This sets the number of vertices used for each corner. Higher values result in rounder corners but take more processing power to compute. When choosing a value, you should take the corner radius (set_corner_radius_all()) into account.
m.StyleBoxFlat.corner_radius_bottom_left: The bottom-left corner's radius. If 0, the corner is not rounded.
m.StyleBoxFlat.corner_radius_bottom_right: The bottom-right corner's radius. If 0, the corner is not rounded.
m.StyleBoxFlat.corner_radius_top_left: The top-left corner's radius. If 0, the corner is not rounded.
m.StyleBoxFlat.corner_radius_top_right: The top-right corner's radius. If 0, the corner is not rounded.
m.StyleBoxFlat.draw_center: Toggles drawing of the inner part of the stylebox.
m.StyleBoxFlat.expand_margin_bottom: Expands the stylebox outside of the control rect on the bottom edge. Useful in combination with border_width_bottom to draw a border outside the control rect.
m.StyleBoxFlat.expand_margin_left: Expands the stylebox outside of the control rect on the left edge. Useful in combination with border_width_left to draw a border outside the control rect.
m.StyleBoxFlat.expand_margin_right: Expands the stylebox outside of the control rect on the right edge. Useful in combination with border_width_right to draw a border outside the control rect.
m.StyleBoxFlat.expand_margin_top: Expands the stylebox outside of the control rect on the top edge. Useful in combination with border_width_top to draw a border outside the control rect.
m.StyleBoxFlat.get_border_width: Returns the specified Side's border width.
m.StyleBoxFlat.get_border_width_min: Returns the smallest border width out of all four borders.
m.StyleBoxFlat.get_expand_margin: Returns the size of the specified Side's expand margin.
m.StyleBoxFlat.set_border_width: Sets the specified Side's border width to width pixels.
m.StyleBoxFlat.set_border_width_all: Sets the border width to width pixels for all sides.
m.StyleBoxFlat.set_corner_radius: Sets the corner radius to radius pixels for the given corner.
m.StyleBoxFlat.set_corner_radius_all: Sets the corner radius to radius pixels for all corners.
m.StyleBoxFlat.set_expand_margin: Sets the expand margin to size pixels for the specified Side.
m.StyleBoxFlat.set_expand_margin_all: Sets the expand margin to size pixels for all sides.
m.StyleBoxFlat.shadow_color: The color of the shadow. This has no effect if shadow_size is lower than 1.
m.StyleBoxFlat.shadow_offset: The shadow offset in pixels. Adjusts the position of the shadow relatively to the stylebox.
m.StyleBoxFlat.skew: If set to a non-zero value on either axis, skew distorts the StyleBox horizontally and/or vertically. This can be used for "futuristic"-style UIs. Positive values skew the StyleBox towards the right (X axis) and upwards (Y axis), while negative values skew the StyleBox towards the left (X axis) and downwards (Y axis).
m.StyleBoxLine.grow_begin: The number of pixels the line will extend before the StyleBoxLine's bounds. If set to a negative value, the line will begin inside the StyleBoxLine's bounds.
m.StyleBoxLine.grow_end: The number of pixels the line will extend past the StyleBoxLine's bounds. If set to a negative value, the line will end inside the StyleBoxLine's bounds.
m.StyleBoxLine.vertical: If true, the line will be vertical. If false, the line will be horizontal.
m.StyleBoxTexture.AXIS_STRETCH_MODE_STRETC: Stretch the stylebox's texture. This results in visible distortion unless the texture size matches the stylebox's size perfectly.
m.StyleBoxTexture.AXIS_STRETCH_MODE_TILE: Repeats the stylebox's texture to match the stylebox's size according to the nine-patch system.
m.StyleBoxTexture.AXIS_STRETCH_MODE_TILE_F: Repeats the stylebox's texture to match the stylebox's size according to the nine-patch system. Unlike AXIS_STRETCH_MODE_TILE, the texture may be slightly stretched to make the nine-patch texture tile seamlessly.
m.StyleBoxTexture.axis_stretch_horizontal: Controls how the stylebox's texture will be stretched or tiled horizontally.
m.StyleBoxTexture.axis_stretch_vertical: Controls how the stylebox's texture will be stretched or tiled vertically.
m.StyleBoxTexture.draw_center: If true, the nine-patch texture's center tile will be drawn.
m.StyleBoxTexture.expand_margin_bottom: Expands the bottom margin of this style box when drawing, causing it to be drawn larger than requested.
m.StyleBoxTexture.expand_margin_left: Expands the left margin of this style box when drawing, causing it to be drawn larger than requested.
m.StyleBoxTexture.expand_margin_right: Expands the right margin of this style box when drawing, causing it to be drawn larger than requested.
m.StyleBoxTexture.expand_margin_top: Expands the top margin of this style box when drawing, causing it to be drawn larger than requested.
m.StyleBoxTexture.get_expand_margin: Returns the expand margin size of the specified Side.
m.StyleBoxTexture.get_texture_margin: Returns the margin size of the specified Side.
m.StyleBoxTexture.modulate_color: Modulates the color of the texture when this style box is drawn.
m.StyleBoxTexture.region_rect: The region to use from the texture.
m.StyleBoxTexture.set_expand_margin: Sets the expand margin to size pixels for the specified Side.
m.StyleBoxTexture.set_expand_margin_all: Sets the expand margin to size pixels for all sides.
m.StyleBoxTexture.set_texture_margin: Sets the margin to size pixels for the specified Side.
m.StyleBoxTexture.set_texture_margin_all: Sets the margin to size pixels for all sides.
m.StyleBoxTexture.texture: The texture to use when drawing this style box.
m.StyleBoxTexture.texture_margin_bottom: Increases the bottom margin of the 3×3 texture box.
m.StyleBoxTexture.texture_margin_left: Increases the left margin of the 3×3 texture box.
m.StyleBoxTexture.texture_margin_right: Increases the right margin of the 3×3 texture box.
m.StyleBoxTexture.texture_margin_top: Increases the top margin of the 3×3 texture box.
m.SubViewport.CLEAR_MODE_ALWAYS: Always clear the render target before drawing.
m.SubViewport.CLEAR_MODE_ONCE: Clear the render target on the next frame, then switch to CLEAR_MODE_NEVER.
m.SubViewport.UPDATE_DISABLED: Do not update the render target.
m.SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE: Update the render target once, then switch to UPDATE_DISABLED.
m.SubViewport.UPDATE_WHEN_PARENT_VISIBLE: Update the render target only when its parent is visible.
m.SubViewport.UPDATE_WHEN_VISIBLE: Update the render target only when it is visible. This is the default value.
m.SubViewport.render_target_clear_mode: The clear mode when the sub-viewport is used as a render target.
m.SubViewport.render_target_update_mode: The update mode when the sub-viewport is used as a render target.
m.SubViewport.size: The width and height of the sub-viewport. Must be set to a value greater than or equal to 2 pixels on both dimensions. Otherwise, nothing will be displayed.
m.SubViewport.size_2d_override: The 2D size override of the sub-viewport. If either the width or height is 0, the override is disabled.
m.SubViewport.size_2d_override_stretch: If true, the 2D size override affects stretch as well.
m.SubViewport.view_count: The number of view layers we are rendering to. Set this to 2 to enable stereo rendering.
m.SubViewportContainer._propagate_input_ev: Experimental: This method may be changed or removed in future versions.
m.SubViewportContainer.mouse_target: Configure, if either the SubViewportContainer or alternatively the Control nodes of its SubViewport children should be available as targets of mouse-related functionalities, like identifying the drop target in drag-and-drop operations or cursor shape of hovered Control node.
m.SubViewportContainer.stretch: If true, the sub-viewport will be automatically resized to the control's size.
m.SubViewportContainer.stretch_shrink: Divides the sub-viewport's effective resolution by this value while preserving its scale. This can be used to speed up rendering.
m.SubtweenTweener.set_delay: Sets the time in seconds after which the SubtweenTweener will start running the subtween. By default there's no delay.
m.SurfaceTool.CUSTOM_MAX: Used to indicate a disabled custom channel.
m.SurfaceTool.CUSTOM_RGBA8_SNORM: Limits range of data passed to set_custom() to signed normalized -1 to 1 stored in 8 bits per channel. See Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM_RGBA8_SNORM.
m.SurfaceTool.CUSTOM_RGBA8_UNORM: Limits range of data passed to set_custom() to unsigned normalized 0 to 1 stored in 8 bits per channel. See Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM_RGBA8_UNORM.
m.SurfaceTool.CUSTOM_RGBA_FLOAT: Stores data passed to set_custom() as full precision floats, and uses all color channels. See Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM_RGBA_FLOAT.
m.SurfaceTool.CUSTOM_RGBA_HALF: Stores data passed to set_custom() as half precision floats and uses all color channels. See Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM_RGBA_HALF.
m.SurfaceTool.CUSTOM_RGB_FLOAT: Stores data passed to set_custom() as full precision floats, and uses only red, green and blue color channels. See Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM_RGB_FLOAT.
m.SurfaceTool.CUSTOM_RG_FLOAT: Stores data passed to set_custom() as full precision floats, and uses only red and green color channels. See Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM_RG_FLOAT.
m.SurfaceTool.CUSTOM_RG_HALF: Stores data passed to set_custom() as half precision floats, and uses only red and green color channels. See Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM_RG_HALF.
m.SurfaceTool.CUSTOM_R_FLOAT: Stores data passed to set_custom() as full precision floats, and uses only red color channel. See Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM_R_FLOAT.
m.SurfaceTool.SKIN_4_WEIGHTS: Each individual vertex can be influenced by only 4 bone weights.
m.SurfaceTool.SKIN_8_WEIGHTS: Each individual vertex can be influenced by up to 8 bone weights.
m.SurfaceTool.add_index: Adds a vertex to index array if you are using indexed vertices. Does not need to be called before adding vertices.
m.SurfaceTool.add_triangle_fan: Inserts a triangle fan made of array data into Mesh being constructed.
m.SurfaceTool.add_vertex: Specifies the position of current vertex. Should be called after specifying other vertex properties (e.g. Color, UV).
m.SurfaceTool.append_from: Append vertices from a given Mesh surface onto the current vertex array with specified Transform3D.
m.SurfaceTool.begin: Called before adding any vertices. Takes the primitive type as an argument (e.g. Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES).
m.SurfaceTool.clear: Clear all information passed into the surface tool so far.
m.SurfaceTool.commit: Returns a constructed ArrayMesh from current information passed in. If an existing ArrayMesh is passed in as an argument, will add an extra surface to the existing ArrayMesh.
m.SurfaceTool.commit_to_arrays: Commits the data to the same format used by ArrayMesh.add_surface_from_arrays(), ImporterMesh.add_surface(), and create_from_arrays(). This way you can further process the mesh data using the ArrayMesh or ImporterMesh APIs.
m.SurfaceTool.create_from: Creates a vertex array from an existing Mesh.
m.SurfaceTool.create_from_arrays: Creates this SurfaceTool from existing vertex arrays such as returned by commit_to_arrays(), Mesh.surface_get_arrays(), Mesh.surface_get_blend_shape_arrays(), ImporterMesh.get_surface_arrays(), and ImporterMesh.get_surface_blend_shape_arrays(). primitive_type controls the type of mesh data, defaulting to Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES.
m.SurfaceTool.create_from_blend_shape: Creates a vertex array from the specified blend shape of an existing Mesh. This can be used to extract a specific pose from a blend shape.
m.SurfaceTool.deindex: Removes the index array by expanding the vertex array.
m.SurfaceTool.generate_lod: Deprecated: This method is unused internally, as it does not preserve normals or UVs. Consider using ImporterMesh.generate_lods() instead.
m.SurfaceTool.generate_normals: Generates normals from vertices so you do not have to do it manually. If flip is true, the resulting normals will be inverted. generate_normals() should be called after generating geometry and before committing the mesh using commit() or commit_to_arrays(). For correct display of normal-mapped surfaces, you will also have to generate tangents using generate_tangents().
m.SurfaceTool.generate_tangents: Generates a tangent vector for each vertex. Requires that each vertex already has UVs and normals set (see generate_normals()).
m.SurfaceTool.get_aabb: Returns the axis-aligned bounding box of the vertex positions.
m.SurfaceTool.get_custom_format: Returns the format for custom channel_index (currently up to 4). Returns CUSTOM_MAX if this custom channel is unused.
m.SurfaceTool.get_primitive_type: Returns the type of mesh geometry, such as Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES.
m.SurfaceTool.get_skin_weight_count: By default, returns SKIN_4_WEIGHTS to indicate only 4 bone influences per vertex are used.
m.SurfaceTool.index: Shrinks the vertex array by creating an index array. This can improve performance by avoiding vertex reuse.
m.SurfaceTool.optimize_indices_for_cache: Optimizes triangle sorting for performance. Requires that get_primitive_type() is Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES.
m.SurfaceTool.set_bones: Specifies an array of bones to use for the next vertex. bones must contain 4 integers.
m.SurfaceTool.set_color: Specifies a Color to use for the next vertex. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.
m.SurfaceTool.set_custom: Sets the custom value on this vertex for channel_index.
m.SurfaceTool.set_custom_format: Sets the color format for this custom channel_index. Use CUSTOM_MAX to disable.
m.SurfaceTool.set_material: Sets Material to be used by the Mesh you are constructing.
m.SurfaceTool.set_normal: Specifies a normal to use for the next vertex. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.
m.SurfaceTool.set_skin_weight_count: Set to SKIN_8_WEIGHTS to indicate that up to 8 bone influences per vertex may be used.
m.SurfaceTool.set_smooth_group: Specifies the smooth group to use for the next vertex. If this is never called, all vertices will have the default smooth group of 0 and will be smoothed with adjacent vertices of the same group. To produce a mesh with flat normals, set the smooth group to -1.
m.SurfaceTool.set_tangent: Specifies a tangent to use for the next vertex. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.
m.SurfaceTool.set_uv: Specifies a set of UV coordinates to use for the next vertex. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.
m.SurfaceTool.set_uv2: Specifies an optional second set of UV coordinates to use for the next vertex. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.
m.SurfaceTool.set_weights: Specifies weight values to use for the next vertex. weights must contain 4 values. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.
m.SyntaxHighlighter._clear_highlighting_ca: Virtual method which can be overridden to clear any local caches.
m.SyntaxHighlighter._get_line_syntax_highl: Virtual method which can be overridden to return syntax highlighting data.
m.SyntaxHighlighter._update_cache: Virtual method which can be overridden to update any local caches.
m.SyntaxHighlighter.clear_highlighting_cac: Clears all cached syntax highlighting data.
m.SyntaxHighlighter.get_line_syntax_highli: Returns the syntax highlighting data for the line at index line. If the line is not cached, calls _get_line_syntax_highlighting() first to calculate the data.
m.SyntaxHighlighter.update_cache: Clears then updates the SyntaxHighlighter caches. Override _update_cache() for a callback.
m.SystemFont.allow_system_fallback: If set to true, system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.
m.SystemFont.disable_embedded_bitmaps: If set to true, embedded font bitmap loading is disabled (bitmap-only and color fonts ignore this property).
m.SystemFont.font_italic: If set to true, italic or oblique font is preferred.
m.SystemFont.font_names: Array of font family names to search, first matching font found is used.
m.SystemFont.font_stretch: Preferred font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage value between 50% and 200%.
m.SystemFont.font_weight: Preferred weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the 100...999 range, normal font weight is 400, bold font weight is 700.
m.SystemFont.force_autohinter: If set to true, auto-hinting is supported and preferred over font built-in hinting.
m.SystemFont.generate_mipmaps: If set to true, generate mipmaps for the font textures.
m.SystemFont.keep_rounding_remainders: If set to true, when aligning glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if subpixel positioning is enabled.
m.SystemFont.modulate_color_glyphs: If set to true, color modulation is applied when drawing colored glyphs, otherwise it's applied to the monochrome glyphs only.
m.SystemFont.msdf_pixel_range: The width of the range around the shape between the minimum and maximum representable signed distance. If using font outlines, msdf_pixel_range must be set to at least twice the size of the largest font outline. The default msdf_pixel_range value of 16 allows outline sizes up to 8 to look correct.
m.SystemFont.msdf_size: Source font size used to generate MSDF textures. Higher values allow for more precision, but are slower to render and require more memory. Only increase this value if you notice a visible lack of precision in glyph rendering.
m.SystemFont.multichannel_signed_distance_: If set to true, glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font vector data.
m.SystemFont.oversampling: If set to a positive value, overrides the oversampling factor of the viewport this font is used in. See Viewport.oversampling. This value doesn't override the oversampling parameter of draw_* methods.
m.SystemFont.subpixel_positioning: Font glyph subpixel positioning mode. Subpixel positioning provides shaper text and better kerning for smaller font sizes, at the cost of memory usage and font rasterization speed. Use TextServer.SUBPIXEL_POSITIONING_AUTO to automatically enable it based on the font size.
m.TCPServer.get_local_port: Returns the local port this server is listening to.
m.TCPServer.listen: Listen on the port binding to bind_address.
m.TCPServer.take_connection: If a connection is available, returns a StreamPeerTCP with the connection.
m.TLSOptions.client: Creates a TLS client configuration which validates certificates and their common names (fully qualified domain names).
m.TLSOptions.client_unsafe: Creates an unsafe TLS client configuration where certificate validation is optional. You can optionally provide a valid trusted_chain, but the common name of the certificates will never be checked. Using this configuration for purposes other than testing is not recommended.
m.TLSOptions.get_common_name_override: Returns the common name (domain name) override specified when creating with client().
m.TLSOptions.get_own_certificate: Returns the X509Certificate specified when creating with server().
m.TLSOptions.get_private_key: Returns the CryptoKey specified when creating with server().
m.TLSOptions.get_trusted_ca_chain: Returns the CA X509Certificate chain specified when creating with client() or client_unsafe().
m.TLSOptions.is_server: Returns true if created with server(), false otherwise.
m.TLSOptions.is_unsafe_client: Returns true if created with client_unsafe(), false otherwise.
m.TLSOptions.server: Creates a TLS server configuration using the provided key and certificate.
m.TabBar.ALIGNMENT_MAX: Represents the size of the AlignmentMode enum.
m.TabBar.CLOSE_BUTTON_MAX: Represents the size of the CloseButtonDisplayPolicy enum.
m.TabBar.CLOSE_BUTTON_SHOW_ACTIVE_ONLY: Only show the close button on the currently active tab.
m.TabBar.CLOSE_BUTTON_SHOW_ALWAYS: Show the close button on all tabs.
m.TabBar.active_tab_rearranged: Emitted when the active tab is rearranged via mouse drag. See drag_to_rearrange_enabled.
m.TabBar.clip_tabs: If true, tabs overflowing this node's width will be hidden, displaying two navigation buttons instead. Otherwise, this node's minimum size is updated so that all tabs are visible.
m.TabBar.close_with_middle_mouse: If true, middle-clicking on a tab will emit the tab_close_pressed signal.
m.TabBar.current_tab: The index of the current selected tab. A value of -1 means that no tab is selected and can only be set when deselect_enabled is true or if all tabs are hidden or disabled.
m.TabBar.deselect_enabled: If true, all tabs can be deselected so that no tab is selected. Click on the current tab to deselect it.
m.TabBar.drag_to_rearrange_enabled: If true, tabs can be rearranged with mouse drag.
m.TabBar.ensure_tab_visible: Moves the scroll view to make the tab visible.
m.TabBar.get_offset_buttons_visible: Returns true if the offset buttons (the ones that appear when there's not enough space for all tabs) are visible.
m.TabBar.get_previous_tab: Returns the previously active tab index.
m.TabBar.get_tab_button_icon: Returns the icon for the right button of the tab at index tab_idx or null if the right button has no icon.
m.TabBar.get_tab_icon: Returns the icon for the tab at index tab_idx or null if the tab has no icon.
m.TabBar.get_tab_icon_max_width: Returns the maximum allowed width of the icon for the tab at index tab_idx.
m.TabBar.get_tab_idx_at_point: Returns the index of the tab at local coordinates point. Returns -1 if the point is outside the control boundaries or if there's no tab at the queried position.
m.TabBar.get_tab_metadata: Returns the metadata value set to the tab at index tab_idx using set_tab_metadata(). If no metadata was previously set, returns null by default.
m.TabBar.get_tab_offset: Returns the number of hidden tabs offsetted to the left.
m.TabBar.get_tab_rect: Returns tab Rect2 with local position and size.
m.TabBar.get_tab_text_direction: Returns tab title text base writing direction.
m.TabBar.get_tab_title: Returns the title of the tab at index tab_idx.
m.TabBar.get_tab_tooltip: Returns the tooltip text of the tab at index tab_idx.
m.TabBar.is_tab_disabled: Returns true if the tab at index tab_idx is disabled.
m.TabBar.is_tab_hidden: Returns true if the tab at index tab_idx is hidden.
m.TabBar.max_tab_width: Sets the maximum width which all tabs should be limited to. Unlimited if set to 0.
m.TabBar.move_tab: Moves a tab from from to to.
m.TabBar.remove_tab: Removes the tab at index tab_idx.
m.TabBar.scroll_to_selected: If true, the tab offset will be changed to keep the currently selected tab visible.
m.TabBar.scrolling_enabled: if true, the mouse's scroll wheel can be used to navigate the scroll view.
m.TabBar.select_next_available: Selects the first available tab with greater index than the currently selected. Returns true if tab selection changed.
m.TabBar.select_previous_available: Selects the first available tab with lower index than the currently selected. Returns true if tab selection changed.
m.TabBar.select_with_rmb: If true, enables selecting a tab with the right mouse button.
m.TabBar.set_tab_button_icon: Sets an icon for the button of the tab at index tab_idx (located to the right, before the close button), making it visible and clickable (See tab_button_pressed). Giving it a null value will hide the button.
m.TabBar.set_tab_disabled: If disabled is true, disables the tab at index tab_idx, making it non-interactable.
m.TabBar.set_tab_hidden: If hidden is true, hides the tab at index tab_idx, making it disappear from the tab area.
m.TabBar.set_tab_icon: Sets an icon for the tab at index tab_idx.
m.TabBar.set_tab_icon_max_width: Sets the maximum allowed width of the icon for the tab at index tab_idx. This limit is applied on top of the default size of the icon and on top of icon_max_width. The height is adjusted according to the icon's ratio.
m.TabBar.set_tab_language: Sets the language code of the title for the tab at index tab_idx to language. This is used for line-breaking and text shaping algorithms. If language is empty, the current locale is used.
m.TabBar.set_tab_metadata: Sets the metadata value for the tab at index tab_idx, which can be retrieved later using get_tab_metadata().
m.TabBar.set_tab_text_direction: Sets tab title base writing direction.
m.TabBar.set_tab_title: Sets a title for the tab at index tab_idx.
m.TabBar.set_tab_tooltip: Sets a tooltip for tab at index tab_idx.
m.TabBar.switch_on_drag_hover: If true, hovering over a tab while dragging something will switch to that tab. Does not have effect when hovering another tab to rearrange. The delay for when this happens is dictated by hover_switch_wait_msec.
m.TabBar.tab_alignment: The horizontal alignment of the tabs.
m.TabBar.tab_button_pressed: Emitted when a tab's right button is pressed. See set_tab_button_icon().
m.TabBar.tab_changed: Emitted when switching to another tab.
m.TabBar.tab_clicked: Emitted when a tab is clicked, even if it is the current tab.
m.TabBar.tab_close_display_policy: When the close button will appear on the tabs.
m.TabBar.tab_close_pressed: Emitted when a tab's close button is pressed or, if close_with_middle_mouse is true, when middle-clicking on a tab.
m.TabBar.tab_count: The number of tabs currently in the bar.
m.TabBar.tab_hovered: Emitted when a tab is hovered by the mouse.
m.TabBar.tab_rmb_clicked: Emitted when a tab is right-clicked.
m.TabBar.tab_selected: Emitted when a tab is selected via click, directional input, or script, even if it is the current tab.
m.TabBar.tabs_rearrange_group: TabBars with the same rearrange group ID will allow dragging the tabs between them. Enable drag with drag_to_rearrange_enabled.
m.TabContainer.POSITION_BOTTOM: Places the tab bar at the bottom. The tab bar's StyleBox will be flipped vertically.
m.TabContainer.POSITION_MAX: Represents the size of the TabPosition enum.
m.TabContainer.POSITION_TOP: Places the tab bar at the top.
m.TabContainer.active_tab_rearranged: Emitted when the active tab is rearranged via mouse drag. See drag_to_rearrange_enabled.
m.TabContainer.all_tabs_in_front: Deprecated: Due to internal changes this doesn't do anything anymore, as they're always in front.
m.TabContainer.clip_tabs: If true, tabs overflowing this node's width will be hidden, displaying two navigation buttons instead. Otherwise, this node's minimum size is updated so that all tabs are visible.
m.TabContainer.current_tab: The current tab index. When set, this index's Control node's visible property is set to true and all others are set to false.
m.TabContainer.deselect_enabled: If true, all tabs can be deselected so that no tab is selected. Click on the current_tab to deselect it.
m.TabContainer.drag_to_rearrange_enabled: If true, tabs can be rearranged with mouse drag.
m.TabContainer.get_current_tab_control: Returns the child Control node located at the active tab index.
m.TabContainer.get_popup: Returns the Popup node instance if one has been set already with set_popup().
m.TabContainer.get_previous_tab: Returns the previously active tab index.
m.TabContainer.get_tab_bar: Returns the TabBar contained in this container.
m.TabContainer.get_tab_button_icon: Returns the button icon from the tab at index tab_idx.
m.TabContainer.get_tab_control: Returns the Control node from the tab at index tab_idx.
m.TabContainer.get_tab_icon: Returns the Texture2D for the tab at index tab_idx or null if the tab has no Texture2D.
m.TabContainer.get_tab_icon_max_width: Returns the maximum allowed width of the icon for the tab at index tab_idx.
m.TabContainer.get_tab_idx_at_point: Returns the index of the tab at local coordinates point. Returns -1 if the point is outside the control boundaries or if there's no tab at the queried position.
m.TabContainer.get_tab_idx_from_control: Returns the index of the tab tied to the given control. The control must be a child of the TabContainer.
m.TabContainer.get_tab_metadata: Returns the metadata value set to the tab at index tab_idx using set_tab_metadata(). If no metadata was previously set, returns null by default.
m.TabContainer.get_tab_title: Returns the title of the tab at index tab_idx. Tab titles default to the name of the indexed child node, but this can be overridden with set_tab_title().
m.TabContainer.get_tab_tooltip: Returns the tooltip text of the tab at index tab_idx.
m.TabContainer.is_tab_disabled: Returns true if the tab at index tab_idx is disabled.
m.TabContainer.is_tab_hidden: Returns true if the tab at index tab_idx is hidden.
m.TabContainer.pre_popup_pressed: Emitted when the TabContainer's Popup button is clicked. See set_popup() for details.
m.TabContainer.select_next_available: Selects the first available tab with greater index than the currently selected. Returns true if tab selection changed.
m.TabContainer.select_previous_available: Selects the first available tab with lower index than the currently selected. Returns true if tab selection changed.
m.TabContainer.set_popup: If set on a Popup node instance, a popup menu icon appears in the top-right corner of the TabContainer (setting it to null will make it go away). Clicking it will expand the Popup node.
m.TabContainer.set_tab_button_icon: Sets the button icon from the tab at index tab_idx.
m.TabContainer.set_tab_disabled: If disabled is true, disables the tab at index tab_idx, making it non-interactable.
m.TabContainer.set_tab_hidden: If hidden is true, hides the tab at index tab_idx, making it disappear from the tab area.
m.TabContainer.set_tab_icon: Sets an icon for the tab at index tab_idx.
m.TabContainer.set_tab_icon_max_width: Sets the maximum allowed width of the icon for the tab at index tab_idx. This limit is applied on top of the default size of the icon and on top of icon_max_width. The height is adjusted according to the icon's ratio.
m.TabContainer.set_tab_metadata: Sets the metadata value for the tab at index tab_idx, which can be retrieved later using get_tab_metadata().
m.TabContainer.set_tab_title: Sets a custom title for the tab at index tab_idx (tab titles default to the name of the indexed child node). Set it back to the child's name to make the tab default to it again.
m.TabContainer.set_tab_tooltip: Sets a custom tooltip text for tab at index tab_idx.
m.TabContainer.switch_on_drag_hover: If true, hovering over a tab while dragging something will switch to that tab. Does not have effect when hovering another tab to rearrange.
m.TabContainer.tab_alignment: The position at which tabs will be placed.
m.TabContainer.tab_button_pressed: Emitted when the user clicks on the button icon on this tab.
m.TabContainer.tab_changed: Emitted when switching to another tab.
m.TabContainer.tab_clicked: Emitted when a tab is clicked, even if it is the current tab.
m.TabContainer.tab_focus_mode: The focus access mode for the internal TabBar node.
m.TabContainer.tab_hovered: Emitted when a tab is hovered by the mouse.
m.TabContainer.tab_selected: Emitted when a tab is selected via click, directional input, or script, even if it is the current tab.
m.TabContainer.tabs_position: The horizontal alignment of the tabs.
m.TabContainer.tabs_rearrange_group: TabContainers with the same rearrange group ID will allow dragging the tabs between them. Enable drag with drag_to_rearrange_enabled.
m.TabContainer.tabs_visible: If true, tabs are visible. If false, tabs' content and titles are hidden.
m.TabContainer.use_hidden_tabs_for_min_siz: If true, child Control nodes that are hidden have their minimum size take into account in the total, instead of only the currently visible one.
m.TextEdit.GUTTER_TYPE_CUSTOM: When a gutter is set to custom using set_gutter_type(), it is used to contain custom visuals controlled by a callback method set via the set_gutter_custom_draw() method.
m.TextEdit.GUTTER_TYPE_ICON: When a gutter is set to icon using set_gutter_type(), it is used to contain an icon set via the set_line_gutter_icon() method.
m.TextEdit.GUTTER_TYPE_STRING: When a gutter is set to string using set_gutter_type(), it is used to contain text set via the set_line_gutter_text() method.
m.TextEdit.LINE_WRAPPING_BOUNDARY: Line wrapping occurs at the control boundary, beyond what would normally be visible.
m.TextEdit.MENU_CUT: Cuts (copies and clears) the selected text.
m.TextEdit.MENU_EMOJI_AND_SYMBOL: Opens system emoji and symbol picker.
m.TextEdit.MENU_INSERT_LRE: Inserts start of left-to-right embedding (LRE) character.
m.TextEdit.MENU_INSERT_LRO: Inserts start of left-to-right override (LRO) character.
m.TextEdit.MENU_INSERT_RLE: Inserts start of right-to-left embedding (RLE) character.
m.TextEdit.MENU_INSERT_RLO: Inserts start of right-to-left override (RLO) character.
m.TextEdit.MENU_MAX: Represents the size of the MenuItems enum.
m.TextEdit.MENU_PASTE: Pastes the clipboard text over the selected text (or at the cursor's position).
m.TextEdit.SELECTION_MODE_LINE: Select whole lines as if the user triple clicked.
m.TextEdit.SELECTION_MODE_POINTER: Select single characters as if the user single clicked.
m.TextEdit.SELECTION_MODE_SHIFT: Select as if shift is pressed.
m.TextEdit.SELECTION_MODE_WORD: Select whole words as if the user double clicked.
m.TextEdit._backspace: Override this method to define what happens when the user presses the backspace key.
m.TextEdit._copy: Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a copy operation.
m.TextEdit._cut: Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a cut operation.
m.TextEdit._handle_unicode_input: Override this method to define what happens when the user types in the provided key unicode_char.
m.TextEdit._paste: Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a paste operation.
m.TextEdit._paste_primary_clipboard: Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a paste operation with middle mouse button.
m.TextEdit.add_caret: Adds a new caret at the given location. Returns the index of the new caret, or -1 if the location is invalid.
m.TextEdit.add_caret_at_carets: Adds an additional caret above or below every caret. If below is true the new caret will be added below and above otherwise.
m.TextEdit.add_gutter: Register a new gutter to this TextEdit. Use at to have a specific gutter order. A value of -1 appends the gutter to the right.
m.TextEdit.add_selection_for_next_occurren: Adds a selection and a caret for the next occurrence of the current selection. If there is no active selection, selects word under caret.
m.TextEdit.adjust_carets_after_edit: Deprecated: No longer necessary since methods now adjust carets themselves.
m.TextEdit.adjust_viewport_to_caret: Adjust the viewport so the caret is visible.
m.TextEdit.apply_ime: Applies text from the Input Method Editor [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Input_method] (IME) to each caret and closes the IME if it is open.
m.TextEdit.autowrap_mode: If wrap_mode is set to LINE_WRAPPING_BOUNDARY, sets text wrapping mode.
m.TextEdit.backspace: Called when the user presses the backspace key. Can be overridden with _backspace().
m.TextEdit.backspace_deletes_composite_cha: If true and caret_mid_grapheme is false, backspace deletes an entire composite character such as ❤️‍🩹, instead of deleting part of the composite character.
m.TextEdit.begin_complex_operation: Starts a multipart edit. All edits will be treated as one action until end_complex_operation() is called.
m.TextEdit.begin_multicaret_edit: Starts an edit for multiple carets. The edit must be ended with end_multicaret_edit(). Multicaret edits can be used to edit text at multiple carets and delay merging the carets until the end, so the caret indexes aren't affected immediately. begin_multicaret_edit() and end_multicaret_edit() can be nested, and the merge will happen at the last end_multicaret_edit().
m.TextEdit.cancel_ime: Closes the Input Method Editor [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Input_method] (IME) if it is open. Any text in the IME will be lost.
m.TextEdit.caret_blink: If true, makes the caret blink.
m.TextEdit.caret_blink_interval: The interval at which the caret blinks (in seconds).
m.TextEdit.caret_changed: Emitted when any caret changes position.
m.TextEdit.caret_draw_when_editable_disabl: If true, caret will be visible when editable is disabled.
m.TextEdit.caret_mid_grapheme: Allow moving caret, selecting and removing the individual composite character components.
m.TextEdit.caret_move_on_right_click: If true, a right-click moves the caret at the mouse position before displaying the context menu.
m.TextEdit.caret_multiple: If true, multiple carets are allowed. Left-clicking with Alt adds a new caret. See add_caret() and get_caret_count().
m.TextEdit.caret_type: Set the type of caret to draw.
m.TextEdit.center_viewport_to_caret: Centers the viewport on the line the editing caret is at. This also resets the scroll_horizontal value to 0.
m.TextEdit.clear: Performs a full reset of TextEdit, including undo history.
m.TextEdit.collapse_carets: Collapse all carets in the given range to the from_line and from_column position.
m.TextEdit.context_menu_enabled: If true, a right-click displays the context menu.
m.TextEdit.copy: Copies the current text selection. Can be overridden with _copy().
m.TextEdit.custom_word_separators: The characters to consider as word delimiters if use_custom_word_separators is true. The characters should be defined without separation, for example #_!.
m.TextEdit.cut: Cut's the current selection. Can be overridden with _cut().
m.TextEdit.deselect_on_focus_loss_enabled: If true, the selected text will be deselected when focus is lost.
m.TextEdit.drag_and_drop_selection_enabled: If true, allow drag and drop of selected text. Text can still be dropped from other sources.
m.TextEdit.draw_control_chars: If true, control characters are displayed.
m.TextEdit.draw_spaces: If true, the "space" character will have a visible representation.
m.TextEdit.draw_tabs: If true, the "tab" character will have a visible representation.
m.TextEdit.editable: If false, existing text cannot be modified and new text cannot be added.
m.TextEdit.emoji_menu_enabled: If true, "Emoji and Symbols" menu is enabled.
m.TextEdit.empty_selection_clipboard_enabl: If true, copying or cutting without a selection is performed on all lines with a caret. Otherwise, copy and cut require a selection.
m.TextEdit.end_action: Marks the end of steps in the current action started with start_action().
m.TextEdit.end_complex_operation: Ends a multipart edit, started with begin_complex_operation(). If called outside a complex operation, the current operation is pushed onto the undo/redo stack.
m.TextEdit.end_multicaret_edit: Ends an edit for multiple carets, that was started with begin_multicaret_edit(). If this was the last end_multicaret_edit() and merge_overlapping_carets() was called, carets will be merged.
m.TextEdit.get_caret_column: Returns the column the editing caret is at.
m.TextEdit.get_caret_count: Returns the number of carets in this TextEdit.
m.TextEdit.get_caret_draw_pos: Returns the caret pixel draw position.
m.TextEdit.get_caret_index_edit_order: Deprecated: Carets no longer need to be edited in any specific order. If the carets need to be sorted, use get_sorted_carets() instead.
m.TextEdit.get_caret_line: Returns the line the editing caret is on.
m.TextEdit.get_caret_wrap_index: Returns the wrap index the editing caret is on.
m.TextEdit.get_first_non_whitespace_column: Returns the first column containing a non-whitespace character on the given line. If there is only whitespace, returns the number of characters.
m.TextEdit.get_gutter_count: Returns the number of gutters registered.
m.TextEdit.get_gutter_name: Returns the name of the gutter at the given index.
m.TextEdit.get_gutter_type: Returns the type of the gutter at the given index. Gutters can contain icons, text, or custom visuals.
m.TextEdit.get_gutter_width: Returns the width of the gutter at the given index.
m.TextEdit.get_h_scroll_bar: Returns the HScrollBar used by TextEdit.
m.TextEdit.get_indent_level: Returns the indent level of the given line. This is the number of spaces and tabs at the beginning of the line, with the tabs taking the tab size into account (see get_tab_size()).
m.TextEdit.get_last_full_visible_line: Returns the last visible line. Use get_last_full_visible_line_wrap_index() for the wrap index.
m.TextEdit.get_last_full_visible_line_wrap: Returns the last visible wrap index of the last visible line.
m.TextEdit.get_last_unhidden_line: Returns the last unhidden line in the entire TextEdit.
m.TextEdit.get_line: Returns the text of a specific line.
m.TextEdit.get_line_background_color: Returns the custom background color of the given line. If no color is set, returns Color(0, 0, 0, 0).
m.TextEdit.get_line_column_at_pos: Returns the line and column at the given position. In the returned vector, x is the column and y is the line.
m.TextEdit.get_line_count: Returns the number of lines in the text.
m.TextEdit.get_line_gutter_icon: Returns the icon currently in gutter at line. This only works when the gutter type is GUTTER_TYPE_ICON (see set_gutter_type()).
m.TextEdit.get_line_gutter_item_color: Returns the color currently in gutter at line.
m.TextEdit.get_line_gutter_metadata: Returns the metadata currently in gutter at line.
m.TextEdit.get_line_gutter_text: Returns the text currently in gutter at line. This only works when the gutter type is GUTTER_TYPE_STRING (see set_gutter_type()).
m.TextEdit.get_line_height: Returns the maximum value of the line height among all lines.
m.TextEdit.get_line_ranges_from_carets: Returns an Array of line ranges where x is the first line and y is the last line. All lines within these ranges will have a caret on them or be part of a selection. Each line will only be part of one line range, even if it has multiple carets on it.
m.TextEdit.get_line_width: Returns the width in pixels of the wrap_index on line.
m.TextEdit.get_line_with_ime: Returns line text as it is currently displayed, including IME composition string.
m.TextEdit.get_line_wrap_count: Returns the number of times the given line is wrapped.
m.TextEdit.get_line_wrap_index_at_column: Returns the wrap index of the given column on the given line. This ranges from 0 to get_line_wrap_count().
m.TextEdit.get_line_wrapped_text: Returns an array of Strings representing each wrapped index.
m.TextEdit.get_local_mouse_pos: Returns the local mouse position adjusted for the text direction.
m.TextEdit.get_menu: Returns the PopupMenu of this TextEdit. By default, this menu is displayed when right-clicking on the TextEdit.
m.TextEdit.get_minimap_line_at_pos: Returns the equivalent minimap line at position.
m.TextEdit.get_minimap_visible_lines: Returns the number of lines that may be drawn on the minimap.
m.TextEdit.get_next_composite_character_co: Returns the correct column at the end of a composite character like ❤️‍🩹 (mending heart; Unicode: U+2764 U+FE0F U+200D U+1FA79) which is comprised of more than one Unicode code point, if the caret is at the start of the composite character. Also returns the correct column with the caret at mid grapheme and for non-composite characters.
m.TextEdit.get_next_visible_line_index_off: Similar to get_next_visible_line_offset_from(), but takes into account the line wrap indexes. In the returned vector, x is the line, y is the wrap index.
m.TextEdit.get_next_visible_line_offset_fr: Returns the count to the next visible line from line to line + visible_amount. Can also count backwards. For example if a TextEdit has 5 lines with lines 2 and 3 hidden, calling this with line = 1, visible_amount = 1 would return 3.
m.TextEdit.get_pos_at_line_column: Returns the local position for the given line and column. If x or y of the returned vector equal -1, the position is outside of the viewable area of the control.
m.TextEdit.get_previous_composite_characte: Returns the correct column at the start of a composite character like ❤️‍🩹 (mending heart; Unicode: U+2764 U+FE0F U+200D U+1FA79) which is comprised of more than one Unicode code point, if the caret is at the end of the composite character. Also returns the correct column with the caret at mid grapheme and for non-composite characters.
m.TextEdit.get_rect_at_line_column: Returns the local position and size for the grapheme at the given line and column. If x or y position of the returned rect equal -1, the position is outside of the viewable area of the control.
m.TextEdit.get_saved_version: Returns the last tagged saved version from tag_saved_version().
m.TextEdit.get_scroll_pos_for_line: Returns the scroll position for wrap_index of line.
m.TextEdit.get_selected_text: Returns the text inside the selection of a caret, or all the carets if caret_index is its default value -1.
m.TextEdit.get_selection_at_line_column: Returns the caret index of the selection at the given line and column, or -1 if there is none.
m.TextEdit.get_selection_from_column: Returns the selection begin column. Returns the caret column if there is no selection.
m.TextEdit.get_selection_from_line: Returns the selection begin line. Returns the caret line if there is no selection.
m.TextEdit.get_selection_origin_column: Returns the origin column of the selection. This is the opposite end from the caret.
m.TextEdit.get_selection_origin_line: Returns the origin line of the selection. This is the opposite end from the caret.
m.TextEdit.get_selection_to_column: Returns the selection end column. Returns the caret column if there is no selection.
m.TextEdit.get_selection_to_line: Returns the selection end line. Returns the caret line if there is no selection.
m.TextEdit.get_sorted_carets: Returns the carets sorted by selection beginning from lowest line and column to highest (from top to bottom of text).
m.TextEdit.get_total_gutter_width: Returns the total width of all gutters and internal padding.
m.TextEdit.get_total_visible_line_count: Returns the total number of lines in the text. This includes wrapped lines and excludes folded lines. If wrap_mode is set to LINE_WRAPPING_NONE and no lines are folded (see CodeEdit.is_line_folded()) then this is equivalent to get_line_count(). See get_visible_line_count_in_range() for a limited range of lines.
m.TextEdit.get_v_scroll_bar: Returns the VScrollBar of the TextEdit.
m.TextEdit.get_version: Returns the current version of the TextEdit. The version is a count of recorded operations by the undo/redo history.
m.TextEdit.get_visible_line_count: Returns the number of lines that can visually fit, rounded down, based on this control's height.
m.TextEdit.get_visible_line_count_in_range: Returns the total number of lines between from_line and to_line (inclusive) in the text. This includes wrapped lines and excludes folded lines. If the range covers all lines it is equivalent to get_total_visible_line_count().
m.TextEdit.get_word_under_caret: Returns a String text with the word under the caret's location.
m.TextEdit.gutter_added: Emitted when a gutter is added.
m.TextEdit.gutter_clicked: Emitted when a gutter is clicked.
m.TextEdit.gutter_removed: Emitted when a gutter is removed.
m.TextEdit.has_ime_text: Returns true if the user has text in the Input Method Editor [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Input_method] (IME).
m.TextEdit.has_redo: Returns true if a "redo" action is available.
m.TextEdit.has_selection: Returns true if the user has selected text.
m.TextEdit.has_undo: Returns true if an "undo" action is available.
m.TextEdit.highlight_all_occurrences: If true, all occurrences of the selected text will be highlighted.
m.TextEdit.highlight_current_line: If true, the line containing the cursor is highlighted.
m.TextEdit.indent_wrapped_lines: If true, all wrapped lines are indented to the same amount as the unwrapped line.
m.TextEdit.insert_line_at: Inserts a new line with text at line.
m.TextEdit.insert_text: Inserts the text at line and column.
m.TextEdit.insert_text_at_caret: Insert the specified text at the caret position.
m.TextEdit.is_caret_after_selection_origin: Returns true if the caret of the selection is after the selection origin. This can be used to determine the direction of the selection.
m.TextEdit.is_caret_visible: Returns true if the caret is visible, false otherwise. A caret will be considered hidden if it is outside the scrollable area when scrolling is enabled.
m.TextEdit.is_dragging_cursor: Returns true if the user is dragging their mouse for scrolling, selecting, or text dragging.
m.TextEdit.is_gutter_clickable: Returns true if the gutter at the given index is clickable. See set_gutter_clickable().
m.TextEdit.is_gutter_drawn: Returns true if the gutter at the given index is currently drawn. See set_gutter_draw().
m.TextEdit.is_gutter_overwritable: Returns true if the gutter at the given index is overwritable. See set_gutter_overwritable().
m.TextEdit.is_in_mulitcaret_edit: Returns true if a begin_multicaret_edit() has been called and end_multicaret_edit() has not yet been called.
m.TextEdit.is_line_gutter_clickable: Returns true if the gutter at the given index on the given line is clickable. See set_line_gutter_clickable().
m.TextEdit.is_line_in_viewport: Returns true if the given line is within the scope of the scrollable area of the viewport.
m.TextEdit.is_line_wrapped: Returns if the given line is wrapped.
m.TextEdit.is_menu_visible: Returns true if the menu is visible. Use this instead of get_menu().visible to improve performance (so the creation of the menu is avoided). See get_menu().
m.TextEdit.is_mouse_over_selection: Returns true if the mouse is over a selection. If edges is true, the edges are considered part of the selection.
m.TextEdit.is_overtype_mode_enabled: Returns true if overtype mode is enabled. See set_overtype_mode_enabled().
m.TextEdit.language: Language code used for line-breaking and text shaping algorithms. If left empty, the current locale is used instead.
m.TextEdit.lines_edited_from: Emitted immediately when the text changes.
m.TextEdit.menu_option: Executes a given action as defined in the MenuItems enum.
m.TextEdit.merge_gutters: Merge the gutters from from_line into to_line. Only overwritable gutters will be copied. See set_gutter_overwritable().
m.TextEdit.merge_overlapping_carets: Merges any overlapping carets. Will favor the newest caret, or the caret with a selection.
m.TextEdit.middle_mouse_paste_enabled: If false, using middle mouse button to paste clipboard will be disabled.
m.TextEdit.minimap_draw: If true, a minimap is shown, providing an outline of your source code. The minimap uses a fixed-width text size.
m.TextEdit.minimap_width: The width, in pixels, of the minimap.
m.TextEdit.multicaret_edit_ignore_caret: Returns true if the given caret_index should be ignored as part of a multicaret edit. See begin_multicaret_edit() and end_multicaret_edit(). Carets that should be ignored are ones that were part of removed text and will likely be merged at the end of the edit, or carets that were added during the edit.
m.TextEdit.paste: Paste at the current location. Can be overridden with _paste().
m.TextEdit.placeholder_text: Text shown when the TextEdit is empty. It is not the TextEdit's default value (see text).
m.TextEdit.remove_gutter: Removes the gutter at the given index.
m.TextEdit.remove_line_at: Removes the line of text at line. Carets on this line will attempt to match their previous visual x position.
m.TextEdit.remove_text: Removes text between the given positions.
m.TextEdit.scroll_fit_content_height: If true, TextEdit fits its minimum height to the number of visible lines instead of scrolling vertically. If a maximum height is set (for example via Control.custom_maximum_size) and content exceeds it, a vertical scrollbar is shown.
m.TextEdit.scroll_fit_content_width: If true, TextEdit fits its minimum width to the widest line instead of scrolling horizontally. If a maximum width is set (for example via Control.custom_maximum_size) and content exceeds it, a horizontal scrollbar is shown.
m.TextEdit.scroll_horizontal: If there is a horizontal scrollbar, this determines the current horizontal scroll value in pixels.
m.TextEdit.scroll_past_end_of_file: Allow scrolling past the last line into "virtual" space.
m.TextEdit.scroll_smooth: Scroll smoothly over the text rather than jumping to the next location.
m.TextEdit.scroll_v_scroll_speed: Sets the scroll speed with the minimap or when scroll_smooth is enabled.
m.TextEdit.scroll_vertical: If there is a vertical scrollbar, this determines the current vertical scroll value in line numbers, starting at 0 for the top line.
m.TextEdit.search: Perform a search inside the text. Search flags can be specified in the SearchFlags enum.
m.TextEdit.select: Selects text from origin_line and origin_column to caret_line and caret_column for the given caret_index. This moves the selection origin and the caret. If the positions are the same, the selection will be deselected.
m.TextEdit.select_word_under_caret: Selects the word under the caret.
m.TextEdit.selecting_enabled: If true, text can be selected.
m.TextEdit.set_caret_column: Moves the caret to the specified column index.
m.TextEdit.set_caret_line: Moves the caret to the specified line index. The caret column will be moved to the same visual position it was at the last time set_caret_column() was called, or clamped to the end of the line.
m.TextEdit.set_gutter_clickable: If true, the mouse cursor will change to a pointing hand (Control.CURSOR_POINTING_HAND) when hovering over the gutter at the given index. See is_gutter_clickable() and set_line_gutter_clickable().
m.TextEdit.set_gutter_custom_draw: Set a custom draw callback for the gutter at the given index. draw_callback must take the following arguments: A line index int, a gutter index int, and an area Rect2. This callback only works when the gutter type is GUTTER_TYPE_CUSTOM (see set_gutter_type()).
m.TextEdit.set_gutter_draw: If true, the gutter at the given index is drawn. The gutter type (set_gutter_type()) determines how it is drawn. See is_gutter_drawn().
m.TextEdit.set_gutter_name: Sets the name of the gutter at the given index.
m.TextEdit.set_gutter_overwritable: If true, the line data of the gutter at the given index can be overridden when using merge_gutters(). See is_gutter_overwritable().
m.TextEdit.set_gutter_type: Sets the type of gutter at the given index. Gutters can contain icons, text, or custom visuals.
m.TextEdit.set_gutter_width: Set the width of the gutter at the given index.
m.TextEdit.set_line: Sets the text for a specific line.
m.TextEdit.set_line_as_center_visible: Positions the wrap_index of line at the center of the viewport.
m.TextEdit.set_line_as_first_visible: Positions the wrap_index of line at the top of the viewport.
m.TextEdit.set_line_as_last_visible: Positions the wrap_index of line at the bottom of the viewport.
m.TextEdit.set_line_background_color: Sets the custom background color of the given line. If transparent, this color is applied on top of the default background color (See background_color). If set to Color(0, 0, 0, 0), no additional color is applied.
m.TextEdit.set_line_gutter_clickable: If clickable is true, makes the gutter on the given line clickable. This is like set_gutter_clickable(), but for a single line. If is_gutter_clickable() is true, this will not have any effect. See is_line_gutter_clickable() and gutter_clicked.
m.TextEdit.set_line_gutter_icon: Sets the icon for gutter on line to icon. This only works when the gutter type is GUTTER_TYPE_ICON (see set_gutter_type()).
m.TextEdit.set_line_gutter_item_color: Sets the color for gutter on line to color.
m.TextEdit.set_line_gutter_metadata: Sets the metadata for gutter on line to metadata.
m.TextEdit.set_line_gutter_text: Sets the text for gutter on line to text. This only works when the gutter type is GUTTER_TYPE_STRING (see set_gutter_type()).
m.TextEdit.set_overtype_mode_enabled: If true, enables overtype mode. In this mode, typing overrides existing text instead of inserting text. The ProjectSettings.input/ui_text_toggle_insert_mode action toggles overtype mode. See is_overtype_mode_enabled().
m.TextEdit.set_search_flags: Sets the search flags. This is used with set_search_text() to highlight occurrences of the searched text. Search flags can be specified from the SearchFlags enum.
m.TextEdit.set_search_text: Sets the search text. See set_search_flags().
m.TextEdit.set_selection_origin_column: Sets the selection origin column to the column for the given caret_index. If the selection origin is moved to the caret position, the selection will deselect.
m.TextEdit.set_selection_origin_line: Sets the selection origin line to the line for the given caret_index. If the selection origin is moved to the caret position, the selection will deselect.
m.TextEdit.set_tab_size: Sets the tab size for the TextEdit to use.
m.TextEdit.set_tooltip_request_func: Provide custom tooltip text. The callback method must take the following args: hovered_word: String.
m.TextEdit.shortcut_keys_enabled: If true, shortcut keys for context menu items are enabled, even if the context menu is disabled.
m.TextEdit.skip_selection_for_next_occurre: Moves a selection and a caret for the next occurrence of the current selection. If there is no active selection, moves to the next occurrence of the word under caret.
m.TextEdit.start_action: Starts an action, will end the current action if action is different.
m.TextEdit.structured_text_bidi_override: Set BiDi algorithm override for the structured text.
m.TextEdit.structured_text_bidi_override_o: Set additional options for BiDi override.
m.TextEdit.swap_lines: Swaps the two lines. Carets will be swapped with the lines.
m.TextEdit.tab_input_mode: If true, ProjectSettings.input/ui_text_indent input Tab character, otherwise it moves keyboard focus to the next Control in the scene.
m.TextEdit.tag_saved_version: Tag the current version as saved.
m.TextEdit.text_set: Emitted when clear() is called or text is set.
m.TextEdit.use_custom_word_separators: If false, using Ctrl + Left or Ctrl + Right (Cmd + Left or Cmd + Right on macOS) bindings will use the behavior of use_default_word_separators. If true, it will also stop the caret if a character within custom_word_separators is detected. Useful for subword moving. This behavior also will be applied to the behavior of text selection.
m.TextEdit.use_default_word_separators: If false, using Ctrl + Left or Ctrl + Right (Cmd + Left or Cmd + Right on macOS) bindings will stop moving caret only if a space or punctuation is detected. If true, it will also stop the caret if a character is part of !"#$%&'()*+,-./:;<=>?@[\]^`{|}~, the Unicode General Punctuation table, or the Unicode CJK Punctuation table. Useful for subword moving. This behavior also will be applied to the…
m.TextEdit.virtual_keyboard_enabled: If true, the native virtual keyboard is enabled on platforms that support it.
m.TextEdit.virtual_keyboard_show_on_focus: If true, the native virtual keyboard is shown on focus events on platforms that support it.
m.TextEdit.wrap_mode: Sets the line wrapping mode to use.
m.TextLine.add_object: Adds inline object to the text buffer, key must be unique. In the text, object is represented as length object replacement characters.
m.TextLine.add_string: Adds text span and font to draw it.
m.TextLine.alignment: Sets text alignment within the line as if the line was horizontal.
m.TextLine.clear: Clears text line (removes text and inline objects).
m.TextLine.draw: Draw text into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
m.TextLine.draw_outline: Draw text into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
m.TextLine.ellipsis_char: Ellipsis character used for text clipping.
m.TextLine.flags: Line alignment rules. For more info see TextServer.
m.TextLine.get_inferred_direction: Returns the text writing direction inferred by the BiDi algorithm.
m.TextLine.get_line_ascent: Returns the text ascent (number of pixels above the baseline for horizontal layout or to the left of baseline for vertical).
m.TextLine.get_line_descent: Returns the text descent (number of pixels below the baseline for horizontal layout or to the right of baseline for vertical).
m.TextLine.get_line_underline_position: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.
m.TextLine.get_line_width: Returns width (for horizontal layout) or height (for vertical) of the text.
m.TextLine.get_object_rect: Returns bounding rectangle of the inline object.
m.TextLine.get_size: Returns size of the bounding box of the text.
m.TextLine.has_object: Returns true if an object with key is embedded in this line.
m.TextLine.hit_test: Returns caret character offset at the specified pixel offset at the baseline. This function always returns a valid position.
m.TextLine.preserve_control: If set to true text will display control characters.
m.TextLine.preserve_invalid: If set to true text will display invalid characters.
m.TextLine.resize_object: Sets new size and alignment of embedded object.
m.TextLine.set_bidi_override: Overrides BiDi for the structured text.
m.TextLine.tab_align: Aligns text to the given tab-stops.
m.TextLine.text_overrun_behavior: The clipping behavior when the text exceeds the text line's set width.
m.TextMesh.autowrap_mode: If set to something other than TextServer.AUTOWRAP_OFF, the text gets wrapped inside the node's bounding rectangle. If you resize the node, it will change its height automatically to show all the text.
m.TextMesh.curve_step: Step (in pixels) used to approximate Bézier curves. Lower values result in smoother curves, but is slower to generate and render. Consider adjusting this according to the font size and the typical viewing distance.
m.TextMesh.depth: Depths of the mesh, if set to 0.0 only front surface, is generated, and UV layout is changed to use full texture for the front face only.
m.TextMesh.font: Font configuration used to display text.
m.TextMesh.font_size: Font size of the TextMesh's text. This property works in tandem with pixel_size. Higher values will result in a more detailed font, regardless of curve_step and pixel_size. Consider keeping this value below 63 (inclusive) for good performance, and adjust pixel_size as needed to enlarge text.
m.TextMesh.horizontal_alignment: Controls the text's horizontal alignment. Supports left, center, right, and fill (also known as justify).
m.TextMesh.language: Language code used for line-breaking and text shaping algorithms. If left empty, the current locale is used instead.
m.TextMesh.line_spacing: Additional vertical spacing between lines (in pixels), spacing is added to line descent. This value can be negative.
m.TextMesh.pixel_size: The size of one pixel's width on the text to scale it in 3D. This property works in tandem with font_size.
m.TextMesh.structured_text_bidi_override: Set BiDi algorithm override for the structured text.
m.TextMesh.structured_text_bidi_override_o: Set additional options for BiDi override.
m.TextMesh.text: The text to generate mesh from.
m.TextMesh.uppercase: If true, all the text displays as UPPERCASE.
m.TextMesh.vertical_alignment: Controls the text's vertical alignment. Supports top, center, and bottom.
m.TextMesh.width: Text width (in pixels), used for fill alignment.
m.TextParagraph.add_object: Adds inline object to the text buffer, key must be unique. In the text, object is represented as length object replacement characters.
m.TextParagraph.add_string: Adds text span and font to draw it.
m.TextParagraph.break_flags: Line breaking rules. For more info see TextServer.
m.TextParagraph.clear: Clears text paragraph (removes text and inline objects).
m.TextParagraph.custom_punctuation: Custom punctuation character list, used for word breaking. If set to empty string, server defaults are used.
m.TextParagraph.draw: Draw all lines of the text and drop cap into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
m.TextParagraph.draw_dropcap: Draw drop cap into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
m.TextParagraph.draw_dropcap_outline: Draw drop cap outline into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
m.TextParagraph.draw_line: Draw single line of text into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
m.TextParagraph.draw_line_outline: Draw outline of the single line of text into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
m.TextParagraph.draw_outline: Draw outlines of all lines of the text and drop cap into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
m.TextParagraph.ellipsis_char: Ellipsis character used for text clipping.
m.TextParagraph.get_dropcap_lines: Returns number of lines used by dropcap.
m.TextParagraph.get_dropcap_rid: Returns drop cap text buffer RID.
m.TextParagraph.get_dropcap_size: Returns drop cap bounding box size.
m.TextParagraph.get_inferred_direction: Returns the text writing direction inferred by the BiDi algorithm.
m.TextParagraph.get_line_ascent: Returns the text line ascent (number of pixels above the baseline for horizontal layout or to the left of baseline for vertical).
m.TextParagraph.get_line_count: Returns number of lines in the paragraph.
m.TextParagraph.get_line_descent: Returns the text line descent (number of pixels below the baseline for horizontal layout or to the right of baseline for vertical).
m.TextParagraph.get_line_object_rect: Returns bounding rectangle of the inline object.
m.TextParagraph.get_line_objects: Returns array of inline objects in the line.
m.TextParagraph.get_line_range: Returns character range of the line.
m.TextParagraph.get_line_size: Returns size of the bounding box of the line of text. Returned size is rounded up.
m.TextParagraph.get_line_underline_positio: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.
m.TextParagraph.get_line_width: Returns width (for horizontal layout) or height (for vertical) of the line of text.
m.TextParagraph.get_non_wrapped_size: Returns the size of the bounding box of the paragraph, without line breaks.
m.TextParagraph.get_range: Returns the character range of the paragraph.
m.TextParagraph.get_rid: Returns TextServer full string buffer RID.
m.TextParagraph.get_size: Returns the size of the bounding box of the paragraph.
m.TextParagraph.has_object: Returns true if an object with key is embedded in this shaped text buffer.
m.TextParagraph.hit_test: Returns caret character offset at the specified coordinates. This function always returns a valid position.
m.TextParagraph.line_spacing: Additional vertical spacing between lines (in pixels), spacing is added to line descent. This value can be negative.
m.TextParagraph.max_lines_visible: Limits the lines of text shown.
m.TextParagraph.preserve_control: If set to true text will display control characters.
m.TextParagraph.preserve_invalid: If set to true text will display invalid characters.
m.TextParagraph.resize_object: Sets new size and alignment of embedded object.
m.TextParagraph.set_bidi_override: Overrides BiDi for the structured text.
