m.TextParagraph.set_dropcap: Sets drop cap, overrides previously set drop cap. Drop cap (dropped capital) is a decorative element at the beginning of a paragraph that is larger than the rest of the text.
m.TextParagraph.tab_align: Aligns paragraph to the given tab-stops.
m.TextParagraph.text_overrun_behavior: The clipping behavior when the text exceeds the paragraph's set width.
m.TextServer.AUTOWRAP_ARBITRARY: Wraps the text inside the node's bounding rectangle by allowing to break lines at arbitrary positions, which is useful when very limited space is available.
m.TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD: Wraps the text inside the node's bounding rectangle by soft-breaking between words.
m.TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART: Behaves similarly to AUTOWRAP_WORD, but force-breaks a word if that single word does not fit in one line.
m.TextServer.BREAK_ADAPTIVE: Should be used only in conjunction with BREAK_WORD_BOUND, break the line between any unconnected graphemes, if it's impossible to break it between the words.
m.TextServer.BREAK_GRAPHEME_BOUND: Break the line between any unconnected graphemes.
m.TextServer.BREAK_MANDATORY: Break the line at the line mandatory break characters (e.g. "\n").
m.TextServer.BREAK_TRIM_END_EDGE_SPACES: Remove spaces and line break characters from the end of broken line segments.
m.TextServer.BREAK_TRIM_INDENT: Subtract first line indentation width from all lines after the first one.
m.TextServer.BREAK_TRIM_START_EDGE_SPACES: Remove spaces and line break characters from the start of broken line segments.
m.TextServer.BREAK_WORD_BOUND: Break the line between the words.
m.TextServer.CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_OFF_CONIC: Contour point isn't on the curve, but serves as a control point for a conic (quadratic) Bézier arc.
m.TextServer.CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_OFF_CUBIC: Contour point isn't on the curve, but serves as a control point for a cubic Bézier arc.
m.TextServer.CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_ON: Contour point is on the curve.
m.TextServer.DIRECTION_AUTO: Text direction is determined based on contents and current locale.
m.TextServer.DIRECTION_INHERITED: Text writing direction is the same as base string writing direction. Used for BiDi override only.
m.TextServer.DIRECTION_LTR: Text is written from left to right.
m.TextServer.DIRECTION_RTL: Text is written from right to left.
m.TextServer.FEATURE_BREAK_ITERATORS: TextServer supports complex line/word breaking rules (e.g. dictionary based).
m.TextServer.FEATURE_CONTEXT_SENSITIVE_CAS: TextServer supports locale dependent and context sensitive case conversion.
m.TextServer.FEATURE_FONT_DYNAMIC: TextServer supports loading dynamic (TrueType, OpeType, etc.) fonts.
m.TextServer.FEATURE_FONT_MSDF: TextServer supports multichannel signed distance field dynamic font rendering.
m.TextServer.FEATURE_UNICODE_IDENTIFIERS: TextServer supports UAX #31 identifier validation, see is_valid_identifier().
m.TextServer.FEATURE_UNICODE_SECURITY: TextServer supports Unicode Technical Report #36 [https://unicode.org/reports/tr36/] and Unicode Technical Standard #39 [https://unicode.org/reports/tr39/] based spoof detection features.
m.TextServer.FEATURE_USE_SUPPORT_DATA: TextServer require external data file for some features, see load_support_data().
m.TextServer.FIXED_SIZE_SCALE_ENABLED: Bitmap font is scaled to an arbitrary (fractional) size. This is the recommended option for non-pixel art fonts.
m.TextServer.FIXED_SIZE_SCALE_INTEGER_ONLY: Bitmap font is scaled to the closest integer multiple of the font's fixed size. This is the recommended option for pixel art fonts.
m.TextServer.FONT_ANTIALIASING_GRAY: Font glyphs are rasterized as 8-bit grayscale anti-aliased bitmaps.
m.TextServer.FONT_ANTIALIASING_LCD: Font glyphs are rasterized for LCD screens.
m.TextServer.FONT_ANTIALIASING_NONE: Font glyphs are rasterized as 1-bit bitmaps.
m.TextServer.FONT_FIXED_WIDTH: Font has fixed-width characters (also known as monospace).
m.TextServer.FONT_LCD_SUBPIXEL_LAYOUT_MAX: Represents the size of the FontLCDSubpixelLayout enum.
m.TextServer.FONT_LCD_SUBPIXEL_LAYOUT_NONE: Unknown or unsupported subpixel layout, LCD subpixel antialiasing is disabled.
m.TextServer.GRAPHEME_IS_BREAK_SOFT: Grapheme is optional break point (e.g. space).
m.TextServer.GRAPHEME_IS_CONNECTED: Grapheme is connected to the previous grapheme. Breaking line before this grapheme is not safe.
m.TextServer.GRAPHEME_IS_EMBEDDED_OBJECT: Grapheme is an object replacement character for the embedded object.
m.TextServer.GRAPHEME_IS_RTL: Grapheme is part of right-to-left or bottom-to-top run.
m.TextServer.GRAPHEME_IS_SAFE_TO_INSERT_TA: It is safe to insert a U+0640 before this grapheme for elongation.
m.TextServer.GRAPHEME_IS_VALID: Grapheme is supported by the font, and can be drawn.
m.TextServer.GRAPHEME_IS_VIRTUAL: Grapheme is not part of source text, it was added by justification process.
m.TextServer.HINTING_LIGHT: Use the light font hinting mode.
m.TextServer.HINTING_NONE: Disables font hinting (smoother but less crisp).
m.TextServer.HINTING_NORMAL: Use the default font hinting mode (crisper but less smooth).
m.TextServer.JUSTIFICATION_AFTER_LAST_TAB: Only apply justification to the part of the text after the last tab.
m.TextServer.JUSTIFICATION_CONSTRAIN_ELLIP: Apply justification to the trimmed line with ellipsis.
m.TextServer.JUSTIFICATION_DO_NOT_SKIP_SIN: Always apply justification to the paragraphs with a single line (JUSTIFICATION_SKIP_LAST_LINE and JUSTIFICATION_SKIP_LAST_LINE_WITH_VISIBLE_CHARS are ignored).
m.TextServer.JUSTIFICATION_KASHIDA: Justify text by adding and removing kashidas.
m.TextServer.JUSTIFICATION_SKIP_LAST_LINE: Do not apply justification to the last line of the paragraph.
m.TextServer.JUSTIFICATION_SKIP_LAST_LINE_: Do not apply justification to the last line of the paragraph with visible characters (takes precedence over JUSTIFICATION_SKIP_LAST_LINE).
m.TextServer.JUSTIFICATION_TRIM_EDGE_SPACE: Remove trailing and leading spaces from the justified text.
m.TextServer.JUSTIFICATION_WORD_BOUND: Justify text by changing width of the spaces between the words.
m.TextServer.ORIENTATION_VERTICAL: Left to right text is written vertically from top to bottom.
m.TextServer.OVERRUN_ADD_ELLIPSIS: Determines whether an ellipsis should be added at the end of the text.
m.TextServer.OVERRUN_ENFORCE_ELLIPSIS: Determines whether the ellipsis at the end of the text is enforced and may not be hidden.
m.TextServer.OVERRUN_JUSTIFICATION_AWARE: Accounts for the text being justified before attempting to trim it (see JustificationFlag).
m.TextServer.OVERRUN_SHORT_STRING_ELLIPSIS: Determines whether the ellipsis should be added regardless of the string length, otherwise it is added only if the string is 6 characters or longer.
m.TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM: Trims the text when it exceeds the given width.
m.TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS: Trims the text per character and adds an ellipsis to indicate that parts are hidden if trimmed text is 6 characters or longer.
m.TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS_FORCE: Trims the text per character and adds an ellipsis to indicate that parts are hidden regardless of trimmed text length.
m.TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_WORD_ELLIPSIS: Trims the text per word and adds an ellipsis to indicate that parts are hidden if trimmed text is 6 characters or longer.
m.TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_WORD_ELLIPSIS_FO: Trims the text per word and adds an ellipsis to indicate that parts are hidden regardless of trimmed text length.
m.TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_WORD_ONLY: Trims the text per word instead of per grapheme.
m.TextServer.SPACING_BOTTOM: Spacing at the bottom of the line.
m.TextServer.SPACING_MAX: Represents the size of the SpacingType enum.
m.TextServer.SPACING_TOP: Spacing at the top of the line.
m.TextServer.STRUCTURED_TEXT_CUSTOM: User defined structured text BiDi override function.
m.TextServer.STRUCTURED_TEXT_LIST: BiDi override for lists. Structured text options: list separator String.
m.TextServer.SUBPIXEL_POSITIONING_AUTO: Glyph horizontal position is rounded based on font size.
m.TextServer.SUBPIXEL_POSITIONING_DISABLED: Glyph horizontal position is rounded to the whole pixel size, each glyph is rasterized once.
m.TextServer.SUBPIXEL_POSITIONING_ONE_HALF: Glyph horizontal position is rounded to one half of the pixel size, each glyph is rasterized up to two times.
Maximum font size which will use "one half of the pixel" subpixel positioning in SUBPIXEL_POSITIONING_AUTO mode.
m.TextServer.SUBPIXEL_POSITIONING_ONE_QUAR: Glyph horizontal position is rounded to one quarter of the pixel size, each glyph is rasterized up to four times.
Maximum font size which will use "one quarter of the pixel" subpixel positioning in SUBPIXEL_POSITIONING_AUTO mode.
m.TextServer.VC_CHARS_AFTER_SHAPING: Displays glyphs that are mapped to the first Label.visible_characters or RichTextLabel.visible_characters characters from the beginning of the text.
m.TextServer.VC_CHARS_BEFORE_SHAPING: Trims text before the shaping. e.g, increasing Label.visible_characters or RichTextLabel.visible_characters value is visually identical to typing the text.
m.TextServer.VC_GLYPHS_AUTO: Displays Label.visible_ratio or RichTextLabel.visible_ratio glyphs, starting from the left or from the right, depending on Control.layout_direction value.
m.TextServer.VC_GLYPHS_LTR: Displays Label.visible_ratio or RichTextLabel.visible_ratio glyphs, starting from the left.
m.TextServer.VC_GLYPHS_RTL: Displays Label.visible_ratio or RichTextLabel.visible_ratio glyphs, starting from the right.
m.TextServer.create_font: Creates a new, empty font cache entry resource. To free the resulting resource, use the free_rid() method.
m.TextServer.create_font_linked_variation: Creates a new variation existing font which is reusing the same glyph cache and font data. To free the resulting resource, use the free_rid() method.
m.TextServer.create_shaped_text: Creates a new buffer for complex text layout, with the given direction and orientation. To free the resulting buffer, use free_rid() method.
m.TextServer.draw_hex_code_box: Draws box displaying character hexadecimal code. Used for replacing missing characters.
m.TextServer.font_clear_glyphs: Removes all rendered glyph information from the cache entry.
m.TextServer.font_clear_size_cache: Removes all font sizes from the cache entry.
m.TextServer.font_clear_system_fallback_ca: Frees all automatically loaded system fonts.
m.TextServer.font_clear_textures: Removes all textures from font cache entry.
m.TextServer.font_draw_glyph: Draws single glyph into a canvas item at the position, using font_rid at the size size. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
m.TextServer.font_draw_glyph_outline: Draws single glyph outline of size outline_size into a canvas item at the position, using font_rid at the size size. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
m.TextServer.font_get_ascent: Returns the font ascent (number of pixels above the baseline).
m.TextServer.font_get_baseline_offset: Returns extra baseline offset (as a fraction of font height).

m.TextServer.font_get_descent: Returns the font descent (number of pixels below the baseline).

m.TextServer.font_get_face_count: Returns number of faces in the TrueType / OpenType collection.
m.TextServer.font_get_face_index: Returns an active face index in the TrueType / OpenType collection.
m.TextServer.font_get_generate_mipmaps: Returns true if font texture mipmap generation is enabled.
m.TextServer.font_get_global_oversampling: Deprecated: Use Viewport oversampling, or the oversampling argument of the draw_* methods instead.
m.TextServer.font_get_glyph_advance: Returns glyph advance (offset of the next glyph).
m.TextServer.font_get_glyph_contours: Returns outline contours of the glyph as a Dictionary with the following contents:
m.TextServer.font_get_glyph_index: Returns the glyph index of a char, optionally modified by the variation_selector. See font_get_char_from_glyph_index().
m.TextServer.font_get_glyph_list: Returns list of rendered glyphs in the cache entry.
m.TextServer.font_get_glyph_offset: Returns glyph offset from the baseline.
m.TextServer.font_get_glyph_texture_idx: Returns index of the cache texture containing the glyph.
m.TextServer.font_get_glyph_texture_rid: Returns resource ID of the cache texture containing the glyph.
m.TextServer.font_get_glyph_texture_size: Returns size of the cache texture containing the glyph.
m.TextServer.font_get_glyph_uv_rect: Returns rectangle in the cache texture containing the glyph.
m.TextServer.font_get_hinting: Returns the font hinting mode. Used by dynamic fonts only.

m.TextServer.font_get_kerning: Returns kerning for the pair of glyphs.
m.TextServer.font_get_kerning_list: Returns list of the kerning overrides.
m.TextServer.font_get_language_support_ove: Returns true if support override is enabled for the language.
Returns list of language support overrides.
m.TextServer.font_get_msdf_pixel_range: Returns the width of the range around the shape between the minimum and maximum representable signed distance.
m.TextServer.font_get_msdf_size: Returns source font size used to generate MSDF textures.
m.TextServer.font_get_opentype_feature_ove: Returns font OpenType feature set override.
m.TextServer.font_get_ot_name_strings: Returns Dictionary with OpenType font name strings (localized font names, version, description, license information, sample text, etc.).
m.TextServer.font_get_oversampling: Returns oversampling factor override. If set to a positive value, overrides the oversampling factor of the viewport this font is used in. See Viewport.oversampling. This value doesn't override the oversampling parameter of draw_* methods. Used by dynamic fonts only.
m.TextServer.font_get_palette_colors: Returns the array in the predefined color palette at index. Palette contains all colors used to render font glyphs. Each palette has the same number of colors. Colors can be overridden using font_set_palette_custom_colors().
m.TextServer.font_get_palette_count: Returns the number of predefined color palettes. Palette contains all colors used to render font glyphs. Each palette has the same number of colors.
m.TextServer.font_get_palette_custom_color: Returns array of custom colors to override predefined palette.
m.TextServer.font_get_palette_name: Returns the name of the predefined color palette at index. Palette contains all colors used to render font glyphs. Each palette has the same number of colors.
m.TextServer.font_get_scale: Returns scaling factor of the color bitmap font.
m.TextServer.font_get_script_support_overr: Returns true if support override is enabled for the script.
Returns list of script support overrides.
m.TextServer.font_get_size_cache_info: Returns font cache information, each entry contains the following fields: Vector2i size_px - font size in pixels, float viewport_oversampling - viewport oversampling factor, int glyphs - number of rendered glyphs, int textures - number of used textures, int textures_size - size of texture data in bytes.
m.TextServer.font_get_size_cache_list: Returns list of the font sizes in the cache. Each size is Vector2i with font size and outline size.
m.TextServer.font_get_spacing: Returns the spacing for spacing in pixels (not relative to the font size).
m.TextServer.font_get_stretch: Returns font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage value between 50% and 200%.
m.TextServer.font_get_subpixel_positioning: Returns font subpixel glyph positioning mode.
m.TextServer.font_get_supported_chars: Returns a string containing all the characters available in the font.
m.TextServer.font_get_supported_glyphs: Returns an array containing all glyph indices in the font.
m.TextServer.font_get_texture_count: Returns number of textures used by font cache entry.
m.TextServer.font_get_texture_image: Returns font cache texture image data.
m.TextServer.font_get_texture_offsets: Returns array containing glyph packing data.
m.TextServer.font_get_transform: Returns 2D transform applied to the font outlines.
m.TextServer.font_get_underline_position: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.
m.TextServer.font_get_underline_thickness: Returns thickness of the underline in pixels.
m.TextServer.font_get_variation_coordinate: Returns variation coordinates for the specified font cache entry. See font_supported_variation_list() for more info.
m.TextServer.font_get_weight: Returns weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the 100...999 range, normal font weight is 400, bold font weight is 700.
m.TextServer.font_has_char: Returns true if a Unicode char is available in the font.
m.TextServer.font_is_allow_system_fallback: Returns true if system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.
m.TextServer.font_is_force_autohinter: Returns true if auto-hinting is supported and preferred over font built-in hinting. Used by dynamic fonts only.
m.TextServer.font_is_language_supported: Returns true if the font supports the given language (as a ISO 639 [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_639-1] code).
m.TextServer.font_is_modulate_color_glyphs: Returns true if color modulation is applied when drawing the font's colored glyphs.
m.TextServer.font_is_multichannel_signed_d: Returns true if glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font vector data.
m.TextServer.font_is_script_supported: Returns true if the font supports the given script (as a ISO 15924 [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_15924] code).
m.TextServer.font_remove_glyph: Removes specified rendered glyph information from the cache entry.
m.TextServer.font_remove_kerning: Removes kerning override for the pair of glyphs.
m.TextServer.font_remove_size_cache: Removes specified font size from the cache entry.
m.TextServer.font_remove_texture: Removes specified texture from the cache entry.
m.TextServer.font_render_glyph: Renders specified glyph to the font cache texture.
m.TextServer.font_render_range: Renders the range of characters to the font cache texture.
m.TextServer.font_set_allow_system_fallbac: If set to true, system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.
m.TextServer.font_set_ascent: Sets the font ascent (number of pixels above the baseline).
m.TextServer.font_set_baseline_offset: Sets extra baseline offset (as a fraction of font height).
m.TextServer.font_set_data: Sets font source data, e.g contents of the dynamic font source file.
m.TextServer.font_set_descent: Sets the font descent (number of pixels below the baseline).
m.TextServer.font_set_disable_embedded_bit: If set to true, embedded font bitmap loading is disabled (bitmap-only and color fonts ignore this property).
m.TextServer.font_set_embolden: Sets font embolden strength. If strength is not equal to zero, emboldens the font outlines. Negative values reduce the outline thickness.
m.TextServer.font_set_face_index: Sets an active face index in the TrueType / OpenType collection.
m.TextServer.font_set_fixed_size: Sets bitmap font fixed size. If set to value greater than zero, same cache entry will be used for all font sizes.
m.TextServer.font_set_fixed_size_scale_mod: Sets bitmap font scaling mode. This property is used only if fixed_size is greater than zero.
m.TextServer.font_set_force_autohinter: If set to true auto-hinting is preferred over font built-in hinting.
m.TextServer.font_set_generate_mipmaps: If set to true font texture mipmap generation is enabled.
m.TextServer.font_set_global_oversampling: Deprecated: Use Viewport oversampling, or the oversampling argument of the draw_* methods instead.
m.TextServer.font_set_glyph_advance: Sets glyph advance (offset of the next glyph).
m.TextServer.font_set_glyph_offset: Sets glyph offset from the baseline.
m.TextServer.font_set_glyph_texture_idx: Sets index of the cache texture containing the glyph.
m.TextServer.font_set_glyph_uv_rect: Sets rectangle in the cache texture containing the glyph.
m.TextServer.font_set_hinting: Sets font hinting mode. Used by dynamic fonts only.
m.TextServer.font_set_keep_rounding_remain: Sets glyph position rounding behavior. If set to true, when aligning glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if subpixel positioning is enabled.
m.TextServer.font_set_kerning: Sets kerning for the pair of glyphs.
m.TextServer.font_set_modulate_color_glyph: If set to true, color modulation is applied when drawing colored glyphs, otherwise it's applied to the monochrome glyphs only.
m.TextServer.font_set_msdf_pixel_range: Sets the width of the range around the shape between the minimum and maximum representable signed distance.
m.TextServer.font_set_msdf_size: Sets source font size used to generate MSDF textures.

m.TextServer.font_set_opentype_feature_ove: Sets font OpenType feature set override.
m.TextServer.font_set_oversampling: If set to a positive value, overrides the oversampling factor of the viewport this font is used in. See Viewport.oversampling. This value doesn't override the oversampling parameter of draw_* methods. Used by dynamic fonts only.
m.TextServer.font_set_palette_custom_color: Sets array of custom colors to override predefined palette. Set to empty array to reset overrides. Use Color(0, 0, 0, 0), to keep predefined palette color at specific position.
m.TextServer.font_set_scale: Sets scaling factor of the color bitmap font.
m.TextServer.font_set_spacing: Sets the spacing for spacing to value in pixels (not relative to the font size).
m.TextServer.font_set_stretch: Sets font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage value between 50% and 200%.
m.TextServer.font_set_subpixel_positioning: Sets font subpixel glyph positioning mode.
m.TextServer.font_set_texture_image: Sets font cache texture image data.
m.TextServer.font_set_texture_offsets: Sets array containing glyph packing data.
m.TextServer.font_set_transform: Sets 2D transform, applied to the font outlines, can be used for slanting, flipping, and rotating glyphs.
m.TextServer.font_set_underline_position: Sets pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.
m.TextServer.font_set_underline_thickness: Sets thickness of the underline in pixels.
m.TextServer.font_set_variation_coordinate: Sets variation coordinates for the specified font cache entry. See font_supported_variation_list() for more info.
m.TextServer.font_set_weight: Sets weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the 100...999 range, normal font weight is 400, bold font weight is 700.
m.TextServer.font_supported_feature_list: Returns the dictionary of the supported OpenType features.
m.TextServer.font_supported_variation_list: Returns the dictionary of the supported OpenType variation coordinates.
m.TextServer.free_rid: Frees an object created by this TextServer.
m.TextServer.get_features: Returns text server features, see Feature.
m.TextServer.get_hex_code_box_size: Returns size of the replacement character (box with character hexadecimal code that is drawn in place of invalid characters).
m.TextServer.get_name: Returns the name of the server interface.
m.TextServer.get_support_data: Returns default TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries).
m.TextServer.get_support_data_filename: Returns default TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) filename.
m.TextServer.get_support_data_info: Returns TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) description.
m.TextServer.has: Returns true if rid is valid resource owned by this text server.
m.TextServer.has_feature: Returns true if the server supports a feature.
m.TextServer.is_confusable: Returns index of the first string in dict which is visually confusable with the string, or -1 if none is found.
m.TextServer.is_locale_right_to_left: Returns true if locale is right-to-left.
m.TextServer.is_locale_using_support_data: Returns true if the locale requires text server support data for line/word breaking.
m.TextServer.is_valid_identifier: Returns true if string is a valid identifier.
m.TextServer.is_valid_letter: Returns true if the given code point is a valid letter, i.e. it belongs to the Unicode category "L".
m.TextServer.load_support_data: Loads optional TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries).

m.TextServer.save_support_data: Saves optional TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) to the file.
m.TextServer.shaped_get_run_count: Returns the number of uniform text runs in the buffer.
m.TextServer.shaped_get_run_direction: Returns the direction of the index text run (in visual order).
m.TextServer.shaped_get_run_font_rid: Returns the font RID of the index text run (in visual order).
m.TextServer.shaped_get_run_font_size: Returns the font size of the index text run (in visual order).
m.TextServer.shaped_get_run_glyph_range: Returns the glyph range of the index text run (in visual order).
m.TextServer.shaped_get_run_language: Returns the language of the index text run (in visual order).

m.TextServer.shaped_get_run_text: Returns the source text of the index text run (in visual order).

m.TextServer.shaped_get_span_object: Returns the text span embedded object key.
m.TextServer.shaped_get_span_text: Returns the text span source text.
m.TextServer.shaped_get_text: Returns the text buffer source text, including object replacement characters.
m.TextServer.shaped_set_span_update_font: Changes text span font, font size, and OpenType features, without changing the text.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_add_object: Adds inline object to the text buffer, key must be unique. In the text, object is represented as length object replacement characters.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_add_string: Adds text span and font to draw it to the text buffer.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_clear: Clears text buffer (removes text and inline objects).
m.TextServer.shaped_text_closest_character: Returns composite character position closest to the pos.

If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_draw_outline: Draw the outline of the shaped text into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos specifies the leftmost point of the baseline (for horizontal layout) or topmost point of the baseline (for vertical layout). If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_fit_to_width: Adjusts text width to fit to specified width, returns new text width.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_ascent: Returns the text ascent (number of pixels above the baseline for horizontal layout or to the left of baseline for vertical).
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_carets: Returns shapes of the carets corresponding to the character offset position in the text. Returned caret shape is 1 pixel wide rectangle.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_character_bre: Returns array of the composite character boundaries.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_custom_ellips: Returns ellipsis character used for text clipping.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_custom_punctu: Returns custom punctuation character list, used for word breaking. If set to empty string, server defaults are used.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_descent: Returns the text descent (number of pixels below the baseline for horizontal layout or to the right of baseline for vertical).
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_dominant_dire: Returns dominant direction of in the range of text.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_ellipsis_glyp: Returns number of glyphs in the ellipsis.

m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_glyph_count: Returns number of glyphs in the buffer.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_glyphs: Returns an array of glyphs in the visual order.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_grapheme_boun: Returns composite character's bounds as offsets from the start of the line.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_inferred_dire: Returns direction of the text, inferred by the BiDi algorithm.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_line_breaks: Breaks text to the lines and returns character ranges for each line.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_line_breaks_a: Breaks text to the lines and columns. Returns character ranges for each segment.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_object_glyph: Returns the glyph index of the inline object.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_object_range: Returns the character range of the inline object.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_object_rect: Returns bounding rectangle of the inline object.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_parent: Returns the parent buffer from which the substring originates.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_preserve_cont: Returns true if text buffer is configured to display control characters.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_preserve_inva: Returns true if text buffer is configured to display hexadecimal codes in place of invalid characters.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_range: Returns substring buffer character range in the parent buffer.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_selection: Returns selection rectangles for the specified character range.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_spacing: Returns extra spacing added between glyphs or lines in pixels.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_trim_pos: Returns the position of the overrun trim.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_underline_pos: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_width: Returns width (for horizontal layout) or height (for vertical) of the text.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_get_word_breaks: Breaks text into words and returns array of character ranges. Use grapheme_flags to set what characters are used for breaking.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_has_object: Returns true if an object with key is embedded in this shaped text buffer.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_has_visible_chars: Returns true if text buffer contains any visible characters.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_hit_test_grapheme: Returns grapheme index at the specified pixel offset at the baseline, or -1 if none is found.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_hit_test_position: Returns caret character offset at the specified pixel offset at the baseline. This function always returns a valid position.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_is_ready: Returns true if buffer is successfully shaped.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_next_character_po: Returns composite character end position closest to the pos.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_next_grapheme_pos: Returns grapheme end position closest to the pos.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_overrun_trim_to_w: Trims text if it exceeds the given width.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_prev_character_po: Returns composite character start position closest to the pos.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_prev_grapheme_pos: Returns grapheme start position closest to the pos.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_resize_object: Sets new size and alignment of embedded object.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_set_bidi_override: Overrides BiDi for the structured text.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_set_custom_ellips: Sets ellipsis character used for text clipping.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_set_custom_punctu: Sets custom punctuation character list, used for word breaking. If set to empty string, server defaults are used.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_set_direction: Sets desired text direction. If set to DIRECTION_AUTO, direction will be detected based on the buffer contents and current locale.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_set_preserve_cont: If set to true text buffer will display control characters.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_set_preserve_inva: If set to true text buffer will display invalid characters as hexadecimal codes, otherwise nothing is displayed.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_set_spacing: Sets extra spacing added between glyphs or lines in pixels.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_shape: Shapes buffer if it's not shaped. Returns true if the string is shaped successfully.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_sort_logical: Returns text glyphs in the logical order.
m.TextServer.shaped_text_substr: Returns text buffer for the substring of the text in the shaped text buffer (including inline objects).
m.TextServer.shaped_text_tab_align: Aligns shaped text to the given tab-stops.
m.TextServer.spoof_check: Returns true if string is likely to be an attempt at confusing the reader.
m.TextServer.string_get_character_breaks: Returns array of the composite character boundaries.

m.TextServer.string_to_lower: Returns the string converted to lowercase.
m.TextServer.string_to_title: Returns the string converted to Title Case.
m.TextServer.string_to_upper: Returns the string converted to UPPERCASE.
m.TextServer.tag_to_name: Converts the given OpenType tag to the readable name of a feature, variation, script, or language.

m.Texture2D._draw: Called when the entire Texture2D is requested to be drawn over a CanvasItem, with the top-left offset specified in pos. modulate specifies a multiplier for the colors being drawn, while transpose specifies whether drawing should be performed in column-major order instead of row-major order (resulting in 90-degree clockwise rotation).

When using a radial fill_mode, this setting will only enable stretching for texture_progress, while texture_under and texture_over will be treated like in NinePatchRect.
m.TextureProgressBar.radial_center_offset: Offsets texture_progress if fill_mode is FILL_CLOCKWISE, FILL_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE, or FILL_CLOCKWISE_AND_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE.
m.TextureProgressBar.radial_fill_degrees: Upper limit for the fill of texture_progress if fill_mode is FILL_CLOCKWISE, FILL_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE, or FILL_CLOCKWISE_AND_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE. When the node's value is equal to its max_value, the texture fills up to this angle.
m.TextureProgressBar.radial_initial_angle: Starting angle for the fill of texture_progress if fill_mode is FILL_CLOCKWISE, FILL_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE, or FILL_CLOCKWISE_AND_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE. When the node's value is equal to its min_value, the texture doesn't show up at all. When the value increases, the texture fills and tends towards radial_fill_degrees.
m.TextureProgressBar.set_stretch_margin: Sets the stretch margin with the specified index. See stretch_margin_bottom and related properties.
m.TextureProgressBar.stretch_margin_bottom: The height of the 9-patch's bottom row. A margin of 16 means the 9-slice's bottom corners and side will have a height of 16 pixels. You can set all 4 margin values individually to create panels with non-uniform borders. Only effective if nine_patch_stretch is true.
m.TextureProgressBar.stretch_margin_left: The width of the 9-patch's left column. Only effective if nine_patch_stretch is true.
m.TextureProgressBar.stretch_margin_right: The width of the 9-patch's right column. Only effective if nine_patch_stretch is true.
m.TextureProgressBar.stretch_margin_top: The height of the 9-patch's top row. Only effective if nine_patch_stretch is true.
m.TextureProgressBar.texture_over: Texture2D that draws over the progress bar. Use it to add highlights or an upper-frame that hides part of texture_progress.
m.TextureProgressBar.texture_progress: Texture2D that clips based on the node's value and fill_mode. As value increased, the texture fills up. It shows entirely when value reaches max_value. It doesn't show at all if value is equal to min_value.
m.TextureProgressBar.texture_progress_offs: The offset of texture_progress. Useful for texture_over and texture_under with fancy borders, to avoid transparent margins in your progress texture.
m.TextureProgressBar.texture_under: Texture2D that draws under the progress bar. The bar's background.
m.TextureProgressBar.tint_over: Multiplies the color of the bar's texture_over texture. The effect is similar to CanvasItem.modulate, except it only affects this specific texture instead of the entire node.
m.TextureProgressBar.tint_progress: Multiplies the color of the bar's texture_progress texture.
m.TextureProgressBar.tint_under: Multiplies the color of the bar's texture_under texture.
m.TextureRect.EXPAND_FIT_HEIGHT: The width of the texture will be ignored. Minimum height will be equal to the current width. Useful for vertical layouts, e.g. inside VBoxContainer.
m.TextureRect.EXPAND_FIT_HEIGHT_PROPORTION: Same as EXPAND_FIT_HEIGHT, but keeps texture's aspect ratio.
m.TextureRect.EXPAND_FIT_WIDTH: The height of the texture will be ignored. Minimum width will be equal to the current height. Useful for horizontal layouts, e.g. inside HBoxContainer.
m.TextureRect.EXPAND_FIT_WIDTH_PROPORTIONA: Same as EXPAND_FIT_WIDTH, but keeps texture's aspect ratio.
m.TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE: The size of the texture won't be considered for minimum size calculation, so the TextureRect can be shrunk down past the texture size.
m.TextureRect.EXPAND_KEEP_SIZE: The minimum size will be equal to texture size, i.e. TextureRect can't be smaller than the texture.
m.TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP: The texture keeps its original size and stays in the bounding rectangle's top-left corner.
m.TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT: Scale the texture to fit the node's bounding rectangle, but maintain the texture's aspect ratio.
m.TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED: Scale the texture to fit the node's bounding rectangle, center it and maintain its aspect ratio.
m.TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_COVERED: Scale the texture so that the shorter side fits the bounding rectangle. The other side clips to the node's limits.
m.TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_CENTERED: The texture keeps its original size and stays centered in the node's bounding rectangle.
m.TextureRect.STRETCH_SCALE: Scale to fit the node's bounding rectangle.
m.TextureRect.STRETCH_TILE: Tile inside the node's bounding rectangle.
m.TextureRect.expand_mode: Experimental: Using EXPAND_FIT_WIDTH, EXPAND_FIT_WIDTH_PROPORTIONAL, EXPAND_FIT_HEIGHT, or EXPAND_FIT_HEIGHT_PROPORTIONAL may result in unstable behavior in some Container controls. This behavior may be re-evaluated and changed in the future.
m.TextureRect.flip_h: If true, texture is flipped horizontally.
m.TextureRect.flip_v: If true, texture is flipped vertically.
m.TextureRect.stretch_mode: Controls the texture's behavior when resizing the node's bounding rectangle.
m.Theme.DATA_TYPE_MAX: Maximum value for the DataType enum.
m.Theme.add_type: Adds an empty theme type for every valid data type.
m.Theme.clear: Removes all the theme properties defined on the theme resource.
m.Theme.clear_color: Removes the Color property defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
m.Theme.clear_constant: Removes the constant property defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
m.Theme.clear_font: Removes the Font property defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
m.Theme.clear_font_size: Removes the font size property defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
m.Theme.clear_icon: Removes the icon property defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
m.Theme.clear_stylebox: Removes the StyleBox property defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
m.Theme.clear_theme_item: Removes the theme property of data_type defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
m.Theme.clear_type_variation: Unmarks theme_type as being a variation of another theme type. See set_type_variation().
m.Theme.default_base_scale: The default base scale factor of this theme resource. Used by some controls to scale their visual properties based on the global scale factor. If this value is set to 0.0, the global scale factor is used (see ThemeDB.fallback_base_scale).
m.Theme.default_font: The default font of this theme resource. Used as the default value when trying to fetch a font resource that doesn't exist in this theme or is in invalid state. If the default font is also missing or invalid, the engine fallback value is used (see ThemeDB.fallback_font).
m.Theme.default_font_size: The default font size of this theme resource. Used as the default value when trying to fetch a font size value that doesn't exist in this theme or is in invalid state. If the default font size is also missing or invalid, the engine fallback value is used (see ThemeDB.fallback_font_size).
m.Theme.get_color: Returns the Color property defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
m.Theme.get_color_list: Returns a list of names for Color properties defined with theme_type. Use get_color_type_list() to get a list of possible theme type names.
m.Theme.get_color_type_list: Returns a list of all unique theme type names for Color properties. Use get_type_list() to get a list of all unique theme types.
m.Theme.get_constant: Returns the constant property defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
m.Theme.get_constant_list: Returns a list of names for constant properties defined with theme_type. Use get_constant_type_list() to get a list of possible theme type names.
m.Theme.get_constant_type_list: Returns a list of all unique theme type names for constant properties. Use get_type_list() to get a list of all unique theme types.
m.Theme.get_font: Returns the Font property defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
m.Theme.get_font_list: Returns a list of names for Font properties defined with theme_type. Use get_font_type_list() to get a list of possible theme type names.
m.Theme.get_font_size: Returns the font size property defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
m.Theme.get_font_size_list: Returns a list of names for font size properties defined with theme_type. Use get_font_size_type_list() to get a list of possible theme type names.
m.Theme.get_font_size_type_list: Returns a list of all unique theme type names for font size properties. Use get_type_list() to get a list of all unique theme types.
m.Theme.get_font_type_list: Returns a list of all unique theme type names for Font properties. Use get_type_list() to get a list of all unique theme types.
m.Theme.get_icon: Returns the icon property defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
m.Theme.get_icon_list: Returns a list of names for icon properties defined with theme_type. Use get_icon_type_list() to get a list of possible theme type names.
m.Theme.get_icon_type_list: Returns a list of all unique theme type names for icon properties. Use get_type_list() to get a list of all unique theme types.
m.Theme.get_stylebox: Returns the StyleBox property defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
m.Theme.get_stylebox_list: Returns a list of names for StyleBox properties defined with theme_type. Use get_stylebox_type_list() to get a list of possible theme type names.
m.Theme.get_stylebox_type_list: Returns a list of all unique theme type names for StyleBox properties. Use get_type_list() to get a list of all unique theme types.
m.Theme.get_theme_item: Returns the theme property of data_type defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
m.Theme.get_theme_item_list: Returns a list of names for properties of data_type defined with theme_type. Use get_theme_item_type_list() to get a list of possible theme type names.
m.Theme.get_theme_item_type_list: Returns a list of all unique theme type names for data_type properties. Use get_type_list() to get a list of all unique theme types.
m.Theme.get_type_list: Returns a list of all unique theme type names. Use the appropriate get_*_type_list method to get a list of unique theme types for a single data type.
m.Theme.get_type_variation_base: Returns the name of the base theme type if theme_type is a valid variation type. Returns an empty string otherwise.
m.Theme.get_type_variation_list: Returns a list of all type variations for the given base_type.
m.Theme.has_color: Returns true if the Color property defined by name and theme_type exists.
m.Theme.has_constant: Returns true if the constant property defined by name and theme_type exists.
m.Theme.has_default_base_scale: Returns true if default_base_scale has a valid value.
m.Theme.has_default_font: Returns true if default_font has a valid value.
m.Theme.has_default_font_size: Returns true if default_font_size has a valid value.
m.Theme.has_font: Returns true if the Font property defined by name and theme_type exists, or if the default theme font is set up (see has_default_font()).
m.Theme.has_font_size: Returns true if the font size property defined by name and theme_type exists, or if the default theme font size is set up (see has_default_font_size()).
m.Theme.has_icon: Returns true if the icon property defined by name and theme_type exists.
m.Theme.has_stylebox: Returns true if the StyleBox property defined by name and theme_type exists.
m.Theme.has_theme_item: Returns true if the theme property of data_type defined by name and theme_type exists.
m.Theme.is_type_variation: Returns true if theme_type is marked as a variation of base_type.
m.Theme.merge_with: Adds missing and overrides existing definitions with values from the other theme resource.
m.Theme.remove_type: Removes the theme type, gracefully discarding defined theme items. If the type is a variation, this information is also erased. If the type is a base for type variations, those variations lose their base.
m.Theme.rename_color: Renames the Color property defined by old_name and theme_type to name, if it exists.
m.Theme.rename_constant: Renames the constant property defined by old_name and theme_type to name, if it exists.
m.Theme.rename_font: Renames the Font property defined by old_name and theme_type to name, if it exists.
m.Theme.rename_font_size: Renames the font size property defined by old_name and theme_type to name, if it exists.
m.Theme.rename_icon: Renames the icon property defined by old_name and theme_type to name, if it exists.
m.Theme.rename_stylebox: Renames the StyleBox property defined by old_name and theme_type to name, if it exists.
m.Theme.rename_theme_item: Renames the theme property of data_type defined by old_name and theme_type to name, if it exists.
m.Theme.rename_type: Renames the theme type old_theme_type to theme_type, if the old type exists and the new one doesn't exist.
m.Theme.set_color: Creates or changes the value of the Color property defined by name and theme_type. Use clear_color() to remove the property.
m.Theme.set_constant: Creates or changes the value of the constant property defined by name and theme_type. Use clear_constant() to remove the property.
m.Theme.set_font: Creates or changes the value of the Font property defined by name and theme_type. Use clear_font() to remove the property.
m.Theme.set_font_size: Creates or changes the value of the font size property defined by name and theme_type. Use clear_font_size() to remove the property.
m.Theme.set_icon: Creates or changes the value of the icon property defined by name and theme_type. Use clear_icon() to remove the property.
m.Theme.set_stylebox: Creates or changes the value of the StyleBox property defined by name and theme_type. Use clear_stylebox() to remove the property.
m.Theme.set_theme_item: Creates or changes the value of the theme property of data_type defined by name and theme_type. Use clear_theme_item() to remove the property.
m.Theme.set_type_variation: Marks theme_type as a variation of base_type.
m.ThemeDB.fallback_base_scale: The fallback base scale factor of every Control node and Theme resource. Used when no other value is available to the control.
m.ThemeDB.fallback_changed: Emitted when one of the fallback values had been changed. Use it to refresh the look of controls that may rely on the fallback theme items.
m.ThemeDB.fallback_font: The fallback font of every Control node and Theme resource. Used when no other value is available to the control.
m.ThemeDB.fallback_font_size: The fallback font size of every Control node and Theme resource. Used when no other value is available to the control.
m.ThemeDB.fallback_icon: The fallback icon of every Control node and Theme resource. Used when no other value is available to the control.
m.ThemeDB.fallback_stylebox: The fallback stylebox of every Control node and Theme resource. Used when no other value is available to the control.
m.ThemeDB.get_default_theme: Returns a reference to the default engine Theme. This theme resource is responsible for the out-of-the-box look of Control nodes and cannot be overridden.
m.ThemeDB.get_project_theme: Returns a reference to the custom project Theme. This theme resources allows to override the default engine theme for every control node in the project.
m.Thread.PRIORITY_HIGH: A thread running with higher priority than normally.
m.Thread.PRIORITY_LOW: A thread running with lower priority than normally.
m.Thread.PRIORITY_NORMAL: A thread with a standard priority.
m.Thread.get_id: Returns the current Thread's ID, uniquely identifying it among all threads. If the Thread has not started running or if wait_to_finish() has been called, this returns an empty string.
m.Thread.is_alive: Returns true if this Thread is currently running the provided function. This is useful for determining if wait_to_finish() can be called without blocking the calling thread.
m.Thread.is_main_thread: Returns true if the thread this method was called from is the main thread.
m.Thread.is_started: Returns true if this Thread has been started. Once started, this will return true until it is joined using wait_to_finish(). For checking if a Thread is still executing its task, use is_alive().
m.Thread.set_thread_safety_checks_enabled: Sets whether the thread safety checks the engine normally performs in methods of certain classes (e.g., Node) should happen on the current thread.
m.Thread.start: Starts a new Thread that calls callable.
m.Thread.wait_to_finish: Joins the Thread and waits for it to finish. Returns the output of the Callable passed to start().
m.TileData.add_collision_polygon: Adds a collision polygon to the tile on the given TileSet physics layer.
m.TileData.add_occluder_polygon: Adds an occlusion polygon to the tile on the TileSet occlusion layer with index layer_id.
m.TileData.changed: Emitted when any of the properties are changed.
m.TileData.flip_h: If true, the tile will have its texture flipped horizontally.
m.TileData.flip_v: If true, the tile will have its texture flipped vertically.
m.TileData.get_collision_polygon_one_way_m: Returns the one-way margin (for one-way platforms) of the polygon at index polygon_index for TileSet physics layer with index layer_id.
m.TileData.get_collision_polygon_points: Returns the points of the polygon at index polygon_index for TileSet physics layer with index layer_id.
m.TileData.get_collision_polygons_count: Returns how many polygons the tile has for TileSet physics layer with index layer_id.
m.TileData.get_constant_angular_velocity: Returns the constant angular velocity applied to objects colliding with this tile.
m.TileData.get_constant_linear_velocity: Returns the constant linear velocity applied to objects colliding with this tile.
m.TileData.get_custom_data: Returns the custom data value for custom data layer named layer_name. To check if a custom data layer exists, use has_custom_data().
m.TileData.get_custom_data_by_layer_id: Returns the custom data value for custom data layer with index layer_id.
m.TileData.get_navigation_polygon: Returns the navigation polygon of the tile for the TileSet navigation layer with index layer_id.
m.TileData.get_occluder_polygon: Returns the occluder polygon at index polygon_index from the TileSet occlusion layer with index layer_id.
m.TileData.get_occluder_polygons_count: Returns the number of occluder polygons of the tile in the TileSet occlusion layer with index layer_id.
m.TileData.get_terrain_peering_bit: Returns the tile's terrain bit for the given peering_bit direction. To check that a direction is valid, use is_valid_terrain_peering_bit().
m.TileData.has_custom_data: Returns whether there exists a custom data layer named layer_name.
m.TileData.is_collision_polygon_one_way: Returns whether one-way collisions are enabled for the polygon at index polygon_index for TileSet physics layer with index layer_id.
m.TileData.is_valid_terrain_peering_bit: Returns whether the given peering_bit direction is valid for this tile.
m.TileData.material: The Material to use for this TileData. This can be a CanvasItemMaterial to use the default shader, or a ShaderMaterial to use a custom shader.
m.TileData.probability: Relative probability of this tile being selected when drawing a pattern of random tiles.
m.TileData.remove_collision_polygon: Removes the polygon at index polygon_index for TileSet physics layer with index layer_id.
m.TileData.remove_occluder_polygon: Removes the polygon at index polygon_index for TileSet occlusion layer with index layer_id.
m.TileData.set_collision_polygon_one_way: Enables/disables one-way collisions on the polygon at index polygon_index for TileSet physics layer with index layer_id.
m.TileData.set_collision_polygon_one_way_m: Sets the one-way margin (for one-way platforms) of the polygon at index polygon_index for TileSet physics layer with index layer_id.
m.TileData.set_collision_polygon_points: Sets the points of the polygon at index polygon_index for TileSet physics layer with index layer_id.
m.TileData.set_collision_polygons_count: Sets the polygons count for TileSet physics layer with index layer_id.
m.TileData.set_constant_angular_velocity: Sets the constant angular velocity. This does not rotate the tile. This angular velocity is applied to objects colliding with this tile.
m.TileData.set_constant_linear_velocity: Sets the constant linear velocity. This does not move the tile. This linear velocity is applied to objects colliding with this tile. This is useful to create conveyor belts.
m.TileData.set_custom_data: Sets the tile's custom data value for the TileSet custom data layer with name layer_name.
m.TileData.set_custom_data_by_layer_id: Sets the tile's custom data value for the TileSet custom data layer with index layer_id.
m.TileData.set_navigation_polygon: Sets the navigation polygon for the TileSet navigation layer with index layer_id.
m.TileData.set_occluder_polygon: Sets the occluder for polygon with index polygon_index in the TileSet occlusion layer with index layer_id.
m.TileData.set_occluder_polygons_count: Sets the occluder polygon count in the TileSet occlusion layer with index layer_id.
m.TileData.set_terrain_peering_bit: Sets the tile's terrain bit for the given peering_bit direction. To check that a direction is valid, use is_valid_terrain_peering_bit().
m.TileData.terrain: ID of the terrain from the terrain set that the tile uses.
m.TileData.terrain_set: ID of the terrain set that the tile uses.
m.TileData.texture_origin: Offsets the position of where the tile is drawn.
m.TileData.transpose: If true, the tile will display transposed, i.e. with horizontal and vertical texture UVs swapped.
m.TileData.y_sort_origin: Vertical point of the tile used for determining y-sorted order.
m.TileData.z_index: Ordering index of this tile, relative to TileMapLayer.
m.TileMap.VISIBILITY_MODE_DEFAULT: Use the debug settings to determine visibility.
m.TileMap._tile_data_runtime_update: Called with a TileData object about to be used internally by the TileMap, allowing its modification at runtime.
m.TileMap._use_tile_data_runtime_update: Should return true if the tile at coordinates coords on layer layer requires a runtime update.
m.TileMap.add_layer: Adds a layer at the given position to_position in the array. If to_position is negative, the position is counted from the end, with -1 adding the layer at the end of the array.
m.TileMap.changed: Emitted when the TileSet of this TileMap changes.
m.TileMap.clear_layer: Clears all cells on the given layer.
m.TileMap.collision_animatable: If enabled, the TileMap will see its collisions synced to the physics tick and change its collision type from static to kinematic. This is required to create TileMap-based moving platform.
m.TileMap.collision_visibility_mode: Show or hide the TileMap's collision shapes. If set to VISIBILITY_MODE_DEFAULT, this depends on the show collision debug settings.
m.TileMap.erase_cell: Erases the cell on layer layer at coordinates coords.
m.TileMap.fix_invalid_tiles: Clears cells that do not exist in the tileset.
m.TileMap.force_update: Deprecated: Use notify_runtime_tile_data_update() and/or update_internals() instead.
m.TileMap.get_cell_alternative_tile: Returns the tile alternative ID of the cell on layer layer at coords.
m.TileMap.get_cell_atlas_coords: Returns the tile atlas coordinates ID of the cell on layer layer at coordinates coords. Returns Vector2i(-1, -1) if the cell does not exist.
m.TileMap.get_cell_source_id: Returns the tile source ID of the cell on layer layer at coordinates coords. Returns -1 if the cell does not exist.
m.TileMap.get_cell_tile_data: Returns the TileData object associated with the given cell, or null if the cell does not exist or is not a TileSetAtlasSource.
m.TileMap.get_coords_for_body_rid: Returns the coordinates of the tile for given physics body RID. Such RID can be retrieved from KinematicCollision2D.get_collider_rid(), when colliding with a tile.
m.TileMap.get_layer_for_body_rid: Returns the tilemap layer of the tile for given physics body RID. Such RID can be retrieved from KinematicCollision2D.get_collider_rid(), when colliding with a tile.
m.TileMap.get_layer_navigation_map: Returns the RID of the NavigationServer2D navigation map assigned to the specified TileMap layer layer.
m.TileMap.get_layer_y_sort_origin: Returns a TileMap layer's Y sort origin.
m.TileMap.get_layer_z_index: Returns a TileMap layer's Z-index value.
m.TileMap.get_layers_count: Returns the number of layers in the TileMap.
m.TileMap.get_neighbor_cell: Returns the neighboring cell to the one at coordinates coords, identified by the neighbor direction. This method takes into account the different layouts a TileMap can take.
m.TileMap.get_pattern: Creates a new TileMapPattern from the given layer and set of cells.
m.TileMap.get_surrounding_cells: Returns the list of all neighbourings cells to the one at coords.
m.TileMap.get_used_cells: Returns a Vector2i array with the positions of all cells containing a tile in the given layer. A cell is considered empty if its source identifier equals -1, its atlas coordinates identifiers is Vector2(-1, -1) and its alternative identifier is -1.
m.TileMap.get_used_cells_by_id: Returns a Vector2i array with the positions of all cells containing a tile in the given layer. Tiles may be filtered according to their source (source_id), their atlas coordinates (atlas_coords) or alternative id (alternative_tile).
m.TileMap.get_used_rect: Returns a rectangle enclosing the used (non-empty) tiles of the map, including all layers.
m.TileMap.is_cell_flipped_h: Returns true if the cell on layer layer at coordinates coords is flipped horizontally. The result is valid only for atlas sources.
m.TileMap.is_cell_flipped_v: Returns true if the cell on layer layer at coordinates coords is flipped vertically. The result is valid only for atlas sources.
m.TileMap.is_cell_transposed: Returns true if the cell on layer layer at coordinates coords is transposed. The result is valid only for atlas sources.
m.TileMap.is_layer_enabled: Returns if a layer is enabled.
m.TileMap.is_layer_navigation_enabled: Returns if a layer's built-in navigation regions generation is enabled.
m.TileMap.is_layer_y_sort_enabled: Returns if a layer Y-sorts its tiles.
m.TileMap.local_to_map: Returns the map coordinates of the cell containing the given local_position. If local_position is in global coordinates, consider using Node2D.to_local() before passing it to this method. See also map_to_local().
m.TileMap.map_pattern: Returns for the given coordinate coords_in_pattern in a TileMapPattern the corresponding cell coordinates if the pattern was pasted at the position_in_tilemap coordinates (see set_pattern()). This mapping is required as in half-offset tile shapes, the mapping might not work by calculating position_in_tile_map + coords_in_pattern.
m.TileMap.map_to_local: Returns the centered position of a cell in the TileMap's local coordinate space. To convert the returned value into global coordinates, use Node2D.to_global(). See also local_to_map().
m.TileMap.move_layer: Moves the layer at index layer to the given position to_position in the array.
m.TileMap.navigation_visibility_mode: Show or hide the TileMap's navigation meshes. If set to VISIBILITY_MODE_DEFAULT, this depends on the show navigation debug settings.
m.TileMap.notify_runtime_tile_data_update: Notifies the TileMap node that calls to _use_tile_data_runtime_update() or _tile_data_runtime_update() will lead to different results. This will thus trigger a TileMap update.
m.TileMap.remove_layer: Removes the layer at index layer.
m.TileMap.rendering_quadrant_size: The TileMap's quadrant size. A quadrant is a group of tiles to be drawn together on a single canvas item, for optimization purposes. rendering_quadrant_size defines the length of a square's side, in the map's coordinate system, that forms the quadrant. Thus, the default quadrant size groups together 16 * 16 = 256 tiles.
m.TileMap.set_cell: Sets the tile identifiers for the cell on layer layer at coordinates coords. Each tile of the TileSet is identified using three parts:
m.TileMap.set_cells_terrain_connect: Update all the cells in the cells coordinates array so that they use the given terrain for the given terrain_set. If an updated cell has the same terrain as one of its neighboring cells, this function tries to join the two. This function might update neighboring tiles if needed to create correct terrain transitions.
m.TileMap.set_cells_terrain_path: Update all the cells in the path coordinates array so that they use the given terrain for the given terrain_set. The function will also connect two successive cell in the path with the same terrain. This function might update neighboring tiles if needed to create correct terrain transitions.
m.TileMap.set_layer_enabled: Enables or disables the layer layer. A disabled layer is not processed at all (no rendering, no physics, etc.).
m.TileMap.set_layer_modulate: Sets a layer's color. It will be multiplied by tile's color and TileMap's modulate.
m.TileMap.set_layer_name: Sets a layer's name. This is mostly useful in the editor.
m.TileMap.set_layer_navigation_enabled: Enables or disables a layer's built-in navigation regions generation. Disable this if you need to bake navigation regions from a TileMap using a NavigationRegion2D node.
m.TileMap.set_layer_navigation_map: Assigns map as a NavigationServer2D navigation map for the specified TileMap layer layer.
m.TileMap.set_layer_y_sort_enabled: Enables or disables a layer's Y-sorting. If a layer is Y-sorted, the layer will behave as a CanvasItem node where each of its tile gets Y-sorted.
m.TileMap.set_layer_y_sort_origin: Sets a layer's Y-sort origin value. This Y-sort origin value is added to each tile's Y-sort origin value.
m.TileMap.set_layer_z_index: Sets a layers Z-index value. This Z-index is added to each tile's Z-index value.
m.TileMap.set_pattern: Paste the given TileMapPattern at the given position and layer in the tile map.
m.TileMap.tile_set: The TileSet used by this TileMap. The textures, collisions, and additional behavior of all available tiles are stored here.
m.TileMap.update_internals: Triggers a direct update of the TileMap. Usually, calling this function is not needed, as TileMap node updates automatically when one of its properties or cells is modified.
m.TileMapLayer.DEBUG_VISIBILITY_MODE_DEFAU: Hide the collisions or navigation debug shapes in the editor, and use the debug settings to determine their visibility in game (i.e. SceneTree.debug_collisions_hint or SceneTree.debug_navigation_hint).
m.TileMapLayer.DEBUG_VISIBILITY_MODE_FORCE: Always hide the collisions or navigation debug shapes.
Always show the collisions or navigation debug shapes.
m.TileMapLayer._tile_data_runtime_update: Called with a TileData object about to be used internally by the TileMapLayer, allowing its modification at runtime.
m.TileMapLayer._update_cells: Called when this TileMapLayer's cells need an internal update. This update may be caused from individual cells being modified or by a change in the tile_set (causing all cells to be queued for an update). The first call to this function is always for initializing all the TileMapLayer's cells. coords contains the coordinates of all modified cells, roughly in the order they were modified. forced_cl…
m.TileMapLayer._use_tile_data_runtime_upda: Should return true if the tile at coordinates coords requires a runtime update.
m.TileMapLayer.changed: Emitted when this TileMapLayer's properties changes. This includes modified cells, properties, or changes made to its assigned TileSet.
m.TileMapLayer.collision_visibility_mode: Show or hide the TileMapLayer's collision shapes. If set to DEBUG_VISIBILITY_MODE_DEFAULT, this depends on the show collision debug settings.
m.TileMapLayer.enabled: If false, disables this TileMapLayer completely (rendering, collision, navigation, scene tiles, etc.)
m.TileMapLayer.erase_cell: Erases the cell at coordinates coords.
m.TileMapLayer.fix_invalid_tiles: Clears cells containing tiles that do not exist in the tile_set.
m.TileMapLayer.get_cell_alternative_tile: Returns the tile alternative ID of the cell at coordinates coords.
m.TileMapLayer.get_cell_atlas_coords: Returns the tile atlas coordinates ID of the cell at coordinates coords. Returns Vector2i(-1, -1) if the cell does not exist.
m.TileMapLayer.get_cell_source_id: Returns the tile source ID of the cell at coordinates coords. Returns -1 if the cell does not exist.
m.TileMapLayer.get_cell_tile_data: Returns the TileData object associated with the given cell, or null if the cell does not exist or is not a TileSetAtlasSource.
m.TileMapLayer.get_coords_for_body_rid: Returns the coordinates of the physics quadrant (see physics_quadrant_size) for given physics body RID. Such an RID can be retrieved from KinematicCollision2D.get_collider_rid(), when colliding with a tile.
m.TileMapLayer.get_navigation_map: Returns the RID of the NavigationServer2D navigation used by this TileMapLayer.
m.TileMapLayer.get_neighbor_cell: Returns the neighboring cell to the one at coordinates coords, identified by the neighbor direction. This method takes into account the different layouts a TileMap can take.
m.TileMapLayer.get_pattern: Creates and returns a new TileMapPattern from the given array of cells. See also set_pattern().
m.TileMapLayer.get_surrounding_cells: Returns the list of all neighboring cells to the one at coords. Any neighboring cell is one that is touching edges, so for a square cell 4 cells would be returned, for a hexagon 6 cells are returned.
m.TileMapLayer.get_used_cells: Returns a Vector2i array with the positions of all cells containing a tile. A cell is considered empty if its source identifier equals -1, its atlas coordinate identifier is Vector2(-1, -1) and its alternative identifier is -1.
m.TileMapLayer.get_used_cells_by_id: Returns a Vector2i array with the positions of all cells containing a tile. Tiles may be filtered according to their source (source_id), their atlas coordinates (atlas_coords), or alternative id (alternative_tile).
m.TileMapLayer.get_used_rect: Returns a rectangle enclosing the used (non-empty) tiles of the map.
m.TileMapLayer.has_body_rid: Returns whether the provided body RID belongs to one of this TileMapLayer's cells.
m.TileMapLayer.is_cell_flipped_h: Returns true if the cell at coordinates coords is flipped horizontally. The result is valid only for atlas sources.
m.TileMapLayer.is_cell_flipped_v: Returns true if the cell at coordinates coords is flipped vertically. The result is valid only for atlas sources.
m.TileMapLayer.is_cell_transposed: Returns true if the cell at coordinates coords is transposed. The result is valid only for atlas sources.
m.TileMapLayer.local_to_map: Returns the map coordinates of the cell containing the given local_position. If local_position is in global coordinates, consider using Node2D.to_local() before passing it to this method. See also map_to_local().
m.TileMapLayer.map_pattern: Returns for the given coordinates coords_in_pattern in a TileMapPattern the corresponding cell coordinates if the pattern was pasted at the position_in_tilemap coordinates (see set_pattern()). This mapping is required as in half-offset tile shapes, the mapping might not work by calculating position_in_tile_map + coords_in_pattern.
m.TileMapLayer.map_to_local: Returns the centered position of a cell in the TileMapLayer's local coordinate space. To convert the returned value into global coordinates, use Node2D.to_global(). See also local_to_map().
m.TileMapLayer.navigation_enabled: If true, navigation regions are enabled.
m.TileMapLayer.navigation_visibility_mode: Show or hide the TileMapLayer's navigation meshes. If set to DEBUG_VISIBILITY_MODE_DEFAULT, this depends on the show navigation debug settings.
m.TileMapLayer.notify_runtime_tile_data_up: Notifies the TileMapLayer node that calls to _use_tile_data_runtime_update() or _tile_data_runtime_update() will lead to different results. This will thus trigger a TileMapLayer update.
m.TileMapLayer.physics_quadrant_size: The TileMapLayer's physics quadrant size. Within a physics quadrant, cells with similar physics properties are grouped together and their collision shapes get merged. physics_quadrant_size defines the length of a square's side, in the map's coordinate system, that forms the quadrant. Thus, the default quadrant size groups together 16 * 16 = 256 tiles.
m.TileMapLayer.rendering_quadrant_size: The TileMapLayer's rendering quadrant size. A quadrant is a group of tiles to be drawn together on a single canvas item, for optimization purposes. rendering_quadrant_size defines the length of a square's side, in the map's coordinate system, that forms the quadrant. Thus, the default quadrant size groups together 16 * 16 = 256 tiles.
m.TileMapLayer.set_cell: Sets the tile identifiers for the cell at coordinates coords. Each tile of the TileSet is identified using three parts:
m.TileMapLayer.set_cells_terrain_connect: Update all the cells in the cells coordinates array so that they use the given terrain for the given terrain_set. If an updated cell has the same terrain as one of its neighboring cells, this function tries to join the two. This function might update neighboring tiles if needed to create correct terrain transitions.
m.TileMapLayer.set_cells_terrain_path: Update all the cells in the path coordinates array so that they use the given terrain for the given terrain_set. The function will also connect two successive cell in the path with the same terrain. This function might update neighboring tiles if needed to create correct terrain transitions.
m.TileMapLayer.set_navigation_map: Sets a custom map as a NavigationServer2D navigation map. If not set, uses the default World2D navigation map instead.
m.TileMapLayer.set_pattern: Pastes the TileMapPattern at the given position in the tile map. See also get_pattern().
m.TileMapLayer.tile_map_data: The raw tile map data as a byte array.
m.TileMapLayer.tile_set: The TileSet used by this layer. The textures, collisions, and additional behavior of all available tiles are stored here.
m.TileMapLayer.update_internals: Triggers a direct update of the TileMapLayer. Usually, calling this function is not needed, as TileMapLayer node updates automatically when one of its properties or cells is modified.
m.TileMapLayer.use_kinematic_bodies: If true, this TileMapLayer collision shapes will be instantiated as kinematic bodies. This can be needed for moving TileMapLayer nodes (i.e. moving platforms).
m.TileMapLayer.x_draw_order_reversed: If CanvasItem.y_sort_enabled is enabled, setting this to true will reverse the order the tiles are drawn on the X-axis.
m.TileMapLayer.y_sort_origin: This Y-sort origin value is added to each tile's Y-sort origin value. This allows, for example, to fake a different height level. This can be useful for top-down view games.
m.TileMapPattern.get_cell_alternative_tile: Returns the tile alternative ID of the cell at coords.
m.TileMapPattern.get_cell_atlas_coords: Returns the tile atlas coordinates ID of the cell at coords.
m.TileMapPattern.get_cell_source_id: Returns the tile source ID of the cell at coords.
m.TileMapPattern.get_size: Returns the size, in cells, of the pattern.
m.TileMapPattern.get_used_cells: Returns the list of used cell coordinates in the pattern.
m.TileMapPattern.has_cell: Returns whether the pattern has a tile at the given coordinates.
m.TileMapPattern.is_empty: Returns whether the pattern is empty or not.
m.TileMapPattern.remove_cell: Remove the cell at the given coordinates.
m.TileMapPattern.set_cell: Sets the tile identifiers for the cell at coordinates coords. See TileMap.set_cell().
m.TileMapPattern.set_size: Sets the size of the pattern.
m.TileSet.CELL_NEIGHBOR_BOTTOM_LEFT_CORNER: Neighbor in the bottom left corner.
m.TileSet.CELL_NEIGHBOR_BOTTOM_LEFT_SIDE: Neighbor on the bottom left side.
m.TileSet.CELL_NEIGHBOR_BOTTOM_RIGHT_CORNE: Neighbor in the bottom right corner.
m.TileSet.CELL_NEIGHBOR_BOTTOM_RIGHT_SIDE: Neighbor on the bottom right side.
m.TileSet.CELL_NEIGHBOR_TOP_LEFT_CORNER: Neighbor in the top left corner.
m.TileSet.CELL_NEIGHBOR_TOP_LEFT_SIDE: Neighbor on the top left side.
m.TileSet.CELL_NEIGHBOR_TOP_RIGHT_CORNER: Neighbor in the top right corner.
m.TileSet.CELL_NEIGHBOR_TOP_RIGHT_SIDE: Neighbor on the top right side.
m.TileSet.TERRAIN_MODE_MATCH_CORNERS: Requires corners to match with neighboring tiles' terrains.
m.TileSet.TERRAIN_MODE_MATCH_CORNERS_AND_S: Requires both corners and side to match with neighboring tiles' terrains.
m.TileSet.TERRAIN_MODE_MATCH_SIDES: Requires sides to match with neighboring tiles' terrains.
m.TileSet.TILE_LAYOUT_DIAMOND_DOWN: Tile coordinates layout where the horizontal axis goes down-right, and the vertical one goes down-left.
m.TileSet.TILE_LAYOUT_DIAMOND_RIGHT: Tile coordinates layout where the horizontal axis goes up-right, and the vertical one goes down-right.
m.TileSet.TILE_LAYOUT_STACKED: Tile coordinates layout where both axis stay consistent with their respective local horizontal and vertical axis.
m.TileSet.TILE_LAYOUT_STACKED_OFFSET: Same as TILE_LAYOUT_STACKED, but the first half-offset is negative instead of positive.
m.TileSet.TILE_LAYOUT_STAIRS_DOWN: Tile coordinates layout where the vertical axis stay vertical, and the horizontal one goes down-right.
m.TileSet.TILE_LAYOUT_STAIRS_RIGHT: Tile coordinates layout where the horizontal axis stay horizontal, and the vertical one goes down-right.
m.TileSet.TILE_SHAPE_HALF_OFFSET_SQUARE: Rectangular tile shape with one row/column out of two offset by half a tile.
m.TileSet.add_custom_data_layer: Adds a custom data layer to the TileSet at the given position to_position in the array. If to_position is -1, adds it at the end of the array.
m.TileSet.add_navigation_layer: Adds a navigation layer to the TileSet at the given position to_position in the array. If to_position is -1, adds it at the end of the array.
m.TileSet.add_occlusion_layer: Adds an occlusion layer to the TileSet at the given position to_position in the array. If to_position is -1, adds it at the end of the array.
m.TileSet.add_pattern: Adds a TileMapPattern to be stored in the TileSet resource. If provided, insert it at the given index.
m.TileSet.add_physics_layer: Adds a physics layer to the TileSet at the given position to_position in the array. If to_position is -1, adds it at the end of the array.
m.TileSet.add_source: Adds a TileSetSource to the TileSet. If atlas_source_id_override is not -1, also set its source ID. Otherwise, a unique identifier is automatically generated.
m.TileSet.add_terrain: Adds a new terrain to the given terrain set terrain_set at the given position to_position in the array. If to_position is -1, adds it at the end of the array.
m.TileSet.add_terrain_set: Adds a new terrain set at the given position to_position in the array. If to_position is -1, adds it at the end of the array.
m.TileSet.cleanup_invalid_tile_proxies: Clears tile proxies pointing to invalid tiles.
m.TileSet.clear_terrains: Clears all terrain properties for the given terrain set.
m.TileSet.get_alternative_level_tile_proxy: Returns the alternative-level proxy for the given identifiers. The returned array contains the three proxie's target identifiers (source ID, atlas coords ID and alternative tile ID).
m.TileSet.get_coords_level_tile_proxy: Returns the coordinate-level proxy for the given identifiers. The returned array contains the two target identifiers of the proxy (source ID and atlas coordinates ID).
m.TileSet.get_custom_data_layer_by_name: Returns the index of the custom data layer identified by the given name.
m.TileSet.get_custom_data_layer_name: Returns the name of the custom data layer identified by the given index.
m.TileSet.get_custom_data_layer_type: Returns the type of the custom data layer identified by the given index.
m.TileSet.get_custom_data_layers_count: Returns the custom data layers count.
m.TileSet.get_navigation_layer_layer_value: Returns whether or not the specified navigation layer of the TileSet navigation data layer identified by the given layer_index is enabled, given a navigation_layers layer_number between 1 and 32.
m.TileSet.get_navigation_layer_layers: Returns the navigation layers (as in the Navigation server) of the given TileSet navigation layer.
m.TileSet.get_next_source_id: Returns a new unused source ID. This generated ID is the same that a call to add_source() would return.
m.TileSet.get_occlusion_layer_light_mask: Returns the light mask of the occlusion layer.
m.TileSet.get_occlusion_layer_sdf_collisio: Returns if the occluders from this layer use sdf_collision.
m.TileSet.get_pattern: Returns the TileMapPattern at the given index.
m.TileSet.get_patterns_count: Returns the number of TileMapPattern this tile set handles.
m.TileSet.get_physics_layer_collision_laye: Returns the collision layer (as in the physics server) bodies on the given TileSet's physics layer are in.
m.TileSet.get_physics_layer_collision_mask: Returns the collision mask of bodies on the given TileSet's physics layer.
m.TileSet.get_physics_layer_collision_prio: Returns the collision priority of bodies on the given TileSet's physics layer.
m.TileSet.get_physics_layer_physics_materi: Returns the physics material of bodies on the given TileSet's physics layer.
m.TileSet.get_source: Returns the TileSetSource with ID source_id.
m.TileSet.get_source_count: Returns the number of TileSetSource in this TileSet.
m.TileSet.get_source_id: Returns the source ID for source with index index.
m.TileSet.get_source_level_tile_proxy: Returns the source-level proxy for the given source identifier.
m.TileSet.get_terrains_count: Returns the number of terrains in the given terrain set.
m.TileSet.has_alternative_level_tile_proxy: Returns if there is an alternative-level proxy for the given identifiers.
m.TileSet.has_coords_level_tile_proxy: Returns if there is a coodinates-level proxy for the given identifiers.
m.TileSet.has_custom_data_layer_by_name: Returns if there is a custom data layer named layer_name.
m.TileSet.has_source: Returns if this TileSet has a source for the given source ID.
m.TileSet.has_source_level_tile_proxy: Returns if there is a source-level proxy for the given source ID.
m.TileSet.map_tile_proxy: According to the configured proxies, maps the provided identifiers to a new set of identifiers. The source ID, atlas coordinates ID and alternative tile ID are returned as a 3 elements Array.
m.TileSet.move_custom_data_layer: Moves the custom data layer at index layer_index to the given position to_position in the array. Also updates the atlas tiles accordingly.
m.TileSet.move_navigation_layer: Moves the navigation layer at index layer_index to the given position to_position in the array. Also updates the atlas tiles accordingly.
