m.Window.hdr_output_requested: If true, requests HDR output for the Window, falling back to SDR if not supported, and automatically switching between HDR and SDR as the window moves between screens, screen capabilities change, or system settings are modified. This will internally force Viewport.use_hdr_2d to be enabled on the main Viewport. All other SubViewport of this Window must have their Viewport.use_hdr_2d property enabl…
m.Window.hide: Hides the window. This is not the same as minimized state. Hidden window can't be interacted with and needs to be made visible with show().
m.Window.initial_position: Specifies the initial type of position for the Window.
m.Window.is_embedded: Returns true if the window is currently embedded in another window.
m.Window.is_layout_rtl: Returns true if the layout is right-to-left.
m.Window.is_maximize_allowed: Returns true if the window can be maximized (the maximize button is enabled).
m.Window.is_using_font_oversampling: Returns true if font oversampling is enabled. See set_use_font_oversampling().
m.Window.keep_title_visible: If true, the Window width is expanded to keep the title bar text fully visible.
m.Window.max_size: If non-zero, the Window can't be resized to be bigger than this size.
m.Window.maximize_disabled: If true, the Window's maximize button is disabled.
m.Window.min_size: If non-zero, the Window can't be resized to be smaller than this size.
m.Window.minimize_disabled: If true, the Window's minimize button is disabled.
m.Window.mouse_entered: Emitted when the mouse cursor enters the Window's visible area, that is not occluded behind other Controls or windows, provided its Viewport.gui_disable_input is false and regardless if it's currently focused or not.
m.Window.mouse_exited: Emitted when the mouse cursor leaves the Window's visible area, that is not occluded behind other Controls or windows, provided its Viewport.gui_disable_input is false and regardless if it's currently focused or not.
m.Window.mouse_passthrough: If true, all mouse events will be passed to the underlying window of the same application. See also mouse_passthrough_polygon.
m.Window.mouse_passthrough_polygon: Sets a polygonal region of the window which accepts mouse events. Mouse events outside the region will be passed through.
m.Window.move_to_center: Centers the window in the current screen. If the window is embedded, it is centered in the embedder Viewport instead.
m.Window.nonclient_area: If set, defines the window's custom decoration area which will receive mouse input, even if normal input to the window is blocked (such as when it has an exclusive child opened). See also nonclient_window_input.
m.Window.nonclient_window_input: Emitted when the mouse event is received by the custom decoration area defined by nonclient_area, and normal input to the window is blocked (such as when it has an exclusive child opened). event's position is in the embedder's coordinate system.
m.Window.output_max_linear_value_changed: Emitted when the output max linear value returned by get_output_max_linear_value() has changed. This occurs when HDR output is enabled or disabled and when any HDR output luminance values of the window have changed, such as when the player adjusts their screen brightness setting or moves the window to a different screen. output_max_linear_value is the new value.
m.Window.popup: Shows the Window and makes it transient (see transient). If rect is provided, it will be set as the Window's size. Fails if called on the main window.
m.Window.popup_centered: Popups the Window at the center of the current screen, with optionally given minimum size. If the Window is embedded, it will be centered in the parent Viewport instead.
m.Window.popup_centered_clamped: Popups the Window centered inside its parent Window. fallback_ratio determines the maximum size of the Window, in relation to its parent.
m.Window.popup_centered_ratio: If Window is embedded, popups the Window centered inside its embedder and sets its size as a ratio of embedder's size.
m.Window.popup_exclusive: Attempts to parent this dialog to the last exclusive window relative to from_node, and then calls popup() on it. The dialog must have no current parent, otherwise the method fails.
m.Window.popup_exclusive_centered: Attempts to parent this dialog to the last exclusive window relative to from_node, and then calls popup_centered() on it. The dialog must have no current parent, otherwise the method fails.
m.Window.popup_exclusive_centered_clamped: Attempts to parent this dialog to the last exclusive window relative to from_node, and then calls popup_centered_clamped() on it. The dialog must have no current parent, otherwise the method fails.
m.Window.popup_exclusive_centered_ratio: Attempts to parent this dialog to the last exclusive window relative to from_node, and then calls popup_centered_ratio() on it. The dialog must have no current parent, otherwise the method fails.
m.Window.popup_exclusive_on_parent: Attempts to parent this dialog to the last exclusive window relative to from_node, and then calls popup_on_parent() on it. The dialog must have no current parent, otherwise the method fails.
m.Window.popup_on_parent: Popups the Window with a position shifted by parent Window's position. If the Window is embedded, has the same effect as popup().
m.Window.popup_window: If true, the Window will be considered a popup. Popups are sub-windows that don't show as separate windows in system's window manager's window list and will send close request when anything is clicked outside of them (unless exclusive is enabled).
m.Window.popup_wm_hint: If true, the Window will signal to the window manager that it is supposed to be an implementation-defined "popup" (usually a floating, borderless, untileable and immovable child window).
m.Window.remove_theme_color_override: Removes a local override for a theme Color with the specified name previously added by add_theme_color_override() or via the Inspector dock.
m.Window.remove_theme_constant_override: Removes a local override for a theme constant with the specified name previously added by add_theme_constant_override() or via the Inspector dock.
m.Window.remove_theme_font_override: Removes a local override for a theme Font with the specified name previously added by add_theme_font_override() or via the Inspector dock.
m.Window.remove_theme_font_size_override: Removes a local override for a theme font size with the specified name previously added by add_theme_font_size_override() or via the Inspector dock.
m.Window.remove_theme_icon_override: Removes a local override for a theme icon with the specified name previously added by add_theme_icon_override() or via the Inspector dock.
m.Window.remove_theme_stylebox_override: Removes a local override for a theme StyleBox with the specified name previously added by add_theme_stylebox_override() or via the Inspector dock.
m.Window.request_attention: Tells the OS that the Window needs an attention. This makes the window stand out in some way depending on the system, e.g. it might blink on the task bar.
m.Window.reset_size: Resets the size to the minimum size, which is the max of min_size and (if wrap_controls is enabled) get_contents_minimum_size(). This is equivalent to calling set_size(Vector2i()) (or any size below the minimum).
m.Window.set_ime_active: If active is true, enables system's native IME (Input Method Editor).
m.Window.set_ime_position: Moves IME to the given position.
m.Window.set_layout_direction: Sets layout direction and text writing direction. Right-to-left layouts are necessary for certain languages (e.g. Arabic and Hebrew).
m.Window.set_taskbar_progress_state: Sets the type and state of the progress bar on the taskbar/dock icon of the Window. See ProgressState for possible values and how each mode behaves.
m.Window.set_taskbar_progress_value: Creates a progress bar on the taskbar/dock icon of the Window if it does not exist, sets the progress of the icon.
m.Window.set_unparent_when_invisible: If unparent is true, the window is automatically unparented when going invisible.
m.Window.set_use_font_oversampling: Enables font oversampling. This makes fonts look better when they are scaled up.
m.Window.sharp_corners: If true, the Window will override the OS window style to display sharp corners.
m.Window.show: Makes the Window appear. This enables interactions with the Window and doesn't change any of its property other than visibility (unlike e.g. popup()).
m.Window.size: The window's size in pixels. See also content_scale_size, which doesn't set the window's physical size but affects how scaling works relative to the current content_scale_mode.
m.Window.start_drag: Starts an interactive drag operation on the window, using the current mouse position. Call this method when handling a mouse button being pressed to simulate a pressed event on the window's title bar. Using this method allows the window to participate in space switching, tiling, and other system features.
m.Window.start_resize: Starts an interactive resize operation on the window, using the current mouse position. Call this method when handling a mouse button being pressed to simulate a pressed event on the window's edge.
m.Window.theme: The Theme resource this node and all its Control and Window children use. If a child node has its own Theme resource set, theme items are merged with child's definitions having higher priority.
m.Window.theme_changed: Emitted when the NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED notification is sent.
m.Window.theme_type_variation: The name of a theme type variation used by this Window to look up its own theme items. See Control.theme_type_variation for more details.
m.Window.title: The window's title. If the Window is native, title styles set in Theme will have no effect.
m.Window.title_changed: Emitted when window title bar text is changed.
m.Window.titlebar_changed: Emitted when window title bar decorations are changed, e.g. macOS window enter/exit full screen mode, or extend-to-title flag is changed.
m.Window.transient: If true, the Window is transient, i.e. it's considered a child of another Window. The transient window will be destroyed with its transient parent and will return focus to their parent when closed. The transient window is displayed on top of a non-exclusive full-screen parent window. Transient windows can't enter full-screen mode.
m.Window.transient_to_focused: If true, and the Window is transient, this window will (at the time of becoming visible) become transient to the currently focused window instead of the immediate parent window in the hierarchy. Note that the transient parent is assigned at the time this window becomes visible, so changing it afterwards has no effect until re-shown.
m.Window.transparent: If true, the Window's background can be transparent. This is best used with embedded windows.
m.Window.unfocusable: If true, the Window can't be focused nor interacted with. It can still be visible.
m.Window.unresizable: If true, the window can't be resized.
m.Window.visibility_changed: Emitted when Window is made visible or disappears.
m.Window.visible: If true, the window is visible.
m.Window.window_input: Emitted when the Window is currently focused and receives any input, passing the received event as an argument. The event's position, if present, is in the embedder's coordinate system.
m.Window.wrap_controls: If true, the window's size will automatically update when a child node is added or removed, ignoring min_size if the new size is bigger.
m.WorkerThreadPool.add_group_task: Adds action as a group task to be executed by the worker threads. The Callable will be called a number of times based on elements, with the first thread calling it with the value 0 as a parameter, and each consecutive execution incrementing this value by 1 until it reaches element - 1.
m.WorkerThreadPool.add_task: Adds action as a task to be executed by a worker thread. high_priority determines if the task has a high priority or a low priority (default). You can optionally provide a description to help with debugging.
m.WorkerThreadPool.get_caller_group_id: Returns the task group ID of the current thread calling this method, or -1 if invalid or the current thread is not part of a task group.
m.WorkerThreadPool.get_caller_task_id: Returns the task ID of the current thread calling this method, or -1 if the task is a group task, invalid or the current thread is not part of the thread pool (e.g. the main thread).
m.WorkerThreadPool.get_group_processed_ele: Returns how many times the Callable of the group task with the given ID has already been executed by the worker threads.
m.WorkerThreadPool.is_group_task_completed: Returns true if the group task with the given ID is completed.
m.WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed: Returns true if the task with the given ID is completed.
m.WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_group_task_com: Pauses the thread that calls this method until the group task with the given ID is completed.
m.WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completio: Pauses the thread that calls this method until the task with the given ID is completed.
m.World2D.canvas: The RID of this world's canvas resource. Used by the RenderingServer for 2D drawing.
m.World2D.direct_space_state: Direct access to the world's physics 2D space state. Used for querying current and potential collisions. When using multi-threaded physics, access is limited to Node._physics_process() in the main thread.
m.World2D.navigation_map: The RID of this world's navigation map. Used by the NavigationServer2D.
m.World2D.space: The RID of this world's physics space resource. Used by the PhysicsServer2D for 2D physics, treating it as both a space and an area.
m.World3D.camera_attributes: The default CameraAttributes resource to use if none set on the Camera3D.
m.World3D.direct_space_state: Direct access to the world's physics 3D space state. Used for querying current and potential collisions. When using multi-threaded physics, access is limited to Node._physics_process() in the main thread.
m.World3D.fallback_environment: The World3D's fallback environment will be used if environment fails or is missing.
m.World3D.navigation_map: The RID of this world's navigation map. Used by the NavigationServer3D.
m.WorldBoundaryShape2D.distance: The distance from the origin to the line, expressed in terms of normal (according to its direction and magnitude). Actual absolute distance from the origin to the line can be calculated as abs(distance) / normal.length().
m.WorldBoundaryShape2D.normal: The line's normal, typically a unit vector. Its direction indicates the non-colliding half-plane. Can be of any length but zero. Defaults to Vector2.UP.
m.WorldBoundaryShape3D.plane: The Plane used by the WorldBoundaryShape3D for collision.
m.WorldEnvironment.camera_attributes: The default CameraAttributes resource to use if none set on the Camera3D.
m.WorldEnvironment.compositor: The default Compositor resource to use if none set on the Camera3D.
m.WorldEnvironment.environment: The Environment resource used by this WorldEnvironment, defining the default properties.
m.X509Certificate.load: Loads a certificate from path ("*.crt" file).
m.X509Certificate.load_from_string: Loads a certificate from the given string.
m.X509Certificate.save: Saves a certificate to the given path (should be a "*.crt" file).
m.X509Certificate.save_to_string: Returns a string representation of the certificate, or an empty string if the certificate is invalid.
m.XMLParser.NODE_CDATA: A node type for CDATA (Character Data) sections, e.g. <![CDATA[CDATA section]]>.
m.XMLParser.NODE_COMMENT: A comment node type, e.g. <!--A comment-->.
m.XMLParser.NODE_ELEMENT: An element node type, also known as a tag, e.g. .
m.XMLParser.NODE_ELEMENT_END: An end of element node type, e.g. .
m.XMLParser.NODE_NONE: There's no node (no file or buffer opened).
m.XMLParser.NODE_TEXT: A text node type, i.e. text that is not inside an element. This includes whitespace.
m.XMLParser.get_attribute_count: Returns the number of attributes in the currently parsed element.
m.XMLParser.get_attribute_name: Returns the name of an attribute of the currently parsed element, specified by the idx index.
m.XMLParser.get_attribute_value: Returns the value of an attribute of the currently parsed element, specified by the idx index.
m.XMLParser.get_current_line: Returns the current line in the parsed file, counting from 0.
m.XMLParser.get_named_attribute_value: Returns the value of an attribute of the currently parsed element, specified by its name. This method will raise an error if the element has no such attribute.
m.XMLParser.get_named_attribute_value_safe: Returns the value of an attribute of the currently parsed element, specified by its name. This method will return an empty string if the element has no such attribute.
m.XMLParser.get_node_data: Returns the contents of a text node. This method will raise an error if the current parsed node is of any other type.
m.XMLParser.get_node_name: Returns the name of a node. This method will raise an error if the currently parsed node is a text node.
m.XMLParser.get_node_offset: Returns the byte offset of the currently parsed node since the beginning of the file or buffer. This is usually equivalent to the number of characters before the read position.
m.XMLParser.get_node_type: Returns the type of the current node. Compare with NodeType constants.
m.XMLParser.has_attribute: Returns true if the currently parsed element has an attribute with the name.
m.XMLParser.is_empty: Returns true if the currently parsed element is empty, e.g. .
m.XMLParser.open: Opens an XML file for parsing. This method returns an error code.
m.XMLParser.open_buffer: Opens an XML raw buffer for parsing. This method returns an error code.
m.XMLParser.read: Parses the next node in the file. This method returns an error code.
m.XMLParser.seek: Moves the buffer cursor to a certain offset (since the beginning) and reads the next node there. This method returns an error code.
m.XMLParser.skip_section: Skips the current section. If the currently parsed node contains more inner nodes, they will be ignored and the cursor will go to the closing of the current element.
m.XRAnchor3D.get_plane: Returns a plane aligned with our anchor; handy for intersection testing.
m.XRAnchor3D.get_size: Returns the estimated size of the plane that was detected. Say when the anchor relates to a table in the real world, this is the estimated size of the surface of that table.
m.XRBodyModifier3D.BONE_UPDATE_FULL: The skeleton's bones are fully updated (both position and rotation) to match the tracked bones.
m.XRBodyModifier3D.BONE_UPDATE_MAX: Represents the size of the BoneUpdate enum.
m.XRBodyModifier3D.BONE_UPDATE_ROTATION_ON: The skeleton's bones are only rotated to align with the tracked bones, preserving bone length.
m.XRBodyModifier3D.body_tracker: The name of the XRBodyTracker registered with XRServer to obtain the body tracking data from.
m.XRBodyModifier3D.body_update: Specifies the body parts to update.
m.XRBodyModifier3D.bone_update: Specifies the type of updates to perform on the bones.
m.XRBodyTracker.JOINT_FLAG_ORIENTATION_TRA: The joint's orientation is actively tracked. May not be set if tracking has been temporarily lost.
m.XRBodyTracker.JOINT_FLAG_ORIENTATION_VAL: The joint's orientation data is valid.
m.XRBodyTracker.JOINT_FLAG_POSITION_TRACKE: The joint's position is actively tracked. May not be set if tracking has been temporarily lost.
m.XRBodyTracker.JOINT_FLAG_POSITION_VALID: The joint's position data is valid.
m.XRBodyTracker.JOINT_LEFT_INDEX_FINGER_PH: Left index finger phalanx distal joint.
Left index finger phalanx intermediate joint.
Left index finger phalanx proximal joint.
m.XRBodyTracker.JOINT_LEFT_MIDDLE_FINGER_P: Left middle finger phalanx distal joint.
Left middle finger phalanx intermediate joint.
Left middle finger phalanx proximal joint.
m.XRBodyTracker.JOINT_LEFT_PINKY_FINGER_PH: Left pinky finger phalanx distal joint.
Left pinky finger phalanx intermediate joint.
Left pinky finger phalanx proximal joint.
m.XRBodyTracker.JOINT_LEFT_RING_FINGER_PHA: Left ring finger phalanx distal joint.
Left ring finger phalanx intermediate joint.
Left ring finger phalanx proximal joint.
m.XRBodyTracker.JOINT_MAX: Represents the size of the Joint enum.
m.XRBodyTracker.JOINT_RIGHT_INDEX_FINGER_P: Right index finger phalanx distal joint.
Right index finger phalanx intermediate joint.
Right index finger phalanx proximal joint.
m.XRBodyTracker.JOINT_RIGHT_MIDDLE_FINGER_: Right middle finger phalanx distal joint.
Right middle finger phalanx intermediate joint.
Right middle finger phalanx proximal joint.
m.XRBodyTracker.JOINT_RIGHT_PINKY_FINGER_P: Right pinky finger phalanx distal joint.
Right pinky finger phalanx intermediate joint.
Right pinky finger phalanx proximal joint.
m.XRBodyTracker.JOINT_RIGHT_RING_FINGER_PH: Right ring finger phalanx distal joint.
Right ring finger phalanx intermediate joint.
Right ring finger phalanx proximal joint.
m.XRBodyTracker.body_flags: The type of body tracking data captured.
m.XRBodyTracker.get_joint_flags: Returns flags about the validity of the tracking data for the given body joint.
m.XRBodyTracker.get_joint_transform: Returns the transform for the given body joint.
m.XRBodyTracker.has_tracking_data: If true, the body tracking data is valid.
m.XRBodyTracker.set_joint_flags: Sets flags about the validity of the tracking data for the given body joint.
m.XRBodyTracker.set_joint_transform: Sets the transform for the given body joint.
m.XRController3D.button_pressed: Emitted when a button on this controller is pressed.
m.XRController3D.button_released: Emitted when a button on this controller is released.
m.XRController3D.get_float: Returns a numeric value for the input with the given name. This is used for triggers and grip sensors.
m.XRController3D.get_input: Returns a Variant for the input with the given name. This works for any input type, the variant will be typed according to the actions configuration.
m.XRController3D.get_tracker_hand: Returns the hand holding this controller, if known.
m.XRController3D.get_vector2: Returns a Vector2 for the input with the given name. This is used for thumbsticks and thumbpads found on many controllers.
m.XRController3D.input_float_changed: Emitted when a trigger or similar input on this controller changes value.
m.XRController3D.input_vector2_changed: Emitted when a thumbstick or thumbpad on this controller is moved.
m.XRController3D.is_button_pressed: Returns true if the button with the given name is pressed.
m.XRController3D.profile_changed: Emitted when the interaction profile on this controller is changed.
m.XRFaceModifier3D.target: The NodePath of the face MeshInstance3D.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_BROW_DOWN: Pulls both eyebrows down and in.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_BROW_DOWN_LEFT: Pulls the left eyebrow down and in.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_BROW_DOWN_RIGHT: Pulls the right eyebrow down and in.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_CHEEK_SUCK_LEFT: Sucks in the left side cheek.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_CHEEK_SUCK_RIGHT: Sucks in the right side cheek.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_EYE_SQUINT_LEFT: Squeezes the left eye socket muscles.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_EYE_SQUINT_RIGHT: Squeezes the right eye socket muscles.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_LIP_FUNNEL_LOWER_LEFT: Lower left lip part pushes into a funnel.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_LIP_FUNNEL_LOWER_RIGHT: Lower right lip part pushes into a funnel.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_LIP_FUNNEL_UPPER_LEFT: Upper left lip part pushes into a funnel.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_LIP_FUNNEL_UPPER_RIGHT: Upper right lip part pushes into a funnel.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_LIP_PUCKER_LOWER_LEFT: Lower left lip part pushes outwards.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_LIP_PUCKER_LOWER_RIGHT: Lower right lip part pushes outwards.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_LIP_PUCKER_UPPER_LEFT: Upper left lip part pushes outwards.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_LIP_PUCKER_UPPER_RIGHT: Upper right lip part pushes outwards.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_LIP_SUCK_CORNER_LEFT: Left lip corner folds into the mouth.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_LIP_SUCK_CORNER_RIGHT: Right lip corner folds into the mouth.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_LIP_SUCK_LOWER_LEFT: Lower left lip part tucks in the mouth.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_LIP_SUCK_LOWER_RIGHT: Lower right lip part tucks in the mouth.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_LIP_SUCK_UPPER_LEFT: Upper left lip part tucks in the mouth.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_LIP_SUCK_UPPER_RIGHT: Upper right lip part tucks in the mouth.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MAX: Represents the size of the BlendShapeEntry enum.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_CORNER_PULL_LEFT: Left lip corner pulls diagonally up and out.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_CORNER_PULL_RIGHT: Right lip corner pulls diagonally up and out.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_DIMPLE_LEFT: Left lip corner is pushed backwards.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_DIMPLE_RIGHT: Right lip corner is pushed backwards.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_LOWER_DOWN_LEFT: Lower left part of the lip pulls up.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_LOWER_DOWN_RIGHT: Lower right part of the lip pulls up.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_PRESS_LEFT: Left side lips press and flatten together vertically.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_PRESS_RIGHT: Right side lips press and flatten together vertically.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_RAISER_LOWER: Raises and slightly pushes out the lower mouth.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_RAISER_UPPER: Raises and slightly pushes out the upper mouth.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_SAD_LEFT: Left side of the mouth expresses sadness.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_SAD_RIGHT: Right side of the mouth expresses sadness.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_SMILE_LEFT: Left side of the mouth smiles.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_SMILE_RIGHT: Right side of the mouth smiles.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_STRETCH_LEFT: Mouth corner lip pulls out and down.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_STRETCH_RIGHT: Mouth corner lip pulls out and down.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_TIGHTENER_LEFT: Left side lips squeeze together horizontally.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_TIGHTENER_RIGHT: Right side lips squeeze together horizontally.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_UPPER_DEEPEN_LEFT: Upper left lip part pushes in the cheek.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_UPPER_DEEPEN_RIGH: Upper right lip part pushes in the cheek.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_UPPER_UP_LEFT: Upper left part of the lip pulls up.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_MOUTH_UPPER_UP_RIGHT: Upper right part of the lip pulls up.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_TONGUE_BLEND_DOWN: Tongue arches up then down inside the mouth.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_TONGUE_CURL_UP: Tongue arches down then up inside the mouth.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_TONGUE_OUT: Tongue visibly sticks out of the mouth.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_TONGUE_ROLL: Sides of the tongue funnel, creating a roll.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_TONGUE_TWIST_LEFT: Tongue tip rotates counter-clockwise, with the rest following gradually.
m.XRFaceTracker.FT_TONGUE_TWIST_RIGHT: Tongue tip rotates clockwise, with the rest following gradually.

m.XRFaceTracker.get_blend_shape: Returns the requested face blend shape weight.
m.XRFaceTracker.set_blend_shape: Sets a face blend shape weight.
m.XRHandModifier3D.BONE_UPDATE_FULL: The skeleton's bones are fully updated (both position and rotation) to match the tracked bones.
m.XRHandModifier3D.BONE_UPDATE_MAX: Represents the size of the BoneUpdate enum.
m.XRHandModifier3D.BONE_UPDATE_ROTATION_ON: The skeleton's bones are only rotated to align with the tracked bones, preserving bone length.
m.XRHandModifier3D.bone_update: Specifies the type of updates to perform on the bones.
m.XRHandModifier3D.hand_tracker: The name of the XRHandTracker registered with XRServer to obtain the hand tracking data from.
m.XRHandTracker.HAND_JOINT_FLAG_ANGULAR_VE: The hand joint's angular velocity data is valid.
m.XRHandTracker.HAND_JOINT_FLAG_LINEAR_VEL: The hand joint's linear velocity data is valid.
m.XRHandTracker.HAND_JOINT_FLAG_ORIENTATIO: The hand joint's orientation is actively tracked. May not be set if tracking has been temporarily lost.

m.XRHandTracker.HAND_JOINT_FLAG_POSITION_T: The hand joint's position is actively tracked. May not be set if tracking has been temporarily lost.
m.XRHandTracker.HAND_JOINT_FLAG_POSITION_V: The hand joint's position data is valid.
m.XRHandTracker.HAND_JOINT_MAX: Represents the size of the HandJoint enum.
m.XRHandTracker.HAND_TRACKING_SOURCE_CONTR: The source of hand tracking data is a controller, meaning that joint positions are inferred from controller inputs.
m.XRHandTracker.HAND_TRACKING_SOURCE_MAX: Represents the size of the HandTrackingSource enum.

m.XRHandTracker.HAND_TRACKING_SOURCE_UNKNO: The source of hand tracking data is unknown.
m.XRHandTracker.HAND_TRACKING_SOURCE_UNOBS: The source of hand tracking data is unobstructed, meaning that an accurate method of hand tracking is used. These include optical hand tracking, data gloves, etc.
m.XRHandTracker.get_hand_joint_angular_vel: Returns the angular velocity for the given hand joint.
m.XRHandTracker.get_hand_joint_flags: Returns flags about the validity of the tracking data for the given hand joint.
m.XRHandTracker.get_hand_joint_linear_velo: Returns the linear velocity for the given hand joint.
m.XRHandTracker.get_hand_joint_radius: Returns the radius of the given hand joint.
m.XRHandTracker.get_hand_joint_transform: Returns the transform for the given hand joint.
m.XRHandTracker.hand_tracking_source: The source of the hand tracking data.
m.XRHandTracker.has_tracking_data: If true, the hand tracking data is valid.
m.XRHandTracker.set_hand_joint_angular_vel: Sets the angular velocity for the given hand joint.
m.XRHandTracker.set_hand_joint_flags: Sets flags about the validity of the tracking data for the given hand joint.
m.XRHandTracker.set_hand_joint_linear_velo: Sets the linear velocity for the given hand joint.
m.XRHandTracker.set_hand_joint_radius: Sets the radius of the given hand joint.
m.XRHandTracker.set_hand_joint_transform: Sets the transform for the given hand joint.
m.XRInterface.XR_AR: This interface supports AR (video background and real world tracking).
m.XRInterface.XR_ENV_BLEND_MODE_ADDITIVE: Additive blend mode. This is typically used for AR devices or VR devices with passthrough.
m.XRInterface.XR_ENV_BLEND_MODE_ALPHA_BLEN: Alpha blend mode. This is typically used for AR or VR devices with passthrough capabilities. The alpha channel controls how much of the passthrough is visible. Alpha of 0.0 means the passthrough is visible and this pixel works in ADDITIVE mode. Alpha of 1.0 means that the passthrough is not visible and this pixel works in OPAQUE mode.
m.XRInterface.XR_ENV_BLEND_MODE_OPAQUE: Opaque blend mode. This is typically used for VR devices.
m.XRInterface.XR_EXCESSIVE_MOTION: Tracking is hindered by excessive motion (the player is moving faster than tracking can keep up).
m.XRInterface.XR_EXTERNAL: This interface outputs to an external device. If the main viewport is used, the on screen output is an unmodified buffer of either the left or right eye (stretched if the viewport size is not changed to the same aspect ratio of get_render_target_size()). Using a separate viewport node frees up the main viewport for other purposes.
m.XRInterface.XR_INSUFFICIENT_FEATURES: Tracking is hindered by insufficient features, it's too dark (for camera-based tracking), player is blocked, etc.
m.XRInterface.XR_MONO: This interface can work with normal rendering output (non-HMD based AR).
m.XRInterface.XR_NOT_TRACKING: Tracking is not functional (camera not plugged in or obscured, lighthouses turned off, etc.).
m.XRInterface.XR_PLAY_AREA_3DOF: Play area only supports orientation tracking, no positional tracking, area will center around player.
m.XRInterface.XR_PLAY_AREA_CUSTOM: Custom play area set by a GDExtension.
m.XRInterface.XR_PLAY_AREA_ROOMSCALE: Player is free to move around, full positional tracking.
m.XRInterface.XR_PLAY_AREA_SITTING: Player is in seated position, limited positional tracking, fixed guardian around player.
m.XRInterface.XR_PLAY_AREA_STAGE: Same as XR_PLAY_AREA_ROOMSCALE but origin point is fixed to the center of the physical space. In this mode, system-level recentering may be disabled, requiring the use of XRServer.center_on_hmd().
m.XRInterface.XR_PLAY_AREA_UNKNOWN: Play area mode not set or not available.
m.XRInterface.XR_QUAD: This interface supports quad rendering (not yet supported by Godot).
m.XRInterface.XR_UNKNOWN_TRACKING: We don't know the status of the tracking or this interface does not provide feedback.
m.XRInterface.XR_VRS_TEXTURE_FORMAT_FRAGME: The texture format is the same as expected by the Vulkan VK_EXT_fragment_density_map extension.
The texture format is the same as expected by the Vulkan VK_KHR_fragment_shading_rate extension.
m.XRInterface.XR_VRS_TEXTURE_FORMAT_UNIFIE: The texture format is the same as returned by XRVRS.make_vrs_texture().
m.XRInterface.ar_is_anchor_detection_enabl: On an AR interface, true if anchor detection is enabled.
m.XRInterface.environment_blend_mode: Specify how XR should blend in the environment. This is specific to certain AR and passthrough devices where camera images are blended in by the XR compositor.
m.XRInterface.get_camera_feed_id: If this is an AR interface that requires displaying a camera feed as the background, this method returns the feed ID in the CameraServer for this interface.
m.XRInterface.get_capabilities: Returns a combination of Capabilities flags providing information about the capabilities of this interface.
m.XRInterface.get_name: Returns the name of this interface ("OpenXR", "OpenVR", "OpenHMD", "ARKit", etc.).
m.XRInterface.get_play_area: Returns an array of vectors that represent the physical play area mapped to the virtual space around the XROrigin3D point. The points form a convex polygon that can be used to react to or visualize the play area. This returns an empty array if this feature is not supported or if the information is not yet available.
m.XRInterface.get_projection_for_view: Returns the projection matrix for a view/eye.
m.XRInterface.get_render_target_size: Returns the resolution at which we should render our intermediate results before things like lens distortion are applied by the VR platform.
m.XRInterface.get_supported_environment_bl: Returns the an array of supported environment blend modes, see EnvironmentBlendMode.
m.XRInterface.get_system_info: Returns a Dictionary with extra system info. Interfaces are expected to return XRRuntimeName and XRRuntimeVersion providing info about the used XR runtime. Additional entries may be provided specific to an interface.
m.XRInterface.get_tracking_status: If supported, returns the status of our tracking. This will allow you to provide feedback to the user whether there are issues with positional tracking.
m.XRInterface.get_transform_for_view: Returns the transform for a view/eye.
m.XRInterface.get_view_count: Returns the number of views that need to be rendered for this device. 1 for Monoscopic, 2 for Stereoscopic.
m.XRInterface.initialize: Call this to initialize this interface. The first interface that is initialized is identified as the primary interface and it will be used for rendering output.
m.XRInterface.interface_is_primary: true if this is the primary interface.
m.XRInterface.is_initialized: Returns true if this interface has been initialized.
m.XRInterface.is_passthrough_enabled: Deprecated: Check if environment_blend_mode is XR_ENV_BLEND_MODE_ALPHA_BLEND, instead.
m.XRInterface.is_passthrough_supported: Deprecated: Check that XR_ENV_BLEND_MODE_ALPHA_BLEND is supported using get_supported_environment_blend_modes(), instead.
m.XRInterface.play_area_changed: Emitted when the play area is changed. This can be a result of the player resetting the boundary or entering a new play area, the player changing the play area mode, the world scale changing or the player resetting their headset orientation.
m.XRInterface.set_environment_blend_mode: Sets the active environment blend mode.
m.XRInterface.set_play_area_mode: Sets the active play area mode, will return false if the mode can't be used with this interface.
m.XRInterface.start_passthrough: Deprecated: Set the environment_blend_mode to XR_ENV_BLEND_MODE_ALPHA_BLEND, instead.
m.XRInterface.stop_passthrough: Deprecated: Set the environment_blend_mode to XR_ENV_BLEND_MODE_OPAQUE, instead.
m.XRInterface.supports_play_area_mode: Call this to find out if a given play area mode is supported by this interface.
m.XRInterface.trigger_haptic_pulse: Triggers a haptic pulse on a device associated with this interface.
m.XRInterface.xr_play_area_mode: The play area mode for this interface.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._end_frame: Called if interface is active and queues have been submitted.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._get_anchor_detecti: Return true if anchor detection is enabled for this interface.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._get_camera_feed_id: Returns the camera feed ID for the CameraFeed registered with the CameraServer that should be presented as the background on an AR capable device (if applicable).
m.XRInterfaceExtension._get_camera_transfo: Returns the Transform3D that positions the XRCamera3D in the world.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._get_capabilities: Returns the capabilities of this interface.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._get_color_texture: Return color texture into which to render (if applicable).
m.XRInterfaceExtension._get_depth_texture: Return depth texture into which to render (if applicable).
m.XRInterfaceExtension._get_name: Returns the name of this interface.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._get_play_area: Returns a PackedVector3Array that represents the play areas boundaries (if applicable).
m.XRInterfaceExtension._get_play_area_mode: Returns the play area mode that sets up our play area.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._get_projection_for: Returns the projection matrix for the given view as a PackedFloat64Array.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._get_render_target_: Returns the size of our render target for this interface, this overrides the size of the Viewport marked as the xr viewport.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._get_suggested_pose: Returns a PackedStringArray with pose names configured by this interface. Note that user configuration can override this list.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._get_suggested_trac: Returns a PackedStringArray with tracker names configured by this interface. Note that user configuration can override this list.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._get_system_info: Returns a Dictionary with system information related to this interface.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._get_tracking_statu: Returns the current status of our tracking.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._get_transform_for_: Returns a Transform3D for a given view.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._get_velocity_textu: Return velocity texture into which to render (if applicable).
m.XRInterfaceExtension._get_view_count: Returns the number of views this interface requires, 1 for mono, 2 for stereoscopic.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._get_vrs_texture: There is currently no description for this method. Please help us by contributing one [https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/documentation/class_reference.html]!
m.XRInterfaceExtension._get_vrs_texture_fo: Returns the format of the texture returned by _get_vrs_texture().
m.XRInterfaceExtension._initialize: Initializes the interface, returns true on success.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._is_initialized: Returns true if this interface has been initialized.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._post_draw_viewport: Called after the XR Viewport draw logic has completed.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._pre_draw_viewport: Called if this is our primary XRInterfaceExtension before we start processing a Viewport for every active XR Viewport, returns true if that viewport should be rendered. An XR interface may return false if the user has taken off their headset and we can pause rendering.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._pre_render: Called if this XRInterfaceExtension is active before rendering starts. Most XR interfaces will sync tracking at this point in time.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._process: Called if this XRInterfaceExtension is active before our physics and game process is called. Most XR interfaces will update its XRPositionalTrackers at this point in time.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._set_anchor_detecti: Enables anchor detection on this interface if supported.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._set_play_area_mode: Set the play area mode for this interface.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._supports_play_area: Returns true if this interface supports this play area mode.
m.XRInterfaceExtension._trigger_haptic_pul: Triggers a haptic pulse to be emitted on the specified tracker.
m.XRInterfaceExtension.add_blit: Blits our render results to screen optionally applying lens distortion. This can only be called while processing _commit_views.
m.XRInterfaceExtension.get_color_texture: There is currently no description for this method. Please help us by contributing one [https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/documentation/class_reference.html]!
m.XRInterfaceExtension.get_depth_texture: There is currently no description for this method. Please help us by contributing one [https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/documentation/class_reference.html]!
m.XRInterfaceExtension.get_render_target_t: Returns a valid RID for a texture to which we should render the current frame if supported by the interface.
m.XRInterfaceExtension.get_velocity_textur: There is currently no description for this method. Please help us by contributing one [https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/documentation/class_reference.html]!
m.XRNode3D.get_has_tracking_data: Returns true if the tracker has current tracking data for the pose being tracked.
m.XRNode3D.get_is_active: Returns true if the tracker has been registered and the pose is being tracked.
m.XRNode3D.get_pose: Returns the XRPose containing the current state of the pose being tracked. This gives access to additional properties of this pose.
m.XRNode3D.pose: The name of the pose we're bound to. Which poses a tracker supports is not known during design time.
m.XRNode3D.show_when_tracked: Enables showing the node when tracking starts, and hiding the node when tracking is lost.
m.XRNode3D.tracker: The name of the tracker we're bound to. Which trackers are available is not known during design time.
m.XRNode3D.tracking_changed: Emitted when the tracker starts or stops receiving updated tracking data for the pose being tracked. The tracking argument indicates whether the tracker is getting updated tracking data.
m.XRNode3D.trigger_haptic_pulse: Triggers a haptic pulse on a device associated with this interface.
m.XROrigin3D.current: If true, this origin node is currently being used by the XRServer. Only one origin point can be used at a time.
m.XROrigin3D.world_scale: The scale of the game world compared to the real world. This is the same as XRServer.world_scale. By default, most AR/VR platforms assume that 1 game unit corresponds to 1 real world meter.
m.XRPose.XR_TRACKING_CONFIDENCE_HIGH: Tracking information is considered accurate and up to date.
m.XRPose.XR_TRACKING_CONFIDENCE_LOW: Tracking information may be inaccurate or estimated. For example, with inside out tracking this would indicate a controller may be (partially) obscured.
m.XRPose.XR_TRACKING_CONFIDENCE_NONE: No tracking information is available for this pose.
m.XRPose.angular_velocity: The angular velocity for this pose.
m.XRPose.get_adjusted_transform: Returns the transform with world scale and our reference frame applied. This is the transform used to position XRNode3D objects.
m.XRPose.has_tracking_data: If true our tracking data is up to date. If false we're no longer receiving new tracking data and our state is whatever that last valid state was.
m.XRPose.linear_velocity: The linear velocity of this pose.
m.XRPose.name: The name of this pose. Usually, this name is derived from an action map set up by the user. Godot also suggests some pose names that XRInterface objects are expected to implement:
m.XRPose.tracking_confidence: The tracking confidence for this pose, provides insight on how accurate the spatial positioning of this record is.
m.XRPose.transform: The transform containing the original and transform as reported by the XR runtime.
m.XRPositionalTracker.TRACKER_HAND_LEFT: This tracker is the left hand controller.
m.XRPositionalTracker.TRACKER_HAND_MAX: Represents the size of the TrackerHand enum.
m.XRPositionalTracker.TRACKER_HAND_RIGHT: This tracker is the right hand controller.
m.XRPositionalTracker.TRACKER_HAND_UNKNOWN: The hand this tracker is held in is unknown or not applicable.
m.XRPositionalTracker.button_pressed: Emitted when a button on this tracker is pressed. Note that many XR runtimes allow other inputs to be mapped to buttons.
m.XRPositionalTracker.button_released: Emitted when a button on this tracker is released.
m.XRPositionalTracker.get_pose: Returns the current XRPose state object for the bound name pose.
m.XRPositionalTracker.hand: Defines which hand this tracker relates to.
m.XRPositionalTracker.has_pose: Returns true if the tracker is available and is currently tracking the bound name pose.
m.XRPositionalTracker.input_float_changed: Emitted when a trigger or similar input on this tracker changes value.
m.XRPositionalTracker.input_vector2_change: Emitted when a thumbstick or thumbpad on this tracker moves.
m.XRPositionalTracker.invalidate_pose: Marks this pose as invalid, we don't clear the last reported state but it allows users to decide if trackers need to be hidden if we lose tracking or just remain at their last known position.
m.XRPositionalTracker.pose_changed: Emitted when the state of a pose tracked by this tracker changes.
m.XRPositionalTracker.pose_lost_tracking: Emitted when a pose tracked by this tracker stops getting updated tracking data.
m.XRPositionalTracker.profile: The profile associated with this tracker, interface dependent but will indicate the type of controller being tracked.
m.XRPositionalTracker.profile_changed: Emitted when the profile of our tracker changes.
m.XRPositionalTracker.set_pose: Sets the transform, linear velocity, angular velocity and tracking confidence for the given pose. This method is called by an XRInterface implementation and should not be used directly.
m.XRServer.DONT_RESET_ROTATION: Does not reset the orientation of the HMD, only the position of the player gets centered.
m.XRServer.RESET_BUT_KEEP_TILT: Resets the orientation but keeps the tilt of the device. So if we're looking down, we keep looking down but heading will be reset.
m.XRServer.RESET_FULL_ROTATION: Fully reset the orientation of the HMD. Regardless of what direction the user is looking to in the real world. The user will look dead ahead in the virtual world.
m.XRServer.TRACKER_ANCHOR: The tracker tracks the location and size of an AR anchor.
m.XRServer.TRACKER_ANY: Used internally to select all trackers.
m.XRServer.TRACKER_ANY_KNOWN: Used internally to filter trackers of any known type.
m.XRServer.TRACKER_BASESTATION: The tracker tracks the location of a base station.
m.XRServer.TRACKER_BODY: The tracker tracks the location and joints of a body.
m.XRServer.TRACKER_CONTROLLER: The tracker tracks the location of a controller.
m.XRServer.TRACKER_FACE: The tracker tracks the expressions of a face.
m.XRServer.TRACKER_HAND: The tracker tracks the location and joints of a hand.
m.XRServer.TRACKER_HEAD: The tracker tracks the location of the player's head. This is usually a location centered between the player's eyes. Note that for handheld AR devices this can be the current location of the device.
m.XRServer.TRACKER_UNKNOWN: Used internally if we haven't set the tracker type yet.
m.XRServer.add_tracker: Registers a new XRTracker that tracks a physical object.
m.XRServer.camera_locked_to_origin: If set to true, the scene will be rendered as if the camera is locked to the XROrigin3D.
m.XRServer.center_on_hmd: This is an important function to understand correctly. AR and VR platforms all handle positioning slightly differently.
m.XRServer.clear_reference_frame: Clears the reference frame that was set by previous calls to center_on_hmd().
m.XRServer.find_interface: Finds an interface by its name. For example, if your project uses capabilities of an AR/VR platform, you can find the interface for that platform by name and initialize it.
m.XRServer.get_interface: Returns the interface registered at the given idx index in the list of interfaces.
m.XRServer.get_interface_count: Returns the number of interfaces currently registered with the AR/VR server. If your project supports multiple AR/VR platforms, you can look through the available interface, and either present the user with a selection or simply try to initialize each interface and use the first one that returns true.
m.XRServer.get_interfaces: Returns a list of available interfaces the ID and name of each interface.
m.XRServer.get_reference_frame: Returns the reference frame transform. Mostly used internally and exposed for GDExtension build interfaces.
m.XRServer.get_tracker: Returns the positional tracker with the given tracker_name.
m.XRServer.get_trackers: Returns a dictionary of trackers for tracker_types.
m.XRServer.interface_added: Emitted when a new interface has been added.
m.XRServer.interface_removed: Emitted when an interface is removed.
m.XRServer.primary_interface: The primary XRInterface currently bound to the XRServer.
m.XRServer.reference_frame_changed: Emitted when the reference frame transform changes.
m.XRServer.tracker_added: Emitted when a new tracker has been added. If you don't use a fixed number of controllers or if you're using XRAnchor3Ds for an AR solution, it is important to react to this signal to add the appropriate XRController3D or XRAnchor3D nodes related to this new tracker.
m.XRServer.tracker_removed: Emitted when a tracker is removed. You should remove any XRController3D or XRAnchor3D points if applicable. This is not mandatory, the nodes simply become inactive and will be made active again when a new tracker becomes available (i.e. a new controller is switched on that takes the place of the previous one).
m.XRServer.tracker_updated: Emitted when an existing tracker has been updated. This can happen if the user switches controllers.
m.XRServer.world_origin: The current origin of our tracking space in the virtual world. This is used by the renderer to properly position the camera with new tracking data.
m.XRServer.world_origin_changed: Emitted when the world origin transform changes.
m.XRServer.world_scale: The scale of the game world compared to the real world. By default, most AR/VR platforms assume that 1 game unit corresponds to 1 real world meter.
m.XRTracker.name: The unique name of this tracker. The trackers that are available differ between various XR runtimes and can often be configured by the user. Godot maintains a number of reserved names that it expects the XRInterface to implement if applicable:
m.XRVRS.make_vrs_texture: Generates the VRS texture based on a render target_size adjusted by our VRS tile size. For each eyes focal point passed in eye_foci a layer is created. Focal point should be in NDC.
m.XRVRS.vrs_min_radius: The minimum radius around the focal point where full quality is guaranteed if VRS is used as a percentage of screen size.
m.XRVRS.vrs_render_region: The render region that the VRS texture will be scaled to when generated.
m.XRVRS.vrs_strength: The strength used to calculate the VRS density map. The greater this value, the more noticeable VRS is.
m.ZIPPacker.APPEND_ADDINZIP: Add new files to the existing zip archive at the given path.
m.ZIPPacker.APPEND_CREATE: Create a new zip archive at the given path.
m.ZIPPacker.APPEND_CREATEAFTER: Append a new zip archive to the end of the already existing file at the given path.
m.ZIPPacker.COMPRESSION_BEST: Start a file with the best Deflate compression level (9). This is slow to compress, but results in smaller file sizes than COMPRESSION_DEFAULT. Decompression speed is generally unaffected by the chosen compression level.
m.ZIPPacker.COMPRESSION_DEFAULT: Start a file with the default Deflate compression level (6). This is a good compromise between speed and file size.
m.ZIPPacker.COMPRESSION_FAST: Start a file with the fastest Deflate compression level (1). This is fast to compress, but results in larger file sizes than COMPRESSION_DEFAULT. Decompression speed is generally unaffected by the chosen compression level.
m.ZIPPacker.COMPRESSION_NONE: Start a file with no compression. This is also known as the "Store" compression mode and is the fastest method of packing files inside a ZIP archive. Consider using this mode for files that are already compressed (such as JPEG, PNG, MP3, or Ogg Vorbis files).
m.ZIPPacker.add_directory: Adds directory to the archive. If modified_time is set to 0, current system time is used.
m.ZIPPacker.close: Closes the underlying resources used by this instance.
m.ZIPPacker.close_file: Stops writing to a file within the archive.
m.ZIPPacker.compression_level: The compression level used when start_file() is called. Use CompressionLevel as a reference.
m.ZIPPacker.open: Opens a zip file for writing at the given path using the specified write mode.
m.ZIPPacker.start_file: Starts writing to a file within the archive. Only one file can be written at the same time. If modified_time is set to 0, current system time is used.
m.ZIPPacker.write_file: Write the given data to the file.
m.ZIPReader.close: Closes the underlying resources used by this instance.
m.ZIPReader.file_exists: Returns true if the file exists in the loaded zip archive.
m.ZIPReader.get_compression_level: Returns the compression level of the file in the loaded zip archive. Returns -1 if the file doesn't exist or any other error occurs. Must be called after open().
m.ZIPReader.get_files: Returns the list of names of all files in the loaded archive.
m.ZIPReader.open: Opens the zip archive at the given path and reads its file index.
m.ZIPReader.read_file: Loads the whole content of a file in the loaded zip archive into memory and returns it.
